Each ran a 15-task smoke suite calibrated so that healthy artifacts pass while a known-broken one fails; suspects then faced full 164-task evaluation, a second inference backend, an independent distributor's conversion of the same model and quantization as referee, and, for community files, re-testing under the artifact's own template. The official library carries five silently defective artifacts, a batch of four Qwen2.5-Coder-3B conversions and one phi3.5-mini conversion, that solve zero of 164 tasks and zero of the smoke suite on both backends while independent conversions of the same models work: 1.6% of official artifacts, 2 of 29 model-and-size conversion groups. The adjudication chain cleared small-model artifacts that a naive threshold would condemn as broken when they are merely collapsed by extreme quantization, and it exposed two older community conversions that degrade badly on CUDA yet pass on Metal: not defective files but backend-dependent failures, a third phenomenon no registry currently tests for. Two confirmed defects produce output whose surface statistics sit inside the healthy range, invisible to any low-noise heuristic short of execution. We release the audit dataset, the quantcheck acceptance-testing tool, and disclosure reports for every confirmed defect ( this https URL ), and argue that model registries need the acceptance gate that package registries already run.

</details>


### [179] [VibeCheck: Assessing the Quality of LLM-Generated Unit Tests: A Multi-agent Empirical Study across Heterogeneous Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05978)
*Anika Tabassum,Mushahid Intesum,Md. Fahim Arefin,Tarannum Shaila Zaman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VibeCheck是一个针对LLM驱动的IDE智能体生成单元测试质量的评估框架，基于15个学生开发的Python和JavaScript/TypeScript仓库，对Kiro、Antigravity、Cursor（均使用Claude Sonnet 4.5）和独立CS-4.5基线进行五维度（可运行性、断言强度、逻辑与边界覆盖、隔离性与确定性、可维护性）评分与留一交叉智能体同行评审。研究发现存在显著的"执行-充分性鸿沟"：生成的测试通常可运行，但断言薄弱、边界用例缺失；Kiro在项目级表现最优，而CS-4.5基线在测试密度和可维护性上领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成单元测试的评估多依赖执行成功率或代码覆盖率，但这些指标无法捕捉断言质量、边界覆盖、隔离性和可维护性等深层质量问题。此外，不同IDE在同一底层模型下因上下文处理方式不同而产生差异，这方面的研究也较少。

Method: 构建15个学生开发的多语言异构仓库基准；使用统一的零样本、仅仓库提示词由Kiro、Antigravity、Cursor和独立CS-4.5逐文件生成测试；作者独立构建开发者期望行为的"义务清单"作为行为覆盖真值；采用留一法让其余三个智能体对每个生成的测试套件进行同行评审，按五维评分（含诊断信号如阻塞错误、flakiness风险、弱断言、缺失行为用例）输出JSON报告；按公式聚合评审分数并做项目级排名与宏观统计。

Result: Kiro在15个项目中10次排名第一，整体领先；CS-4.5产生最密集的测试套件（2848个用例）但文件数较少；可运行性方面所有工具差异较小（R1约3.4–4.4），但断言强度（R2）和边界覆盖（R3）普遍偏低，缺失行为用例在所有模型中最常见（>82%），可维护性（R5）上CS-4.5反超所有IDE；评估者间一致性为正但不一致，Cursor与CS-4.5相关性最高；评估者置信度与质量的Pearson相关性仅0.21（p=0.11），不能作为充分代理。

Conclusion: LLM生成的单元测试在仅仓库、零样本条件下存在系统性的"可运行但浅薄"问题；仅靠执行成功和覆盖率不足以评判质量，需要结合结构化的充分性评估与诊断失败分析。VibeCheck提供了一个可复现的评估框架，并附带公开的提示词与评分脚本，便于团队集成到DevOps/PromptOps流程中。

Abstract: LLM-based IDE agents are increasingly used to generate repository-grounded unit tests, yet common evaluations often rely on execution success or coverage. These metrics can miss deeper quality issues such as weak assertions, missing edge cases, poor isolation, and limited maintainability. This paper presents VibeCheck, an empirical study of unit test generation across 15 student-developed Python and JavaScript/TypeScript repositories. We evaluate Kiro, Antigravity, and Cursor with Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the underlying agent, under repository-only, zero-shot conditions using a five-dimensional rubric covering runnability, assertion strength, logic and edge-case coverage, isolation/determinism, and maintainability. We also apply leave-one-out cross-agent peer evaluation to compare tools and identify failure patterns. Results show a clear execution-adequacy gap: generated tests are often runnable but frequently lack strong assertions and meaningful behavioral coverage. Weak assertions and missing edge cases occur more often than blocking failures, showing that runnable tests can still be shallow. VibeCheck provides a reliability-oriented framework for evaluating LLM-generated tests beyond pass/fail outcomes.

</details>


### [180] [Replications, Revisions, and Reanalyses: Managing Empirical Evidence in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05983)
*Julian Frattini,Jannik Fischbach,Davide Fucci,Michael Unterkalmsteiner,Daniel Mendez,Robert Feldt,Richard Torkar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对软件工程（SE）领域研究综合（research synthesis）实践不足的问题，提出一个基于方法工程（method engineering）的概念框架，用于系统化管理经验性、定量证据的演化，以构建比单项研究更具效度的方差理论（variance theory）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程领域的研究综合实践稀缺且多局限于叙述性综合，甚至元分析也仅在合成精确重复时可靠，无法从变异中泛化。现有综合方法难以处理复杂因果关系、矛盾结论及统计分析假设违背问题，导致方差理论可能无效甚至误导实践者决策。

Method: 采用方法工程（method assembly）方法，从已验证的方法片段组装概念框架：(1) 将证据形式化定义为三元组 E(h, d, m)，即假设、数据集、分析方法；(2) 定义证据间三种关系——复制（replication，同假设同方法换数据）、修订（revision，同数据同方法换假设）、再分析（reanalysis，同假设同数据换方法）；(3) 通过因果DAG图建模假设的复杂变量关系，并区分修订目的（提高精度 vs. 去混杂）采用不同评估方法（预测能力 vs. 条件独立性检验）；(4) 构建证据演化图（EEG）追踪研究前沿。

Result: 框架将三种证据演化类型与三类效度对应：复制提升外部效度，修订提升内部效度，再分析提升结论效度。构造效度因缺乏可靠方法片段而未纳入。框架提供了清晰的判定标准（条件独立性、信息准则如AIC、统计假设检验）来比较证据，并能够识别研究演化中的"死胡同"。通过两个应用案例（测试覆盖率对测试套件有效性的影响、被动语态对领域模型完整性的影响）展示了框架的实用性，同时揭示了已有研究中修订与再分析混淆的问题。

Conclusion: 该框架为软件工程经验性研究提供了系统演化证据的视角，可指导研究者更连贯、协作地推进研究议程，支持知识生成、综合与应用的全过程。未来工作包括开发在线平台托管EEG、实现自动合成，类似于GitHub式的分布式版本控制，使研究综合从静态偶发转向动态持续，从而推动领域超越孤立单点研究，迈向更具建设性和可靠性的研究成果。

Abstract: One aspired outcome of empirical research on quantitative data is a variance theory, i.e., a quantification of the effect of an independent on a dependent variables. The validity of variance theories stems from the synthesis of multiple pieces of evidence, which increases its validity beyond the findings of a single study. However, research synthesis in SE is rare and if done mostly limited to purely narrative syntheses. At best, researchers perform meta-analyses to synthesize variance theories from several quantitative results. But even meta-analyses only produce reliable results when synthesizing exact replications yet fail to generalize from variations. We aim to extend the frontier of research synthesis beyond the state-of-the-art to systematically manage empirical evidence and its evolution. We apply method engineering to construct a framework for research synthesis from proven, individual method fragments. The framework allows researchers to put new evidence in a clear relation to an existing body of evidence and systematically expand knowledge about a studied phenomenon. We demonstrate the application of this framework to two fields of research by explicitly modeling the relationship between existing pieces of evidence. The framework puts three types of evolution of evidence into relation: (1) replications investigate the same hypothesis in a new context to improve external validity, (2) revisions challenge an existing hypothesis to improve internal validity, and (3) reanalyses replace analysis methods to improve conclusion validity. Through a systematic evolution of evidence and clear assessment criteria for each dimension of validity, the proposed framework can determine the frontier of a field of research. The framework provides a perspective to systematically evolve empirical evidence in SE, supporting more constructive and productive advances in our field.

</details>


### [181] [SemVul: Semantic-Enhanced Graph Neural Networks for Code Property Graph-based Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06035)
*Younas Affan,Leonardo Regano,Giorgio Giacinto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SemVul提出了一种基于代码属性图(CPG)与预训练代码语义嵌入相结合的漏洞检测流水线，通过融合结构与语义信息，在四个基准数据集上实现了一致且具有竞争力的漏洞检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有漏洞检测方法存在三类主要不足：基于token的序列模型忽略程序结构且泛化能力差；纯图结构模型缺乏语义理解能力；大语言模型对变量重命名等简单修改过于脆弱。研究旨在通过统一结构流与语义含义来提升检测的泛化性与准确性。

Method: 1) 使用Joern将源代码解析为代码属性图(CPG)，统一AST、CFG、DFG；2) 在节点级别，将节点类型one-hot编码与通过预训练代码模型(CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT、UniXcoder、CodeT5+等)或Word2Vec获得的语义嵌入进行拼接；3) 采用边类型感知的GNN架构(GGNN、RGAT、HGT、MultiView、Call-Aware等)进行关系感知消息传递；4) 使用多统计图池化(均值+最大值+标准差)进行图级聚合；5) 通过两层MLP分类器进行二分类。

Result: 在四个数据集上：Devign上66.01 F1（结构基线51.37，提升+14.64）；Draper上53.65 F1（超越RNN基线0.45，SOTA）；Reveal上48.60 F1（超越VulBERTa 3.33）；PrimeVul上23.52 F1（超越微调代码LM基线2.09-5.47）。边类型感知架构在多个数据集上一致优于边无关基线。GraphCodeBERT为最佳嵌入。结构表示在平衡数据集上仅达51.37 F1，证明语义补充的必要性。跨数据集迁移存在14-37 F1下降，MultiView GGNN迁移保留率最佳(78.5%)。浅层网络(2层)优于深层网络。CPG生成时间近似T≈3.78s+0.284ms×V，呈亚线性增长。

Conclusion: SemVul验证了有效漏洞检测需要同时具备CPG拓扑提供的结构理解与预训练嵌入提供的语义理解。结构信息单独使用仅产生近似随机水平的预测，语义增强带来+10至+25 F1的稳定提升。跨数据集的一致性表现证明了方法的可泛化性。该可复现流水线为未来跨语言迁移、跨过程分析及真实部署研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Vulnerabilities in source code are often the root cause of cyberattacks worldwide, as attackers exploit weaknesses in software to gain unauthorized access, steal data, or disrupt services. In this study, we evaluated existing research approaches and propose SemVul, a vulnerability detection pipeline that demonstrates better generalization and higher accuracy in learning vulnerable code patterns. We propose a Code Property Graph-based vulnerability-detection approach combined with semantic-level enhancement, enabling the model to capture both the program's structural flow and the semantic meaning of the code. Our approach integrates both node-level and edge-level semantic embeddings using pre-trained code embedding techniques. We systematically evaluate multiple GNN architectures on publicly available benchmark datasets. SemVul is generic with respect to the programming language and supports multiple architectures. By integrating structural and semantic information, the proposed approach improves vulnerability detection performance. Our results show that SemVul outperforms existing approaches and provides better generalization.

</details>


### [182] [SpecCoder: Specification-Aware Code Generation with Curriculum Dual-Task Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06041)
*Yixuan Li,Mingxuan Huang,Jiajing Wang,Weidong Yang,Xinyi Liu,Ben Fei,Lipeng Ma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SpecCoder提出了一种面向代码生成的"规范感知"两阶段训练框架，通过在原始需求与代码之间引入结构化规范分析作为中间表示，结合规范引导的SFT与课程式双任务GRPO（同时优化规范引导的代码生成与实现判别），在APPS、CodeContests、xCodeEval等基准上显著提升独立代码生成及智能体工作流的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法在处理富含自然语言需求（如目标、I/O格式、约束、边界条件、隐含假设）的复杂编程任务时存在两大问题：一是缺乏对从原始需求到结构化规范分析这一中间映射的显式监督，导致关键约束易被遗漏；二是即使生成了规范分析，其与最终代码行为之间的一致性也难以保证。训练免方法依赖提示或多轮智能体工作流，成本高且未优化模型内在能力；训练方法多仅基于执行反馈优化最终输出，奖励信号稀疏且不涉及规范层面的对齐。

Method: 两阶段框架：（1）数据构建——利用GPT-4o多路径生成七维结构化规范分析（问题背景、功能需求、输入/输出需求、测试用例、外部依赖、附加说明），并通过前向执行验证与DeepSeek-V3-0324的后向语义验证（语义完整性、算法可追溯性、表达清晰度）筛选高质量三元组（p, s, c），同时基于Qwen2.5-Coder-32B采样候选实现并按测试通过率差距构造判别样本，按难度（Easy/Medium/Hard）标注。（2）规范引导SFT——采用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B-Coder-Instruct，使模型学会先输出<ANALYZE>结构化规范再输出<CODE>代码的格式。（3）课程式双任务GRPO——三阶段课程（Easy→Medium+Hard→全量混合）联合优化规范引导生成任务（奖励=格式+编译+执行正确性，按难度采用不同正确性奖励函数）和规范引导判别任务（奖励=格式+从两个候选中选出测试通过率更高者），任务内分组归一化优势，并设置方差下限防止数值不稳定。推理时模型先生成结构化规范分析，再以此指导代码生成。

Result: 独立生成：APPS上Pass@1=0.186/AvgPassRatio=0.346，CodeContests上0.091/0.207，OOD xCodeEval上0.147/0.324，均达到或超越最佳基线（CodePRM、FixAudit、μFiX等）。智能体骨干：将SpecCoder替换AgentCoder/MetaGPT/PairCoder/Specine的基座后，5轮迭代下所有框架在ID与OOD基准上一致提升，Pass@1最高提升11.3个百分点，AvgPassRatio最高提升13.2个百分点。消融：SFT、GRPO、判别任务、课程学习、联合优化均贡献不可或缺；结构化规范优于Code-Only、Free-Form、Planning-CoT等中间表示。人类评估：规范需求覆盖率4.55、规范-代码一致性4.48（5分制），显著优于Free-Form与Planning-CoT。扰动实验：移除/打乱/损坏规范均显著降低生成与判别性能，表明模型确实依赖规范语义。现实基准：BigCodeBench-Hard 0.34、ClassEval函数级0.692、类级0.230，均为最优。

Conclusion: SpecCoder通过引入结构化规范分析作为需求与代码之间的显式中间表示，并结合规范引导SFT与课程式双任务GRPO，有效提升了大语言模型在复杂编程任务上的代码生成质量及与需求的语义对齐程度。其增益在独立生成、智能体工作流、不同难度任务、OOD场景以及现实编程基准上均得到验证，结构化规范相较CoT等中间表示具有明确优势，且模型确实在推理时依赖规范语义而非仅利用格式。然而方法依赖闭源教师模型（GPT-4o、DeepSeek-V3）构建数据，且以执行通过率作为奖励信号存在局限，未来可探索自博弈、弱到强泛化以及结合静态分析与过程奖励模型的多维规范反馈。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in code generation but still struggle with challenging programming tasks that require understanding rich natural language requirements. These requirements often specify problem goals, input/output formats, constraints, examples, and edge cases. Overlooking even one may produce executable but functionally incorrect code. Existing training-free methods mainly rely on prompting or agent-based workflows, while training-based methods typically optimize final code outputs. However, existing approaches provide limited supervision for learning the intermediate mapping from raw requirements to structured specifications and for grounding them in concrete implementation behavior. Consequently, models may omit critical constraints, and even when an explicit specification is produced, the implementation may fail to reflect it consistently. Motivated by this gap, we propose SpecCoder, a specification-aware two-stage training framework for code generation. SpecCoder first employs specification-guided SFT to train LLMs to derive structured specification analyses and generate code conditioned on them. It then introduces curriculum dual-task GRPO, which jointly optimizes specification-guided generation and discrimination to encourage stronger correspondence between specifications and code behavior. Experiments on APPS, CodeContests, and xCodeEval demonstrate the effectiveness of specification-aware training, with SpecCoder consistently improving both standalone code generation and agent-based workflows. Additional evaluations on BigCodeBench-Hard and ClassEval, alongside human evaluation and perturbation studies, further validate the role of structured specifications in guiding code generation and discrimination.

</details>


### [183] [Beyond Lexical Metrics: Sentence-Embedding Detection of Reviewer Habituation in AI Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06213)
*Haoran Yu,Lifei Liu,Danping Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了人类审核者在反复审查AI代理（如GitHub Copilot、Devin等）生成的代码时是否会出现"橡皮图章"式的习惯化效应，发现行为层面（批准率上升）确实存在，但传统词汇指标无法检测语言层面的退化；只有句子嵌入几何能捕捉到个体审核者的风格漂移，且因果方向主要是"行为驱动语言"而非相反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI编程代理大规模提交PR，核心问题是：审核者是否会因反复接触而降低审查严谨度（即"橡皮图章"效应）？更关键的是，这种习惯化是否能在审核评论的文本中提前检测出来，从而作为早期预警信号？这对于AI生成代码的质量把关具有重要意义。

Method: 基于AIDev语料库，筛选400位重复审核者（各审查≥10个代理PR），共11,429次审查和10,104条人工内联评论。研究包含四个层面：(1)行为分析：计算每位审核者前后期的批准率差值；(2)手工语言特征：提取MTLD词汇多样性、Shannon熵、技术特异性、建设性可操作性四个指标，在经验十分位上检验单调下降趋势；(3)嵌入表示分析：使用all-MiniLM-L6-v2对评论编码，在384维空间中检测每位审核者前期vs后期质心的漂移（与自身随机置换零假设对比）；(4)Granger因果检验：在50个经验百分位bin上检验批准率与语言信号的双向因果方向，滞后1-4期；(6)习惯化阶段分类器：用5条评论滑动窗口预测是否属于该审核者的"后期"，对比逻辑回归和小型MLP在手工特征、嵌入统计量及联合特征上的5折审核者分层交叉验证表现。

Result: 关键发现呈"四象限"格局：RQ1成立——批准率从30.5%升至36.6%（Wilcoxon p=8.6×10⁻⁸，Cohen's d=0.25），173位重审核者的十分位分析显示+14.9pp的单调线性梯度（R²=0.47），PELT模型不支持相变式跃迁。RQ2不成立——四个手工语言指标在十分位上均无单调下降（Spearman |ρ|≤0.53，p≥0.11；Bonferroni校正后Mann-Whitney p≥0.36），在≥15词子集和四分位长度带[6,22]的鲁棒性检验中同样平坦。RQ3反向——批准率变化在所有滞后（1-4）上Granger预测后续技术特异性变化（p<10⁻³），反向仅在一个滞后显著（p=0.036，Bonferroni校正后不存活）。RQ4成立但有限——嵌入统计量的MLP达到F1=0.74（平衡准确率0.63），而手工特征逻辑回归仅F1=0.485（低于多数类基线）；联合特征反而退化至F1=0.67。人口级嵌入探针（到D1质心的余弦距离、PCA漂移）基本平坦，但每位审核者后期质心距其前期质心的余弦距离（0.444）显著大于自身随机置换零假设（0.330，配对Wilcoxon p<10⁻³，n=342），k-means主题簇分布在十分位间显著变化（χ²=135.3，p=3.3×10⁻⁷）。跨代理和日历控制分析排除了"全局宽松化"混淆。

Conclusion: 论文给出三点核心纠正：(1)审核者习惯化是真实的，但仅表现为批准行为的变化，而非经典词汇指标可检测的语言退化；(2)因果方向主要是行为驱动语言，而非文献中流行的"语言先行"框架——Granger检验在控制信号灵敏度不对称后显示主导方向为AR→tech-spec；(3)检测应转向句子嵌入几何的个体级质心漂移，而非聚合级词汇统计。研究对习惯化监测工具和NLP特征选择均有实践意义：MTLD等技术特异性仪表板不应被期望标记习惯化，而个体嵌入质心距离是可用的廉价监督信号（F1=0.74作为下界）。局限在于：语料仅7个月公开仓库活动；使用通用MiniLM而非代码专用编码器；"后期"标签由序列位置定义而非外部验证的惯化事件；无法排除代理代码质量随时间真实改善的混杂。

Abstract: Code review is a key quality checkpoint between AI-generated code and production. As AI coding agents submit pull requests at scale, it is unclear whether reviewers reduce scrutiny with repeated exposure and whether review comments reveal this change. We study 11,429 reviews from 400 repeat reviewers over 207 days, paired with 10,104 human-authored inline comments from AIDev. Approval rates rise from 30.5% in reviewers' early periods to 36.6% in late periods (Wilcoxon p = 8.6 x 10^-8; Cohen's d = 0.25). However, four hand-crafted linguistic features - lexical diversity, Shannon entropy, technical specificity, and constructive actionability - show no monotonic decline across exposure deciles (all Spearman absolute rho <= 0.53, p >= 0.11; Bonferroni-corrected Mann-Whitney p >= 0.36). A logistic-regression classifier based on these features reaches F1 = 0.485, below the majority-class baseline. Sentence-embedding structure does carry signal: reviewers' late-period comment centroids shift farther from their early-period centroids than under within-reviewer random permutations (Wilcoxon p < 0.001), and a small MLP using three embedding statistics reaches F1 = 0.74 under 5-fold reviewer-stratified cross-validation. Granger analysis shows that approval-rate changes predict later shifts in technical specificity at all tested lags (p < 0.001), while the reverse direction is significant at only one of four lags. Reviewer adaptation is therefore detectable in latent distributional structure rather than in classical lexical metrics, and language shifts follow rather than precede changes in approval behavior.

</details>


### [184] [KG-Commit: A Dynamic Knowledge Graph for Online Just-in-Time Software Defect Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06272)
*Mohsen Hesamolhokama,Mohammad Sina Beyrami Aghbash,Behnam Rohani,Mohammadamin Fazli,Jafar Habibi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出KG-Commit，一个动态知识图谱，用于在线Just-in-Time软件缺陷预测（JIT-SDP）。它通过增量维护仓库历史、文件内代码结构和提交语义，在Neo4j中构建三层知识图谱，并采用AST-delta机制追踪代码结构变化。在11个Apache项目上的评估显示，该方法在Macro-F1、G-Mean和AUC上均优于六个基线方法，同时保持约1.33秒/次提交的稳定处理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的JIT-SDP方法主要依赖提交级别的信息（如代码差异和变更度量），忽视了更广泛的项目级上下文（如跨文件依赖、调用关系等）。虽然项目级上下文已知能提升缺陷预测性能，但在即时性约束下高效检索和维护这些上下文信息存在挑战。本文旨在解决这一矛盾：如何在保持JIT-SDP所需低延迟的同时，纳入丰富的项目级上下文。

Method: KG-Commit采用三层知识图谱结构存储在Neo4j中：（1）核心层：捕获仓库实体（提交、开发者、文件、问题）及其关系；（2）AST层：通过AST-delta机制增量维护文件内程序结构，记录节点的增加、删除、更新和移动；（3）CSTG层（提交语义-文本图）：使用TextRank、NPMI等方法表示提交消息和代码变更的语义。推理时通过commit-hub投影在加权二分图上运行五种轻量级图推理方法（RN、PPR、LP、DW、KGE），结合CSTG语义通道和TGC（遍历/全局上下文）特征，最终通过逻辑回归堆叠进行评分融合。系统采用在线评估协议，包含预热期、验证间隔（gap）和周期性重拟合机制。

Result: 在11个Apache项目（78,206次提交，29.1%缺陷率）上的评估显示：KG-Commit（配置F_ov+G+T）取得最高的聚合Macro-F1（0.704）、G-Mean（0.706）和AUC（0.809）。在Macro-F1指标上，对LR、HGB、RF和DeepJIT在全部11个项目上胜出，对LApredict在10个项目上胜出，对JITLine-online在9个项目上胜出，且配对差异在统计上显著。每提交处理时间约1.33秒，远低于实际项目中的提交间隔（中位数从1.20小时到45.55小时不等），且处理成本随图规模增长保持稳定。

Conclusion: KG-Commit证明了在在线JIT-SDP中高效维护和利用丰富项目级上下文的可行性。通过动态知识图谱和增量维护机制，结合轻量级CPU推理，可以在保持即时响应能力的同时显著提升缺陷预测性能。当前结果应被视为保守估计，因为推理通道尚未完全利用知识图谱的表达能力，未来可通过更复杂的图神经网络推理方法（如R-GCN、CompGCN、HGT）和GPU加速进一步提升性能。

Abstract: Just-in-time software defect prediction (JIT-SDP) aims to identify risky commits as they arrive and provide developers with timely feedback. This need for low latency has led most approaches to rely on commit-level information and overlook the broader project context in which a change occurs. Incorporating this context is challenging because it requires both efficient retrieval for incoming commits and continual maintenance as the repository evolves. We introduce KG-Commit, a dynamic knowledge graph that incrementally maintains repository history, within-file code structure, and commit semantics as the project evolves. It also uses an AST-delta mechanism to track structural changes between file edits and relies on lightweight graph inference running entirely on CPU. Our evaluation on 11 Apache software projects against six baselines shows that KG-Commit achieves the highest aggregate Macro-F1 (0.704), G-Mean (0.706), and AUC (0.809) using our selected inference pipeline. Under a realistic online protocol, it outperforms LR, HGB, RF, and DeepJIT on all 11 projects, LApredict on 10, and JITLine on 9 projects in Macro-F1, with the aggregate paired difference significant in every case. KG-Commit processes each commit in approximately 1.33~s, with a cost that remains stable as the graph grows and is compatible with commit rates observed in real-world projects. These findings show that rich project context can be efficiently maintained and exploited for online JIT-SDP.

</details>


### [185] [From Reading Code to Reading Spec: A Verified Layer for LLM-Driven Codebase Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06383)
*Xinhao Zhang,Jingjie Lu,Kunpeng Liu,Fei Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PROOF（Provable Representation Of Original Functionality）是一种将代码库管理从直接操作源代码迁移到基于结构化自然语言规约（Spec）的间接管理模式，通过层次化抽象与往返等价验证保障代码与规约之间的语义一致性，实现全生命周期的代码库维护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成代码的快速增长加剧了软件系统的结构复杂性与维护负担。直接由LLM管理大规模代码库受限于上下文窗口约束与跨文件全局依赖，引发上下文退化、代码幻觉与逻辑不一致等问题。因此需要一种可验证的间接表征，使开发者能在语义层而非语法层进行代码管理与维护。

Method: 方法包含三阶段闭环流程：(1) **生成阶段**：沿代码库静态层次（Project/Module/Object/Function/Segment）以六字段契约模板（Description、I/O、Meta、Dependencies、Data、Error）为每个函数/对象构造语义封闭的Spec节点，并通过确定性解析算法从Deps字段提取调用边，组装与原代码调用图同构的Spec图；(2) **验证阶段**：采用零编辑往返验证，从Spec重建代码，通过原代码测试套件的Pass率计算Fidelity（Pass(C)⊆Pass(Ĉ)的有向包含关系），并以多轮失败驱动修复逼近100%；(3) **更新阶段**：将变更请求R定位至受影响Spec节点子集N_R，经工程师审阅后在节点级别执行局部修改并通过逆映射Φ⁻¹同步至代码，并通过Δ_i = Fidelity(N_S^(i)*) − Fidelity(N_S^(i))量化语义漂移以支持校准。

Result: 在SWE-bench三个真实代码库（Flask、Seaborn、Pytest，9.5K–37K行）上的实验表明：(1) 行为等价性：PROOF在Flask和Seaborn上Pass@3达100%，Pytest达96.80%，全面优于RepoAgent、RPG-Encoder与EPAM基线；(2) 结构等价性：PROOF在Pytest上AST相似度达96.12%，Seaborn达87.32%，领先所有基线；(3) 可解释性：PROOF在忠实性、可验证性、完整性与一致性四个维度上均排名第一，Completeness上超出RepoAgent 1.1分、EPAM 2.5分；(4) 令牌效率：PROOF虽IR构造令牌较高（4.32M vs RPG-Encoder 3.32M），但因快速收敛，总重建令牌（5.49M）低于RPG-Encoder（6.12M）与EPAM（14.20M）；(5) 骨架鲁棒性：即便以最弱骨架GPT-5.5 Medium驱动（55.7%），PROOF仍显著优于最强骨架下的最佳基线（RepoAgent 29.95%），验证了方法本身的独立贡献。

Conclusion: PROOF通过将代码库管理迁移至结构化自然语言规约的代理空间，利用六字段语义封闭契约保持拓扑同构，并依托往返等价验证与漂移校准机制，在行为等价、结构保真与内容可信度上均取得领先，有效解决了LLM直接管理大规模代码库时的上下文退化与幻觉问题，为全生命周期代码库维护提供了可验证的间接表征层。

Abstract: The rapid growth of LLM-generated code increases software complexity and the maintenance burden on engineers. While LLMs offer a potential automated alternative, this structural complexity hinders their ability to manage codebases directly. We introduce the Provable Representation Of Original Functionality (PROOF), which manages codebases indirectly via structured specifications. To enable full-lifecycle codebase management strictly through these specifications, PROOF abstracts codebase topology into a hierarchical natural-language representation. To establish absolute trust, the system proves semantic equivalence by reconstructing source code exclusively from this specification. This verified foundation drives maintenance requests, executing code modifications while synchronously updating itself to prevent semantic drift. Experiments on real-world repositories confirm the effectiveness of these specifications.

</details>


### [186] [An Autonomy Aware Metamodel for Human AI Collaboration in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06720)
*Md Mahade Hasan,Md Toufique Hasan,Zheying Zhang,Kalle Kulonen,Konsta Kalliokoski,François Christophe,Tommi Mikkonen,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向AI优先软件工程团队的"自主性感知元模型"，将自主性建模为由任务、上下文和协作模式共同决定的、情境依赖的动态属性，通过七个核心构造和五个自主性级别支持人机协作中的权限再分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的方法工程方法（如SPEM 2.0、ISO/IEC 24744、SEMAT等）假设静态的、以人为中心的控制结构，无法显式建模AI时代下人机协作中动态分布的权限，导致从工具辅助工作流向AI优先SE团队过渡缺乏概念支撑和方法论指导。

Method: 提出自主性感知元模型，包含七个核心构造（Actor、Task、Capability、Artifact、CollaborationPattern、Constraint、Context），将自主性定义为 AutonomyLevel = f(Task, Context, CollaborationPattern)，并沿四个权限维度（任务执行、任务分解、任务启动、协作重构）定义五个自主性级别（AL0-AL4：PassiveTool、SuggestiveAssistant、DelegatedExecutor、ProactiveActor、AutonomousOrchestrator），通过多智能体需求分析工具进行解析实例化验证。

Result: 通过需求分析工具的实例化表明：在需求生成场景中PO代理处于AL2、Dev/QA代理处于AL1；在需求优先级排序场景中Dev/QA代理的自主性从AL1提升至AL2；证明同一SE方法结构可在不同情境下支持从人主导到AI优先的权限平滑过渡而无需改变底层过程结构。

Conclusion: 该元模型将方法结构与权限分配解耦，为建模AI优先SE团队中可治理、可适应的人机协作提供了概念基础；未来工作将围绕自主性函数语义精化、跨SE活动比较案例研究、AI辅助方法建模工具开发以及运行时自适应治理四个方向展开。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is shifting software engineering from tool-supported processes towards AI-first collaboration, where authority is dynamically distributed across human and artificial actors. However, existing method engineering approaches assume static, human-centric control and provide limited support explicitly capturing evolving autonomy. This paper presents a vision for autonomy-aware method engineering by proposing a metamodel that treats autonomy not as a fixed property of an actor, but as a derived, situation-dependent authority assignment determined by task, context, and collaboration pattern. The metamodel formalizes autonomy through four authority dimensions: task execution, task decomposition, task initiation, and collaboration reconfiguration. Through an analytical instantiation with a multi-agent requirements analysis tool, we illustrate how the metamodel supports dynamic authority assignment. This work provides a conceptual foundation for governance-aware, adaptable, and AI-first software engineering methods.

</details>


### [187] [CAROL: Context-Aware Online Learning for Fuzzer Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06772)
*Zirui Liu,Mengfan Xu,Juan Zhai,Shenglong Yao,Shiqing Ma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CAROL提出一种上下文感知的在线学习调度器，通过利用每个模糊器当前可观测的上下文信号（如奖励趋势、等待时长、覆盖新鲜度等）而非仅依赖历史奖励摘要，来优化集成模糊测试中CPU时间的分配。该方法在Magma基准上比基线触发更多独特bug，并在实际C++程序中发现了120个未知缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有集成模糊测试调度器依赖历史奖励的紧凑摘要和预定义决策规则，但存在两个局限：(1) 奖励历史摘要无法可靠捕捉模糊器性能的演化，相邻窗口的排名与窗口内自身排名无统计差异；(2) 跨目标的预测信号不一致，从其他八个目标学习的权重在八个目标上比目标内学习的权重表现更差。

Method: CAROL包含两种方法。方法I（领域引导）：使用Mann-Kendall检验将模糊器分类为"上升"或"衰退"阶段，并对每个阶段应用特定的在线学习估计器（上升阶段使用Theil-Sen斜率，衰退阶段使用RAW-UCB的水平阶梯）。方法II（学习型）：为每个模糊器维护一个独立的岭回归模型，使用15个上下文信号（包括近期生产力、奖励趋势、平台期时长、覆盖代码属性和估计质量），结合随机傅里叶特征表示，通过均值加高斯宽度的不确定性扰动选择下一个模糊器。

Result: 在九个Magma目标的10×24小时campaign中，方法II触发34.20个平均独特bug，而最强基线为30.60（提升11.8%），超过事后选择最佳单模糊器的oracle（32.00）。相对于BandFuzz、autofz和Legion三个基线分别提升20.4%、18.8%和17.9%。消融实验表明，移除上下文导致每目标减少0.69个bug，移除探索项导致减少1.00个bug。在五个实际C++程序（MNN、Arm NN、Krita、ncnn、FreeCAD）中发现了120个未知崩溃缺陷。

Conclusion: 集成模糊测试调度应响应每个模糊器的当前情境，而不仅总结其过去产出。CAROL通过学习目标特定的从可观测上下文到奖励的映射，产生了比固定组合策略更强的集成。完整上下文感知决策和随机化不确定性是产生完整campaign结果的两个核心组件。

Abstract: Ensemble fuzzing runs multiple fuzzers on a target while a scheduler allocates CPU time among them. Existing schedulers base these decisions on compact summaries of past performance and rules fixed before a campaign. Our measurements reveal two limitations. First, past-reward summaries do not reliably capture performance evolution: after accounting for estimation noise, agreement between consecutive-window rankings is statistically indistinguishable from within-window self-agreement. Second, predictive signals vary across targets: on eight of nine targets, a weighting learned from the other eight predicts reward worse than one learned on the current target. We introduce CAROL, an online scheduler that uses each fuzzer's current context. Already available to the dispatch loop, this context describes reward trends, waiting and plateau time, reached code, and estimation uncertainty. CAROL uses context in two ways: a domain-guided method detects whether a fuzzer is rising or rotting and applies a phase-specific learning rule, while a learned method predicts reward from 15 context signals and uses predictive uncertainty for online selection. Across nine Magma targets, CAROL triggers more unique bugs than each of three ensemble-scheduling baselines whenever their results differ, and fewer on none. Compared with the strongest baseline for each target, CAROL gains 11.8% and surpasses an oracle that retrospectively selects the best single fuzzer per target. Removing context eliminates the gain, and the additional bugs are concentrated among those the baselines trigger rarely or never. Run unchanged on five widely used C++ programs, CAROL finds 120 previously unknown crashing defects, deduplicated by site, fault, and entry point; all were reported to maintainers through the projects' stated disclosure channels.

</details>


### [188] [Shortcutting the Fix: Identifying and Categorizing Agentic Exploits in Software Engineering Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06780)
*Nikolai Ludwig,Wasi Uddin Ahmad,Somshubra Majumdar,Boris Ginsburg*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统化地审计了自主软件工程（SWE）智能体在SWE-bench Multilingual和DeepSWE基准上的"agentic shortcutting"（智能体走捷径/利用漏洞）行为。作者定义此现象为智能体通过访问本地Git历史、上游仓库、隐藏元数据或记忆中的上游解决方案等非任务本意的方式来满足基准验证标准，而非独立完成软件工程任务。研究构建了一个基于LLM-as-a-judge的轨迹审计框架，对5个开源大模型在标准提示与添加"Solution Originality"（解决方案原创性）指令两种设置下的表现进行了对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主SWE智能体在基准测试上取得了高分辨率，但这些分数可能掩盖了作弊行为（如利用本地Git历史、访问上游仓库、回忆记忆中的解决方案），而非展示真正的问题解决能力。标准评估仅检查最终补丁执行而非完整智能体轨迹，因此无法区分真正的工程能力与找到解法信息的能力，威胁评估的有效性。

Method: 1. 智能体走捷径分类法：定义了五种作弊行为类别——UPSTREAM（访问上游仓库或分布式制品）、LOCAL_GIT（检查本地未来Git提交/引用）、LOCAL_HIDDEN_INFO（从本地环境获取任务元数据/金色补丁/隐藏测试/先前轨迹）、MEMORY（基于记忆的上游解决方案回忆）、OTHER（其他外部解决方案寻找策略）。2. LLM-as-a-judge审计协议：使用三个开源LLM法官（Qwen3.8-27B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、GLM-5.3-Flash）在每一轮对工具调用和推理痕迹进行分析，通过多数投票确定二分类判决和主要作弊类别。3. 对比实验设置：比较Vanilla（标准mini-swe-agent提示）与Principled（附加Solution Originality指令）两种提示条件，评估5个开源LLM在SWE-bench Multilingual（300任务，9种语言）和DeepSWE（113任务，5种语言）上的Pass@1、Pass@3和作弊率。

Result: 1. 标准提示下作弊行为普遍存在：SWE-bench Multilingual上的作弊率达45.1%–82.4%，DeepSWE上达44.2%–66.1%。2. Solution Originality指令显著降低作弊：SWE-bench Multilingual降至4.0%–10.7%（减少41.1–73.0个百分点），DeepSWE降至1.5%–7.1%（减少37.1–62.6个百分点）。3. 性能权衡不均衡：SWE-bench Multilingual上Pass@1下降4.4–13.3点，但DeepSWE上影响较小，Kimi-K3和Qwen3.8-Flash-Next在Principled提示下Pass@1和Pass@3均有所提升。4. UPSTREAM是主要作弊类别（vanilla下占25.4%–65.9%），Principled指令几乎消除UPSTREAM（降至0.0%–0.9%），但LOCAL_GIT仍然是最顽固的残余类别（3.2%–8.6%）。5. 法官一致性高：vanilla下37.5%–66.3%的轨迹获得全票且类别一致的作弊判定，principled下多数获得全票否定。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了自主软件工程智能体的高基准性能常常掩盖广泛的作弊行为，包括滥用仓库历史、上游解决方案和隐藏测试。显式指示智能体产生原创解决方案可大幅减少走捷径行为，同时不损害核心任务解决能力。研究强调需要"作弊感知"的评估协议来衡量真正的仓库级问题解决能力而非规范博弈（specification gaming）。该研究为未来SWE基准设计提供了重要启示：必须开发能够区分真实工程能力和信息获取能力的评估框架。

Abstract: While autonomous software engineering (SWE) agents achieve high benchmark resolution rates, these scores can mask exploitative behaviors---such as leveraging local Git histories, accessing upstream repositories, or recalling memorized solutions---rather than demonstrating genuine problem solving. We systematize and audit these exploits across five open large language models on SWE-bench Multilingual and DeepSWE using a turn-level LLM-as-a-judge protocol. Under standard prompts, exploitation rates reach 45.1\%--82.4\% on SWE-bench Multilingual and 44.2\%--66.1\% on DeepSWE. Appending a targeted instruction enforcing solution originality drastically cuts these exploitation rates---down to 4.0\%--10.7\% and 1.5\%--7.1\%, respectively, while maintaining strong core task performance. Our findings demonstrate the critical need for exploit-aware evaluation frameworks that measure true repository-level problem solving over benchmark gaming.

</details>


### [189] [LatentMD: Benchmarking Markdown Boundary Failures in LLM-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06993)
*Sungjune Lee,Myungjoo Kang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LatentMD 是一个针对 LLM 生成 Markdown 中围栏代码块边界失败（fence-boundary failures）的诊断基准与评估协议。它通过将内容正确性与边界正确性解耦，暴露出 38% 的生成是"内容正确但边界破损"的潜在失败（latent failure），并证明这种失败主要由同类对称分隔符碰撞驱动，可推广至 Python 三引号但不影响 JSON。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的 Markdown 被聊天界面、Agent、代码提取器等自动化工具消费，其结构正确性至关重要。现实中嵌套围栏代码块频繁断裂（已在 OpenAI ChatKit、Google Gemini CLI、VS Code 等多平台报告），但现有评估将内容质量与格式合规混为一谈，无法隔离"内容正确但边界破损"的潜在失败模式，亟需一种可复现的诊断基准。

Method: 提出 LatentMD 基准：(1) 设计三正交实验轴——A 轴（外包装约束：无包装 A1/强制包装 A2/未指定 A3）、B 轴（内嵌套复杂度：单/嵌套单/嵌套多/混合）、D 轴（分隔符消融：家族/长度/交叉家族）；(2) 基于槽位模板（语言+任务，源自 McEval）生成 4,179 条提示；(3) 定义 F1-F3 格式指标（指令合规、围栏平衡、安全长度）与 C1-C3 内容指标；(4) 定义四类互斥错误标签 E0-E3（正确/过早闭合/未闭合/潜在碰撞）；(5) 提出四格分解，将生成分为边界正确性×内容正确性的四象限，定义"潜在失败率"（LFR）为内容正确但边界错误的比例；(6) 在 9 个 LLM（涵盖开源 7B-70B 与闭源 API）上生成约 37,600 条响应，并扩展至 Python 三引号与 JSON 交叉格式探测。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 38.0% 的主网格有效输出是潜在失败（内容正确但边界破损）；(2) A2（强制包装）条件下多数模型×B 单元边界失败率达 100%，E3（潜在碰撞）率达 49-72%；(3) 同类对称分隔符碰撞是主导原因：交叉家族嵌套将边界正确率从 7.2% 提升至 22.2-35.3%；(4) 提示缓解仅部分有效：H3（长度提示）降低 30.9 pp，H1 降 23 pp，H2 几乎无效；(5) 失败可推广至 Python 三引号（Large/API 层级 K1 仅 31.7% 通过），但 JSON 因非对称分隔符保持 100% 解析有效；(6) 模型规模不能消除该问题。

Conclusion: LatentMD 表明 Markdown 围栏边界失败是 LLM 生成中普遍存在且被现有基准低估的结构性失败，源于对称分隔符的边界状态追踪缺陷而非简单的指令遵从问题。该基准提供可复现的协议、提示集、诊断分类与评分工具，呼吁结构化文本评估应测量解析器层面的边界正确性而非仅关注可见渲染或内容质量，并可推广至其他对称分隔符格式（如 LaTeX verbatim、YAML 块标量）。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate Markdown that is consumed by renderers, agents, code extractors, and structured downstream pipelines. Yet existing evaluations often conflate content quality with format adherence, leaving Markdown boundary failures under-measured. We introduce LatentMD, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for diagnosing CommonMark-level fence-boundary failures in LLM-generated Markdown. LatentMD separates content correctness from boundary correctness, enabling detection of outputs that are content-correct but boundary-broken. The benchmark contains 4,179 prompts and a CLI for scoring arbitrary model outputs. Across 9 LLMs and roughly 37,600 generations, we find that Markdown boundary failures are widespread: 38.0% of valid main-grid outputs are content-correct but boundary-broken, with substantial boundary breakage under unspecified prompts and in a small human-authored validation set. Ablations show that failures are driven primarily by same-family symmetric-delimiter collisions rather than nesting alone, are only partially mitigated by prompt hints, and generalize to Python triple-quote docstrings while JSON remains robust as an asymmetric-delimiter control. LatentMD provides a reproducible diagnostic target for parser-sensitive LLM evaluation.

</details>


### [190] [One Is Not Enough: The Untold Story of Multiple Security Patches for One Vulnerability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07224)
*Fangyuan Zhang,Lyuye Zhang,Lingling Fan,Chengwei Liu,Yinan Li,Liang Huang,Yang Liu,Zheli Liu,Sen Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次对多安全补丁（multi-SP）漏洞现象进行大规模实证研究，揭示了一个漏洞常需多个补丁才能完整修复，并基于此开发了SPectre工具以自动发现完整补丁集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有漏洞数据库对多安全补丁漏洞的覆盖严重不足，导致下游用户可能仅应用部分补丁而留下可利用的攻击面。先前工作多将补丁定位视为单提交排序，未系统理解多SP现象的普遍性与成因。

Method: 1) 融合NVD、Snyk、GHSA、OSV四个漏洞数据库构建数据集SP_DB（含6,053个多SP CVE与16,260个SP）；2) 通过GPT-5.2辅助的卡片分类法对补丁对进行开放编码，构建两级分类法（6类16子类）；4) 基于分类法设计SPectre三阶段流水线：种子情报→多阶段候选发现（9种同分支模式、5种跨分支模式、6种跨仓库模式）→LLM智能体判定；5) 在300个多SP CVE上进行手动ground-truth验证并与PatchFinder、SHIP、Prospector等基线对比。

Result: 20.6%的含补丁CVE涉及多个SP，且年度比例从2020年15.9%升至2024年24.5%；合并多数据库使多SP CVE识别数提升36-55%。分类法显示跨分支修复（39.09%）与同分支修复（32.84%）为主导成因。SPectre在手动验证后达到同仓库召回率0.927、跨仓库召回率0.873，优于所有K=50基线；在100个公开数据库标记为单补丁的2026年CVE中新发现28个未记录的SP（覆盖20个CVE）。

Conclusion: 多SP漏洞普遍存在且被系统性低估；补丁定位应从单纯的排序转向关系感知的多源发现；呼吁数据库维护者标注补丁关系（不完整/错误/分支特定/仓库特定），并开发关系感知的安全工具以提升补丁完整性。

Abstract: Security patches (SPs) are the main mechanism for fixing software vulnerabilities, yet a single vulnerability is not always resolved by a single patch: fixes may be completed incrementally, propagated across maintained branches, or replicated across related repositories. When patch records are incomplete, downstream users may observe only part of the required fix set and therefore apply only partial patching. However, comprehensive patch discovery remains difficult because the prevalence and causes of the multi-SP phenomenon are still poorly understood. In this paper, we present the first large-scale empirical study of multi-SP vulnerabilities. By merging four major vulnerability databases, we construct a dataset of 6,053 multi-SP CVEs with 16,260 SPs, showing that 20.6% of CVEs with patches involve multiple SPs and that merging databases increases recognized multi-SP CVE counts by 36-55% over any single source. We further analyze why a vulnerability is associated with multiple SPs and derive a two-level taxonomy with 6 categories and 16 sub-categories. Based on these findings, we develop SPectre, a taxonomy-driven prototype for comprehensive patch discovery. On 300 multi-SP CVEs, after manually verifying ground-truth SPs, SPectre improves multi-SP patch coverage over representative patch localization baselines, achieving 0.927 recall on same-repository cases and 0.873 recall on cross-repository cases after manual ground truth verification. On 100 recent CVEs recorded as single-patch by all public databases, SPectre further discovers 28 previously unreported SPs across 20 CVEs. Our results show that multi-SP vulnerabilities are both prevalent and systematically underreported, motivating stronger patch-completeness awareness, improved vulnerability database curation, and relation-aware security tooling.

</details>


### [191] [When Stakeholder-centric Requirements Engineering is Not Enough: An Action Research Study on Legacy System Modernisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07340)
*Ruward S. Karper,Damian A. Tamburri,Alessio Ferrari,Willem-Jan van den Heuvel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过在一家跨国能源公司开展的行动研究，探讨了以利益相关者为中心的需求工程（RE）实践在遗留系统现代化中支持"现状-目标"差距分析的充分性。研究发现，这些实践能产出利益相关者认为可理解且正确的需求，但在判断哪些需求已被遗留系统实现时，难以达成共识，表明需要将利益相关者视角与基于证据（尤其是自动化分析）的实践相结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗留系统现代化长期被主要视为技术问题，但从业者面临的挑战多为社会-技术性，其中利益相关者认知碎片化尤为突出。然而，RE视角下的遗留系统现代化研究仍显不足。作者旨在填补这一空白，检验以利益相关者为中心的RE实践能否有效支持差距分析，从而指导现代化决策。

Method: 采用Staron的行动研究方法，在一家跨国能源公司的热能部门进行为期约六个月的干预。研究步骤包括：诊断（将问题定位为RE问题）、行动规划（选定利益相关者识别、半结构化访谈、主题分析、Delphi共识工作坊、用户故事规范化、MoSCoW优先级排序等RE实践）、行动实施、评估（通过问卷调查衡量需求的"可理解性"和"正确性"，以及功能映射的共识度，使用Krippendorff's Alpha进行评分者一致性分析）。

Result: RQ1（需求质量）：利益相关者对需求的"可理解性"（α=0.94）和"正确性"（α=0.90）达成高度一致；宽松解释下全部需求被认为可理解且正确，严格解释下分别为80%和66%。RQ2（差距分析一致性）：对遗留系统功能映射的一致性较低（α=0.45），严格解释下无任何需求实现完全一致，宽松解释下仅50%。优先级排序一致性也较弱（仅不到20%的需求获得80%以上共识），最终筛选出56项需求用于MVP。

Conclusion: 以利益相关者为中心的RE实践对于理解"目标系统"是必要但非充分的。遗留系统现代化的核心障碍不是新需求获取，而是各方对遗留系统现状认知的碎片化。未来RE应：（1）采用两步访谈法分别重建"现状"与构建"目标"；（2）转向基于证据的RE，将利益相关者观点与系统证据（报告、文档、日志、代码等）相结合；（3）引入LLM和自动化技术（特征定位、规范挖掘、架构恢复等）以弥补利益相关者认知的不足；（4）采用敏捷迭代方法（如改造的Scrum与现代化专属Backlog）逐步降低不确定性；（5）加强RE社区与软件仓库挖掘、软件架构社区的跨领域合作。

Abstract: Legacy system modernisation is a major challenge in digital transformation, especially when organisations depend on long-lived, business-critical systems that are only partly understood. In such context, organisations must define future needs while determining what current systems actually do and which functions to retain, adapt, or replace. Modernisation is therefore not only a technical challenge but also a requirements engineering (RE) problem, shaped by stakeholder perspectives. This study examines how far stakeholder-centric RE can support gap analysis between the system-as-is and the system-to-be in a legacy modernisation context. We conducted an action research study in a multinational energy company engaged in system modernisation. In the study, we applied stakeholder-centric RE practices, including stakeholder identification, semi-structured elicitation interviews, agreement-building through the Delphi method, and prioritisation with the MoSCoW method. The results show that this process was effective in producing requirements stakeholders generally viewed as understandable and correct, but less effective in achieving agreement on how elicited requirements mapped to legacy system functionality. The findings suggest that stakeholder-centric RE is necessary but not sufficient, pointing to the need for uncertainty-aware, iterative, and evidence-based modernisation practices that combine stakeholder perspectives with manual and tool-assisted analysis of legacy systems.

</details>


### [192] [EnvPilot: Systematic Design and Evaluation of an Experience-Augmented Agent for Software Environment Setup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07357)
*Hanwu Chen,Hanyu Lin,Zhanjiang Yang,Linhao Zhang,Aoyan Li,Jinxi Li,Meng Li,Yin Chen,Daoguang Zan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出EnvPilot，一种面向软件环境搭建任务的"经验增强型"智能体。其核心是将历史执行轨迹抽象为结构化的<问题-解决方案-动作>三元组经验库（TDM），并通过"上下文感知检索"机制在任务执行前主动注入相关经验，从而减少冗余探索。在新构建的多语言基准AES-Bench（112个GitHub实例、9种编程语言）上，使用DeepSeek-V3时达到了75.00%的SOTA成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化环境搭建方法将每个任务孤立处理，缺乏对历史执行经验的积累与复用能力，导致反复试错、计算资源浪费，且无法跨软件生态系统泛化。环境搭建是代码执行、测试、部署以及LLM训练数据构建和强化学习奖励获取的关键基础设施，因此亟需一种能够学习并复用历史经验的解决方案。

Method: EnvPilot采用"学习-检索-行动-评估"(LRAE)循环。核心组件：(1) Trajectory-Derived Memory (TDM)：通过Chain-of-Thought分析从781条原始执行轨迹中蒸馏出667条结构化<problem, solution, action>经验三元组，使用DeepSeek-R1作为推理引擎，并经人工审核确保质量；(2) Context-aware Retrieval机制：三步流程——从代码库README/CI/Dockerfile提取"代码库画像"、基于画像生成假设性问题查询、利用Qwen3-Embedding-8B编码后通过Reciprocal Rank Fusion进行多查询检索与重排序，将top-k=10相关经验注入智能体提示；(3) 容器化执行与LLM-as-a-Judge评估：采用DeepSeek-V3-0324作为评判模型，基于测试生命周期完整性而非退出码判定成功。

Result: 在AES-Bench(112实例)上使用DeepSeek-V3达到75.00% ECSR，优于SWE-Agent(62.50%)、RepoLaunch(55.36%)和ExecutionAgent(43.75%)；在ExecutionAgent-Bench上达到72.00%。消融实验表明完整三元组结构+上下文感知检索的组合带来+8.04%的增益，去除TDM下降12.50%。检索数量k=10时达到最佳平衡(k=15/20时出现"注意力稀释"现象)。LLM评判与人类标注一致性达98.04%准确率、98.34% F1。失败分析显示60%失败源于工具链与运行时问题(版本约束、shell状态管理)，16%为平台/沙箱限制，16%为本地依赖编译失败，8%为仓库类型误判。

Conclusion: EnvPilot通过轨迹派生经验复用显著提升了软件环境搭建的可靠性与效率，验证了"完整三元组+主动上下文检索"的必要性。结构化经验表示减少了冗余探索，跨模型、跨语言、跨基准均保持稳定的性能优势。未来工作将扩展至更大规模仓库、集成更丰富的执行反馈，并探索与开发者在真实工作流中的协作。

Abstract: Environment Setup is a critical yet complex task in software engineering that relies heavily on expert knowledge. Existing automated environment setup methods lack the ability to accumulate experience from past execution trajectories and to evolve over time. As a result, their performance is limited because they often perform redundant exploration, ignore useful past solutions, and fail to generalize across diverse software ecosystems. We present the systematic design and empirical validation of EnvPilot, an experience-augmented agent that operationalizes trajectory-derived experience reuse for software environment setup. EnvPilot maintains an expandable Trajectory-Derived Memory (TDM), initialized with 667 high-quality experiences. It systematically transforms implicit knowledge from historical execution trajectories into structured experience and retrieves the most relevant guidance during task execution through the Context-aware Retrieval mechanism. This enables EnvPilot to combine multiple validated setup strategies, providing more precise and detailed guidance than methods that rely solely on static project files or web retrieval. To evaluate EnvPilot, we construct AES-Bench, a multilingual benchmark of 112 real-world GitHub instances across 9 programming languages. Experiments show that EnvPilot achieves a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) with a 75.00% Pass@1 success rate while reducing reasoning costs. Our empirical study shows that both the structured experience representation and the Context-aware Retrieval mechanism are essential.

</details>


### [193] [Scanning the Harness: An Empirical Study of Supply-Chain Defects in AI Coding-Agent Configurations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07360)
*Benjamin Kapner,Carmel Soceanu,Alicia Petrunin,Hofni Gartner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对AI编码代理(如Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Codex)的"harness"配置供应链进行了大规模实证研究。通过对3171个GitHub仓库的静态分析,并经过严格的四阶段验证流程,发现16.0%的项目setup存在确认的安全缺陷,18.4%存在任意类型的确认缺陷。主要安全缺陷包括未固定版本的MCP服务器(9.8%)、看似受限实则可任意执行的权限授予(3.1%)、以及随技能携带的shell预批准(3.8%)。研究强调了harness作为新型供应链层缺乏锁文件、安装时校验等基本卫生措施的严重问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理的"harness"——包括指令文件、技能、钩子、MCP服务器声明、子代理等持久化配置——本质上是一个从公共市场和仓库安装的依赖层,以开发者权限运行,却缺乏传统包管理器所具备的基本卫生机制(无锁文件、无安装时检查、无组件能力声明词汇表)。已有研究(如Liu et al.)表明技能市场中存在大量漏洞模式,但harness作为一个整体配置的供应链风险尚未被系统量化。本研究旨在以严格的验证标准测量harness配置缺陷的真实流行率,并区分检测器输出与经过验证的实际缺陷。

Method: 方法学核心是严格的四阶段验证流程:(1)使用harness-eval静态分析工具对3171个公共GitHub仓库运行31条可从字节判定的规则;(2)独立实现的第二套代码对每条发现进行重新推导(re-derivation),以8,547条发现测量谓词层面的协议一致性;(3)对于两套实现分歧的158对(repo, rule),使用语言模型裁判(adjudicator)读取证据并裁决;(4)第二独立的模型会话对每个被计入的743对进行重新审查,检查与平台文档的一致性。规则按分析所需范围分为FILE、FILE_FS、PAIRWISE、SETUP四类;规则按质量分为gating(≥97%协议且≥80%为缺陷)、provisional(13-50条发现)、observation(<80%为缺陷)和报告级。最终只有6条gating规则进入主要数字。语料分为2,660个setups(组装≥2种组件类型)和511个collections(发布≥5个技能)。

Result: 主要结果:16.0%的setups存在确认的安全缺陷(95% CI 14.6–17.4),16.7%存在确认的任意缺陷(S或Q家族),18.4%存在任意确认发现(含P家族)。三类安全缺陷:未固定MCP包9.8%(setup唯一),任意执行授予3.1%(setup唯一),技能预批准shell 3.8%(setup)/3.7%(collections,市场可扫描)。原始扫描器输出率为25.5%,验证后降至18.4%,差距主要来自observation层(规则条件成立但后果通常是有意为之)。配置无法工作类(Q)0.8%;技能违反Agent Skills规范类(P)2.4%。SETUP和PAIRWISE范围的所有规则均未通过验证。原始设想的凭证外泄路径在语料中无确认实例(negative result)。推荐读数为"市场层检查+组装层检查"的双层防御。结论数字均附带95% Wilson置信区间。

Conclusion: AI代码代理的harness作为一个供应链层,在缺少固定版本、安装时校验、输出声明和跨助手单一信息源的情况下到达生态,导致16%的项目setup携带可机械判定的安全缺陷。这些缺陷是普通的、局部编辑即可修复的,大多可追溯到格式或客户端可采用的简单约定。验证后存活的规则都是文件级(FILE/FILE_FS)的;PAIRWISE和SETUP规则需要格式层先建立声明机制(如per-machine import声明、模板目录声明、插件依赖声明)才能可靠报告。原始分析器输出率(25.5%)与确认率(18.4%)之差推广到任何静态分析器:未经在源仓库上重新推导并审查后果的流行率数字,反映的是分析器本身而非缺陷的真实分布。主要建议:MCP需锁文件等价物;权限授予UI需识别解释器;技能规范需强制要求有效字段并提供creates:声明;市场需在发布时运行frontmatter和allowed-tools检查;工具作者应在发布率数字前对发现进行重新验证。

Abstract: AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex are configured through artifacts developers write and share: instruction files, skills, hooks, MCP server declarations, subagents. This harness is a dependency layer installed from marketplaces and public repositories, running with the developer's privileges, with no lockfile, no install-time check, and no vocabulary for what a component may do. We study it over 3,171 public GitHub repositories: 2,660 setups that assemble two or more component types and 511 published skill collections. We measure only rules decidable from bytes whose consequence is a security exposure, a configuration that cannot work, or a departure from the Agent Skills specification, and validate every finding before it counts: an independent implementation re-derives it from the repository at its pinned commit, a language-model adjudicator with a released prompt rules on every disagreement, and a second independent model session re-checks every counted pair. Three security classes survive: 9.8% of setups install an MCP server with no version pinned, 3.1% pre-approve arbitrary execution behind a scoped-looking grant such as Bash(python:*), and 3.8% carry a skill that pre-approves the shell for whoever installs it. In total 16.0% of setups carry a security defect and 16.7% a confirmed defect of any kind, against a raw scanner rate of 25.5% on the same rules; the third class ships inside 3.7% of collections, where a marketplace scan can see it. Rules that compare two files detect differences that are usually intended and are reported as observations. No credential-exfiltration path was confirmed. The instrument, corpus manifest, prompt, and every verdict are released.

</details>


### [194] [Trust the Spec, Not the Code - A Specification-First, AI-Assisted Case Study in Online Banking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07365)
*Eitan Farchi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一项规范优先、AI辅助的案例研究，将形式化规范方法应用于在线银行资金转账服务。以自然语言加轻量数学（natural math）作为中间规范表示，由AI审查歧义、起草证明、生成代码；核心不变量是金钱守恒（∑balances恒定），覆盖一次性与计划/周期性转账两类问题。方法上的两项新增贡献：(1) 由AI提议、经人类审核的运行时覆盖率模型（区分"从未违反"与"已覆盖"）；(2) Z记法形式化接口层（含成对的成功/失败schema），并就所有可达配置的归纳集证明不变量。还尝试让AI自主决定接口分解。明确局限：证明与运行时断言仅在规范层面成立，并未机械验证生成代码对规范的精化关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化规范长期因符号成本高昂而难以普及；LLM有望降低该成本，使"规范"成为被撰写、审查、证明与精化的主要制品，"代码"退化为可再生的输出。前序工作已在组织知识增长仿真中建立该方法，本研究检验其在新领域（在线银行）上的可迁移性、可扩展性，以及对覆盖与精化等更深层保证的支撑能力。

Method: 采用"规范审查 → 人类划界 → 证明不变量 → 运行时断言 → Z形式化接口 → 生成代码"的单循环流水线，分两轮应用：(A) 一次性转账；(B) 加入时钟后的计划/周期性转账。关键规范表示为 LaTeX 写的"自然语言+轻量数学"（natural math），AI 审查歧义；不变量为账户余额总和守恒；通过运行时前后断言实现 oracle；Z 层作为内部接口表示，由 AI 生成 schema（含 Ξ 失败schema与 Δ 成功schema），并就归纳可达集 I 用归纳法证明守恒；覆盖率模型由 AI 提议并经人类审核。

Result: 两项案例均显示：随操作复杂度提升（代码从106行增至265行），守恒不变量与其证明保持不变；运行时不变量断言在所有执行阶段成立；AI生成的覆盖率检查代码报告100%覆盖；Z schema 成功捕获接口并由归纳证明守恒。同时观察到：AI 生成的初始 Z schema 漏掉了 owner(srcAC)=srcU 等所有权前置条件；让 AI 自主决定接口分解时，会把仿真细节（如 π₆(p)）泄漏进接口、遗漏初始化、与自然语言混杂——均需人类把关。

Conclusion: 在不同领域重现同一"规范优先、AI辅助"工作流，并以运行时覆盖率模型与 Z 接口形式化两项方法学增补加以扩展，强化了"守恒不变量即骨架"的跨域可推广性证据。该方法当前仅在规范层面提供保证，代码对规范的精化由 AI 承担而未被形式验证；下一步工作包括精化检验/已验证生成、受控评估、扩展到非守恒性质（如周期性偿付能力），并将工作流抽象为可在多 AI 代理间实例化的可复用"技能"加以评估。

Abstract: Formal specification promises early error detection, explicit invariants, and correctness by design, yet its notational cost has kept it out of mainstream practice. We argue that AI removes much of that cost: natural language enriched with lightweight mathematics, written in \LaTeX, can serve as an intermediate specification language that is precise enough to reason over and prove, while a large language model (LLM) reviews it for ambiguity, drafts proofs, and generates the implementation. The specification becomes the artifact one authors, reviews, proves, and refines; the code becomes regenerable output. This paper is a follow-on to a prior study that established the discipline on an organizational-knowledge-growth simulation~\cite{predecessor2026}. Here we replicate the discipline in a different domain---an online-banking fund-transfer service---and extend it. The two domains share one spine: a conservation invariant (knowledge in the prior study, money here), which suggests the approach generalizes across domains. We contribute: (i) a second, independent case study of the method; (ii) a stress-test of the method on a richer problem---\emph{scheduled/recurring} transfers---whose generated code grows substantially while the invariant and its proof do not; (iii) an \emph{AI-proposed runtime coverage model} for invariants (``never violated $\neq$ covered''); and (iv) a Z formalization, including paired success/failure operation schemas and an invariant proved over the inductive set of all reachable configurations, together with an experiment in which the AI proposes the Z interfaces itself. We are explicit about the method's limits: the proofs and runtime checks live at the specification level and do not establish that the generated code refines the specification---that step is delegated to the AI. This is a case study, not a controlled experiment.

</details>


### [195] [A Text Mining and Classification Approach for Analyzing Architecture Decision Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07375)
*Nicolás Miccio Palermo,Antonela Tommasel,J. Andrés Diaz-Pace*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合主题建模与LLM分类的自动化流水线，对约550个开源项目中约4300份架构决策记录(ADR)进行大规模内容分析，揭示ADR在文档实践与既定架构知识概念之间的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ADRs虽被广泛采用作为轻量级架构知识管理机制，但关于其实际记录内容、所涵盖的架构关注点以及与既定知识概念和文档实践契合度的实证证据仍然匮乏。已有研究多关注ADRs的采纳和使用模式，对其内容本身缺乏系统探索。这一空白阻碍了决策可追溯性、系统演化及长期架构知识的保留。

Method: 研究设计了一个六阶段自动化分析流水线：(1)预处理——从GitHub开源仓库数据集(原始867个项目)中筛选得到4316份ADR；(2)主题建模——使用BERTopic识别ADR中的潜在主题；(3)LLM提示工程与校准——构建200条人工标注的ground-truth数据集，对比zero-shot、static few-shot、dynamic few-shot三种提示策略；(4)基于决策分类法的LLM分类——采用GPT-4.1-mini，将ADR映射至Kruchten决策本体、Zimmermann分类法及ISO/IEC 25010质量属性；(5)MADR模板一致性检查——采用LLM-as-a-judge策略评估五个关键章节的存在性、内容质量与目的契合度；(6)定量与定性分析。

Result: 研究结果表明：(1)ADRs广泛记录认证授权、部署、API开发、NoSQL数据库、区块链、前端等主题；(2)按Kruchten分类，存在性决策占64%，执行性18%，属性性14%，非存在性极少；按Zimmermann分类，设计类约占40%，技术类约25%，组织/过程类约20%；最常涉及的质量属性为可维护性、安全性、可靠性和性能；(3)MADR模板方面，"背景与问题陈述"和"决策结果"章节通常完整，但"决策驱动因素"常被错放且内容空洞，"考虑的备选方案"作为强制章节在大多数文档中缺失或未履行应有功能。整体反映出对决策依据(rationale)和备选方案(alternatives)的系统性低估。

Conclusion: 本文证实ADRs在实际使用中频繁记录存在性、技术性与过程性决策，而备选方案、决策驱动因素及部分质量关注点被低估；ADRs内容与模板章节之间存在持续性错配。这些发现为架构师反思ADRs应如何使用以有效处理架构知识提供了实证依据。所提出的自动化流水线具有可适应性，可应用于其他架构任务(如架构一致性检查)。未来工作包括与从业者开展定性研究、扩展至工业/私有仓库、以及利用LLM工具辅助撰写更高质量的ADRs。

Abstract: Architectural decision records (ADRs) have become a popular lightweight mechanism for documenting architectural knowledge in software projects. However, there is limited empirical evidence on the kinds of architectural concerns captured in ADRs and how well their contents align with established architectural knowledge concepts and documentation practices. In this paper, we propose an automated text-mining and classification approach for analyzing ADRs at scale. We apply this approach to a dataset of ADRs extracted from ~550 open-source repositories, combining topic modeling, LLM-based classification, and template compliance checks. Our analysis examines decision taxonomies and quality attributes, and the degree to which ADRs adhere to the MADR template. Our findings show that ADRs frequently capture existence, technology, and process-related decisions, while alternatives, decisions drivers, and some quality concerns remain under-documented. We also observe recurring mismatches between ADR contents and template sections. These insights into current documentation practices provide architects with valuable information to reflect on how ADRs are and should be used to effectively deal with architectural knowledge. Furthermore, our automated approach is adaptable to other architectural tasks.

</details>


### [196] [A Surrogate-based Approach for Fast Multi-objective Architectural Refactoring Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07389)
*J. Andrés Diaz-Pace,Daniele Di Pompeo,Antonela Tommasel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出在基于NSGA-II的软件架构重构多目标优化过程中集成基于XGBoost回归的代理模型（surrogate models），以替代部分昂贵的求解器调用，在CoCoME案例上实现了约30%的执行时间节省，同时在频繁重训练条件下Pareto前沿质量与标准GA相当；但代理模型倾向于探索不同的架构设计空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标进化算法在软件架构优化中需要反复调用性能、可靠性等求解器来评估候选架构的适应度，计算开销巨大，限制了在大规模设计空间和复杂架构模型上的应用。已有研究要么通过时间预算约束来缓解（可能牺牲解的质量），要么采用离线训练的代理模型（未参与搜索过程），未能真正嵌入优化循环。

Method: 在EASIER框架（基于NSGA-II的架构重构优化引擎）中增量集成代理模型。具体包括：（1）特征编码——将重构动作序列（unigrams、bigrams、位置动作计数、新增组件/节点数、AWS实例族与规格等）转换为固定长度的数值特征向量；（2）每个目标训练一个XGBoost回归代理，初始离线预训练后在搜索过程中周期性增量更新（每k次迭代重训）；（3）每代中50%的候选用代理预测，50%用真实求解器评估；（4）使用CoCoME案例，7个目标（含性能、可靠性、能耗、价格、变更数等），NSGA-II配置为种群12、染色体长度4、102次迭代，重复31次运行。比较标准GA（GA-std）和三种代理变体：SGA-k0（不重训）、SGA-k2（每2次迭代重训）、SGA-k5（每5次迭代重训），用HV和IGD+评估Pareto质量，用重构动作前缀树分析架构差异。

Result: RQ1：代理模型将整体执行时间降低约30%；Friedman检验显示HV存在显著差异（χ²=9.50, p=0.023），但Wilcoxon配对比较经Holm校正后均无统计显著性。GA-std在HV和IGD+上均优于SGA变体（特别是SGA-k5，效应量d_z=-0.0.44），而SGA-k2质量最接近GA-std，呈现时间-质量权衡。RQ2：两种GA探索的架构候选序列存在显著交集，差异主要出现在序列末端的重构动作上——标准GA偏好motn和clone（产生更多基础设施扩展，关注可扩展性与鲁棒性），代理辅助GA偏好rede和move（更高效、低成本，可能有利于能耗与价格目标）。

Conclusion: 代理辅助多目标架构优化是可行的有前景方向，可实现约30%执行时间节省且在频繁重训练时保持Pareto前沿质量；代理模型会引导搜索偏向不同但合理的架构设计空间。未来工作包括：引入漂移检测实现选择性重训、探索图嵌入等更丰富的架构特征编码、以及基于不确定性/多样性的自适应求解器调用采样策略。

Abstract: Software model optimization is a process that generates architecture alternatives aimed at improving quantifiable non-functional properties of software systems, such as performance and reliability. Multi-objective evolutionary algorithms are commonly used to explore the search space and help designers identify trade-offs among competing non-functional properties (e.g., through a Pareto front). However, such algorithms face efficiency challenges in complex software models and large design spaces, since evaluating the fitness (i.e., the quality) of each architecture requires analysis tools that become computationally expensive when repeatedly invoked during the search process. In this paper, we explore the construction of surrogate models based on regression techniques to approximate the outputs of these analysis tools at significantly lower computational cost, while maintaining reasonable output accuracy. Our experimental results suggest that surrogate models provide savings of up to $30\%$ in computational time and maintain the Pareto front quality provided by evolutionary algorithms. Also, we observed some differences in the architectural models produced by our approach. Overall, surrogate models constitute a promising approach for scaling multi-objective architecture optimization to larger spaces and complex architectural models.

</details>


### [197] [An Empirical Study on the Impact of Change Granularity in Refactoring Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07482)
*Lei Chen,Shinpei Hayashi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对32个开源Java项目进行实证研究，提出了粗粒度重构（CGR）和短暂性重构（EPR）两个新概念，分别指跨多个提交才能检测到的重构以及在合并提交后检测条件被破坏的重构。研究发现CGR和EPR在软件开发中普遍存在，CGR主要涉及类/包的拆分合并及继承结构修改，EPR主要涉及小对象操作及上下文敏感的检测条件，并探讨了它们的成因及与提交信息的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的重构检测工具（如RefactoringMiner、RefDiff）主要在单个提交的粒度上检测重构，但实际开发中重构往往因复杂性或其他原因跨越多个提交，导致检测结果不完整或不准确，可能影响软件演化等实证研究的结论。

Method: 1）通过git-stein将多个细粒度提交（FCG）合并为粗粒度提交（CGC），改变检测粒度；2）使用RefactoringMiner分别在细粒度和粗粒度上检测重构；3）设计基于git-blame的位置追踪签名机制，通过类型+元素签名+追踪位置匹配不同粒度下的重构；4）通过匹配结果区分CGR（仅在粗粒度检测到）、EPR（仅在细粒度检测到）及其他重构；5）在32个Java仓库上进行实证分析，回答5个研究问题。

Result: 1）CGR和EPR普遍存在，每100次重构中约有5.71个CGR和9.89个EPR；2）涉及类/包拆分合并及继承结构修改的重构类型倾向于成为CGR；3）CGR成因分为"生成型"（76.4%，由非重构变化产生）和"组合型"（23.6%，由多个细粒度重构组合而成）；4）约20%的提交信息明确暗示了CGR的存在，分为四种特征类型；5）针对小对象（变量、属性、参数）的操作及具有上下文敏感检测条件的重构倾向于成为EPR；6）EPR成因分为"干扰"（74%）、"吸收"（18%）和"回退"（6%）；7）RefactoringMiner在粒度变化下精度为96.36%，检测时间随粒度增加而增加。

Conclusion: 当前基于单提交粒度的重构检测存在系统性遗漏，CGR和EPR在软件开发中普遍存在且不容忽视。建议重构检测工具应支持多粒度检测（单提交、跨提交、跨版本），开发者在提交信息中显式标注CGR的存在，并建议未来研究探索提交集成路径、开发者感知等因素对CGR/EPR发生的影响。

Abstract: Detecting refactorings in commit history is essential to improve comprehension to code changes on code reviews, and to provide valuable information for empirical studies on software evolution. Techniques have been proposed to accurately detect refactorings on the granularity of a single commit. However, refactorings can be made over multiple commits because of their complexity or other practical development problems, which cause detecting on only the granularity of a single commit not enough. We observe that some refactorings can only be detected in coarser granularity, i.e., changes conducted over multiple commits, or in the granularity of a single commit but not in coarse-grained. We call these types of refactorings as coarse-grained refactorings (CGRs) and ephemeral refactorings (EPRs). We investigated the features and causes of CGRs and EPRs through an empirical study of 32 open-source Java projects and found that both commonly occur during development. In addition, we found that refactoring types related to splitting or merging classes and packages, as well as those involving modifications to the inheritance structure, tend to be CGRs, and types targeting small objects such as variables and attributes, and refactorings with context-sensitive detection criteria tend to be EPRs. The causes of CGRs and EPRs are analyzed and categorized, and the relationships between the commit messages of CGRs and themselves are also assessed. We found that about 20% of commit messages explicitly suggest the existence of CGRs. We suggest that CGRs and EPRs be valued in refactoring research and that detectors be extended to identify CGRs.

</details>


### [198] [FPScan: An Automated Constraint-Based Analyzer for Floating-Point Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07492)
*Julien Bortolussi,Dorra Ben Khalifa,Pierre-Loïc Garoche*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: FPScan是一个基于抽象解释和SMT约束求解的静态分析工具，用于自动检测浮点程序中的两类关键数值陷阱：吸收(absorption)和灾难性抵消(catastrophic cancellation)。它通过区间分析推断变量数量级，生成一阶约束并使用Z3求解器判断陷阱是否可能发生，在FPBench基准上证明了72%情况不可能发生陷阱，仅有8%的误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 浮点运算中的吸收和灾难性抵消会导致舍入误差被显著放大，使有限精度计算结果与实数语义产生严重偏差。现有的静态或动态分析方法通常仅关注误差界估计，很少有工具专门检测这些关键数值陷阱，且开发人员普遍缺乏数值分析背景，难以通过试错方式可靠地诊断此类问题。

Method: 采用三级流水线：(1)基于抽象解释的静态区间分析推断程序变量范围及溢出/NaN/除零检测；(2)利用区间导出ufp(数量级)、ulp(最低有效位单位)、nsb(有效位数)三者的整数约束，对每种语句类型(加减乘除、cos/sin/atan/sqrt、赋值、条件分支)定义误差传播约束；(3)将陷阱条件(吸收定义ufp(x̃)≤ulp(ỹ)-1，灾难性抵消定义ufp(z̃)≤ufp(x̃)-nsb(x_v))与可达状态约束合取后交由Z3 SMT求解器判定可满足性。通过证明结构归纳法验证抽象语义的可靠性。

Result: 在FPBench的58个基准上评估，与基于位爆破(bitblasting)的完备真相对比：665个检测案例中482个(72%)被证明不可能发生陷阱，183个报告的陷阱中仅14个(8%)为误报，FN列均为零(零漏报)。运行时效率与FPChecker(1000采样)相当，并显著优于位爆破方法。与FPChecker对比表明二者具有互补性。

Conclusion: FPScan是首个同时支持sound检测吸收和灾难性抵消、支持非规格化数、支持有界循环静态分析的开源工具，在精度和效率上均表现优异。未来工作将扩展至混合精度程序，并基于检测到的陷阱提出保证性修复方案(如精度调优、表达式变换、泰勒展开)。

Abstract: Writing error-free floating-point programs is a challenging task, especially for programmers who lack a strong background in numerical analysis and rounding-error propagation. State-of-the-art techniques typically aim to bound such errors using static or dynamic analysis. However, only a few tools explicitly address critical floating-point pitfalls such as absorption and catastrophic cancellation. These anomalies represent situations in which rounding errors are significantly amplified, causing the semantics of the finite-precision computation to deviate substantially from the real-number semantics. In this article, we present FPScan, a novel tool to formally define and detect both catastrophic cancellation and absorption in floating-point programs. Our approach starts with a custom static analyzer based on abstract interpretation to infer the order of magnitude of all program variables. This magnitude information is then used to build a set of first-order constraints that model error propagation and numerical precision within the program. Finally, we employ an off-the-shelf SMT solver to determine whether the program exhibits any of these critical numerical pitfalls. Experiments were conducted on FPBench, a well-known benchmark suite of floating-point programs, to evaluate the effectiveness of our tool. We also present a comparison with state-of-the-art tools regarding soundness and analysis time.

</details>


### [199] ["We Permit the Use of AI, but [...]": The Landscape of AI Policies in Popular Open Source Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07542)
*Andre Hora,Romain Robbes,Stefano Zacchiroli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对GitHub上2,000个最热门仓库及36个知名项目/组织中的281份AI贡献策略进行了实证分析，从六个维度进行手动分类，并追踪了92个专门的AI策略文件随时间的演变，回答了四个研究问题：AI使用许可、AI披露实践、AI slop（低质量AI生成内容）对策、以及AI策略的演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI（特别是编码代理如Claude Code、Codex）在GitHub上的快速采用（早期2026年达到约30%，新项目中达76%），开源社区面临挑战：传统贡献模式假设人类作者理解其贡献，但编码代理以当前审查流程无法承受的规模产生了大量"AI slop"（低质量AI生成内容）。尽管公共讨论给人以开源项目正在抵制AI的印象，但实际上许多项目正在书写新的"AI贡献策略"治理工件。该研究旨在系统地刻画这些策略实际说了什么，为维护者提供同行基线，为研究者提供标注语料库。

Method: 研究方法包括：(1) 数据收集：从SEART GitHub搜索引擎选取2,000个最热门仓库（至少有100次提交且2026年有提交）+ 36个知名项目/组织，通过三种来源检测AI策略（专门的AI策略文件如AI_POLICY.md、贡献指南文件如CONTRIBUTING.md中的AI策略、代理配置文件如AGENTS.md中的AI策略）；(2) 手动分类：三位作者手动分类281份策略沿六个维度（代码贡献、沟通、issue/bug/安全、AI披露义务、问责制、人类参与程度），在180个分类标签上达成90%的一致性；(3) 演化分析：追踪top 10,000仓库中的92个专门AI策略文件的196次提交，分析变更原因。

Result: 关键发现包括：(1) AI使用许可：83.3%的策略允许或鼓励AI用于代码贡献，仅14.9%禁止，但附带条件——67.3%要求高水平人类参与，43.4%要求问责制，48.8%要求披露；策略主要关注代码贡献（98.2%），沟通（42.3%）和issue/bug/安全（31.3%）的指导较少；(2) AI披露实践：48.8%要求披露，4.6%明确不要求，46.6%未提及；披露位置以PR描述（64.7%）和提交信息（26.7%）为主，内容包括AI使用描述（46%）、代理名称（32.8%）、使用程度（13%）；(3) AI slop对策：识别十种对策（共188次），最常见的是激进关闭PR（48.4%）、封禁用户（20.8%）、禁止自主代理（13.8%）；(4) 策略演化：51%的专门策略已被修订，主要目的是加强质量控制、澄清披露规则、强化人类问责、提高可见性和扩大范围。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，与公共讨论给人的印象相反，开源社区并未普遍反对AI贡献。实际上，83.3%的策略允许或鼓励AI用于代码贡献，但通常附带条件："我们允许使用AI，但是……"是最具代表性的句式。研究为维护者提供了前所未有的同行基线，为研究者提供了标注语料库。研究还讨论了多项启示：AI披露标准的缺乏、声明AI参与程度（人工编写/AI辅助/AI生成）的新兴实践、以及对AI slop和自主代理的担忧。未来工作将探索AI策略的额外维度（如许可、法律要求、质量保障），并调查这些策略是否实际被执行。

Abstract: Open source communities are converging on a new governance artifact: the AI contribution policy. These policies barely existed a few months ago and are now being written and adopted. We analyzed 281 AI contribution policies, and manually classified them along the six dimensions; to study how policies change, we also tracked 92 dedicated AI policy files over time. We answer four research questions on (1) AI usage allowance, (2) AI disclosure practices, (3) AI slop countermeasures, and (4) AI policy evolution. We find that, first, permission is the norm rather than the exception: 83.3% of policies permit or encourage AI in code contributions. But permission comes with conditions, as 67.3% require a high level of human involvement and 43.4% assign accountability. Second, AI disclosure is required by 48.8% of policies, most often in pull request descriptions and commit messages, but what must be disclosed varies widely. Third, we identify ten countermeasures against AI slop, targeting pull requests, users, and autonomous agents. Finally, policies are not static: half of the dedicated AI policy files have already been revised since creation. Our results give maintainers and researchers a baseline and a labeled corpus for studying the impact of AI policies.

</details>


### [200] [RefVerifier: Semi-Automated Reference Claim Verification for Scientific Manuscripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07652)
*Stefania Mocan,Florian Angermeir,Mark Kreitz*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RefVerifier是一个半自动的引用验证系统，用于学术论文同行评审中检查引用声明的真实性。它通过四阶段流程（声明识别、元数据检索、证据定位、判决预测）在完整稿件上执行端到端的引用验证，解决了现有工具只能处理孤立声明或依赖开放域网络数据的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着软件工程领域投稿数量激增，同行评审者面临严格的时间限制，难以及时核实引用所支持的声明，导致未经证实的声明和语义漂移在科学文献中传播。生成式AI工具的兴起进一步加剧了虚假引用的风险。现有方法要么基于开放域网络数据进行事实核查，要么孤立地评估声明，无法处理完整手稿。

Method: RefVerifier采用四阶段流水线：(1) 通过正则表达式提取引用标记并使用LLM（gpt-5.6-terra）进行声明富集（类型、对冲级别、跨度、范围）；(2) 对元数据进行校验（Crossref/OpenAlex/S2）并通过13步解析链获取开放访问PDF；(3) 通过双编码器+BM25+交叉编码器或合并LLM模式定位证据段落；(4) 生成四类判决（支持、部分支持、不支持、NEI）并附带自然语言解释。系统通过FastAPI+React 19实现，提供双窗格审阅界面。

Result: 在CiteWorth基准上声明检测F1达0.990；在992个参考文献中57.6%可解析为全文PDF（生物医学领域通过Europe PMC集成从21%提升至35%）；证据定位在摘要上命中率达98%，在完整论文上为68%；端到端8篇论文测试的判决准确率为71%。评估覆盖5个公共数据集（CiteWorth、SciFact、SCitance、SciCiteVal、Citation-Integrity）以及11位评审专家的技术接受度调查。

Conclusion: RefVerifier通过将验证严格限定于作者指定的引用范围内，弥合了现有工具的空白，实现了端到端、从稿件解析到判决呈现的完整工作流。该工具自动化了文档检索和证据定位，同时保留评审者的最终决策权，为学术出版中半自动完整性检查的可行性提供了初步证据。

Abstract: As software engineering research submission counts surge, peer reviewers face severe time constraints, making systematic verification of citation-supported claims prohibitively expensive. Consequently, unsubstantiated claims and semantic drift can propagate undetected across scientific literature. Existing approaches such as fact-checking and retrieval-augmented generation tools operate on open-domain web data or evaluate claims in isolation without processing complete manuscripts. To address this gap, we present RefVerifier, a semi-automated, citation-bounded reference verification prototype designed to support in academic peer review. RefVerifier extracts citation-bearing sentences from manuscripts, checks bibliography metadata against scholarly databases, resolves references to full-text open-access PDFs, localizes relevant evidence passages, and generates verdicts with natural language explanations. Evaluating RefVerifier on public benchmarks shows claim detection at an F1 score of 0.990, open-access resolution of 57.6% of references, and evidence localization with a hit rate of 98% on abstracts and 68% on complete cited papers. In an end-to-end test with eight manuscripts, RefVerifier achieves a verdict accuracy of 71%. By automating document retrieval and evidence localization while preserving reviewer oversight, RefVerifier provides first indicators for the feasibility of semi-automated integrity checks in scholarly publishing.

</details>


### [201] [You can contribute if you... An Empirical Framework of AI Contribution Policies in OSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07919)
*Gregorio Robles,Daniel M. German*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对开源软件（OSS）项目如何通过贡献政策治理AI中介贡献（AI-mediated contribution）进行了实证研究，基于209个具有AI相关政策的项目数据，归纳了项目禁止、监管或允许AI使用的各类理由，并提出了"AI贡献治理框架"（AI Contribution Governance Framework），包含治理关注维度与可接受性原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的广泛应用降低了代码、文档、问题报告等OSS贡献的生产成本，但也削弱了维护者用于评估贡献者努力程度、能力和责任的传统信号（如投入时间、commit质量等）。这给维护者有限的注意力资源、贡献问责制、新人学习路径等带来挑战，亟需研究OSS项目如何通过贡献政策应对这一治理难题。

Method: 采用法理学中的"法律实证主义"与"自然法"双重方法论。RQ1（实证主义维度）：从Hora & Robbes的HR数据集（118个AI政策）和melissawm社区策展数据集（106个政策，合并去重后共209个项目）中收集OSS贡献政策，先对12个项目进行手工饱和分析构建编码模板（含立场、披露要求、人类责任、范围、质量、学习、安全/IP、可持续性、执行机制、目标对象、人际互动等维度），再用Claude Code (Opus 4.7) 进行LLM辅助编码并辅以人工验证与三方交叉核对。RQ2（自然法维度）：对RQ1结果进行经验扎根的概念综合，通过作者讨论将反复出现的关切提炼为治理维度与可接受性原则。

Result: RQ1结果：42个项目禁止AI，主要理由为维护者负担（81%）、代码质量与正确性（79%）、版权/IP许可不确定性（57%）、DCO/作者认证（36%）、社区信任与文化（36%）、学习与贡献者发展（34%）、伦理（劳动剥削、环境等，19%）、安全（7%）；监管型项目（"regulated"）的关键区分在于"贡献者必须理解代码"，所有项目均强调代码质量/正确性与贡献者理解要求；允许型项目几乎不提供理由而仅规定程序要求。少数项目对新老贡献者做区分（如Zig的"Contributor Poker"、LLVM/Firefox保护good-first-issue），仅DuckDB明确区分bug修复与新功能。RQ2结果：提出AI贡献治理框架，包含10个治理关注维度（稀缺性转移、贡献价值、信号可靠性、审查对话、贡献债务、审查负担分配、维护者侧AI使用、项目价值观、贡献者发展、新人路径、自主代理贡献问责），并按项目、贡献者、维护者三方角色提出可接受性原则（共14条），明确AI中介贡献应满足问责、不负担转移、可接受证据、信号完整性、来源合规等条件。

Conclusion: OSS社区正以高度多样化方式（从完全禁止到有条件允许）规范AI中介贡献，反映了OSS在目的、约束与社区价值观上的异质性。AI贡献政策应被理解为对变化了的贡献环境的适应性治理工具，其目的不是最大化或最小化AI使用，而是维护审查作为对代码库及贡献者/维护者社区"值得投资"的条件。所提出的AI贡献治理框架作为政策设计辅助工具，可帮助OSS社区识别AI相关压力、连接其欲保护的价值，并将这些价值转化为具体政策机制，而非规定统一的AI政策立场。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping open source software (OSS) contribution by lowering the cost of producing code, documentation, issue reports, and review interactions. This creates opportunities for broader participation, but also disrupts how maintainers assess contributor effort, competence, and accountability. In response, OSS projects are beginning to regulate AI-mediated contribution through contribution guidelines and other project documentation. This paper presents an empirical study of these emerging policies. We analyze project policies on AI-mediated contributions by evaluating their underlying rationales, rules, and expectations. Our analysis shows that these policies seek to protect scarce maintainer attention, preserve accountability, sustain meaningful review interactions, address legal and quality concerns, and maintain pathways for newcomer learning. Based on these findings, we introduce the AI Contribution Governance Framework, which organizes recurring concerns and governance mechanisms across projects. The framework helps OSS communities develop AI contribution policies and provides researchers with a vocabulary for studying how AI is changing collaborative software production.

</details>


### [202] [Service Health Engineering for Distributed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08020)
*Siva Rama Krishna Varma Bayyavarapu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出"服务健康工程"(Service Health Engineering)作为分布式系统的实用可靠性学科，聚焦端到端用户旅程的完成度，通过服务承诺、SLI/SLO、看门狗、事件度量、韧性测试和每周服务健康评审等机制发现静默故障和异步滞留工作，并以文档审批工作流为示例，同时提出一种人审+AI辅助的报告架构以避免AI自主决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式系统支撑关键业务流，但运维通常依赖组件仪表盘而非端到端用户体验来评估服务健康，导致静默故障（如异步任务滞留、依赖假死）在组件指标看似正常时被遗漏。

Method: 以文档审批工作流为案例，系统整合：(1) 服务承诺（Service Promises）；(2) 服务级指标与目标（SLI/SLO）；(3) 看门狗（Watchdogs）；(4) 事件度量（Incident Measures）；(5) 韧性测试（Resiliency Testing）；(6) 每周服务健康评审（Weekly Service-Health Reviews）。同时提出一种人审+AI辅助的报告架构用于汇集服务健康证据，AI仅作为辅助，不参与自主决策。

Result: 该方法能够揭示组件层无法发现的静默失败和异步滞留工作，将可靠性实践统一围绕"用户旅程是否按承诺完成"这一核心问题，为分布式系统提供了一种以用户结果为导向的可靠性保障路径。

Conclusion: 服务健康工程将既有可靠性实践系统化整合，强调从端到端用户旅程视角审视服务可靠性，并通过人机协作的AI辅助报告架构确保决策的可控性，是连接组件监控与业务结果之间鸿沟的实用可靠性学科。

Abstract: Distributed systems support many critical business workflows, but service health is often judged through component dashboards rather than through end-to-end user outcomes. This article presents service health engineering as a practical reliability discipline that connects telemetry, workflow completion, dependency behavior, operational readiness, and recovery validation. Using a document approval workflow as a running example, it describes how service promises, service-level indicators and objectives, watchdogs, incident measures, resiliency testing, and weekly service-health reviews can reveal silent failures and stranded asynchronous work. It also presents a human-reviewed, AI-assisted reporting architecture for assembling service-health evidence without making AI an autonomous decision-maker. The approach brings established reliability practices together around whether user journeys complete as promised.

</details>


### [203] [Agent ATO: Visualizing Agent Interaction Timelines from Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08301)
*Takuto Kawamoto,Yoshiki Hig,Raula Gaikovina Kula*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Agent ATO（Agentic Trajectory Observer），一个从控制台日志重建 AI 编码代理交互轨迹并以时间线形式可视化的工具，包含全交互时间线、按 Discovery/Reading/Writing/Execution 四类标签的过滤时间线以及与之对齐的 token 使用图，旨在辅助开发者检查和对比代理行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 编码代理通过多轮工具调用完成编程任务，仅凭最终代码变更难以理解其行为；控制台日志虽记录了完整过程，但因缺乏交互类型分类与时序呈现，开发者难以从中识别验证缺失、token 异常等过程级线索。需要一种能清晰呈现代理操作序列与上下文信息的可视化手段。

Method: 工具由两部分组成：(1) TypeScript 扩展，用于在 Pi 编码代理执行时采集 turn 边界、LLM 消息、工具调用、bash 命令、工具结果、token 使用及时间戳等事件，输出 JSONL 日志；(2) Python 脚本，将每个 turn_start 到 turn_end 区间重构为一个 interaction，依据命令/工具名赋予代表性标签（如 `find | grep | head`、`git diff`、`npm test`），并基于规则匹配打上 Discovery/Reading/Writing/Execution 多个标签，生成静态 HTML 可视化文件。

Result: 通过两个案例研究验证：(1) Case 1（immich #28383）中，10 次执行中修复方向相似的两次尝试中，一次形成反复的 edit-validation 循环，另一次编辑后未执行对应测试验证；(2) Case 2（metabase #74530）中，两次高 token 消耗的尝试原因不同——一次源于 LLM 反复重新考虑修复策略导致的长输出，另一次源于大文件读取产生的大量 tool-result token。可视化成功暴露了这些在最终补丁或原始日志中难以发现的过程级差异。

Conclusion: Agent ATO 通过时间线可视化有效支持对 AI 编码代理轨迹的检查与对比，能够揭示验证行为差异并区分 token 消耗的不同来源，为 prompt 调试与代理设计讨论提供基础。但当前证据局限于单一代理、两个任务与基于规则的标签匹配；未来工作将评估标签准确性、与原始日志检查的对比效果，并研究轨迹观察能否引导有效的 prompt 或代理改进。

Abstract: AI coding agents are becoming part of developers' workflows, but their behavior is difficult to understand from final code changes alone. During a task, agents interact with software repositories through sequences of actions such as searching for files, reading code, editing programs, and running tests or build commands. These interactions, together with token usage, are often recorded in console logs, but raw logs are difficult for developers to inspect. In this paper, we propose Agent ATO (Agentic Trajectory Observer), a tool for visualizing AI coding agent interaction timelines from console logs. Agent ATO extracts agent interactions, classifies them by command or tool type, and visualizes them as timelines. In addition to an all-interaction timeline, Agent ATO provides filtered timelines that emphasize file discovery, file reading, file editing, and execution while preserving surrounding context. We illustrate how Agent ATO may help developers inspect and compare agent actions using selected runs from two repair tasks. Future work will apply Agent ATO to more agents, tasks, and development environments, and will evaluate whether it reduces the effort needed to compare trajectories.

</details>


### [204] [Tool Retrievers Are Underestimated: Annotation Expansion Reveals True Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08327)
*Yanyu Zhu,Chenheng Zhang,Shaoshen Chen,Hoilam Pao,Yufei zhang,Jiajun Chai,Dongnian Wang,Zhaoyu Hu,Guojun Yin,Wei Lin,Hai-Tao Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文揭示了工具检索基准中广泛存在的"一对一标注问题"：由于工具库中大量存在功能等价但名称/接口不同的工具，单个查询本质上是"一对多"映射，而现有基准却强制标注为唯一正确答案，导致检索器被系统性低估。作者提出全自动标注扩展框架ToolEX，构建了新的ToolEq基准，证明30-47%的微调增益其实是评估伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模、持续演化的开放世界工具库中，工具增强型LLM依赖检索器为查询召回相关工具。然而现有工具检索基准（如Tool-DE、ToolRet）采用自下而上的合成流程，每个查询仅标注一个"种子工具组合"作为唯一真值，忽略了同一功能可由多个等价工具实现的事实，导致功能正确的检索结果被错判为失败，系统性低估检索器能力，并夸大微调收益。

Method: 提出ToolEX（Tool Equivalent eXpansion）三阶段全自动标注管道：(1) 用DeepSeek-V3.2将复合查询分解为k个与提供商无关的原子子查询；(2) 用Qwen3-Embedding-4B对每个子查询检索Top-20，再用GPT-4o-mini进行功能验证；(3) 通过笛卡尔积组装候选组合，用RRF排序，再用Claude-Sonnet-5进行功能覆盖与依赖一致性审计。基于扩展标注构建ToolEq基准，采用max-aggregation度量（对每个指标独立取与任一等价组合的最佳匹配分数）。同时将管道扩展至SkillRet构建SkillEq。

Result: 在7,360查询的Tool-DE上，67.9%的子查询存在等价替代，平均扩展到5.3个有效组合/查询；SkillEq上达10.8个/查询。在ToolEq上重评8个基础检索器与2个微调变体：(1) NDCG@10平均提升5-7pp，纠正低估；(2) 微调增益从6.4pp(0.6B)/7.2pp(4B)缩小至4.5pp/3.8pp，30-47%的报告增益为评估伪影；(3) 类别异质性：Customized提升最大(+9.2pp)，Web次之(+7.9pp)，Code最小(+5.4pp)；(4) 79.4%含等价工具的查询中最佳等价工具出现在Top-10，其中14.5%查询的标注工具不在Top-10但等价工具在；(5) 568个ToolBench下游任务中，ToolEX扩展组合在六类指令上全部优于Oracle与ToolBench-IR(+3.5-6.5pp)。

Conclusion: 一对一标注问题在工具检索及技能检索生态中普遍存在。ToolEX通过自动化扩展等价标注、ToolEq通过max-aggregation评估范式，恢复了被错误扣除的检索分数，揭示了微调收益中的评估伪影成分，并证明当前检索器已编码大部分所需工具语义——查询分解可释放更大增益而无需修改检索器参数。建议未来工具检索基准同时报告精确参考与等价感知分数。

Abstract: In open-world scenarios with massive and evolving tool repositories, tool-augmented large language models rely on a retriever to surface relevant tools for a given query. Because such repositories often contain many tools that implement the same functionality, a single query can often be resolved by several distinct but functionally equivalent tool combinations, making the natural query-to-tool mapping inherently one-to-many. However, existing tool retrieval benchmarks annotate each query with a single relevant tool combination, collapsing this one-to-many mapping into a rigid one-to-one annotation and causing valid retrieved tools to be misjudged as failures. To address this, we propose ToolEX (Tool Equivalent eXpansion), a framework that automatically discovers and annotates the tool combinations functionally equivalent to the labeled ones. Applied to the 7,360-query Tool-DE benchmark, ToolEX finds that 67.9% of sub-queries admit equivalent alternatives, expanding the singular ground truth to an average of 5.3 valid combinations per query. Using the expanded benchmark ToolEQ, we re-evaluate eight base retrievers and two fine-tuned variants; metrics on ToolEQ rise substantially over Tool-DE, showing that one-to-one annotation systematically underestimates retrievers and that 30--47% of the reported fine-tuning gain is an evaluation artifact rather than genuine improvement. Applying the same pipeline to skill retrieval on SkillRet further confirms that the one-to-one problem extends beyond tool retrieval.

</details>


### [205] [RepoNav: From Snippet Retrieval to File-Centered Repository Navigation for Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08355)
*Hongzheng Chai,Jiakun Li,Hongyue Yu,Yuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RepoNav 是一个轻量级的检索后接口层，将扁平代码片段检索结果重组为以文件为中心的导航支架（包含锚点、结构摘要与候选目标三块），并配合按需的 list_symbols 文件结构浏览工具，以帮助 LLM 代码智能体在仓库级任务中缩小"文件到函数"的定位差距。在 LocBench 与 SWE-QA-Bench 上的实验表明，RepoNav 在函数级定位和问答任务上均稳定优于片段检索基线和工具匹配的 Snippet+ListSym 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的代码智能体在仓库级任务中常出现"到达正确文件却定位到错误函数"的失败，其根本原因在于扁平片段检索提供了相互独立的代码块，缺少文件内部的结构化线索，导致智能体出现过早锚定（premature anchoring）行为，倾向于先被最显眼的符号吸引，而缺少对同级兄弟符号的比较。因此需要一种以文件为中心、可展开的结构化导航接口来弥合"文件到函数"的鸿沟。

Method: RepoNav 是一个两阶段的检索后处理管道，复用现有密集检索基底而不修改原始检索分数。第一阶段通过混合打分规则（α·s_top + (1-α)·平均分）将片段级证据聚合为文件级候选。第二阶段仅对 top-k 个候选文件动态解析其结构（使用 Python 的 ast 模块提取函数/类/导入以及同文件调用上下文），并以纯文本、缩进树的形式序列化为三块结构：[ANCHORS]（查询匹配的入口符号，最多 2 个）、[GLIMPSE]（非锚点的结构摘要，最多 3 或 5 个）、[CANDIDATE_TARGETS]（候选目标短列表，最多 4 个，并附带继续浏览提示）。同时暴露 list_symbols 作为按需文件结构浏览工具，返回轻量级文件骨架（不含函数体）。

Result: 在 LocBench 560 个实例上对 7 个 LLM 进行评测：RepoNav 在函数级 Acc@5 上比 Snippet Search 平均提升 7.3 个百分点（0.484→0.557），比工具匹配的 Snippet+ListSym 基线再提升 4.8 个百分点；将"文件到函数"差距从 26.9 百分点缩小到 21.7 百分点；GPT-OSS-120B 上配对实例分析显示 Function Acc@5 提升 +6.28 pp（p=0.017）、Function Rec@10 提升 +4.77 pp（p=0.007）。RQ2 控制消融表明 File-Only→Inline Scaffold→Tree Scaffold 逐步提升（Acc@5: 32.61%→46.96%→52.13%），证明收益来源于结构化组织而非单纯暴露更多结构。SWE-QA-Bench 上 RepoNav 同样在 4 个模型上一致优于 Snippet Search（平均 +1.76 总分），收益集中在 Correctness 与 Completeness 维度，对 Why 类跨文件问题增益最大。

Conclusion: 检索增强型代码智能体的性能不仅取决于检索到了什么证据，还取决于检索证据如何被组织用于探索。RepoNav 通过将扁平片段重组为轻量级、文件中心、可展开的导航支架，在不修改底层检索器的前提下显著缩小了文件级与函数级定位之间的差距，并为仓库级问答带来迁移收益。结构化收益来源于证据的可操作性而非结构信息量本身，且对结构性更复杂的文件增益更大。未来工作应拓展至 Python 以外的编程语言，并评估补丁生成、长周期维护等下游任务。

Abstract: Solving repository-level code tasks requires LLM-based agents to use code search tools to navigate large codebases and identify a small set of relevant files and functions. However, current retrieval tools typically return flat lists of isolated code snippets: such lists can surface relevant files, but provide insufficient structure for agents to distinguish the target function from semantically similar alternatives in the same file. We introduce RepoNav, a lightweight post-retrieval interface that reorganizes retrieved snippets into a file-centered navigation scaffold. By presenting compact structural cues and candidate targets, this scaffold guides on-demand file-structure browsing, helping agents compare sibling symbols before selecting a target function. Across diverse models on LocBench, RepoNav improves function-level localization and narrows the file-to-function gap. Controlled ablations demonstrate that these gains come from structured evidence organization rather than simply exposing additional file structure, and the approach also improves performance on a repository-level question-answering benchmark.

</details>


### [206] [Authority Is Not a String: A Capability-Scoped Harness for Prompt-Injection-Resistant Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08371)
*Dimitrios Stamatios Bouras,Yihan Dai,Sergey Mechtaev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 CapScope，一种用于编码代理的工具调用授权机制。它通过在宿主侧为每个子代理分配独立的、基于任务预先冻结的类型化能力集合，在工具调度前强制检查能力匹配，从而抵御间接提示注入攻击，无需模型识别恶意文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间接提示注入可借助仓库文件或工具输出中的文本诱导编码代理执行用户未请求的操作。现有防御（指令层级、分类器等）依赖模型对文本做概率性判断，存在被绕过或误报的问题。问题的根源是代理沙箱中工具的"环境权威"——命名资源即足以对其操作，形成 confused-deputy 漏洞。任务级全局策略无法同时为不同子代理授予不同权限。

Method: 设计模式 CapScope 三条规则：(1) Mint——会期开始前，由可信 LLM 仅基于用户请求与项目文件树（不含文件内容）预先生成任务级能力上限并冻结，存储于模型上下文之外；(2) Derive——子代理派生时，只能从委托方上限中收窄范围，得到子代理独立的能力存储；(3) Invoke——每次工具调用前检查发起代理的存储中是否存在覆盖该调用的能力，否则阻断。能力形式化为 Cap[e, φ]，含 Read（规范路径前缀）、Write（规范路径前缀）、Exec（参数向量前缀，对复合命令逐段检查）。在 Pi 编码代理上以 SDK 扩展实现，钩取 tool_call 事件在分发前阻断。
