Result: 在 5 个 Python 修复任务 × 5 个注入面（README/AGENTS.md/技能文件/源码注释/pytest 输出）× 4 个授权条件 × 3 次试验共 300 次运行中：环境权威（B0）攻击执行 47/75，静态全局策略（B1）46/75，任务特定全局策略（B2）33/75，CapScope（C）仅 3/75。任务完成率：B0 为 72/75，B2 与 C 均为 68/75。CapScope 通过 AGENTS.md 注入面仍发生 3 次攻击，源于授予过宽或注入文本影响子代理生成。平均延迟 C 为 316 s，B0 为 145 s。

Conclusion: CapScope 通过宿主侧能力检查而非模型侧文本分类抵御间接提示注入，可大幅降低攻击执行率。其代价是任务完成率下降 4 次、延迟增加；过窄的预检或过宽的子代理授予可能导致漏防或误拒。CapScope 不解决机密性或已授权能力的滥用，需与信息流控制与进程沙箱配合。

Abstract: Coding agents use system-level tools to read files, execute commands, and modify source code. Within the agent's sandbox, these tools often carry ambient authority: naming a resource is sufficient to act on it. Indirect prompt injection exploits this authority by placing instructions in repository files or tool output that cause the agent to perform actions the user did not request. We propose CapScope, a harness-level authorization mechanism that restricts tool use without requiring the model to identify malicious text. Before repository contents or tool output are read, CapScope derives a task-wide authority ceiling from trusted input. It then assigns each agent a separate set of typed capabilities, stored outside the model's context. Every tool call is checked against the capabilities of the agent that issued it. Permissions assigned to one sub-agent are therefore not automatically available to another. An injection may cause an agent to request an action, but the request is blocked unless that agent already has the required capability. We implement CapScope on the Pi coding agent and evaluate it in a repair workflow where an orchestrator delegates subtasks to separate sub-agents. The evaluation covers five Python tasks, five injection surfaces, four authorization conditions, and three trials per cell (300 runs). The injected effect executes in 33-47/75 runs under the ambient-authority and global-policy baselines, compared with 3/75 under CapScope. CapScope completes 68/75 repairs, while the baselines complete 68-72/75.

</details>


### [207] [PLC-Bin2Src: Retrieving Corresponding Structured Text Source Files for PLC Binaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08563)
*Ang Jia,Yaxin Duan,He Jiang,Ming Fan,Zhilei Ren,Xiaochen Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PLC-Bin2Src 是首个针对 PLC 二进制文件的跨平台 binary2source 匹配框架,旨在从源代码仓库中检索出与不透明 PLC 二进制制品相对应的 ST（Structured Text）源文件。该框架通过平台感知的前端构建可比较的表示,并在后端等权重融合控制-数据流图（CDFG）、函数调用图（FCG）和恢复符号三种相似度,对源候选进行排序。在 PLC-BEAD 数据集上,跨四个 PLC 平台（CODESYS、GEB、OpenPLC v2、OpenPLC v3）实现了 95.89% Recall@1、99.66% Recall@5 和 0.9769 的 MRR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件复用与第三方库集成在 PLC 开发中很常见,但纯二进制形式的组件会模糊其来源与实现细节。现有 PLC 二进制逆向工程框架（如 ICSREF、PLC-BinX）仅专注于从专有制品中重构执行结构和控制语义,无法识别与二进制制品对应的 ST 源文件。因此,需要一种 binary2source 匹配框架来实现依赖清单、漏洞评估、溯源和安全审计等软件成分分析任务。该任务面临三大挑战:跨平台编译异构性、二进制与源代码之间的表示鸿沟、恢复的二进制单元与 ST 源文件之间的粒度不匹配。

Method: PLC-Bin2Src 将 binary2source 匹配建模为源候选排序问题,包含三个阶段:（1）预处理阶段——二进制前端通过反汇编、核心函数提取（基于 PLC-BinX 方法并应用平台特定规则）和反编译（IDA Pro/Hex-Rays）生成类 C 表示;源前端通过 MATIEC 将 ST 转换为 C 表示并提取核心函数;两侧均进行标准化处理。（2）表示构建阶段——构建三个通道:CDFG（控制-数据流图,通过 WL 核提取 n-gram 特征描述函数内控制-数据语义）、FCG（函数调用图,编码程序级调用拓扑和归一化的函数角色）、Symbols（恢复的符号标签及语义角色,不编码图拓扑）。（3）相似度计算阶段——对每个通道分别进行 TF-IDF 向量化和余弦相似度计算,以固定等权重（各 1/3）融合三个通道的相似度,对候选 ST 文件进行降序排序,返回 top-k 结果。

Result: 在 PLC-BEAD 数据集的 2358 个有效样本上（482 CODESYS、617 GEB、619 OpenPLC v2、640 OpenPLC v3）,PLC-Bin2Src 总体达到 95.89% Recall@1、99.66% Recall@5 和 0.9769 的 MRR。平台层面:CODESYS 最高（Recall@1 98.55%）,OpenPLC v2 最低（94.83%）。通道消融实验显示:FCG 单通道最强（Recall@1 91.94%）;等权三通道融合优于所有单通道和双通道组合,相比最强双通道配置提升 2.12 个百分点。效率方面,源仓库预处理一次需 180.81 秒,跨平台二元预处理需 467.73–1141.17 秒,相似度计算仅需 0.92–2.87 秒。错误分析识别出三类模式:同一函数族变体得分相近、保留的类型/常量差异微小、前端关联错误扭曲证据。

Conclusion: PLC-Bin2Src 是首个面向 PLC 二进制文件的 binary2source 匹配框架,通过跨平台语义恢复和对齐的二进制-源代码表示,在四个主流 PLC 平台上实现了高精度的源文件检索。这证明了在不透明 PLC 二进制上进行跨平台 binary2source 匹配的可行性,为更广泛的溯源和软件成分分析奠定了基础。该工作的局限性在于评估仅覆盖 PLC-BEAD 中包含的工具链和制品类型,固定等权重融合规则在通道质量差异显著的数据集上可能并非最优,且未涵盖经过故意符号剥离或名称混淆的二进制场景。

Abstract: Software reuse allows existing components and third-party libraries to be incorporated into new applications, but binary-only components can obscure their origins and implementations. Software composition analysis seeks to identify these reused components and trace their provenance, supporting dependency inventory, vulnerability assessment, and security auditing. For PLC applications, binary2source matching provides a core link in this analysis: given an opaque PLC binary artifact, retrieve its corresponding Structured Text (ST) source file from a collected source repository. However, this task is complicated by cross-platform compilation heterogeneity, the representation gap between PLC binaries and ST source code, and the granularity mismatch between recovered binary units and ST source files. This paper presents PLC-Bin2Src, a cross-platform binary2source matching framework for retrieving corresponding ST source files for binaries produced by CODESYS, GEB, OpenPLC v2, and OpenPLC v3. Platform-aware frontends construct comparable representations, and a shared backend equally combines control--data flow graph (CDFG), function call graph (FCG), and recovered-symbol similarities to rank source candidates. We evaluate PLC-Bin2Src on PLC-BEAD. Results show that PLC-Bin2Src achieves 95.89% Recall@1, 99.66% Recall@5, and an MRR of 0.9769 across four PLC platforms.

</details>


### [208] [Beyond Fixed Fault Models: Comparing LLM-Based and Rule-Based Fault Injection in OpenStack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08681)
*Giuseppe De Rosa,Pietro Liguori,Domenico Cotroneo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对基于LLM的故障注入与基于规则的故障注入（ProFIPy）在OpenStack Nova和Cinder服务中进行了系统对比，发现两者在故障行为上具有互补性：LLM生成更多Catastrophic（灾难性）故障，ProFIPy产生更多Silent（静默）和跨组件传播的故障，且两个生成模型在同一注入点也表现出不同的故障特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规则化故障注入器（如ProFIPy）依赖手工编码的故障模式，难以覆盖上下文相关的缺陷；LLM提供数据驱动的替代方案，但生成故障的有效性和运行时行为尚不明确，且现有研究多关注代码级属性（语法、相似度、变异分数），而非操作级影响。核心问题是：LLM生成的故障是否扩展了固定故障模型所观测到的操作行为空间。

Method: 使用PyResBugs数据集对Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct和DeepSeek-Coder-33B进行QLoRA微调；采用核采样（temperature=0.4, top-p=0.95）生成故障，经Python 2.7兼容性两层验证后接受；在OpenStack Pike测试平台上与ProFIPy对比，使用四个Oracle（API、状态断言、日志、覆盖率）按Koopman CRASH量表对故障分类，并按IMPACT维度评估传播范围；包含122个单目标场景（Nova 66个、Cinder 56个），并在37个三注入器共享函数上进行位置控制分析。

Result: （1）共享目标上激活率和可观测故障率相近，但故障特征不同：LLM在Nova上产生更多Catastrophic故障（DeepSeek 28.6%，Qwen 22.7% vs ProFIPy 4.3%），ProFIPy产生更多Silent故障（30.4% vs 9.5%/18.2%）；Cinder无Catastrophic故障，以Hindering为主。（2）ProFIPy产生更多Multi-component传播效果（Nova 26.1% vs 9.5%/13.6%；Cinder 25.0% vs 11.8%/5.3%），LLM更多表现为Local或Total（系统级中断）。（3）DeepSeek与Qwen在共享位置上仅55%（Nova）/71%（Cinder）CRASH结果一致，但IMPACT一致率达80%/88%，表明架构和注入位置对传播范围影响更大，而模型选择影响故障表现方式。

Conclusion: LLM与基于规则的故障注入具有互补性而非优劣关系：LLM扩展了行为覆盖范围（更多Catastrophic和工作流相关故障），降低了操作符编写成本；ProFIPy提供更好的可控性、可重复性和更多保留执行的传播性故障。实际采用仍需受控的生成、运行时验证、系统级Oracle和可重现的实验溯源。未来工作将整合运行时反馈到生成过程中，并将相关生成故障提升为确定性操作符，以构建自适应管道。

Abstract: Software Fault Injection (SFI) supports testing of cloud systems by introducing software defects and observing their manifestation. Rule-based injectors such as ProFIPy provide controlled and reproducible source-level mutations but require fault patterns to be encoded manually. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a data-driven alternative by generating context-dependent software faults. We compare two code LLMs, Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder, with ProFIPy in OpenStack's Nova and Cinder services. On shared injection targets, activation and observable-failure rates are comparable, but operational profiles differ: LLM-generated faults produce more Catastrophic outcomes on Nova, whereas ProFIPy produces more Silent and Multi-component effects. The sampled LLM outputs also differ in how they manifest failure, while showing greater agreement in their propagation scope. These findings show that LLM-based fault injection extends the behavioral coverage of fixed fault models without establishing general superiority, and that practical adoption still requires controlled generation, runtime validation, system-level oracles, and reproducible experimental provenance.

</details>


### [209] [DJPlus: Generating minimal test suites for strong coverage criteria in graph models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08953)
*Yavuz Köroğlu,Mutlu Beyazıt,Onur Kılınççeker,Serge Demeyer,Franz Wotawa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为DJPlus的优化驱动方法，用于从图模型生成最小化测试套件。与现有最优方法DJ相比，DJPlus在保持最少测试用例数的同时，进一步减少了测试步骤数。该方法被集成到流行的GraphWalker MBT工具中，并在四个真实系统上验证了其有效性：相比Random、QRandom和DJ等方法，DJPlus生成的测试步骤冗余度低2至26倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图模型的测试生成（MBT）中，测试覆盖强度与测试执行效率之间存在矛盾：较强的图覆盖准则（如边对覆盖、简单路径覆盖）能确保测试质量，但会生成大量冗余的测试步骤，导致测试执行时间过长，限制了MBT在工业规模上的应用。现有的最优方法DJ虽然能最小化测试用例数，但无法优化测试步骤数。

Method: DJPlus是DJ方法的改进版，核心创新在于用"展开"（unrolling）策略替代DJ的"解旋"（unwinding）策略。DJ使用超图最小流优化来最小化测试用例数，但通过解旋将超顶点还原为循环时会引入冗余步骤。DJPlus的策略是：在每一步展开一个超顶点时，将循环中的元素展开两次（用撇号标记副本），保持流图无环，并重新执行最小流优化，从而消除DJ中两类次优问题：超顶点多余出现的任意选择，以及阻止超顶点循环的片段化遍历。最终生成需求流图（RFG），从中导出测试套件。该方法还通过GWPlus集成到GraphWalker工具中，处理多图、线图转换等实际工程问题。

Result: 在四个真实系统（TLC、RISC-V、Parabank、Testinium）上的实验表明：(1) 简单路径准则（PPC）在Testinium上需要超过100万个测试需求，存在严重的可扩展性问题，被判定为不可行；边对准则（EPC）是可行的。(2) DJPlus生成的测试步骤数始终不多于DJ，且差距随模型规模增大而扩大。(3) Random、DJ、QRandom的冗余度分别是DJPlus的26.21倍、4.24倍和2.06倍。(4) 测试步骤数与执行时间呈强线性相关（PCC接近1），DJPlus通过减少步骤数有效降低执行时间。测试生成时间上，DJPlus在EPC下对最大模型Testinium需约186秒，相比之下测试执行时间仍是瓶颈。

Conclusion: DJPlus是迈向工业规模MBT的重要一步。它在保持最少测试用例数的同时有效减少测试步骤数，使边对覆盖准则在真实系统上变得可行。未来工作包括扩展至带条件边的图模型、支持低于100%的覆盖率目标，以及通过变异分析评估DJPlus的故障检测能力。

Abstract: Automated test generation from graph models is essential to model-based testing. In this type of testing, graph coverage ensures test suite strength but also results in long test cases that take time to execute on the system under test. We propose a novel optimization-driven method, DJPlus, which generates reduced test suites while satisfying given graph-based test requirements. We implement DJPlus and show the feasibility of edge-pair criterion, a stronger coverage criterion than vertex or edge criteria, on four realistic systems, while prime path criterion poses scalability issues. Our evaluation reveals that the alternative methods generate 2 to 26 times more redundant test steps than DJPlus and DJPlus decreases test execution times by reducing the number of test steps. These results show that DJPlus is a positive step towards tackling the challenges of model-based testing at an industrial scale.

</details>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [210] [From Version Conflicts to Decision Conflicts: Selective Revalidation for Long-Running AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08015)
*Yongjian Lyu,Yang Ren,Ruofei Lai,Wenting Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ATR (Affected-closure Targeted Revalidation)是一种针对长时运行AI Agent的选择性重验证机制,通过区分"版本冲突"与"决策冲突",仅重新检查受状态变更影响的可执行前提条件,避免在Agent等待审批或工具调用期间盲目丢弃已有决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时运行AI Agent在读取状态到执行外部操作之间存在时间间隔,期间支撑决策的证据可能发生变化。传统的乐观并发控制(OCC)能检测到版本变化,但无法判断该变化是否真的使待执行操作的决策依据失效——例如,客户名变更(展示元数据)不应影响退款决策,而退款限额从100降至50则必须阻断。论文旨在解决"版本变化触发检查,而不是自动作废决策"这一核心问题。

Method: 1) **模型层**:形式化Agent事务 T=<R,D,I,E>,引入"前提条件"(typed premise)、决策图G=(V,A)、影响闭包(affected closure)、绑定集B(e)等概念;区分四种验证结果(KEEP/REFRESH/REPLAN/BLOCK),严重度排序 BLOCK>REPLAN>REFRESH>KEEP。
2) **协议层**:维护依赖图与反向索引,采用对象/字段/谓词三种粒度捕获依赖;算法1(Validate)将事件提示与权威PRE_EFFECT版本比对结合,沿依赖图遍历受影响闭包,仅对可达前提执行类型化验证;通过目标端事务或CAS将检查态绑定到提交。
3) **两个安全命题**:命题1给出"绑定前置效果安全性"条件(依赖完备性、验证器可靠性、令牌忠实性、观察绑定、目标原子执行);命题2证明反向索引可将遍历局部化至O(|A_c|+|V_c|+L)。

Result: 在21万次控制执行(3个业务场景×5种变更×7次重复×1万条轨迹)中,ATR在所有15种变更情形下与开发者指定的判定结果100%一致,零假允许、零假阻断;无检查(NoCheck)错误释放60%,版本中止(VersionAbort)过度重规划100%安全变更。在10个SQLite持久化checkpoint/resume单元中,ATR每次变更仅评估0.6个前提(FullScan为6.0);4093次读取规模下ATR耗时9.3μs,FullScan为2595.9μs;7000对两客户端竞态测试中无双提交或零提交;跨资源策略历史中,仅目标CAS无法阻止违反外部策略的操作(100/100错误提交),加入策略令牌绑定后100/100被正确拒绝;依赖边随机省略1%/5%/10%分别产生0.95%/5.05%/9.97%的假允许率。

Conclusion: ATR证明版本失配无需在"忽略变更"与"全盘丢弃推理"之间二选一:通过记录证据到效果的依赖、对影响闭包进行选择性重验证、并用检查过的目标令牌绑定提交,可在微秒级验证成本下保留无害决策、阻断无效决策。但其保证是局部的:跨资源前提需要事务或显式预留/租约机制;依赖捕获必须完备或保守过近似;前提提取与验证器可靠性仍由开发者负责。该工作确立受控可行性,不声称生产通用性,下一步是与持久化Agent框架及事务连接器集成,并基于生产轨迹评估前提提取错误。

Abstract: Long-running AI agents may read state, reason, wait for tools or human approval, and perform an external action much later. The state that justified the action can change in the meantime. For example, after an agent proposes an 80 GBP refund under a limit of 100, a customer-name change affects only presentation metadata, a new limit of 90 still permits the refund, a limit of 50 invalidates it, and a refund issued by another worker must prevent a duplicate. Standard optimistic concurrency control and version checks can detect that previously read state has changed, but by themselves do not determine whether that change invalidates the pending action's justification. We call any detected version change a version conflict; when that change invalidates the action's justification, it is also a decision conflict. ATR records the explicit, executable conditions that justify a pending action and rechecks only the conditions affected by a change before releasing the external operation. It can retain the action, refresh non-decisive metadata, require replanning, or block execution; a target-side transaction or compare-and-set binds checked state to commit. Across 210,000 controlled executions over 15 mutation cases, ATR matched every developer-specified outcome with no false allows or blocks. In ten durable SQLite checkpoint/resume cells, it evaluated 0.6 conditions per change versus 6.0 for FullScan. At 4,093 recorded reads, ATR took 9.3 microseconds versus 2595.9 microseconds for FullScan. These deterministic results establish controlled feasibility, not production generality or automatic extraction of the required conditions.

</details>


### [211] [Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05437)
*Sunny Rai,Jinyi Kuang,Reyhan Jamalova,Annie Lou,Cristina Bicchieri,Niyati Malhotra,Victor Hugo Orozco-Olvera,Ana Maria Munoz-Boudet,Lyle H Ungar,Sharath C Guntuku*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个评估大语言模型"元规范推理"（metanorm reasoning）能力的框架和基准数据集 NormReact。研究发现，当前 LLM 系统性地构建了一个比人类更严厉、更具惩罚性的社会规范执行模型，缺失了对社会距离、关系校准和容忍节制的理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 AI 对齐工作主要关注一阶社会规范（教模型"什么是对/错"），但忽视了二阶社会规范（元规范/metanorm），即关于"谁会执行规范、如何执行、在什么条件下执行"的共享期望。这种对二阶社会推理的忽视使 AI 系统在冲突调解、政策模拟、内容审核等规范敏感领域中可能产生扭曲的社会图景。

Method: 1. 提出元规范评估框架，包含两个维度：情绪评估（emotional appraisal）和行为反应（behavioral response），并区分自我调节（self-regulation，违反者）和他者调节（other-regulation，观察者）；2. 引入社会距离变量（强关系/弱关系/陌生人）；3. 构建 NormReact 数据集：450 个规范违反场景，来自 Social-Chem-101，涵盖五大道德基础，并按违反者性别和观察者社会距离人工标注情绪和行为反应；4. 招募 871 名 Prolific 参与者进行人工标注；5. 评估 6 个 SOTA 模型（GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro、Claude-4.5-Opus、GPT-OSS-20B、Llama-4-Scout-17B、Gemma-3-12B）；6. 通过三个二分类任务评估模型：自我调节、他者调节、规范执行；7. 分析描述性规范（实际会做什么）vs. 规范性规范（应该做什么）的差异。

Result: 1. LLM 系统性过度预测负面制裁，在人类预期会"不作为"的情况下预测惩罚；2. 与人类判断的一致性随社会距离增加而恶化；3. LLM 过度预测观察者的他聚焦情绪（愤怒、厌恶、轻蔑），低估自我聚焦情绪（羞愧、内疚）；4. LLM 对陌生人的行为预测 F1 分数从强关系（0.8）大幅下降至陌生人（0.48）；5. 规范性规范比描述性规范更难预测（弱关系 F1: 0.56 vs 0.46）；6. LLM 在情绪强度上呈现"模式坍缩"（mode collapse），输出集中于中间值；7. 存在精确率-召回率权衡：GPT-5.2、GPT-OSS、LLaMA 高召回易过度执法；Claude 高精确率但对陌生人反应识别保守；8. LLM 过度预测八卦（weak ties 过度预测达 66%），在规范性框架下从八卦升级为言语对抗；9. 情绪强度对执法的预测关系在 LLM 中更陡峭，呈现过早饱和现象。

Conclusion: 当前 LLM 缺乏三个关键能力：1) 条件偏好概念（制裁取决于社会期望而非自动反应）；2) 参考网络敏感性（执法合法性随社会关系分布）；3) 描述性与规范性期望的区分。这种惩罚性偏见可能源于训练语料过度表征道德愤慨、后训练机制奖励果断反应以及安全政策推动公开谴责。该研究具有实践意义：AI 系统可能放大人类的多元无知（pluralistic ignorance），导致用户高估社区的惩罚程度，造成 AI 介导的规范扭曲。未来工作应扩展到目标导向任务、跨文化情境，并建模不对称社会成本。该研究将元规范推理确立为社会智能 AI 的核心组成部分，呼吁 AI 对齐超越"对错"判断，延伸至对悔恨、节制、合法性和关系动态的推理。

Abstract: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. Current LLMs portray a harsher social world: across six models, they overpredict negative sanctions where humans would expect inaction, and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases. These findings suggest that AI systems in norm-sensitive domains from conflict mediation to policy simulation, may risk producing a distorted picture of social regulation: one that over-represents punishment and under-represents the tolerance, restraint, and relational calibration that characterize actual norm enforcement in real world.

</details>


### [212] [CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05439)
*Huifang Du,Zecheng Zuo,Sen Wang,Chenghao Fan,Haofen Wang,Yehui Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CriticGen 是一个面向大语言模型推理任务的"生成感知"评估框架，通过为每个问答对动态生成样本专属的评分维度与等级化准则（rubric），并将这些准则作为接口条件，统一生成分数、归因解释、可执行的修改建议以及改写后的答案，将评估从"判断"转变为"可执行的改进控制信号"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是评估标准通常是任务级或场景级的固定 rubric，难以捕获单个问答对中的具体缺陷；二是评估信号与生成过程脱节，评估结果只能间接通过奖励模型或强化学习影响下游生成。作者希望验证：评估能否同时做到"样本专属"和"可执行"，从而直接驱动答案改写。

Method: 框架由两个 SFT 模块组成，通过 rubric 接口耦合：(1) Rubric 归纳器 G 为每个 (q, a) 生成 m 个评估维度 d_i 及其 0–5 分级准则 C_i，组织在三大高层约束族下（主观质量、客观正确性、自衍生约束）；(2) Rubric 条件化评估-改写模型 S，输入 (q, a, d_i, C_i)，统一输出 (s_i, r_i, u_i, a'_i)——分数、归因解释、可执行修改建议和改写后答案。训练数据 RubricData（51,774 条）和 RefineData（1,204,548 条）由 GPT-5 标注，并经 Claude Sonnet 4.5 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的一致性过滤、词汇多样性与近重复过滤。两个模块均使用负对数似然 SFT 目标训练，不引入额外 RL 阶段。

Result: 在 240 个 held-out 问答对的人类评估中，动态 rubric 将相关性/覆盖率从静态 rubric 的 3.33/4.03 提升至 3.97/4.24；维度名 Jaccard 移位 0.37，证明 rubric 对答案敏感。在 RefineData 上，CriticGen-Qwen3.5-9B 取得最佳 Pearson/Spearman 相关系数 0.9556/0.9560，超越 GPT-5（0.9212/0.9143）；归因解释 F1 从 0.6369 提升至 0.7554，可执行建议 F1 从 0.5994 提升至 0.7900。改写任务中改进率 73.17%，非退化率 93.28%。消融实验显示移除归因解释或修改建议会使改进率从 73.54% 降至约 60–62%。Feedback Bench 域外测试中三个相关系数均取得最优，验证了 rubric 条件化评估能力的可迁移性。

Conclusion: 实验验证了核心假设：细粒度评估应同时具备"实例专属"和"可执行"两种属性。CriticGen 通过结构化的 SFT 监督轨迹（分数-解释-建议-改写），将动态诱导的 rubric 转化为直接的答案改进信号，使评估成为可控生成改进的机制，而非仅仅是诊断工具。局限在于：依赖生成数据质量、当前仅在文本推理任务验证、未引入强化学习优化。

Abstract: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. These criteria then serve as a dynamic rubric for jointly producing a score, a reason, an executable refinement suggestion, and a refined answer. This rubric-conditioned refinement process enables models to diagnose flaws and perform targeted answer improvement. Experimental results show that fine-grained evaluation should be both instance-specific and actionable. CriticGen induces higher-quality rubrics, improving relevance/coverage from 3.33/4.03 to 3.97/4.24. CriticGen also achieves the best score correlations, with 0.9556 Pearson and 0.9560 Spearman, and raises the F1 of criterion-grounded reasons and executable suggestions from 0.6369/0.5994 to 0.7554/0.7900. Crucially, its feedback translates into reliable answer improvement, improving 73.17% of answers with a 93.28% non-degradation rate.

</details>


### [213] [When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05441)
*Shweta Mishra,Shashank Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MERIT 是一个面向工具调用型 LLM 智能体的长期记忆评测基准，通过可编程验证的跨会话任务、控制性记忆依赖、难度阶梯、受控记忆腐化与完整的 token/美元计量，衡量记忆对任务执行的边际效用而非对话回忆能力。核心发现是：嵌入检索在事实更新（hard 层级）下不可预测地崩塌，混合方案劣于其最佳组件，LLM 摘要因每轮覆写而天然抗更新，且全量重放在成本上始终不经济。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆评测（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、BEAM 等）以对话问答为主，存在三大盲点：(1) 衡量的是问答而非工具调用行动；(2) 假定记忆有帮助，却未量化其危害（如陈旧记忆导致自信地犯错）；(3) 报告了成本但未给出成本调整后的边际效用。生产部署真正关心的是记忆是否改变了智能体的行动，以及每增加一美元所换来的成功率提升。

Method: MERIT 基准包含三个领域（客服、IT 运维、个人助理），采用 ReAct 工具循环 + SQLite 可变世界状态，arc 由 4–6 个 episode 组成（plant / update / probe / independent）。三档难度梯：easy（单事实）、medium（多事实组合）、hard（事实中途更新，需取最新值）。六个记忆条件：C0 无记忆、C1 全量重放、C2 检索（关键词或嵌入）、C3 滚动摘要（截断或 LLM）、C4 结构化事实存储（正则或 LLM 抽取，update-on-write）、C5 混合（C4+C2）。每条件有 starter 与 real 两代实现。关键防护：自动 leak check（确保 gold fact 不出现在 probe 输入或初始世界状态中）+ delta scoring（仅当 checker 谓词在 episode 内由 false 翻转为 true 才算成功）。指标：TSR、MUR、Ignore Rate、SMH、CAMU（含记忆侧调用计量）。统计方法：配对自举按 arc 聚类 + Holm–Bonferroni，预注册 H1–H4。两阶段实验：gpt-4.1-mini 双代 pilot（9,940 episodes），加 3 模型 × 3 种子全量网格（13,500 episodes），附 Sonnet 5、Opus 4.8 抽查。

Result: 在 23,440 计分 episodes、$42.57 API 成本上：C0 无记忆基线在依赖任务上 leak 验证后确为 0.00，独立任务 0.83–1.00；所有记忆条件在 easy 上 +0.55 至 +1.00。Hard 层级呈现架构分离——C2 嵌入检索跨模型/种子不稳定（0.30–0.95，最大种子差距 0.45），C3 LLM 摘要（因每轮覆写）与 C4 事实存储稳定在 0.70–1.00，C5 混合在所有领域 hard 上劣于 C4（0.50–0.80 vs. 0.75–1.00）。即使正确事实已在检索块中（55 个 probe），智能体仅 55% 真正按其行动（Ignore Rate 0.45–0.53）；C1 全量重放在多事实组合上 ignore 高达 0.50。Stale 腐化下唯一 Holm 显著伤害出现在 C5（+0.25 at ρ=0.3, p=0.030）。实施替换可使任务成功率移动高达 60 分（如 C4 D2 由正则 1.00 降至 LLM 抽取 0.40；C3 hard 由截断 0.00 升至 LLM 1.00）。CAMU：每领域最佳条件为该领域最经济的 2.7–3.9 倍；C1 全量重放始终不经济。Sonnet 5 抽查复制了该模式（DPO 等政策审慎的混淆须以 C1 为对照解读）。

Conclusion: MERIT 将智能体记忆评测从"能否回忆"重构为"回忆是否改变了智能体行为、代价几何、如何失败"。在事实会被更新的场景下应优先选择覆写式记忆（结构化事实存储或 LLM 摘要），混合方案不继承最佳组件行为，全量重放成本上不经济。提取质量是结构化记忆的隐性税，应被 CAMU 计量。MEMIT 的 leak check 与 delta scoring 应成为任务执行型记忆基准的标准实践；跨模型比较应相对于各自 C1 全量重放控制来读，以隔离政策审慎对记忆利用率的混淆。作者公开了基准、harness、追踪数据与预注册。

Abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. MERIT provides episodic tool-use tasks in three domains whose dependence on earlier-episode facts is verified by an automated leak check; a difficulty ladder ending in updated-fact recall; controlled memory corruption; and full token and dollar metering of every memory operation. Across 23,440 scored episodes ($42.57), a two-generation pilot on gpt-4.1-mini and a preregistered 3-model x 3-seed grid (GPT-4.1, Claude Haiku 4.5; memory side held fixed), memory lifts dependent-task success from a leak-verified floor of 0.00 to 0.55-1.00. On updated facts, embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably (0.30-0.95 across models; max seed gap 0.45), and agents act on a correctly retrieved value only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores (a structured fact store and, notably, LLM summarization) remain at 0.70-1.00; the hybrid is worse than the fact store alone. A latest-generation spot-check (Claude Sonnet 5, gated on a clean full-replay control) reproduces the pattern. Swapping a memory's implementation moves task success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical: the best condition per domain delivers 2.7-3.9x its marginal utility per dollar. We release the benchmark, harness, and all traces.

</details>


### [214] [AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05446)
*Adib Hasan,Daniel Schaffield,Akashnil Dutta,Tarik Adnan Moon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 AutoFyn：一种面向长时程智能体任务的非参数化专家迭代框架。它保持基础模型及其角色分配不变，每轮开启全新模型会话，将候选方案、验证证据和经验提炼到持久化状态中，再由外部验证器产生的奖励决定是否更新当前最佳结果。该方法在奥数、数据科学基准和软件安全审计中展示出较强表现，但多数结果属于系统级部署比较，尚不足以分离各组件的独立贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体通常同时面临两个问题：单一会话不断累积上下文，导致模型对历史信息的利用不均；以及智能体依赖自评纠正自身错误，使早期误判在后续迭代中固化。论文据此设计一个以“新鲜会话＋显式持久状态＋外部验证”为核心的循环：上下文长度由可控的持久状态决定，而进展只由环境验证信号确认。

Method: AutoFyn 保持角色到模型的参数和分配 Θ 冻结，将持久状态 M_t 划分为目标/用户修订、评估历史、规则与角色经验、工作状态、最佳候选及其证据。外部控制进程为每轮建立空历史的新会话；编排器在探索、规划、构建和审查阶段调用专业角色智能体，并生成多个候选。验证器将每个候选映射为带状态/分数、证据、保证等级和验证者身份的结构化记录。系统仅在候选被接受且质量高于当前最佳时更新 incumbent，同时将有价值的轨迹、证据和经验提炼进 M_t。该方法被形式化为非参数化专家迭代：搜索负责提出候选，外部验证器提供专家判据，状态蒸馏相当于策略更新。它不同于经典专家迭代，因为不更新模型参数、不构建显式专家策略，也不保证验证无误；改进必须由后续已验证表现确认。

Result: 在 IMO 2026 六道题上，五个模型在 AutoFyn 中的得分均达到或超过其供应商编码智能体：GPT-5.6 Sol 为 42.0 对 40.0，Claude Fable 5 均为 42.0，Claude Opus 4.8 为 34.7 对 28.0，Claude Sonnet 5 为 29.7 对 23.3，GLM 5.2 为 32.0 对 20.7。分数经独立前沿模型审计并由三名往届 IMO 奖牌获得者复核，结果未反馈到生成过程。需要注意，六个子前沿单元为三次独立运行的均值，且不同智能体在时长、工具、检索和多智能体结构上并不等同，因此不能将全部增益归因于 AutoFyn 循环本身。在 Spider 2.0 dbt 公共榜单中，AutoFyn 自主构建和优化的 SignalPilot Agent 得分 65.60，位列第一；论文所列第二至第五名分别为 60.29、41.18、39.71 和一个图表中未标数值但排名第五的条目。安全审计方面，系统在 13 个项目中找到超过 150 个可复现漏洞，提交 43 份公告，其中 16 份已获项目维护者确认。论文还给出五项审计的逐轮曲线，例如 Hermes Agent 在 19 轮内达到 56 个经确认的可利用路径，pnpm 在第 8 轮关闭 13 个路径并一度停滞，之后在第 129 轮完成一条链。

Conclusion: 作者认为，AutoFyn 将长上下文管理、多候选搜索、外部验证和持久记忆整合为一个可审计的长时程循环，并通过三类任务证明其广泛适用性。其主要理论定位是：模型参数保持不变，但通过持久状态改变模型后续行为所依赖的上下文条件，从而实现非参数化专家迭代。论文同时明确其局限：该对应是结构性的，验证器可能误收或误拒，持久状态更新是有损的，因此策略本身不保证单调改善；IMO 实验也是完整部署之间的比较，没有隔离上下文重置、多智能体搜索、工具权限和检索等组件的贡献。因此，结论更支持 AutoFyn 作为一种有效且可审计的系统设计，而非已证明普遍优越或理论保证充分的算法。

Abstract: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the six fresh problems of the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, every model with room to improve scores higher under AutoFyn than in its provider's own coding agent. AutoFyn also built the top-ranked agent on the Spider 2.0 dbt benchmark, and has produced $16$ maintainer-confirmed vulnerability advisories in this http URL , MetaMask, pnpm, Warp, LiteLLM, Langflow, and Open WebUI.

</details>


### [215] [Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05448)
*Salem Ameen,Sunil Vadera*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于损伤感知多臂老虎机（damage-aware MAB）的结构化剪枝方法，用于在固定候选单元评估预算下选择Transformer中的完整功能单元（注意力头与MLP通道组），通过配对损伤奖励与UCB/分数Beta Thompson Sampling策略顺序构建掩码，在多个语言与视觉Transformer上以更少评估次数实现低于预算贪心方法的性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝中，完整功能单元的选取缺乏高效的自适应评估策略；随机、幅度、静态显著性等方法未利用单元间的信息交互，而预算贪心方法评估代价高且易过拟合校准批次。需要一种在有限评估预算下、能自适应分配评估次数以选择低损伤单元的框架。

Method: 将注意力头与MLP通道组视作老虎机臂，临时屏蔽并以"掩码损失-基线损失"的配对损伤作为奖励，采用平滑有界奖励驱动UCB或分数Beta Thompson Sampling策略；顺序地每步加入一个单元构建最终掩码，并在原始稠密检查点中功能性地置零所选单元（仅模拟结构性抑制，不产生物理压缩或实测加速）。

Result: 在WikiText-2、LAMBADA与Imagenette上覆盖GPT-2、OPT、Pythia、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2、ViT-B/16、DeiT-Tiny、Swin-Tiny等多个模型；五颗种子下，配对语言模型比较中老虎机方法通常降低退化；论文强调的28项比较中，23项bootstrap置信区间排除零、11项配对检验p<0.05；在全部116项数据集级检验中，经Benjamini-Hochberg校正后6项q<0.05；ViT-B/16与Swin-Tiny的匹配评估表明优势并非仅由更大评估预算带来。

Conclusion: 损伤感知多臂老虎机为Transformer结构化单元选择提供了一种预算高效且统计学上显著优于预算贪心的方案；所报告的参数效应反映功能层面的结构性抑制而非实际压缩或加速，且其收益在控制评估预算后仍部分存在。

Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2, OPT, Pythia, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny, and Swin-Tiny, with comparisons against random, magnitude, static-saliency, and budgeted-greedy selection. Across five seeds, the bandit methods usually reduce degradation relative to budgeted greedy in the paired language-model comparisons. Of 28 comparisons highlighted in the paper, 23 bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero and 11 paired tests have p < 0.05; six have q < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full family of 116 dataset-wise tests. Matched-evaluation results for ViT-B/16 and Swin-Tiny indicate that their gains are not explained solely by a larger candidate-evaluation budget.

</details>


### [216] [Compiling VGDL into Causal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05459)
*Mohit Jiwatode,Bodo Rosenhahn,Alexander Dockhorn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性框架，将VGDL（视频游戏描述语言）编写的游戏直接转换为动态结构因果模型（DSCM），以保证因果保真度，支持反事实推理、因果强化学习训练和程序化内容验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准强化学习智能体依赖虚假相关，大语言模型则容易幻觉游戏规则。虽然因果强化学习提高了可解释性，但目前缺少将复杂游戏机制直接映射为因果模型的形式化方法。需要一种能够保证因果保真度、无需从噪声数据中推断的框架。

Method: 将VGDL的四个核心组件（SpriteSet精灵集、LevelMapping关卡映射、InteractionSet交互集、TerminationSet终止集）确定性编译为动态结构因果模型（DSCM）。每个游戏tick表示从时间t到t+1的因果转移：(1) 精灵动力学定义局部因果机制（移动精灵、不可移动精灵、随机NPC各自的结构方程）；(2) 交互机制通过空间重叠条件激活（如stepBack、killSprite规则）；(3) 终止机制从存活实例计数推导胜负状态。内生变量包括位置、朝向、速度、存活状态等，外生变量包括玩家动作、随机数和初始布局。以basicgame为例给出完整的SCM映射表。

Result: 该框架提供了一个原则性的桥梁，将符号化游戏描述与因果基础的游戏AI连接起来，产生了透明的反事实推理路径，支持因果强化学习智能体训练，并可进行程序化内容验证。主要局限在于因果模型规模随VGDL描述复杂度线性增长，且依赖VGDL与实际实现的一致性。

Conclusion: 通过将视频游戏映射到动态因果框架，使对游戏中动作和结果的推理成为可能，补充了基于统计和学习的游戏AI方法。未来工作包括开发从游戏代码自动提取SCM的工具、扩展到多智能体和实时游戏、探索空间关系编码方法，并通过实验评估对智能体性能的影响。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. Each game tick represents a causal transition from state variables at time $t$ to $t+1$. By establishing this grounded mapping, the approach guarantees absolute causal fidelity to the ground-truth game mechanics. The resulting models offer transparent causal pathways that support counterfactual reasoning, causal reinforcement learning agent training, and procedural content validation. This framework provides a principled bridge between symbolic game descriptions and causally grounded game AI.

</details>


### [217] [ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05461)
*Zhengshu Zhang,Zhiyuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ARC-Bench 提出了一种无泄漏、固定候选动作的审计协议，用于评测冻结 JEPA 世界模型（如 DINO-WM、V-JEPA 系列）中基于潜在距离的动作排序假设是否成立。研究发现：在官方发布的 JEPA-WM 检查点上，"潜在距离近似动作优劣"的假设严重失效——Push-T 上 96.8% 的锚点选择了次优动作，MetaWorld reach-wall 上 100% 错误；即便用 V-JEPA 1/2 视频预训练编码器替换 DINOv2，缺陷依然存在。该缺陷之所以长期未被察觉，是因为闭环重规划（每步重新规划）会不断覆盖单步排序错误——降低重规划频率后，成功率显著下降（PointMaze 从 89.6% 降至 61.8%，Push-T 从 36.1% 降至 12.5%）。因此，闭环成功率系统性地高估了冻结潜在表示的动作可排序性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无奖励潜在世界模型（JEPA-WM、V-JEPA 2-AC 等）通过候选动作预测的未来嵌入与目标嵌入之间的距离来选择动作，隐含假设"潜在距离排序与真实代价排序一致"。该假设此前从未被直接基准测试过，而闭环成功率可能掩盖单步排序缺陷，因此需要一套标准化的审计协议来量化这一假设的可靠性。

Method: ARC-Bench 采用无泄漏、固定候选动作的审计协议：(1) 在锁定测试集上对官方 JEPA-WM 检查点进行评分审计；(2) 报告 top-1 遗憾、Hit@k、WRR、Mirage 率、Spearman 相关系数等指标；(3) 进行控制实验——替换视觉骨干网络（V-JEPA 1/2 ViT-L/G）、进行欠训练控制、匹配预算骨干控制、度量循环性控制；(4) 附加轻量级终端排序探针作为局部化诊断；(5) 通过改变重规划频率 k（k=1,2,4,6）来隔离闭环重规划对排序缺陷的掩盖效应；(6) 在 U-Maze 和 MiniGrid/FourRooms 上进行拓扑压力审计，验证终端距离几何的固有缺陷。

Result: 在官方 JEPA-WM 检查点上：Push-T 错误率 96.8%（Hit@1 仅 3.2%），MetaWorld reach-wall 错误率 100%（Hit@1=0，Hit@3≈0.1%），得分-代价 Spearman 相关性显著为负。V-JEPA 骨干替换后缺陷依然存在（Push-T 错误率 91.1–97.3%，MetaWorld 仍 100%）。采样预算从 2 增加到 12 不修复排序缺陷。降低重规划频率后：PointMaze 成功率从 89.6% 降至 61.8%（McNemar p=1.51×10⁻⁹），Push-T 从 36.1% 降至 12.5%（p=1.08×10⁻⁹）。在 PointMaze 上，41.7% 的高 Mirage 情节被频繁重规划拯救，而低 Mirage 情节仅 8.3%。拓扑压力审计证实原始终端欧氏距离排序在 100% 锚点上是错误的。

Conclusion: 冻结 JEPA 世界模型中基于潜在距离的动作排序假设在官方检查点上严重失效且具结构性，跨导航和操控域普遍存在，跨视觉骨干持续存在，且无法通过增加采样预算修复。该缺陷之所以长期未被发现，是因为闭环重规划通过每步重新观测掩盖了单步排序错误——这意味着闭环成功率系统性地高估了冻结潜在表示的真实动作可排序性。该工作的核心贡献在于提供 ARC-Bench 这一可报告的度量协议以及闭环重规划掩盖机制的解释，而非提出修复方案。

Abstract: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1 and V-JEPA 2 encoders at ViT-L/ViT-G scale. Provenance, undertraining, matched-budget backbone controls, and metric-circularity controls rule out trivial explanations. We then explain why this defect has stayed invisible: closed-loop replanning masks it. When we reduce the planner's replanning frequency, success collapses in both a navigation and a manipulation domain, and the episodes rescued by frequent replanning are enriched for severe first-plan ranking failures in the PointMaze first-plan diagnostic. Closed-loop success rates therefore systematically overstate the rankability of frozen latent representations. ARC-Bench supplies the measurement, and the masking mechanism the explanation, for methods that adapt, amortize, or replan around latent-space planners without directly auditing released JEPA-WM action rankability.

</details>


### [218] [RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05481)
*Ali Mahdavi,Azadeh Zamanifar,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Omid Kashefi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RAPID（Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation），将关系蒸馏中的"目标可靠性门控"与"自适应采样提议"解耦，通过逆提议修正实现固定关系预算下的条件无偏估计，并在 AG News 与 SST-2 两个文本分类任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: inter-example 关系蒸馏在 mini-batch 内计算所有对具有 O(B²) 复杂度，而均匀子采样对有限的关系预算利用效率低下；同时，对教师关系应赋予多少信任（目标可靠性）与应优先评估哪些关系（评估优先级）是两个不应混淆的设计决策，现有方法（如 RKD、CRD、基于重要性采样的 KD）未将二者分离。

Method: 1) 标签感知的归一化可靠性门控 r_i = max{r_min, sqrt(p_T^cal(y_i) * m_i)}，通过混合系数 λ 在均匀目标与完全门控目标之间插值；2) 基于分解式端点概率 q_a(i,j) = 2*a_i*a_j / Z(a) 的全支持配对提议，静态信号结合标定熵与可靠性，自适应部分逐步引入脱钩的师生残差；3) 端点级和配对级防御混合保证 q_t(i,j) ≥ ε/M；4) 精确逆提议修正使得损失和停止梯度（stopped-proposal）估计量在给定 F_t 条件下无偏，并通过 Cauchy–Schwarz 分析得到标量损失最优提议 ∝ f_ij。

Result: 在 AG News（BERT→DistilBERT，K=256，3 个配对种子）和 SST-2（DistilBERT→DistilBERT，K=64，3 个配对种子）上：可靠性门控关系蒸馏取得最高观测均值（AG News 94.285±0.054%，SST-2 88.800±0.532%），RAPID 紧随其后（94.241±0.025%，88.685±0.462%），均优于交叉熵基线（94.154±0.124%，87.271±0.162%）；在 AG News 上 RAPID 训练时间最短（62.4 min）且显存最低（2127 MB）。但所有方法间的差距均在种子噪声范围内，作者明确表示不主张 RAPID 严格优于纯门控对照。

Conclusion: 论文支持关系蒸馏中"目标可靠性"与"评估优先级"是可分离设计维度的模块化观点；RAPID 通过门控-提议分离、无偏修正、全支持提议与固定预算记账，在两个文本分类场景中均优于交叉熵、KD 和均匀关系采样，但 RAPID 与纯门控方法之间的差距处于种子噪声范围内，因此该结论为提示性而非决定性；未来工作需要在匹配架构下进行多预算扫描、更多配对种子以及直接方差诊断。

Abstract: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

</details>


### [219] [PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05488)
*Weizhi Nie,Rihao Chang,Weijie Wang,Yuting Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN 是一个用于多变量生理指标联合概率预测的"轨迹优先"框架，结合缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特异性动态关系、非线性 Kolmogorov-Arnold 消息传递和低秩多元 Student-t 输出头；在 MIMIC-IV 衍生队列上获得最佳 RMSE 和次低 MAE，且在概率预测各项 proper score 上优于所评估基线，但衍生的次级风险评分弱于专用 GRU-D 分类器，限制了临床声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床恶化涉及耦合且部分观测的多变量生理轨迹，而非单一诊断标签。直接将历史压缩为风险评分的"history-to-label"范式无法揭示变量如何变化、何时跨越阈值或多个器官系统是否共同恶化。需要一个能保留可检查中间表征、显式建模变量与时间不确定性、并分离"生理预测可靠性"与"事件分类能力"的轨迹优先框架。

Method: 1) 缺失感知临床输入：基于掩码 M 与测量间隔 Δ 构造学习式可靠性 r，区分观测/插补/陈旧值；2) 逐变量多尺度 TimeKAN 编码器：FFT 频带分解为 Q 个分量，每分量经 TimeKAN 块（含 Chebyshev 标量 KAN 边）处理后由状态依赖门组合；3) 软器官系统先验：变量-系统映射 S 与系统级软关系 C_organ 经行归一化生成 A_prior；4) 患者特异性动态关系：每时刻 query/key 注意力 + 可靠性偏置生成 A_dyn，由学习门 G 与先验融合 A_rel，并加平滑正则；5) KAN 跨变量消息传递：用 Chebyshev 基函数 ϕ^KAN 替代边权重，输出 m 加 LayerNorm 残差更新；6) 直出式多步解码器；7) 低秩多元 Student-t 输出：Σ = UU⊤ + diag(σ²)，ν>2，共享自由度，配 scale-mixture 采样；8) 掩码联合似然 + Woodbury 加速；9) 由相干样本估计阈值穿越概率与器官功能恶化概率；10) 训练目标含 NLL + 稀疏/平滑/可选风险正则。

Result: 在 6,882 例患者、54,694 窗口、5 个种子、13 个模型的冻结 MIMIC-IV 衍生队列上（24h 历史 → 6h 预测）：归一化 MAE 0.37727±0.00029（次低，GRU-D 最低 0.37636），RMSE 0.52656±0.00034（最低），相对确定性 TimeKAN MAE 降低 0.52%；概率指标边际 NLL 0.66380、CRPS 0.27301、能量分数 0.35715 均最优；经验覆盖率 50/80/95% 为 0.533/0.831/0.958（50%、80% 略保守）。消融：移除关系结构造成最大 MAE 损失（0.38162），KAN 关系最优；协方差秩 2→16 几乎不影响 MAE（≤0.00026）但联合 NLL/obs 从 0.58930 改善至 0.50323。轨迹衍生风险评分 AUROC 0.603，弱于 GRU-D 分类器 0.650；正窗口流行率仅 1.039%。

Conclusion: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN 在 13 个模型中获得最低 RMSE 与次低 MAE，并在所评估概率基线中取得全部最优 proper score；消融与协方差秩分析最有力支持跨变量依赖建模；联合轨迹生成提供可检查的中间表征。但准确的生理预测并不保证校准的事件检测器：次级轨迹衍生风险评分弱于专用分类器，作者明确限定其非临床可部署的脓毒症预测器。联合轨迹建模本身有价值，但临床转化仍需更强的端点证据、完整 SOFA 变量、可审计的感染证据、外部/多中心验证与改进的校准。

Abstract: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

</details>


### [220] [SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05505)
*Miguel Zabaleta,Baihan Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SciLitBench是一个多阶段基准测试，涵盖标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导的数据抽取三个系统综述阶段，基于42,981条记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的标注数据。它评估了来自六个模型家族的22个开源大语言模型，揭示了显式纳入/排除标准可使标题摘要筛选F2提高28.8%，研究者撰写的理由可将全文筛选提高15%，但开放性证据抽取仍是重大瓶颈，最强模型仅能恢复30%的评估证据和25%的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型评估通常孤立地考察综述流程的各个阶段，缺乏对单一语料库上从检索、筛选到抽取全流程的统一基准。此外，自动化证据合成中哪些设计选择能提升可靠性、可靠性是否在各阶段间迁移、以及从低歧义到开放性抽取的过渡中性能如何变化，这三个关键问题尚未得到解答。

Method: 基于一项关于文献综述自动化的真实系统综述构建语料库（42,981条检索记录→1,012篇全文→888篇纳入论文），开发六个抽取字段的迭代式模式（年份、领域、综述阶段、方法、评估结果、局限性）。评估22个来自Llama、Gemma、Qwen、Mistral、Phi、gpt-oss家族的开源LLM，采用标准化提示词（基础/纳入/纳入+排除三种变体）、零样本与少样本对比、强池和宽松池的多数投票集成、token感知的路由集成。对于开放性字段采用校准的LLM-as-a-judge协议（基于100篇校准集和29,724条标注的判断决策）。标注审计包括8-12周后重新标注（标题摘要κ=0.992，全文κ=1.00）以及500条银标排除的污染率估计。

Result: 1）标题摘要筛选：纳入提示使F2提升17.0%，加入排除推理后总提升达28.8%；强池多数投票（F2=0.808）和宽松池（0.803）均超过最佳单模型；组合池在完美召回下精度为0.275，工作量减少约90%。2）全文筛选：输出可靠性取决于参数规模和上下文窗口的联合作用；研究者理由将少样本F2从0.551提升至0.633（提升15%）；最佳单模型Llama 3.3-70B零样本F2达0.981。3）数据抽取：闭式字段从年份准确率0.97降至方法Jaccard 0.37；开放性字段最强模型仅恢复30%评估证据和25%局限性。4）级联实验中，仅12.1%的论文在到达抽取阶段后能完全正确抽取。

Conclusion: 该基准揭示了LLM辅助系统综述中的一个实践可靠性边界：筛选可通过协议设计变得可靠（高召回），但证据完整的抽取在目标变得更具解释性时仍不够可靠。协议设计与模型规模同等重要；可靠筛选是不对称决策问题而非传统分类任务；开放性抽取的主要失败模式是证据覆盖不完整而非无法产生合理输出。人类的判断在过程中向上游移动而非消失，负责定义标准、确定粒度、精炼模式、记录理由。基准以开源模型为中心以确保纵向可复现性。研究结果强调，自动化应减少综述负担而不应使证据路径变得不那么透明可见。

Abstract: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.

</details>


### [221] [SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05511)
*Bowei He,Xiaokun Zhang,Meng Ding,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Scaffold是一个面向视觉网页智能体的自改进框架,通过多实例参数化技能归纳、MDL驱动的技能库压缩、递归组合和权重蒸馏四个核心机制,在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web上以11.1-17.2绝对成功率提升超越现有最强基线,并在5次迭代中持续改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网页智能体将每个任务视为独立片段,丢弃积累的过程性知识;现有技能增强框架使用扁平或两层提示缓存,缺乏冗余压缩和递归组合机制,且知识仅存在于提示中而未内化为模型权重。

Method: 五阶段自改进循环:(1)使用当前策略收集轨迹;(2)基于多实例聚类(≥n_min条相似轨迹)归纳参数化可执行技能并通过保留验证;(3)允许新技能调用任何已有技能实现递归组合并追踪抽象深度；(4)每M次迭代通过MDL准则执行合并(行为等价技能)、重构(重复子序列提升为中层技能)和剪枝(未使用技能)三种算子;(5)将技能增强轨迹通过SFT+辅助技能名预测损失蒸馏到基础策略权重中(LoRA)。

Result: 在WebArena/VWA/OM2W-X上达到42.7%/36.3%/43.5%成功率,较SkillRL提升11.1-17.2绝对点;5次迭代持续改进无库崩溃;技能库规模稳定在约181个技能(无压缩则达470个);平均抽象深度从1.05增至2.71;跨站点迁移35.9% vs SkillWeaver 16.6%;在延迟/DOM扰动/时间漂移下退化≤2.1点;平均每任务12.4个原子动作(优于基线)。

Conclusion: Scaffold的四个组件(多实例归纳、递归组合、MDL压缩、权重蒸馏)协同构成单一闭环机制,共同解决现有技能归纳方法的三大局限;局限包括依赖GPT-4o归纳器、依赖每任务验证器、MDL贪婪近似无收敛保证、跨站点迁移存在天花板以及≤1.2点的蒸馏遗忘。

Abstract: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{ this https URL }{repository}.

</details>


### [222] [Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05512)
*Leonard Twagirayezu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"推理感知压缩"框架，针对大型推理模型(LRMs)如DeepSeek-R1系列，系统性地识别并保护对量化最敏感的推理电路。核心方法是通过对所有196-224个(layer, projection)对进行扰动扫描建立INT4脆弱性剖面，然后选择性将最脆弱的电路恢复为FP16精度。关键发现包括：(1) INT4量化可能因延长推理链反而增加总能耗；(2) 脆弱性具有任务依赖性——注意力投影对数学推理更关键；(3) 选择性压缩可达到均匀量化无法实现的Pareto最优权衡(R1-Qwen-7B Top-10%在ProofWriter上以-9.7%能耗实现+12pp精度提升)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)部署能耗巨大，现有压缩方法如AWQ/GPTQ采用均匀量化，会损害关键推理电路。先前研究表明3-bit量化可使R1-Distill-Llama-8B在AIME 2024上精度从42.2%暴跌至10.0%，但仅保护2%参数(最终层MLP)即可恢复6.57%精度，说明量化损伤高度局部化。然而现有方法存在三个局限：(1) 校准数据基于WikiText-2等通用语料而非推理任务；(2) 将模型视为黑盒处理能耗，不归因到具体模块；(3) 机械可解释性工作未衡量压缩脆弱性与能耗影响。因此需要回答核心问题：哪些(layer, projection)对最容易受量化影响，保护它们如何在精度与能耗间权衡？

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 分组量化模块类型保护——通过INT4+Attention(恢复q/k/v/o至FP16)与INT4+MLP(恢复gate/up/down至FP16)两类粗粒度条件，确定任务相关的投影类型重要性；(2) 扰动扫描脆弱性分析——在FP16模型上对每个(layer, projection)对逐一量化为INT4，在30个校准样本上评估精度下降V(l,p)=baseline_acc-quantized_acc；(3) 选择性压缩——基于脆弱性排名将Top-K%(K∈{10%,20%,30%,40%})最敏感模块恢复至FP16，其余保持INT4。实验在Tesla V100-SXM2 GPU上采用NVML以100ms间隔采样功耗，每查询能耗E=P̄×Δt。数据采用50/50划分：校准集(仅用于脆弱性打分)与留存评估集(所有报告指标)以消除循环性。模型为R1-Distill-Llama-8B(224对)与R1-Distill-Qwen-7B(196对)，数据集涵盖GSM8K、FOLIO、MATH-500、ProofWriter、MuSiQue五个推理基准。

Result: 三大核心发现：(1) INT4量化可能因延长推理链而增加能耗——R1-Llama-8B在GSM8K上Full INT4生成1094 token(vs FP16 891 token，+22.8%)，将25%功耗降低转化为22.9%能耗增加；(2) 脆弱性任务依赖——注意力投影对数学推理更关键(INT4+Attention在MATH-500上两模型均获最佳精度：Llama-8B +2.50pp，Qwen-7B +3.75pp)，而逻辑推理中Qwen-7B Full INT4在ProofWriter上达77.08%(+7.50pp vs FP16)，表明均匀量化对形式演绎任务起隐式正则化作用；(3) 选择性压缩实现Pareto最优——R1-Qwen-7B Top-10%在ProofWriter上达84.00%精度(+12pp vs FP16)同时降低9.7%能耗(1743J vs 1931J)。Llama-8B在MATH-500上Top-20%获49.17%精度(+35.84pp vs FP16)。但方法存在限制：ProofWriter上Llama-8B的校准排序未能泛化至评估集；MuSiQue因基线精度过低无法可靠检测模块脆弱性。INT4+MLP因MLP占参数79.9%，恢复后内存超FP16基线，需≥24GB VRAM。附录B的消融实验显示Top-K%在MATH-500上一致优于Random-K%与Bottom-K%，但在FOLIO/GSM8K上差异不显著。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了推理感知压缩作为LRMs能效部署的有效策略。三项部署可操作发现：(1) 对LRMs必须进行硬件级每查询能耗采样——因为INT4功率降低可能被推理链延长完全抵消甚至逆转；(2) 脆弱性具任务依赖性，无通用保护策略适用于所有任务类型，数学推理应保护注意力投影，逻辑推理可考虑均匀量化作为正则化器；(3) 选择性压缩可达到均匀方法无法企及的Pareto前沿点，但前提是校准阶段脆弱性信号足够强(如ProofWriter Qwen-7B)。未来工作方向包括：低秩近似恢复层以降低内存开销、跨数据集泛化的任务自适应脆弱性排序、30B-70B规模模型评估。论文同时承认了硬件单一(V100)、30样本评估在MuSiQue等低精度场景统计效力不足、仅评估训练后压缩而未涉及QAT等局限性。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [223] [When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05513)
*Jianwei Zhang,Sihan Cao,Pengcheng Zheng,Ya Wen,Pei Ke,Kuien Liu,Shen Gao,Wei Dong,Yang Yang,Chaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对部署后网络 Agent 在线适配中调用教师模型成本高昂的问题，本文提出"Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming"框架，从"何时教"（episode 级的可解性感知教师门控）和"教什么"（turn 级的分数引导选择）两个维度优化预算分配，可在保持相当的首过成功率的同时显著降低教师调用与学生训练计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署大尺寸专有模型作为 Web Agent 成本过高，实际应用中往往使用轻量本地模型并依赖部署后在线教学。然而，标准交互式反馈成本居高：教师并非对所有失败都可解，且长轨迹中充斥冗余动作；无差别的全轨迹偏好优化在 episode 与 turn 两个粒度上都存在严重的预算浪费。

Method: 将在线教学建模为双预算（教师调用预算 B_T、学生训练 token 预算 B_S）下的首过成功率最大化问题，并提出两阶段机制：(1) 可解性感知教师门控——维护基于语义任务表征 ϕ(·) 的 k-NN 历史记忆 M，估计教师对当前失败的可解性 p̂_t，仅当 p̂_t ≥ λ（且检索证据充分时才覆盖）才发起教师调用；(2) 分数引导的 turn 选择——在获得教师成功的正负轨迹对后，对正例保留学生当前 log-prob 最低（最难）的 M 个 turn，对负例保留 log-prob 最高（最易重复错误）的 M 个 turn，组装裁剪后的偏好对。该裁剪对可与任意轨迹级偏好优化目标兼容（实例化为 DPO 与 SimPO 两种载体）。

Result: 在 MiniWoB（125 集流）与 TimeWarp（150 集流）上，使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 作为学生、GPT-4o 作为教师：在 DPO 与 SimPO 两种载体下，加入查询门控 + turn 选择后，平均教师调用减少 22.6%，学生 PFLOPs 减少 52.1%，首过成功率与全轨迹基线相当或更高（如 TimeWarp SimPO：50/150 → 46/150，但 PFLOPs 由 37.96 降至 19.86；MiniWoB DPO：37.5/125 → 40.5/125，PFLOPs 由 16.66 降至 8.45）。消融实验表明：负侧裁剪是 MiniWoB 上效率提升的主要来源（−36% PFLOPs）；门控在不同 λ、ε_exp 与随机基线相比均稳定多 +2.5 至 +5.9 次 oracle 命中；turn 预算与 β 在合理范围内结果稳健。

Conclusion: 本文将网络 Agent 的在线教学形式化为预算分配问题，并提出 episode 级可解性门控与 turn 级分数引导裁剪的双阶段框架，在不损害首过成功率的前提下显著降低了教师调用与学生训练开销，为可扩展、成本可控的在线 Agent 适配提供了一个高效范式。局限：仅在仿真基准上评估，依赖通用嵌入做 k-NN，单教师假设，未来将探索多教师与自改进教师配置。

Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [224] [The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05514)
*Farah Atif,Sougata Saha,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文基于世界价值观调查（WVS）构建大规模多智能体仿真框架（1,200个角色、约4,000次对话、15个话题、3个LLM：GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemma-4-E4B），发现LLM智能体在首次对话中即有超过50%未能表达所分配的WVS价值观（实例化失败），而仅有2-7%在多次对话后发生价值观漂移。模拟对话表现出"风格趋同但内容分散"的模式，与人类对话相反。去除人口统计信息反而提高价值忠实度，表明人口统计条件化反而干扰价值表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体被广泛用作社会科学研究中人类参与者的替代品，但其能否忠实模拟多样化且相互冲突的人类价值系统尚不清楚。现有评估多为静态问卷式，未测试在持续交互中价值是否能被表达并保持。

Method: 1）从WVS第七波数据中采样约1,200个真实人类参与者作为persona基础；2）根据Inglehart-Welzel文化地图推断其在"传统-世俗理性"和"生存-自我表达"两维上的价值取向（高/中/低三档）；3）随机分配四种沟通风格（说服性×接受性）；4）按职业分组（5组），每组设计3个职业相关话题（共15个）；5）两两随机跨文化配对进行多轮对话（约15轮），使用结构化记忆累积历史；6）使用Gemini-3-Flash作为评判器，在严格和宽松两种标准下评估价值忠实度、价值漂移和对话真实性（对话行为+SentenceBERT嵌入）。

Result: 1）实例化失败为主：超过50%的persona在首次对话即未能表达分配的WVS价值观；2）漂移较少：仅有2-7%的persona在多次对话后出现价值漂移；3）说服型沟通风格是导致不忠实的最强预测因子（OR=3.29-5.04）；4）模拟社会的最终价值分布系统性地偏向Traditional/Survival象限，而Balanced/Balanced细胞收缩；5）去除人口统计信息显著提高GPT-4o和Gemini的忠实度（+23-27%），说明人口统计条件化反而干扰价值表达；6）GPT-4o风格最一致（与人类最不相似），Gemma-4-E4B风格最多样；人类对话呈"风格多样但内容相似"，而LLM呈"风格趋同但内容分散"。

Conclusion: LLM智能体能生成看似合理的对话，但作为人类价值分布代理存在根本局限：主要失败发生在实例化阶段而非漂移阶段，人口统计信息丰富的提示并不能保障价值忠实度。因此LLM社会模拟应被视为"模型中介的工具"而非虚拟受访者，需对目标人群进行验证，否则可能放大WEIRD偏见和算法单文化问题。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

</details>


### [225] [Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05527)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TEAM-Design，一种针对"人-AI协同工作流是否值得保留"这一部署决策的预算化重放设计方法。它解决了在固定预算下应优先重放哪些任务的哪个基线（人-only或agent-only）的问题，通过为每个任务分配两个重放概率来优化决策目标，并通过理论证明和实验验证了其有效性和最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在编码智能体协助工程师、临床模型辅助放射科医生等部署场景中，关键问题是人-AI协同工作流是否值得保留——即它是否同时优于"人单独"和"agent单独"两种替代方案。然而一旦部署，这两种替代结果均未被观测到；获取任一基线结果都需要额外的专家时间或计算开销重放任务。在固定重放预算下，现有方法（智能体基准、基于方差的采样、贝叶斯信息方法）均未直接针对这一部署决策，因此需要一种能够明确选择测量哪个缺失基线的评估设计。

Method: TEAM-Design为每个任务分配两个重放概率（人-only和agent-only各一个），概率在闭式形式中确定。其核心思想是：提高难以预测缺失基线结果且该比较更难确立的任务的重放概率，降低重放成本高昂的任务的概率。问题被形式化为凸极小极大规划：外层最大化取两个比较中更难的一个，内层最小化使该比较尽可能容易解决。证明表明平方根规则是该问题的精确解。该方法利用小规模试点集（所有三种配置均运行）来估计所需的预测难度、增益差距等量，然后基于此设置评估池的重放概率。理论上证明了基于试点选择重放概率后随机重放仍可控制错误判定工作流优于两者的概率，且无需多重性校正（作为交集-并集检验）。

Result: 在6个临床设置（8723次阅读）中，辅助临床医生均优于单独临床医生但劣于单独模型，没有任何设置中人-AI工作流同时优于两个替代方案。在合成实验中，当一个比较明显更难时，TEAM-Design在77.1%的重复中判定工作流优于两者，而Neyman分配仅为65.1%；但当两个比较同等困难时，Neyman表现更好。在基于真实胸部X光研究的半合成设计中，TEAM-Design在每个低于完全重放的预算下对更难基线的增益估计误差最低。高斯获取研究中，TEAM-Design达到76.3%的功效，而参数-EIG和均等分配仅约60%。敏感度分析显示，成本比从5:1扩大到10:1时优势缩小，但结果在ρ=0.75的相关性下仍稳健。

Conclusion: TEAM-Design是首个直接针对部署决策的评估设计，通过为每个任务分配两个重放概率，在固定预算下优化测量哪些缺失基线。它特别适用于两个基线比较难度不均衡的场景，此时优于基于方差的方法（Neyman分配）。但当两个比较同等困难时，它可能不如Neyman。该方法将试点的作用限定于设定效率而非决定有效性——不良试点导致低效设计但不影响错误率。临床证据表明，许多声称"AI帮助人类"的部署实际上并未同时击败两个替代方案，这凸显了采用更严格决策标准的重要性。

Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

</details>


### [226] [EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05553)
*Zeyang Cui,Jiannong Cao,Zhiyuan Wen,Bo Yuan,Junlan Feng,Shengyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EdgeMem提出了一种无需LLM的智能体记忆框架，通过保留原始交互轮次并构建多锚点超图（时间、共现、情节子图），实现高效的证据级记忆构建与检索，在多个基准上以更低成本达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的记忆方法在构建和检索阶段反复调用生成模型，导致高昂的token成本，且摘要或提取过程可能在不知未来查询需求的情况下丢失关键证据细节，损害答案保真度。

Method: 保留原始交互轮次，使用轻量级本地NLP工具（spaCy命名实体识别、BM25、dateparser）提取实体、词汇和日期锚点，构建包含时间子超图、共现子超图和情节子超图的多锚点超图；检索时通过确定性规则激活匹配超边，按情节为核心、共现和时间为补充的固定预算策略融合证据包，仅在最终答案生成阶段调用单一reader LLM。

Result: 在LoCoMo上以共享提示取得严格评分最高分61.01（对比最强基线58.70），对抗性问题上精确拒答率92.57%；在LongMemEval-S上取得最佳会话级Recall@3（81.49）和NDCG@3（90.49），仅使用竞品36%的token；记忆构建和检索实现零生成式LLM调用，构建时间1.8分钟，每查询约1.3秒。

Conclusion: 保留原始证据并通过确定性多锚点结构组织访问路径，可以在不使用生成式记忆管理的情况下，为智能体记忆提供有效且高效的基础，源证据保真度与结构化检索的结合避免了生成式压缩造成的信息不可逆丢失。

Abstract: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achieves the highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems under a shared prompt (61.01 versus 58.70), while construction and retrieval require no generative-LLM calls. Overall, EdgeMem shows that preserving and organizing source evidence provides an effective and efficient foundation for agent memory without generative memory management.

</details>


### [227] [Deep belief networks are exact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05572)
*Gleb Smirnov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 证明任意严格正的概率分布在{-1,1}^n上可以被有限参数的sigmoid信念网络精确表示，使用Brouwer不动点定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答Sutskever和Hinton提出的开放问题：是否每个严格正的概率分布都能被sigmoid信念网络精确表示（而非仅近似）。Le Roux和Bengio以及Sutskever和Hinton之前的结果只证明了通用逼近性。

Method: 1. 回顾Sutskever-Hinton的sharing构造（近似版本）；2. 通过大权重w构造sigmoid信念网络，使sharing近似误差随w指数衰减且关于参数p一致；3. 将sharing映射Φ和有限网络映射Φ_w视为(0,1)^M→Δ°的连续映射，利用一致性收敛构造自映射T(p)=p*+p-Φ^{-1}(Φ_w(p))；4. 由Brouwer不动点定理得T存在不动点p，使得Φ_w(p)=目标分布π。

Result: 定理1.1：每个严格正分布在{-1,1}^n上可被最大层宽n+1、深度3(2^n-1)+1的sigmoid信念网络精确表示。严格正性是必要的，因为有限参数的sigmoid网络必然具有完全支撑。该证明是存在性的，不提供构造算法。

Conclusion: 解决了Sutskever-Hinton关于sigmoid信念网络精确表示能力的开放问题。证明表明有限参数网络可以精确表示任意严格正分布，但严格正条件是必要的。证明方法依赖Brouwer不动点定理，是存在性而非构造性证明，未来工作可寻找构造性证明。

Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

</details>


### [228] [EnvCraft: Synthesizing Executable Environments in Agentic RL for Claw-like Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05576)
*Yirong Zeng,Shen You,Jinhang Feng,Yufei Liu,Xiao Ding,Yutai Hou,Hao Cong,Yuxian Wang,Wu Ning,Wang Xu,Bibo Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnvCraft是一个自动化框架，用于合成可执行环境和可扩展的训练数据，专门用于训练Claw-like智能体。它通过环境合成引擎构建沙箱隔离的工作空间，并通过拓扑感知的数据生成引擎产生连贯的任务轨迹，最终合成了139个交互式环境和约20K的复杂任务用于Agentic RL训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM范式已从被动语言接口快速转向在有状态工作空间中执行长期任务的自主Claw-like智能体。Agentic强化学习（Agentic RL）为优化这些智能体提供了一条有前景的路径，但其规模化严重受限于交互式训练环境的严重稀缺。现有的合成环境严格局限于工具调用端点，不足以满足claw-like智能体端到端的真实世界需求。

Method: EnvCraft通过两个互补的引擎运行：环境合成引擎（基于九种交互原型，采用原型驱动的合成框架，从自然语言描述生成可执行、沙箱隔离的环境）和数据生成引擎（通过拓扑感知采样策略，基于环境内变量和跨环境工具依赖构建双层有向图，通过加权随机游走产生语义连贯的工具链，进而逆向工程多轮用户意图并生成确定性验证脚本）。所有合成的环境和数据均经过严格的质量审计（静态代码分析、动态运行时分析、基于LLM的质量审计和难度校准）。

Result: 实验在Qwen3/3.5模型（8B-32B）上展示了：1）在Claw-style基准测试上提升高达+11.9%；2）在通用工具使用基准测试上提升+8.0%；3）推理token成本同时降低高达35%。结果证实，合成的可执行环境为训练提供了稳健且可泛化的学习信号。

Conclusion: EnvCraft是一个端到端合成框架，自动化从自然语言描述生成可执行环境和可验证RL训练任务的过程，消除了手动环境工程的需求。本文贡献了139个RL环境和约20K的训练实例。实验证明在Claw-style和通用工具使用基准测试上均取得持续提升，同时降低了推理token成本。这些结果表明，可扩展的自动化环境合成是训练claw-like智能体的可行途径。

Abstract: The paradigm of LLMs has rapidly shifted from passive language interfaces to autonomous Claw-like agents that execute long-horizon tasks across stateful workspaces. While Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) provides a promising path to optimize these agents, its scaling is heavily bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of interactive training environments. Existing synthetic environments are strictly limited to tool-calling endpoints, rendering them insufficient for accommodating the end-to-end real-world demands of claw-like agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnvCraft, an automated framework for synthesizing executable environments and scalable training data. Specifically, EnvCraft employs an environment synthesis engine to build sandbox-isolated workspaces, alongside a topology-aware data generation engine to produce coherent task trajectories. Overall, we synthesize 139 interactive environments comprising approximately 20K complex tasks for Agentic RL training. Experiments on Qwen3/3.5 models (8B-32B) show that our method yields gains of up to +11.9% on Claw-style benchmarks and +8.0% on general tool-use benchmarks, with concurrent reductions in inference token cost. The results confirm that synthesized executable environments provide robust and generalizable learning signals for training.

</details>


### [229] [Planning and Scheduling Business Processes under Control-Flow Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05578)
*Michel Kunkler,Stefanie Rinderle-Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对业务流程中由于运行时决策导致的控制流不确定性，提出了一种机会约束优化框架，将活动的"规划"与"调度"结合起来，以最小化完工时间（makespan）。作者提出了两种方法：一种两阶段的分解方法（先规划最小化冗余活动，再调度最小化makespan）和一种集成方法（将两者统一为一个优化模型）。在三个数据集上的评估显示，集成方法能产生更优的makespan但难以扩展，而分解方法可扩展到大规模场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业务流程调度可提升效率（如缩短完工时间），但面临控制流不确定性挑战：案例完成所需的活动序列往往因运行时数据决策而不可预知。现有研究要么仅调度到不确定性可消除为止，要么采用在线资源分配，削弱了调度的可见性优势。因此需要一种能在整个案例周期内进行规划与调度的框架，利用历史日志的概率信息平衡可行性（完成概率）与资源利用率（避免过多冗余活动）。

Method: 采用基于随机过程树（SPT）的形式化建模，包含顺序（→）、并行（+）、排他选择（×）和redo循环（↻）四种算子。提出了两种机会约束优化方法：（1）分解方法：第一阶段通过MINLP选择分支与循环迭代次数，最小化期望冗余活动数，满足可行性阈值θ；第二阶段将过程树展开并调度以最小化makespan，允许互斥活动共享资源。多案例情形下使用统一选择（θ=E/n）。（2）集成方法：将规划与调度合并为单一MINLP，允许按案例选择，并允许非互斥活动重叠调度。通过定义活动优先级、执行场景、威胁活动集等概念构建跨案例的可行性下界𝔼_fc，作为机会约束。使用Google OR-Tools CP-SAT实现。

Result: 在Repair Shop（合成）、BPIC-14I和BPIC-17W（两个真实数据集）上评估，使用AMD Ryzen 9 PRO 8945HS、32GB RAM、单次运行20分钟时限。分解方法的规划阶段始终快速且最优，调度阶段是瓶颈；除最复杂的BPIC-17W N=50外，所有配置都找到可行调度。集成方法在N=5的Repair Shop/BPIC-14I和N=1的BPIC-17W上可行，相比分解方法产生更短makespan但活动数更多。集成方法在大规模配置下基本无法在时限内找到可行解。基线（单一最可能路径）在BPIC-14I简单结构上接近分解方法，但在BPIC-17W上可行性极低。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了解决方案质量与可扩展性之间的权衡：集成方法虽能产生更优makespan但扩展性差，分解方法在几乎所有测试配置中都能可靠找到可行调度。实践意义在于：调度至案例完成（而非仅至下一个决策点）使资源能预先安排活动并向客户做出可靠承诺；可行性阈值充当管理杠杆，平衡重新调度风险与预留但可能未用的容量（类似超额预订）。所有输入均可从事件日志中发现，便于集成到现有流程感知信息系统。局限在于循环中排他选择的分支选择对所有迭代统一，可能导致次优计划。未来工作可研究迭代相关的分支选择，并将处理时间不确定性纳入控制流不确定性。

Abstract: Scheduling activities in business processes can improve efficiency (e.g., reduce makespan), but is challenging because the exact sequence of activities required to complete a case is often uncertain due to decisions based on data that emerges during execution. Nevertheless, probabilistic information regarding such decisions can often be estimated or derived from historical execution logs, and can help anticipate which execution paths are likely to lead to successful completion. Planning with particular execution paths affects feasibility, i.e., the probability of successful completion, and the expected number of superfluous activities that are planned but never executed. We frame the problem as a chance-constrained optimization problem and present two formulations: A decomposed approach with two stages, a planning stage that minimizes the expected number of superfluous activities subject to a feasibility constraint, and a scheduling stage that minimizes the makespan over the planned activities; and an integrated approach that combines planning and scheduling into a single formulation. Evaluation on two real-world and one synthetic dataset shows that the integrated approach yields superior makespans but is intractable at scale, while the decomposed approach scales to large settings.

</details>


### [230] [Agents Trust Tools Too Much: Measuring Reliance on Unreliable Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05587)
*Hoyeol Yang,Woojung Song,Taewon Kim,Jonghyun Song,Seoyeon Park,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文识别并系统量化了工具型智能体的一种持续性故障：即使工具返回的内容看似合理却实际错误，智能体仍可能将其写入最终答案。作者在网络搜索、LLM 子智能体和代码执行三种工具上测试14个模型，并用“采纳率”和“覆盖正确初始答案的覆盖率”刻画问题。结果显示，P1错误在三种工具中的平均采纳率均超过三分之一，其中搜索为68.0%；即使智能体已展示出独立作答能力，覆盖率仍分别为56.4%、27.2%和33.4%。更严重的是，模型常在推理中发现冲突、算出正确答案，却仍给出未经说明的错误答案。用户提示、可信度元数据和后训练均未形成跨工具、跨模型一致的修复方案。论文的核心结论不是减少工具使用，而是对工具输出进行验证，并在出现未解决冲突时透明告知用户。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用评测通常默认搜索、代码执行器和子智能体等工具返回正确结果，主要衡量工具选择、调用和任务完成能力，却没有考察当工具返回“可信但错误”的内容时，智能体会否盲目采纳。这种可靠性假设在生成式搜索摘要、模型生成代码和LLM子智能体等真实系统中并不成立。因此，论文聚焦一个基础安全问题：智能体是否过度信任工具返回，以及这种行为能否通过提示、工具元数据或后训练缓解。

Method: 研究构建三类工具化评测：1）网络搜索：基于418个FreshQA事实问题，将正确结果替换为P1可信错误、P2移植自其他问题的值或P3虚构值；2）LLM子智能体：对45份文档生成准确摘要，并在45个条件中分别替换核心事实或添加虚假陈述；3）代码执行器：300道六类算术题，在成功执行后按预先冻结的倍率、方向和符号扰动标准输出。关键指标为Adoption rate（最终答案采用注入错误内容的比例）和Override rate（模型无工具三次作答多数正确时，仍被错误返回覆盖的比例）。研究测试14个模型，并比较Thinking配置、信息呈现方式、提示策略、来源/可靠性元数据及Recovery SFT、Correct-tool SFT和Fixed-context DPO。结果使用项目级bootstrap置信区间、严格曝光门控、模型判定及人工验证。

Result: 14个模型没有一族能跨三种工具稳定抵抗错误返回。P1平均Adoption率在搜索、子智能体、代码执行器上分别为68.0%、40.5%和35.4%，均超过三分之一；Override率分别为56.4%、27.2%和33.4%，表明大量错误返回覆盖了模型本可独立答对的答案。即使在永不过时事实上，搜索P1采纳和覆盖率也达59.7%和53.9%；子智能体在模型知识截止前已有材料上仍达24.5%和19.0%。代码执行器对保号错误尤其敏感：保号时的采纳率为56.4%，变号时降至14.3%。推理轨迹进一步揭示，搜索中约一半最终采纳错误的轨迹提到冲突，代码执行中超过90%提到冲突，很多还推导出正确值，但最终回答几乎不警告用户；总体警告率仅搜索5.3%、执行器1.8%。干预方面，Compare、Verify或Disclose仅对部分模型/工具有效，常伴随正常返回准确率下降或方向反转；可信度元数据没有稳定效果，被要求考虑元数据后，高可靠性标签反而使采纳率增加3.7–4.5个百分点；Fixed-context DPO在搜索上降低P1采纳率5.1个百分点，却降低正常返回准确率1.7个百分点，且没有迁移到代码执行器。

Conclusion: 该研究证明，工具型智能体对不可靠返回的过度信任是一种跨搜索、委派和执行渠道普遍存在、且难以由单一策略消除的系统性故障。其高风险表现不是模型完全没有察觉，而是内部推理已发现冲突、恢复正确值，最终输出却隐藏冲突并提交错误答案。工具并非应被弃用；目标应转向“受治理的依赖”，包括独立验证关键工具输出、对无法解决的冲突进行明确披露，以及联合评测正常返回准确率、错误返回抵抗率和冲突披露率。提示、来源标签、可靠性标签和简单后训练均不足以提供跨工具的一致保障，未来系统需要更通用的验证机制及透明报告能力。

Abstract: Existing evaluations of tool-using agents primarily measure whether an agent can successfully complete diverse tasks with tools. These evaluations generally assume that tools return reliable information. However, tool returns in real-world systems can be plausible yet incorrect. We investigate how agents respond to unreliable tool returns by evaluating fourteen LLMs using three tools-web search, LLM sub-agent delegation, and code execution. For each tool, we corrupt its returns and measure whether agents adopt the corrupted content in their final answers. Agents exhibit high levels of overtrust across all three settings: the mean adoption rate exceeds one third for every tool and reaches 68.0% for web search. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals a particularly concerning failure mode: agents often recognize conflicts and even recover the correct answer internally, yet present only the corrupted answer without warning the user. To mitigate agents' overtrust in tool returns, we intervene at three levels: prompting by the user, metadata from the tool provider, and post-training by the agent builder. Although some interventions help for particular models or tools, none consistently mitigates overtrust across tools. These findings identify overtrust in unreliable tools as a serious and persistent failure mode, motivating evaluations and interventions that enable agents to validate tool outputs and transparently communicate unresolved conflicts.

</details>


### [231] [The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05643)
*Eliu Huerta,Xiaoyun Wang,Geetika Gupta,Edward H. Sargent,Cameron J. Owen,Victor Fung,Abhishek Mitra,Austin Cheng,Emma Bouchard,Shams Mehdi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评论探讨了人工智能推理、自主实验、高性能计算和量子计算四项技术浪潮的融合,如何重塑化学与材料科学发现范式,提出"会聚实验室"(convergent laboratory)概念,并以催化剂发现为例展示了 LLM 推理代理、MLIP 势函数、自驱动实验室(SDL)和容错量子计算(FTQC)在自主智能体框架下的端到端集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学发现长期受限于"一个研究者、一个实验台、一个实验"的串行模式,速率瓶颈在于数据生成与知识整合的割裂。论文旨在论证:当 LLM 科学推理、SDL、MLIP、FTQC 与自主智能体框架同步成熟时,化学发现范式将发生变革性跃迁,并呼吁以开放基础设施保障可复现性与可及性。

Method: 文章采用"会聚"论述结构,围绕五大能力展开:(1) NVIDIA Nemotron/NeMo-RL/NeMo Gym 开源科学推理与强化学习栈;(2) Sargent 团队 7 类 SDL 及 GAM Changer 可编辑玻璃箱分类器,以及 CMU AI Science Foundry/ASAP 云实验室;(3) CMU Isayev 团队的 AIMNet2 系列 MLIP(含 AIMNet2-Rxn、AIMNet2-Pd);(4) PsiQuantum 光子容错量子计算平台,结合 BLISS、THC、DFTHC 算法压缩电子结构资源;(5) Lila Sciences 自主智能体框架贯穿"假设—干实验—湿实验—分析"全链条。最终以催化剂发现为案例,论证端到端闭环工作流的乘数效应。

Result: (1) Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 在 LabBench 视觉科学问答上匹配或超越 GPT-4o-mini,文献检索 oracle 得分 89%;(2) Sargent 团队通过可编辑玻璃箱 SDL,将 CO₂ 电还原丙烯选择性催化剂发现时间从约 60 周缩短至 5 周;(3) AIMNet2-Rxn 在 650 个反应上正确区分 Diels-Alder endo/exo 选择性,精度 ~0.5 kcal/mol;AIMNet2-Pd 几分钟内在 CPU 上完成 Suzuki-Miyaura 循环;(4) PsiQuantum 与 Boehringer Ingelheim 合作,使 P450 heme 与 FeMoco 主动空间估算运行时间分别缩短约 234 倍与 278 倍,DFTHC 进一步将 FeMoco Toffoli 成本再降 4.3 倍;(5) Lila 智能体已用于性能优于商业品的 mRNA 疗法及产氢催化剂发现。

Conclusion: "会聚实验室"已成现实而非远景——五大组件当下均已存在,工程整合可行且已显现威力;未来化学发现的速度限制将从"产生数据"转向"跨模态知识整合"。论文呼吁化学界积极参与塑造这一融合,坚持开放、可复现、以人为本的研究文化。

Abstract: This Comment emerges from TPC26 ( this https URL ), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.

</details>


### [232] [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663)
*T.J. Barton,Chris Constantakis,Patti Hauseman,Annie Mous,Alaska Hoffman,Brian Bergeron,Hunter Goodreau*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于两个生产系统的六个月、群体规模的LLM交易代理实证记录(7.5M次调用、30万链上动作、14596笔成交),核心结论是:运行层(滑块、渲染、订单路径)而非模型推理决定代理行为;两类代理群体均无方向性收益,且在剥头皮交易中DXAP代理落后于零售基准(胜率41% vs 50%)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于LLM交易代理的评估主要依赖排行榜P&L和时间窗较短的锦标赛,缺乏在生产环境中以群体规模长期记录"用户-代理-执行"完整追踪的连续观测,无法定位行为由系统哪一层真正决定、收益损失从何而来。

Method: 利用DX Terminal Pro(3,505个金库,21天,真实ETH,Base memecoin市场,单模型Qwen3-235B)与DXAP live alpha(500-599个用户代理,69天,Hyperliquid永续,多模型,以qwen3.7-plus为主)两个共享设计谱系的系统;以日聚类推断、排列零假设、统一费率重述、揭示偏好指标、pre-registered RDD、固定效应模型与配对重放模型联赛为分析手段;证据按firm/provisional分级,包含自身三次撤稿。

Result: 1) 运行层决定行为:riskTolerance滑块每级解释+0.425倍杠杆;代理固定效应吸收60%方差;排行榜渲染边界在rank-3/rank-4处产生1.75×选择率跳跃(因果RDD)。2) 仓位对波动性视而不见:六个波动性六分位中位杠杆均为5.0×;动量姿态×频率滑块5单元格(占账户11%)承载62%的爆仓。3) 捕获缺口巨大:43.2%头寸24h内触及+300bps有利偏移,但其中49.3%以负收益平仓;2%/4%机械括号可挽回+39.0bps/仓位。4) 无方向性优势:DXAP在四天往返胜率41%(零售基准50%),累计实现P&L −$217K(5.5bps费率重述后);决策联赛中三种前沿模型回放遗憾差异不显著(min p=0.46),仅选择稳定性差异显著;内存写入频率与P&L负相关(ρ=−0.200)。

Conclusion: 生产LLM交易代理的行为、收益与失败模式由运行层决定,而非模型推理或策略文本;建设性干预集中于订单路径(原子化带保护的开仓、波动率缩放杠杆、渲染A/B)而非提示工程或模型选择;前沿模型在当前时间尺度下决策质量难以区分,差异化必须来自以自身生产环境为训练分布的微调/RL;附17条方法论规范作为可迁移产出。

Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate). A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.

</details>


### [233] [CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05708)
*Chung-En Johnny Yu,David Garcia,Brian Jalaian,Nathaniel D. Bastian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CUSP提出了一种无需训练、无需logit/校准标签的异构VLM系统级不确定性量化框架，通过语义意见池化将多个VLM的采样响应映射到共享语义空间，输出集体不确定性（collective uncertainty）与JSD两个互补信号，并证明集合熵可精确分解为个体熵均值加JSD，在静态多VLM集成与多智能体轨迹场景中均取得优于多数投票与朴素选择基线的预测错误检测与弃答排序性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单模型置信度或聚合答案的置信度无法刻画异构VLM集成或多智能体系统的整体可靠性；现有UQ方法要么针对单模型，要么止步于选择式聚合，无法在系统层面分离"总体分散度"与"模型间冲突"，且商用API常限制logit访问。需要一个无需logit/校准、训练-free的系统级信号，同时区分dispersion与conflict。

Method: 将K个VLM对同一多模态输入x=(I,q)的N个自由形式响应映射到共享语义响应空间S_x（用LLM-based语义等价判定聚类），对每个模型构建经验语义意见p̂_k(s^j|x)；以均匀权重做线性意见池化（Linear Opinion Pooling）得到合并意见p̄_M；定义归一化集体不确定性U_M = H(p̄_M)/log_2 J；定义JSD = H(p̄_M)−(1/K)ΣH(p̂_k)刻画模型间冲突，并利用广义JSD分解得到精确恒等式 H_M^coll = H̄_M^ind + D_JS。在多智能体场景中对每个证据获取轮t计算轮次级U_M,t与D_M,t，再用时序均值/最大聚合为轨迹信号。

Result: 静态集成（ScienceQA/MMMU-Pro，56/20/20个三VLM系统）：小模型下collective uncertainty达0.764 AUROC/0.889 AUARC，优于多数投票与朴素选择4.7–15.8点，且随集成规模扩大差距扩大；大模型下0.906/0.987；商用模型下JSD最强（0.819/0.910），硬答案冲突诊断AUROC高达0.982；池化预测准确率较单模型均值提升5.6–13.0个百分点；聚合开销仅微秒级，可忽略。多智能体（100 ScienceQA，3轮证据采集）：collective uncertainty轨迹AUARC最佳（0.699，max聚合），AUROC达0.619，显著优于随机。均匀池化在多数配置下优于不确定性加权变体。

Conclusion: CUSP为异构VLM系统提供了一种无需logit/校准、训练-free的统一系统级不确定性框架，集合熵精确分解为个体不确定性均值与JSD之和，明确分离dispersion与conflict两个互补信号；实验验证其在静态集成与多智能体轨迹中均支持预测错误检测、弃答排序与冲突诊断，并为池化预测带来准确率增益。未来工作应降低采样与语义映射开销，并探索在线验证/弃答策略。

Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. Requiring neither token logits nor calibration labels, CUSP applies to open-weight and commercial VLMs alike.
