An independent layout-only planner handles all 72 structural transitions but establishes only 54 complete obligations; a byte-only minimizer proposes 40 semantically invalid candidates, all rejected by SemBridge. On nine real edges, SemBridge produces distinct observation-aware plans that reduce startups on all nine and payload bytes on the three result edges. A live CUDA/CANN run derives and executes full-logit reconstruction, source projection, and owner-token delivery from log-probability, token-only, and owner-scoped requests. On a measured two-host 1-GbE capacity-spillover deployment, source projection cuts result traffic by more than 99.97% and increases throughput by 8.92-80.20% across Dense, MoE, and MiniMax workloads. All 18 MiniMax restart pairs at concurrency 1, 8, and 16 favor source projection. A Qwen3-14B MLP slice additionally verifies bitwise activation-shard delivery and HCCL completion of row-parallel partials. These results establish consumer observation as a semantic layer between placement and collective execution.

</details>


### [474] [Sample-Guided Exact Top-K Selection for Long-Context Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08450)
*Siran Liu,Yang Xue,Theo Tang,Changxu Shao,Qian Cheng,Haimeng Ren,Donghua Jiang,Haipeng Ming,Lehua Ding,Zhonghan Lin,Shengying Wei,Wei Liu,Kai Liu,Jianchen Zhu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 HPC-Ops Top-K，一种基于采样引导的精确 Top-K 选择器，针对长上下文稀疏注意力场景。它通过固定步长部分视图提出粗边界，再由完整行扫描验证并精确化候选集，从而将精确 Top-K 的行级遍历开销压缩至接近单次扫描的理论下限。在 Hy4-Preview 上比最优外部基线快 1.29–1.75×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，稀疏注意力虽然将下游注意力开销限制在 K 个被选位置，但精确 Top-K 算子本身仍需扫描全部物化的 FP32 评分行，长度随上下文线性增长。生产 radix 选择器需要至少两次完整行遍历（一次建直方图，一次按边界分类），导致行级流量 R_eq ≥ 2，落后于理论单次扫描下限 R_eq=1。现有方法各有局限：有序状态法受秩容量限制，阈值搜索需行驻留片上内存，时序预测依赖历史步骤。亟需一种在不假设历史状态或片上容量的前提下，把行级流量压到接近 1 的精确选择器。

Method: 三阶段采样引导精确选择：(1) Phase 1 用固定步长 s 的部分视图构建 FP16 粗键直方图，定位主边界 τ₀（目标秩 K̃=1.5K）和次边界 τ₁（1.75K）；(2) Phase 2 一次性完整行扫描，融合边界验证、候选收集与首位精确数字直方图构建；若 C(τ₀)<K 则用 τ₁ 扩展带状区域，若仍不足则进入精确粗恢复；(3) Phase 3 仅对未解析前沿 Q_j 进行 3 位 FP32 radix 精确细化，逐位提交优于边界的组、丢弃劣于边界的组、保留唯一边界组继续下一位。GPU 实现包含持久型（每行一 CTA）、KV-split 型（行段并行+finisher 合并）以及针对短行的直接精确内核，通过形状稳定分发器统一调度。正确性由完整行计数验证、Theorem 4.2 保证。

Result: 在 NVIDIA H20 上用 Hy4-Preview indexer 评分评估（K=2048）：20 种算子配置（M=512–8192, N=128K–1M）全部最快，比最快外部精确基线（多为 SGLang V2）快 1.29–1.75×，几何均值 1.55×；框架级 245K 与 430K 长上下文 trace 上分别快 1.36× 与 1.48×；score-and-select 链路在 245K/430K 节省 9.15/13.31 ms。消融实验显示 s=128、K̃=1.5K 为最佳折中点；次边界可消解 93–96% 的主边界欠填充；边界定位本身贡献了 92–97% 的延迟节省。采样方案在行宽 N≥64K 时稳定优于精确边界定位方案。

Conclusion: 采样在稀疏注意力精确 Top-K 中应被视为"提议机制"而非"近似"。粗边界控制送入精确细化的候选量，而完整行验证与精确恢复机制确保正确性始终成立。HPC-Ops 通过把定位紧凑上尾与解析精确秩边界两件事解耦，在保留精确语义的同时将公共路径行级流量从 ≥2 压缩至 1+1/s。已开源为腾讯 HPC-Ops 算子库的一部分。

Abstract: Sparse attention bounds downstream attention work by retaining a fixed-size subset of indexed tokens, but its standalone exact Top-$K$ stage must still process materialized score rows whose length grows with context. Production radix selectors discover their first actionable boundary only after a complete-row pass, forcing another row-scale traversal before exact refinement. We observe that locating a compact upper tail requires substantially less resolution than identifying the exact rank boundary, and that fixed-stride partial views of the current row remain calibrated to the corresponding complete-row rank across ragged lengths. We present HPC-Ops Top-K, a sample-guided exact selector for ragged sparse-attention score rows. A fixed-stride view proposes a row-local coarse boundary; the mandatory complete-row pass certifies its sufficiency, forms the admitted candidate set, and initializes exact FP32 refinement over the unresolved frontier. A nested secondary boundary and exact recovery handle underfilled proposals before any output is committed, so sampling controls common-path work but never correctness. The GPU implementation fuses complete-row certification and candidate formation, and combines persistent, KV-split, and direct-exact execution behind graph-capturable ragged-row dispatch. We evaluate HPC-Ops Top-K on indexer scores from Hy4-Preview. It outperforms the fastest verified external exact baseline by $1.29$--$1.75\times$ across 20 operator configurations, with a $1.55\times$ geometric-mean speedup. It further achieves $1.36\times$ and $1.48\times$ speedups on two framework-derived sparse-attention traces. The implementation is available in HPC-Ops, Tencent's open-source high-performance operator library for LLM inference, at this https URL .

</details>


### [475] [Measuring Sustainability in Multi-Scale High-Performance Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08688)
*Carlos J Barrios,Frédéric Le Mouël,Yves Denneulin*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多维度量框架，用于刻画从传统HPC向计算连续体（Computing Continuum）过渡中的多尺度混合架构，旨在指导现代工作负载的部署策略，平衡性能、利用率、可持续性和精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着计算范式从传统HPC向涵盖云-边-端的计算连续体转变，资源呈现多尺度、异构化特征，如何高效管理与可持续利用这些混合架构资源成为关键挑战；同时AI、量子计算等新型应用对系统模块的匹配提出了更高要求。

Method: 构建多维度量框架，整合架构性能指标（吞吐量、延迟、可扩展性）、系统利用率、以及可持续性与精度指标（能效、功耗等）；基于模块化混合测试床开展实验，揭示各度量间的复杂耦合关系（如精度-能耗权衡、混合节点效率等），并给出部署指导原则。

Result: 实验揭示了多维度量间的复杂关联，尤其明确了精度与能耗之间的权衡以及混合节点的效率特性；所提指南能够识别系统最优运行点，为编排器与调度器（如Kubernetes）的资源分配提供依据。

Conclusion: 多维度量框架可有效刻画多尺度混合架构特性，为计算连续体环境下高需求应用（AI、量子计算等）的合理部署提供理论与实践支撑，有助于同时实现高性能与可持续性目标，并为编排调度策略优化奠定基础。

Abstract: The transition from traditional High Performance Computing (HPC) to the Computing Continuum emphasizes efficient resource management and sustainable practices across Multi-Scale hybrid architectures. This paper introduces a multidimensional metric framework to characterize these systems and guide deployment strategies for modern workloads. The framework combines Architectural Performance metrics (such as Throughput, Latency, Scalability), System Utilization, and key Sustainability and Accuracy indicators (such as Energy Efficiency and Power Consumption). Using a modular hybrid testbed, experiments reveal complex relationships among metrics, especially the trade-offs between accuracy and energy, and the efficiency of hybrid nodes. The guidelines help identify optimal operating points and lay the groundwork for improving orchestrators and schedulers (e.g., Kubernetes) to assign demanding applications, including AI and Quantum Computing, to suitable system modules, ensuring high performance and sustainability.

</details>


### [476] [Tools-CC-Bench: a Benchmark Suite for Collective Communication with Compression in HPC and AI Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08739)
*Haozhe Fan,Wei Wang,Xingchen Liu,Man Liu,Xingjian Tian,Haoquan Long,Zedong Liu,Daran Sun,Jinwu Yang,Bo Yang,Jie Liu,Yonggang Che,Hairui Zhao,Guangming Tan,Dingwen Tao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: CC-Bench 是首个面向压缩增强型集合通信的开源基准测试套件，通过声明式配置模块解耦通信库、压缩器、数据集与精度度量，结合函数级拦截与硬件计数器监控，在 CPU/GPU 集群上系统评估 HPC 与 LLM 负载下的通信压缩效果，揭示精度-性能权衡与瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式 HPC 与 LLM 负载中通信开销成为主要性能瓶颈，通信压缩虽能减少数据量但难以评估：现有基准缺乏多样化后端支持、真实数据集、应用特定精度度量以及重叠引发的资源竞争，无法指导实际部署与优化。

Method: 设计轻量级、可扩展、应用导向的基准套件：(1) 应用导向配置模块——通过 JSONC 声明式配置解耦通信包装层、压缩包装层（基于 LD_PRELOAD 注入）、动态偏差度量计算器与负载守护进程；(2) 全栈剖析模块——结合函数级拦截（剖析 compress/send/recv/decompress 阶段）与硬件计数器守护进程（SM/DRAM/NIC/PCIe 利用率），并通过 function_analyzer 报告重叠效率与相位分解；(3) 内置代表性数据集（HPC：Hurricane ISABEL、NYX、CESM-ATM；LLM：Llama 3 8B 激活/梯度/权重、KV-cache 轨迹）。通过两阶段运行分离延迟测量与相位分解，输出多维度报告。

Result: 在 CPU 集群（2×Xeon Platinum 8358P + 200G InfiniBand）与 GPU 集群（2×EPYC 7402 + 8×A800 SXM4）上以 AllReduce 为代表原语评估三种压缩通信库（ZCCL+SZx/SZ3、UCCL+DietGPU、COCCL+SDP4Bit/TAH-Quant）。关键发现：(1) 压缩率与精度强依赖数据集，低熵 HPC 数据呈压缩率驱动、高熵 LLM 训练呈精度驱动，单一指标选压缩器具有误导性；(2) 在 GPU 小消息（8KB/512KB）上 COCCL+SDP4Bit 获 21–40× 加速，大消息（≥512MB）也达 1.2–7.5× 加速，但中间尺寸存在延迟尖峰；(3) ZCCL+SZx 阶段分解显示 92% 通信时间与编解码重叠，瓶颈在编解码而非通信本身；(4) 后台 GPU 负载达 70% 时压缩通信延迟显著恶化，孤立微基准结论在真实条件下不成立。

Conclusion: CC-Bench 是首个全面评估通信压缩的开源基准套件，通过声明式配置与全栈剖析弥合了孤立微基准与端到端应用剖析之间的鸿沟。评估表明延迟、吞吐与精度必须联合考量，瓶颈随重叠与干扰而变化，孤立微基准的结论在真实条件下并不总成立。未来工作将沿三个方向扩展：迭代式错误传播剖析、新压缩器/硬件/I/O 监控插件集成、轻量级代理在 mini-app 与训练循环中重放集合轨迹。

Abstract: Distributed HPC and LLM workloads increasingly require efficient communication for scalability, yet growing data movement has become a major performance bottleneck. Communication compression can reduce this overhead and complement execution-level optimizations, but its benefits remain difficult to assess because existing benchmarks lack support for diverse backends, realistic datasets, application-specific accuracy metrics, and overlap-induced resource contention. We present CC-Bench, a lightweight, extensible, and application-oriented benchmark suite for evaluating communication compression under realistic execution conditions. CC-Bench uses declarative application-environment modeling to decouple profiling logic from communication libraries, datasets, and fidelity metrics, enabling portable cross-library evaluation. It further combines function-level interception and hardware counter monitoring to characterize per-phase latency, hardware utilization, numerical fidelity, and computation interference. With representative datasets from HPC and LLM workloads, CC-Bench evaluates three compression-enabled communication libraries on CPU and GPU clusters, revealing accuracy-performance trade-offs and bottlenecks to guide practical deployment and optimization.

</details>


### [477] [Exploring the Genesis Platform Capabilities to Accelerate Scientific Discovery in OPAL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08844)
*Daniel Rosendo,Renan Souza,Kelsey Carter,John Lagergren,Frédéric Suter,Shelaine L. Curd,David Weston,Rafael Ferreira da Silva*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文介绍了美国能源部Genesis Mission平台通过American Science Cloud提供的五项可复用能力（托管Kubernetes执行环境、MLflow模型目录、MAG LLM推理网关、数据湖仓、Flowcept溯源服务），以橡树岭国家实验室OPAL植物表型分析工作流为实例，展示其如何将跨设施自主实验所需的基础设施抽象为平台能力，使新用例仅需提供领域模型、数据模式和智能体决策逻辑。在40天镍处理实验中将约12小时的手动分析缩短为秒至分钟的交互式查询，溯源开销低于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨设施科学实验需要长期运行服务、模型版本化分发、LLM治理访问、共享数据底座和端到端溯源等基础设施；传统上每个项目重复构建且难以复用，形成瓶颈。本文将这类共性需求上升为平台能力，通过Genesis平台统一提供，以加速科学发现。

Method: 采用"平台能力+外部服务+用例自供组件"的分层架构：(1)平台侧提供Kubernetes集群、MLflow模型目录、MAG (LiteLLM) 推理网关、数据湖仓、Flowcept溯源服务；(2)外部服务包括Globus数据传输、S3M Redis跨设施消息、Academy智能体部署框架、Parsl HPC任务编排；(3)OPAL用例自供组件含Co-Scientist对话智能体、Compute Agent逻辑、ViT分割模型与性状提取算法。工作流分为离线（每小时预处理与推理）与在线（秒级湖仓查询 / 分钟级HPC计划执行）双轨，配合溯源图谱实现报告验证。

Result: 在40天APPL镍处理campaign中筛查360株pennycress：(1)交互延迟分布为问候<1s、知识库2–5s、湖仓查询3–10s、计划执行(掩膜已有)<1min、8株按需推理≈5min、争用队列30min–2h、溯源查询3–10s；(2)单次推理约10秒，冷启动延迟主要由队列等待主导；(3)Flowcept细粒度溯源增加<1%运行时开销；(4)对比手工基线(6天×2小时≈12小时)，分析时间降低约600倍，提取性状数增加约100倍；(5)成功检测并辅助诊断5月3日浇水故障导致的叶片面积骤降事件。

Conclusion: Genesis平台将跨设施自主实验的共性基础设施抽象为可复用能力，使新用例仅需关注领域模型、数据模式和智能体决策逻辑；OPAL案例证明该架构可在不损失审计性的前提下(溯源开销<1%)将分析周期从campaign后压缩至campaign中。关键工程模式为"可用性检查+缓存回退模型检索"。未来工作包括将Flowcept正式纳入平台溯源服务、完成数据湖仓平台化集成，并向流式仪器数据与多DOE实验室跨设施部署扩展。

Abstract: Autonomous, cross-facility science requires capabilities that no individual project should have to build for itself: managed execution for long-lived services, versioned distribution of models to remote compute systems, governed access to large language models, a shared substrate for experimental data, and end-to-end provenance. The U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission platform, delivered through the American Science Cloud, provides these as reusable services. This paper reports how the Genesis platform enables cross-facility experiments and accelerates scientific discovery. We explore the plant phenotyping workflow of the Orchestrated Platform for Autonomous Laboratories as the exemplar: it couples Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Advanced Plant Phenotyping Laboratory with the Frontier supercomputer. In a 40-day nickel-treatment campaign, the resulting workflow replaced roughly twelve hours of manual analysis with interactive queries returning in seconds to minutes.

</details>


### [478] [ContinuumBench: Benchmarking Joint Autoscaling and Placement Across Evaluation Regimes in the Cloud-Edge Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08946)
*Lanpei Li,Antonino Vaccarella,Vincenzo Lomonaco,Massimo Coppola*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了 ContinuumBench，一个用于云-边连续体中联合评估自动扩缩容与放置策略的基准测试。它基于 ECLYPSE 模拟器构建，引入"完成感知"(completion-aware) 记账方法（将延迟、未完成和被丢弃的任务均视为违反 SLO），并在四种场景、两种评估机制下对九个控制器进行了受控消融实验。核心发现：在所研究的容量受限机制下，弹性容量（而非放置策略的复杂度）才是决定任务完成率的主要因素；放置质量仅在容量耗尽时才有区分度；且记账方式本身会改变控制器的排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的云-边资源管理评估存在"评估依赖"问题：(1) 放置与扩缩容决策通常被分开研究；(2) 工作负载、网络和校准等假设未被明确声明；(3) 基于已完成任务的指标会掩盖未完成的工作。这些问题使得所报告的收益难以归因到具体控制策略上。作者希望回答两个核心问题：控制策略的复杂度何时真正提升云-边资源管理性能，以及应当如何衡量已交付的工作量。

Method: 方法包含四个核心贡献：(1) 在 ECLYPSE 之上构建基于周期的控制层，纳入任务到达、worker 弹性、间歇传输、缓冲与故障模型，并审计每个动作的可行性；(2) 提出"完成感知记账"，将延迟、未完成和被丢弃的任务统一视为 SLO 违反；(3) 设计受控消融评估协议，固定所有变量仅变动单一因子（重规划调度、容量、放置瓶颈等）；(4) 评估九个控制器（4 个仅放置 + 5 个可扩缩容，含 HPA、KEDA 和 MILP 优化器），覆盖四种场景（EO、V2X、分割推理、工业 IoT）和两种机制（R1 合成基线、R2 含轨迹驱动接触窗口）。完成感知综合评分为 C/G − 0.5P/G − V_slo/E_slo − 0.01·p95延迟 − 0.001·迁移次数。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 发现1——若不进行实际迁移，仅重规划放置不会带来可测量的改进（差异 < 10⁻³）；仅执行实际迁移的 MILP 能提升约 0.045 的完成率。(2) 发现2——在容量扫描中，可扩缩容控制器（HPA、联合启发式、KEDA）分别达到过度配置参考水平的 99–100%、97–100% 和 89–100%；而仅放置控制器仅达 44–100%，且随负载增加而退化。(3) 发现3——在放置瓶颈场景下，仅按完成率计分会隐藏约 8 倍的按时交付差距。(4) 发现4——记账方式本身可改变排名：节点不可用时，仅基于已完成任务计分会在 24 个配置中的 21 个中出现违反率随故障增加而"下降"的倒置现象；HPA 与 KEDA 在某些场景下完成率相同，但完成感知违反率分别为 0.01 和 0.57。编排开销在 4–6 节点基础设施上每周期 < 3ms（占 1s 周期的 < 0.3%）。

Conclusion: 在所评估的容量受限机制下，弹性容量是决定任务完成率的主导因素，一旦容量充足，自动扩缩容策略的选择便决定了按时交付的比例。放置质量仅在容量耗尽时才在控制器间产生区分度，且只有执行实际迁移的放置优化才能带来额外收益。同时，记账方式本身会改变控制器的排名——仅基于完成率与完成感知计分可给出不同结论。设计建议：优先保证弹性容量；重规划与放置优化仅在 worker 容量不再是瓶颈时才值得投入。未来工作包括引入显式成本模型、增加基于学习的控制器、扩展至千节点网络以及在合成拓扑上验证结论的普适性。

Abstract: Cloud-edge controllers coordinate service placement, replica scaling, and resource pre-warming to keep end-to-end latency within application deadlines. But evaluations often obscure the source of a reported gain: placement and scaling are studied separately; workload, connectivity, and calibration assumptions remain implicit; and metrics over completed tasks hide unfinished work. We present ContinuumBench, a benchmark that controls these factors. Its completion-aware accounting treats late, unfinished, and discarded tasks as deadline misses. A common protocol compares placement-only and scale-capable controllers under declared regimes and stressors. Built on the ECLYPSE simulator, ContinuumBench adds arrivals, worker elasticity, intermittent transport, buffering, and failures to close the control loop. We evaluate nine controllers across four scenarios and two regimes. The studied regimes are capacity-bound: elastic capacity, not placement sophistication, drives completion, and once capacity suffices, the choice of autoscaling policy decides how much of that work arrives on time. Placement re-planning has no measurable effect without relocation, while cost-free migration defines the observed exception. Consequently, scale-capable controllers approach an over-provisioned reference while placement-only controllers degrade with load; and placement quality separates controllers only once capacity is exhausted. Finally, the accounting choice itself changes the reported result: completion-only and completion-aware scoring can rank controllers differently.

</details>

### [479] [Concord: A Video Relational Algebra for Cross-Modal Query Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05756)
*Sultan Muratbek,Charisse Ivana Yeung,Chanwut Kittivorawong,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Concord提出了一种用于跨模态语义视频查询处理的Video Relational Algebra（VRA），通过模态替换、跨模态时间候选下推和Detect–Track–Join三种查询重写优化，显著降低MLLM调用成本并提升查询质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义视频查询使用户能通过自然语言提示和MLLM解释视频内容，但朴素执行将整个视频发送至MLLM，导致高延迟、高成本和精度下降。需要一种声明式代数来表达和优化这类查询，以在减少MLLM用量的同时提升结果质量。

Method: 1. 定义Video Relational Algebra（VRA）：在视频、转录文本、帧、目标轨迹之上的嵌套关系代数，扩展关系算子（Map/Filter/Reduce/Join/Unnest）和媒体算子（View/Transcribe/Detect/Track）。2. 提出三种近似重写优化：O1模态替换（用转录文本替换视频进行语义推理）、O2跨模态时间候选下推（利用转录文本定位候选时间窗口，将视频推理范围缩小）、O3语义Reduce-Unnest到Detect–Track–Join分解（将整体视频语义关联分解为检测、跟踪、轨迹级连接）。

Result: 在4.59小时足球比赛和3.92小时讲座视频上，transcript-to-video查询仅将5.32%和2.47%的视频时长发送至MLLM，MLLM成本降低高达87%，F1显著提升。在两段5秒高速公路视频的18辆手动标注跨摄像头车辆上，Detect–Track–Join查询将F1从.364提升至.813，且完全不调用MLLM。

Conclusion: Concord通过VRA将模态、时间范围和处理粒度作为显式查询选项，在保持输出模式的同时，通过三种近似重写显著降低了语义视频查询的MLLM成本并提升了查询质量，为未来语义视频处理系统提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Semantic video queries let users embed natural language prompts and use multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret the video. Such queries are increasingly popular for querying video data. However, their expressiveness comes at a steep cost: an MLLM may process hours of media to return only seconds of relevant output, making naive execution slow, expensive, and inaccurate. We propose Concord, a system for expressing and optimizing semantic video queries. We makes three contributions. First, we introduce Video Relational Algebra (VRA), a nested algebra over videos, transcripts, frames, and object tracks that captures common semantic video operations. Second, we derive a set of approximate optimizations that rewrite VRA queries to reduce MLLM usage while improving result quality. For narrated video, Concord either processes transcripts instead of video or uses them to identify video clips for MLLM processing. For cross-camera queries without narration, detection and tracking replace a whole-video MLLM join with a track-level relational join. Third, we evaluate Concord on real-world videos. Across 4.59 hours of soccer broadcasts and 3.92 hours of lectures, transcript-to-video queries send only 5.32% and 2.47% of source-video duration to the MLLM and reduce MLLM cost by up to 87%. In two five-second highway clips with 18 manually adjudicated cross-camera vehicles, a Detect-Track-Join query improves F1 from .364 to .813 while making no MLLM calls. See our project at this https URL .

</details>


### [480] [sheval: An RDF data shapes evaluation tool and test-suite for recursive shapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05944)
*Shqiponja Ahmetaj,Iovka Boneva,Jan Hidders,Maxime Jakubowski,Jose-Emilio Labra-Gayo,Wim Martens,Filip Murlak,Cem Okulmus,Ognjen Savković,Mantas Šimkus,Dominik Tomaszuk*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: sheval 是一个针对 RDF 形状语言的评估框架，包含一个命令行工具和一个测试套件，专门用于比较 ShEx 和 SHACL 不同引擎在处理递归形状时的行为差异。核心贡献在于揭示 SHACL 规范未定义递归语义导致各引擎实现不一致的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ShEx 明确规定了基于 GFP（最大不动点）的递归语义，但 SHACL 将递归形状的语义留给各引擎实现，导致不同 SHACL 引擎（如 TopQuadrant、Apache Jena、pySHACL、SHACL-S、rudof）在面对递归定义时表现出不一致甚至冲突的行为（如崩溃、超时、无限循环），严重影响互操作性和用户预期。

Method: 1. 定义了一个简单形状语言（Simple Shape Language）作为抽象语法，包含布尔连接词、量词和形状引用，并引入形状赋值（shape assignment）形式化语义。2. 区分四种递归语义：LFP（最小不动点）、GFP（最大不动点）、勇敢支持模型语义（bSMS）、谨慎支持模型语义（cSMS）。3. sheval 架构：基于 YAML 清单（manifest.yaml）描述测试套件，通过统一的 Runner 接口隔离各引擎差异（pySHACL、Jena、rudof、ShEx-S、TopQuadrant 等），由 Orchestrator 调度，commands 模块负责子进程执行和超时控制，error_classification 映射失败模式（Timeout、Crashed、CyclesDetected、NonStratified），semantics 模块对比引擎结果与预期语义，输出 YAML/CSV/LaTeX 报告。4. 设计了多类测试用例：基本分离测试（bsep1-4）、可达性分离测试（reach1-2、safe1-2）、功能性测试（nstrat、cons、fresh）、对偶性测试（dual1-2）、非递归控制测试（norec1-2）。

Result: 1. 非递归控制测试中所有引擎表现一致。2. 三个 ShEx 引擎（rudof、ShEx-S、Jena ShEx）与 GFP 语义一致。3. SHACL 生态高度不一致：pySHACL 多返回 conforms=true；SHACL-TQ 表现为独特语义，不符合任何标准语义；rudof SHACL 通过标志位可切换 GFP/LFP/bSMS/cSMS；Jena SHACL 遵循 GFP；SHACL-S 存在超时错误。4. 非分层（non-stratified）用例中，仅 rudof 和 ShEx-S 正确拒绝，其他引擎尝试验证。5. cons2 测试中 Jena ShEx 的不对称行为可能源于软件缺陷。6. 对偶性测试中 ShEx 验证器符合 GFP，SHACL 验证器也倾向于 GFP。

Conclusion: sheval 作为一个开源（GitHub: cogsl/sheval）、支持 Docker 的可复现评估框架，有效识别了现有形状引擎在递归处理上的不一致性，为 SHACL 1.2 规范的递归语义标准化提供了实证基础。测试结果并未证明任何引擎严格遵循特定语义，但揭示了实现差异。未来的工作包括扩展更多引擎实现、增加测试套件，并探索表达力、互操作性、性能和可解释性等维度。

Abstract: Two different languages have been developed to validate RDF data based on the concept of a shape: ShEx and SHACL. In each language it is possible to define a shape that refers to itself, which is called a recursive shape. While in the case of ShEx, the semantics of recursive shapes is well defined and is part of the specification, in the case of SHACL, the semantics of recursive shapes is left to the implementation of the different SHACL engines. Consequently, the different SHACL engines show different behaviours when confronted with recursive shapes. In this paper we present sheval: an evaluation framework consisting of a tool and a test suite that can be used to compare the behaviour of different shapes technologies when confronted with recursive definitions. The tool has been used to evaluate and understand the differences in the implementation of recursive shapes in ShEx and SHACL. It provides a framework for testing and comparing the behaviour of different shape engines, helping to identify inconsistencies and potential issues, and providing a basis for further research and development in the field of shape-based validation of RDF data.

</details>


### [481] [Compiling Linear Datalog to SQL for Program Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06301)
*Amir Shaikhha,Anna Herlihy,Hung Ngo*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出DLSQL编译器，将线性Datalog片段编译为标准递归SQL（SQL:1999的WITH RECURSIVE），借助现代关系数据库引擎（Umbra、DuckDB、Hyper等）执行程序分析工作负载。通过设计中间语言Midlog解决Datalog与SQL在互递归和作用域规则上的不匹配，并引入函数依赖发现（主键提示）和多头部优化。在Umbra后端上，相较Soufflé在8线程下获得最高14.3倍、几何平均5.46倍的加速，生成的SQL可移植至七个数据库系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序分析社区使用Datalog（如Soufflé）将其编译为C++，绕过了现代关系数据库引擎在递归查询优化方面的进展；而数据库引擎虽支持递归CTE，却缺乏Datalog的抽象与表达能力。两条研究线路长期分离。本文旨在重新连接Datalog与关系数据库，让RDBMS作为高效的Datalog后端运行，无需定制运行时。

Method: 1) 识别Linear Datalog片段：每条递归规则体中至多包含一个SCC内的谓词，与SQL:1999线性递归约束对齐；2) 设计Midlog中间语言，吸收Datalog与SQL的两大结构性差异：互递归支持缺失和作用域规则不同；3) 四阶段编译流水线：Datalog规范化→Datalog到Midlog→Midlog规范化（含tagged归约消除MultiDef）→Midlog到SQL；4) 两项优化：(a) 多头部优化——当SCC存在自然primary时，反馈顶点条件成立则避免引入tagged合成关系；(b) 函数依赖发现——从输入数据中恢复主键，作为CREATE TABLE的PRIMARY KEY暴露给引擎；5) 局部IDB内联与CTE-shadowing改写以适配更严格的SQL引擎。

Result: 在五个程序分析基准（varpointsto、cgcha、escape、csda、borrow）上与Soufflé、FlowLog、Logica、RecStep对比：DLSQL+Umbra 8线程几何平均加速5.46×，单基准最高14.31×（borrow）；DLSQL+DuckDB单线程0.96×、8线程0.68×；DLSQL+Hyper几何平均1.02×。同后端对比中，DLSQL+DuckDB相对Logica快17–20×。多头部优化在合成SCC M=6时消除1.76–3.51×的tagged开销；FD优化在Umbra上对escape和csda带来1.49–1.68×加速。SQL在七个数据库系统（DuckDB、Umbra、Hyper、PostgreSQL、MariaDB、MySQL、SQLite）上可移植运行。在chains基准的扩展性测试中，运行时间随边数近线性增长，Datalog原生系统在轮数增加时表现更平稳。

Conclusion: DLSQL证明了以现代RDBMS作为Datalog后端的可行性：Linear Datalog片段足以表达调用图构造、指向分析、逃逸分析、数据流分析与借用检查等核心程序分析；Midlog成功弥合Datalog与SQL之间的结构差异；将递归作为单一WITH RECURSIVE块交给引擎优化，相比外部驱动循环（如Logica/RecStep）具有数量级优势。局限性在于线性限制与表达性边界（域敏感指向分析等需非线性规则）；未来工作包括放宽线性约束、SCC级线性检测作为Datalog引擎后端选择策略，以及格值聚合。

Abstract: Datalog is a declarative query language that has proven highly effective for expressing static program analyses. Although Datalog has deep roots in database theory, most recent advances have largely emerged from the programming languages and compiler communities, with systems such as Soufflé. In contrast, modern relational engines have made significant progress in optimizing recursive SQL. This paper revisits the connection between Datalog and relational databases, advocating recursive SQL as a backend for Datalog evaluation. We present a compilation framework that translates Datalog programs, particularly those in the Linear Datalog fragment, into equivalent recursive SQL queries. To bridge the gap between Datalog and SQL, the compiler routes every program through an intermediate language called Midlog. The compiler additionally recovers functional dependencies from the program and exposes them as schema keys, unlocking the engine's standard query optimizations. This approach enables existing database engines to execute a broad class of program analyses, outperforming the Soufflé engine by up to an order of magnitude on the Umbra backend. Umbra achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 5.46$\times$ at 8 threads, whereas DuckDB is competitive with Soufflé single-threaded and is slower at 8 threads (geometric-mean speedup of 0.68$\times$). Furthermore, the generated SQL is portable; it runs on seven database systems without any engine modification. Our results highlight what the relational engines require to fully support Datalog for large-scale program analysis.

</details>


### [482] [X-DigCheck: Co-Evolving Application Profiles and Knowledge Graphs, Demonstrated on the RTI Documentation of Rupe Magna](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07694)
*Celian Ringwald,Huseyin Erdogan,Valentina Presutti,Cristiano Putzolu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: X-DigCheck 是一个领域无关的应用配置文件与知识图谱协同演化环境，通过能力问题、SHACL 验证和双向覆盖率分析，将配置文件、映射、约束和数据的迭代修订整合为闭环流程，并以文化遗产领域 Rupe Magna 的反射变换成像（RTI）文档为验证用例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对固定本体构建的应用配置文件会随数据生产而逐渐偏离其建模假设，而现有工具（如 Astrea、OWL2SHACL、ABSTAT、OOPS!）多为单层自动化，难以同时追踪配置文件、shapes 与实例数据三者间的持续对齐。本文将配置文件工程视为本体—数据的协同演化过程。

Method: 构建基于 Docker + Apache Jena Fuseki 的 X-DigCheck 环境，提供三种验证机制：(1) 配置文件与知识图谱的覆盖率/对齐分析；(2) 基于 eXtreme Design 的能力问题（编译为 SPARQL 回归测试）执行；(3) SHACL 验证（OWL2SHACL 自动派生 shapes + 手工编写的约束 shapes）。生成侧使用 semRTI（基于 SPARQL Anything 的 Python 管道）将 RTI 采集输出与人工注释提升为 RDF/Turtle，再经 OWL 推理物化蕴含。支持浏览器门户与 CLI 两种模式。

Result: 通过在 Rupe Magna（意大利 Grosio）RTI 调查项目中运行 10 轮协同演化循环，构建了 RupeMagna-RTI 配置文件（CHS-ODP 的首个 RTI 专门化），包含六个模块化本体、28 条可执行能力问题（93% 通过）和 42 条 shapes（76% 通过），产出约 148k 三元组的 FAIR 兼容知识图谱，并将所有能力问题、shapes、配置文件和数据集以 CC BY 4.0 开放发布。

Conclusion: 本体工程与知识图谱构建应被视为协同演化过程；X-DigCheck 验证了将能力问题、SHACL 与覆盖率分析贯穿配置文件开发周期的可行性与领域无关性。未来工作包括将映射文件纳入报告、跟踪 Git 修订历史以及结合 LLM 代理辅助映射修复、shapes 生成与查询维护，同时保留可执行验证准则。

Abstract: We demonstrate X-DigCheck, a domain-independent environment for building and maintaining application profiles as they co-evolve with the data they describe. Profiles developed against a fixed ontology quickly drift from the schema they were meant to capture. X-DigCheck treats profile construction as a continuous ontology-data co-evolution loop: data are lifted into RDF against the profile, checked through competency questions and SHACL, and the resulting reports jointly drive revisions of the ontology, mappings, constraints, and graph. The loop is agnostic to the domain and to the pipeline that produces the graph. We validate and demonstrate the tool in the cultural heritage domain, on the construction of RupeMagna-RTI, the first Reflectance Transformation Imaging (RTI) specialisation of the Cultural Heritage Survey ODP (CHS-ODP), aligned with CIDOC-CRM/CRMdig, ArCo, CHAD-KG, and Getty AAT, with semRTI as the lifting pipeline of this use case. The demonstration lets visitors run one full turn of the loop -on the shipped Rupe Magna (Grosio, Italy) RTI survey, or on a profile and graph of their own -executing the competency-question and SHACL checks live and reading the bidirectional coverage report that flags modelling gaps and stale assumptions. The result is a portable co-evolution environment for profile engineering, together with a reusable RTI application profile produced through it. A screencast of the demonstration is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [483] [Preserving contextual information in cultural heritage metadata through multidimensional knowledge graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07695)
*Lyndon Nixon,Valentina Presutti,Celian Ringwald,Andrea Schimmenti*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文针对文化遗产元数据中标准知识图谱无法表达陈述上下文依赖有效性的问题，提出多维知识图谱（Multidimensional Knowledge Graphs, MKGs）的概念基础。MKGs 基于 RDF 1.2 的引用三元组机制（quoted triples）以及 SHACL 1.2 验证机制，将每条陈述与显式的"维度—约束"对关联，使同一对象可同时承载多重、相互冲突的诠释（如殖民/后殖民视角、政治立场差异、时期不同的科学共识），并支持基于视角的上下文感知查询。论文给出了形式化模型（含 Only / Excludes / AnyOf / AllOf / Exactly 五种集合论算子）、RDF 1.2 + SHACL 1.2 表示方案，并以"君士坦丁赠礼"的作者归属和"Derry/Londonderry"地名争议为案例进行说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文化遗产对象（CHOs）常承载多版本、相互冲突的诠释（殖民与后殖民视角、政治立场、不断演化的科学共识等）。RDF 的模型论语义未规定三元组断言的成立条件，导致标准知识图谱只能默认陈述普遍为真，无法表达陈述在不同社会、文化、政治、时空视角下的条件性有效。已有方案（RDF 再化、命名图、PROV-O、Wikidata 限定符、RDF-star、NdFluents、Annotated RDF 等）要么局限于单一维度，要么依赖应用层隐式语义，缺乏一个统一、可与现行 RDF/Linked Data 基础设施兼容的框架来同时建模与查询多维上下文。

Method: 1. 提出 MKG 形式定义：知识图谱 G=(E,R,T) 中的每条三元组 t 与一个上下文集合 C_t 关联；每个上下文为 (d, κ)，其中 d 为维度（如时间、空间、政治视角、机构权威、语言社群、科学范式），κ 为该维度值空间上的有效性约束。约束通过受限集合代数表达：Only(S)、Excludes(S)、AnyOf(S)、AllOf(S)、Exactly(S) 五种算子。2. 表示层：基于 RDF 1.2 quoted triples（遵循 Daquino 等的 "Expressing Without Asserting" 原则）将上下文资源连接到三元组的 reifier；维度与约束均建模为带类型的 RDF 资源。3. 验证层：利用 SHACL 1.2 的 reifierShape / reificationRequired / Node Expressions 将"维度—约束"对的良构性声明为可强制执行的图形状。4. 查询层：通过 SPARQL 1.2 对引用三元组进行模式匹配以实现上下文感知检索；提出 SHACL 1.2 Profiling 用于声明不同社区的"视角画像"（如 Unionist/Nationalist 在 Derry/Londonderry 上的分歧）。5. 案例：以 Shakespeare 作者归属（Stratfordian / anti-Stratfordian）说明五种算子语义；以"君士坦丁赠礼"在 750–1440 年间被天主教会认定为君士坦丁一世所著、1440 年后被现代史学否定的多维建模与查询为例进行端到端展示。

Result: 论文给出了 MKG 的概念基础与形式化定义、RDF 1.2 + SHACL 1.2 的具体表示与验证模式，并通过 Shakespeare 作者归属和"君士坦丁赠礼"两个文化遗产案例展示了：(a) 多重、相互冲突的诠释可同时保留而无须挑选权威陈述；(b) 基于维度的上下文感知 SPARQL 1.2 查询可直接表达；(c) 不同社区/机构可通过 Profile 注册竞争性的维度值集，使分歧显式、可引用、可独立版本化。同时也明确了代价与开放问题：图规模与查询性能开销、共存上下文的合取/析取语义需在查询引擎中显式约定（否则会被规范化合并）、维度值空间的本体工程可能引发新的争议、维度选择与 Profile 注册属于治理问题，模型本身不预设权威。

Conclusion: MKG 提供了一个统一、可扩展、与 RDF 1.2 及 Linked Data 基础设施完全兼容的框架，用于在任意认识论维度上建模和查询陈述的条件性有效。它并非取代现有语义网技术，而是补足其上下文建模缺口。下一步工作计划：以 INFINITY 项目为依托，将 MKG 作为公开 Note 提交至 RDF/Linked Data 社区讨论，推动在欧洲 ECCCH 与 DS4CH 中采用；设计将 FAIR 与 CARE 原则在陈述级别机器可检查化的"数据 Profile"，并参考 Local Contexts 的 Traditional Knowledge Labels 引入社区授权元数据；同时强调真实社区协商不可被模式设计所替代。

Abstract: Using Knowledge Graphs (KGs) to describe Cultural Heritage Objects (CHOs) supports semantic richness and interoperability. However, standard KGs fail to capture the context-dependent validity of statements. This limitation is critical for cultural heritage metadata, which must often accommodate evolving or conflicting viewpoints, such as colonial versus post-colonial perspectives or shifting scientific consensus. While current knowledge representation methods address basic contextualization via provenance, qualifiers or reification, they lack a unified framework to simultaneously model and query data across multiple social, cultural, and political dimensions. To bridge this gap, we introduce the conceptual foundations of Multi-dimensional Knowledge Graphs (MKGs) and discuss how they preserve complex, multi-layered contexts in CHO metadata.

</details>


### [484] [TrajectoryDB: A New Database for Agent Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07782)
*Yunjia Zheng,Juncheng Yang*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出TrajectoryDB,一种面向AI智能体执行轨迹的专用数据管理系统,主张将智能体轨迹视为一种独立的数据类型,并围绕其层次化结构、大体量语义化文本、高冗余性及复杂的数据血缘关系,协同设计数据导入、存储与查询处理流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI智能体产生的执行轨迹数据分散存储于文件、数据库和可观测性系统中,缺乏专门的管理系统。现有方案(JSONL文件、向量数据库、日志存储)只能处理轨迹生命周期的部分环节,无法同时兼顾结构、语义、顺序与血缘的联合推理需求,且随着智能体在生产环境中的大规模部署(如OpenRouter上智能体代币消耗5个月内增长14倍),这一问题日益突出。

Method: 论文采用愿景论文(vision paper)形式,首先将智能体轨迹抽象为一种新的数据类型,定义其session-turn-step-message的层次化结构,梳理六类典型应用场景(记忆提取、微调、根因分析、安全监控、运行时监控、资源调度)。然后从三个维度提出系统需求:(1)结构感知检索(层次结构检索与序列检索);(2)将LLM作为UDF进行语义算子与关系算子的组合及增量评估;(3)血缘查询(上下文重建与语义判定血缘保留)。最后将需求映射为七项技术挑战(C1-C7),并讨论现有数据库系统在结构重建、存储布局、查询优化方面的不足及可能的设计方向。

Result: 论文未给出具体的实验结果,作为愿景论文,其核心贡献是:(1)首次系统性地论证智能体轨迹应作为一种独立数据类型进行管理;(2)通过生产环境的实证数据(如80%的会话存在上下文突变、连续请求间隔可达数小时至数天、数据导出采用Zstandard可获得20倍压缩率等)支撑设计假设;(3)提出TrajectoryDB的整体愿景,涵盖数据模型、查询算子与跨层优化机会,为后续研究指明方向。

Conclusion: 智能体轨迹作为层次化结构、大文本量、高冗余、富含血缘的复合数据,无法被现有数据库系统有效管理。TrajectoryDB通过协同设计摄入、存储与查询处理,将原始轨迹及其衍生数据视为一等公民,支持结构、顺序、语义与血缘的联合推理,目标是使智能体轨迹的存储、查询与优化如同文档数据在文档数据库、时序数据在时序数据库中一样自然。

Abstract: AI agents generate rich execution trajectories that capture their interactions with large language models, tools, and external environments. These trajectories are increasingly valuable for downstream tasks such as memory extraction, model fine-tuning, runtime optimization, and security and cost monitoring. Yet trajectory data today is fragmented across files, databases, and observability systems, with no persistent data management system designed around its unique structure and access patterns. We argue that trajectories should be treated as a distinct data type. A trajectory combines hierarchical execution structure, large volumes of text whose analysis often requires semantic reasoning, and rich dependencies and lineage among events, intermediate states, and derived artifacts. These properties introduce new requirements throughout the data lifecycle. Ingestion must reconstruct and preserve execution structure and lineage; storage must efficiently organize large but highly redundant contexts while maintaining relationships among records; and query processing must jointly reason over structure, temporal order, semantics, and lineage. We therefore envision TrajectoryDB, a trajectory-native data management system that co-designs ingestion, storage, and query processing to efficiently manage and analyze agent execution trajectories.

</details>


### [485] [Generalized DBLog: A Verified Contract for Interleaving Database Rows with a Change Log](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08160)
*Andreas Andreakis*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出"广义DBLog"框架，将Netflix的DBLog变更数据捕获（CDC）算法推广为一个通用正确性契约。该契约为复制数据库行与变更日志合并提供了严格的形式化保证条件，涵盖了Debezium和Flink CDC等多种主流CDC实现，并经过Isabelle/HOL、Lean 4和TLA+三种工具的机器化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CDC管道在引导初始化、添加表或修复下游数据时需要合并现有行的副本与活跃的变更日志，这一"copy-to-log handoff"问题面临两大核心挑战：一是变更不能从间隙中漏掉，二是较旧的复制状态不能覆盖较新的日志更新或复活已删除的行。尽管Netflix的DBLog、Debezium和Flink CDC采用了类似的设计，但缺乏一个统一的形式化框架来证明各种变体实现何时能正确重构源数据库状态。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 方法包含以下核心要素：(1) 建立源端契约——包括S-LOG（提交有序键控日志）、S-IMG（图像充分性）、S-OBS（可观测性）三项源承诺，以及O1-O5五项计划义务（覆盖性、括号局部有效性、域完整性、声明的外部断言、表示一致性）；(2) 证明核心"切割定理"——证明在任何满足契约的捕获计划中，规范回放等于在边界位置上的源行事件回放状态；(3) 形式化三种合并语义——窗口丢弃（window-discard）、范围合并（range-merge）和点拼接（point-splice），并证明其与规范规则的等价性；(4) 实例化五种生产协议——经典水印DBLog、Debezium信号表模式、Debezium MySQL/MariaDB只读模式、Flink CDC并行分块，以及坐标绑定读取/原生转储；(5) 三重机器化验证——Isabelle/HOL（约5000行）、Lean 4（核心定理独立证明）和TLA+（五个有界模型检查）。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 切割定理（Theorem 2）证明任何满足契约的计划的规范回放在边界位置上与源行事件回放状态逐键相等，无需全局数据库快照，不同键可在不同时刻被读取；(2) 三个推论——共享见证推论（Corollary 8/Shared witness）允许在更早的协调点启动轨迹，延续推论（Corollary 9/Continuation）保证扩展观测下状态仍精确，组合推论（Corollary 10/Mixing）支持异构引导（如转储与分块读取混合）；(3) 证明了O2条件（每键存在性括号局部有效性）严格弱于单一读取点的要求（Proposition 4），展示了每个键可反映括号内不同坐标的实例；(4) 证明了"扣留门"（withholding gate）的必要性（Proposition 13）——窗口收窄变体会错误地让预括号事件复活已删除行；(5) 退化定理（Theorem 6/Degradation）将可信点拼接推广为不确定性区间括号的T2级契约；(6) 四种保证级别T0-T3的语义层级加T4认证覆盖层。所有核心结果均通过Isabelle/HOL完整机器化验证（约5000行），中心切割定理在Lean 4中独立重新证明，五个TLA+模型通过有界模型检查验证了操作协议。

Conclusion: 广义DBLog为扩展和组合CDC捕获方法提供了统一基础。中心论断是：一旦复制和协调完成，复制的行和记录的变更必须正确地重构所选数据。该框架明确区分了源数据库必须提供什么保证与连接器实现必须建立什么行为，使得任何新的副本获取方式都可以依据同一契约进行评估。该契约的机器化开发为这些扩展和组合提供了可重用的形式化证明，交付、崩溃恢复和下游应用则需要单独验证。对于连接器维护者和作者而言，该契约为检查现有捕获路径、改变其操作方式或在保持对复制行、更新和删除的正确处理的同时增加新方法提供了具体依据。组合结果还允许一个捕获对不同的表或键范围使用不同的方法（如一张表使用原生转储，另一张表使用分块读取），只要它们都建立在同一源历史之上且分配的键不重叠，就能保持正确性保证。

Abstract: Change-data capture (CDC) feeds downstream systems like caches, search indexes, and data warehouses from a database's log of committed row changes. When bootstrapping, adding a table, or repairing downstream data, a pipeline must also copy existing rows. Merging this copy with the active log introduces the copy-to-log handoff problem. Changes must not fall through a gap, and older copied state must not overwrite a newer logged update or resurrect a deleted row. DBLog, developed at Netflix, addressed this problem by reading tables in chunks and interleaving those reads with the live log. Watermarks identify the changes that overlap each read, and the log wins when a copied row is stale. Debezium and Flink CDC have since adapted this design. Earlier work proved that applying the original algorithm's copied rows and logged changes in their emitted order reconstructs the source's rows, including the effect of every logged insert, update, and delete processed. Generalized DBLog asks when the same result holds for variants of that design. We state the conditions the source and capture implementation must satisfy. Once copying and reconciliation are complete, we prove that the result holds across all selected tables and key ranges even when their rows were read at different times. A single database snapshot is not required for the copy. Further logged changes advance the reconstructed state one event at a time. We establish these guarantees for classic watermarking, Debezium's signal-table and read-only modes, Flink CDC's parallel chunks, reads and dumps tied to exact log positions, and engine-consistent backups whose log position lies within known bounds. The complete theory is machine-checked in Isabelle/HOL, its core independently verified in Lean 4, and the protocols are also examined by bounded model checking in TLA+.

</details>


### [486] [UnespDataLens-RM: A Reference Model for Analytical Data Engineering with Governance, Quality, Provenance, and Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08184)
*Ronaldo Celso Messias Correia,Douglas Francisquini Toledo,Camila Tolin Santos da Silva*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种与技术无关的参考模型 UnespDataLens-RM，旨在统一整合分析数据工程中的技术运营流程与跨领域能力（如治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性），以解决当前分析数据全生命周期中方法论碎片化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着数据驱动决策的普及，数据工程在构建处理异构数据管道方面愈发重要。然而，分析资产的可靠性不仅依赖于数据处理能力，还依赖于治理、质量保证、溯源、可追溯性、版本控制和可复现性等机制。这些责任通常由不同的模型、框架和运营实践分别承担，导致分析数据生命周期内出现方法论碎片化，缺乏统一指导。

Method: 采用设计科学研究（Design Science Research, DSR）方法论开发 UnespDataLens-RM。该模型包含八个技术运营模块、八个跨领域模块、补充维度，以及一套形式化的工件、指标和验证标准，将技术操作流程与跨领域能力集成在统一结构中，从设计阶段就纳入治理、质量、溯源、可追溯性和可复现性考量。

Result: 产出了一个全面且与技术无关的参考模型规范。该模型提供了概念性和方法论性的框架，包含具体的模块划分、补充维度，以及用于评估和实施的正式化工件、指标和验证标准，支持未来分析管道的实例化和经验评估。

Conclusion: UnespDataLens-RM 为构建更具可治理性、有据可查、可追溯、可审计和可复现的分析管道提供了统一的概念与方法论基础，可作为未来相关管道实例化及实证评估的指导框架。

Abstract: The growing reliance on data in analytical processes and evidence-based decision-making has reinforced the importance of Data Engineering in building pipelines capable of integrating, transforming, validating, and delivering data from heterogeneous sources. However, the reliability of analytical assets depends not only on data processing capabilities but also on mechanisms for governance, quality assurance, provenance, traceability, versioning, and reproducibility throughout their lifecycle. These responsibilities are commonly addressed by different models, frameworks, and operational practices, resulting in methodological fragmentation across the analytical data lifecycle. To address this gap, this article proposes UnespDataLens-RM, a technology-independent reference model that integrates technical-operational processes and cross-cutting capabilities within a unified structure for Analytical Data Engineering. The model aims to support the specification, organization, and evolution of analytical pipelines by incorporating governance, quality, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility from the design stage. Developed following the Design Science Research approach, UnespDataLens-RM comprises eight technical-operational modules, eight cross-cutting modules, complementary dimensions, and a formalized set of artifacts, metrics, and validation criteria. The resulting specification offers a conceptual and methodological framework for future instantiations and empirical evaluations of analytical pipelines designed to be more governable, documented, traceable, auditable, and reproducible.

</details>


### [487] [SmartANN: Object Causal Modeling Boosts Approximate Nearest Neighbor Diagnosis and Auto-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08240)
*Yutong Zhou,Guoxin Kang,Lei Wang,Xueya Zhang,Qinwei Yang,Jianfeng Zhan*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SmartANN是一个基于对象因果模型(OCM)的框架，用于近似最近邻(ANN)算法的瓶颈归因和自动重设计。它将ANN工作流建模为八个有序、可替换的对象，通过顺序诊断-替换循环识别瓶颈，再从可插拔动作库中组合兼容动作生成端到端优化方案。在八个真实数据集上，Recall提升0.24–74.20%，QPS提升28.8–256.5%，且调优开销低于VDTuner 2.9–42.0倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ANN性能分析方法存在两个层面的不足：(1)组件级分析孤立比较设计选择，无法追踪性能损失在依赖阶段间的传播；(2)端到端基准仅报告聚合指标，无法定位根因。这阻碍了自动重设计，因为用户面对特定数据集和工作负载的瓶颈时，只能进行昂贵的试错循环来选择优化方法。

Method: SmartANN包含三大组件：(1)对象因果模型——将ANN索引构建与查询执行分解为8个有序对象O1–O8（表征、单元实例化、候选关系生成、关系物化、访问定位、候选探索、候选打分、结果决策），每个对象定义机制Mi、诊断指标Pi和动作Ai；(2)顺序诊断-替换循环——按执行顺序遍历对象，将首个偏离期望的对象标记为瓶颈，用测试预言(test oracle)或更强的替换实现替换其输出后再继续下游诊断，从而抑制上游性能损失传播；(3)归因引导的自动重设计——从42个动作的可插拔库中，经对象覆盖过滤与失败原因匹配两阶段筛选，组合兼容动作并通过选择集评估选出最优设计。框架基于Evaluatology理论，实例化于IVF-PQ和HNSW两大代表性ANN族。

Result: 在八个真实数据集(SIFT、Deep、GIST、Tiny5M、GloVe、MSong、Yandex-200、Wikipedia)上，IVF-PQ和HNSW均验证有效：Recall提升0.24–74.20个百分点，或在可比Recall下QPS提升28.8–256.5%。相比随机基线，瓶颈归因能更可靠地选择匹配失败原因的动作；相比VDTuner黑盒调优器，SmartANN在HNSW上端到端延迟加速2.9–36.4倍（聚合约5.0倍），IVF-PQ上加速4.7–42.0倍（聚合约11.6倍）。消融实验验证了替换算子在揭示被掩盖的下游瓶颈中的关键作用。

Conclusion: SmartANN通过对象级因果建模和顺序替换诊断，实现了对ANN算法性能瓶颈的细粒度归因与自动化重设计。其核心贡献在于：(1)首次将Evaluatology的对象因果模型应用于ANN诊断；(2)通过替换引导的归因解决损失传播掩盖下游瓶颈的难题；(3)将42个异构优化动作模块化，通过对象接口实现可插拔组合。实验证明该方法在Recall–QPS权衡上优于黑盒调优方法，同时开销显著降低。

Abstract: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) algorithms achieve high efficiency through interdependent phases across index construction and query execution. This coupling allows upstream performance loss to propagate downstream, affecting execution behavior and measurable outputs. Existing component-level analyses mainly compare isolated design choices, while end-to-end benchmarks report aggregate metrics; neither traces loss propagation across dependent phases, hindering root-cause attribution and automated redesign. We present SmartANN, a framework based on the object causal model (OCM) for ANN bottleneck attribution and automated redesign. SmartANN represents an ANN workflow as eight ordered, replaceable objects and diagnoses them with a sequential diagnose-and-replace loop. At each iteration, it identifies the first object deviating from expected behavior or output as a bottleneck. Because an upstream bottleneck can obscure downstream ones, SmartANN replaces it with a test oracle when available, or with an implementation producing a better outcome, then continues downstream diagnosis. From the diagnosed bottlenecks and failure causes, SmartANN composes compatible actions from a pluggable action library to generate an optimized end-to-end ANN design. We instantiate SmartANN for IVF-PQ and HNSW, covering partition-and-quantization and graph-based ANN families. Experiments on eight real-world datasets show that SmartANN improves Recall by 0.24--74.20%, and increases QPS by 28.8--256.5% at comparable Recall, with low diagnosis and auto-design overhead. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [488] [WiDiff: Extracting Changes from Wikidata's Edit History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08508)
*Carolina Cortés,Lisa Ehrlinger,Lorena Etcheverry,Felix Naumann*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: WiDiff是一个开源工具，用于从Wikidata完整的编辑历史中提取变更数据，并提供统一接口支持大规模分析查询。它将Wikidata的XML转储解析为变更日志并加载到关系数据库中，以支持对知识图谱演化的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wikidata作为最大的开放协作知识图谱，拥有超过1.2亿实体和超过20亿次编辑，但现有的数据格式（定期转储和实时事件流）均不支持对完整编辑历史进行大规模分析查询。已有方案（如Wikidated 1.0、Tanon等人的SPARQL端点）要么未公开发布，要么已下线，要么功能受限，无法满足对KG演化研究的需求。

Method: WiDiff基于扩展的"变更立方体"（change cube）模型，将每次变更表示为⟨timestamp, entity_id, property, new_value⟩元组，并进一步扩展以捕获语句值、rank、限定符值和引用值四个粒度的变更。架构包括：1)文件解析器（使用lxml流式读取bz2压缩的XML文件）；2)变更提取器（通过比较JSON快照对连续修订之间的标签、描述、语句值、rank、限定符和引用进行比较，使用SHA-1哈希识别限定符和引用的值）；3)使用PostgreSQL作为存储层（经基准测试优于QLever RDF存储2.25倍）。处理流程支持多文件并行和多worker进程配置。

Result: 使用2025年6月的Wikidata转储（共2125个XML文件，2.2TB压缩数据），WiDiff在HPC集群上用6.1天（实际计算时间，非并行）处理了1.207亿实体、23.12亿次修订，提取的数据压缩后为4.43TB。应用过滤器（排除学术文章、天体对象和少于10次值变更的实体）后，得到3100万实体、7.43亿次修订、7.095亿次值变更、6.163亿次rank变更、18.77亿次引用变更、1.825亿次限定符变更。研究发现了以下洞察：(1)修订计数会严重低估编辑活动（如《野性的呼唤》有14302次修订但仅涉及61个属性）；(2)35%的rank弃用缺乏P2241限定符说明原因，最常见原因是标识符过时（19%）和已撤回的标识符值（15%）；(3)71%的rank弃用由注册用户执行，58%的rank提升由机器人执行；(4)仅0.07%和0.14%的rank提升和弃用被回退，表明这些变更具有较高可信度。

Conclusion: WiDiff填补了Wikidata完整编辑历史大规模分析工具的空白，提供了开源工具和公开数据集。未来工作将涵盖多语言标签/描述变更提取、别名和站点链接变更捕获，以及扩展到DBpedia等其他知识图谱。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs have become a key resource for integrating heterogeneous data and powering downstream tasks such as question answering, entity linking, and semantic search. They are built and maintained incrementally, either (i) fully automated, e.g., YAGO, (ii) semiautomatically with community oversight, e.g., DBpedia, or (iii) manually through collaborative editing, e.g., Wikidata. Understanding the evolution of knowledge graphs is essential as changes may reflect real-world updates, error corrections, or noise introduced by vandalism, all of which affect the reliability of downstream applications. Among openly available knowledge graphs, Wikidata is the most challenging case to study evolution, with over 120 million entities edited by humans and bots and an edit history spanning more than a decade. Although Wikidata exposes change data in various formats (e.g., periodic dumps and real-time event streams), none support analytical queries over the complete edit history. Therefore, we present WiDiff, a tool that extracts changes from Wikidata's complete edit history and provides a unified interface for large-scale analytical queries over it.

</details>


### [489] [SQLMorph: Query Mutation and Fine-Grained Metrics for Text-to-SQL Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08950)
*Mohammadhossein Malekpour,Mohamed Riahi,Maxime Lamothe,Amine Mhedhbi*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SQLMorph是一个Text-to-SQL评估框架，通过查询变异（Join Query Expansion和Textual Query Augmentation）自动生成和扩展评估集，并引入细粒度的执行级指标（Execution Precision和Execution Recall）以替代二元的Execution Accuracy，从而更精确地诊断Text-to-SQL系统的过预测和欠预测错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前Text-to-SQL评估面临两大瓶颈：一是公共基准（如BIRD）无法反映企业级schema的复杂性和命名习惯，私有评估集构建成本高且难以复现；二是主流指标Execution Accuracy（EX）是二值的，无法区分部分正确性，无法区分过预测（多出列/行）和欠预测（遗漏行/列），也难以诊断系统具体失败原因。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Join Query Expansion (JQE)——基于schema图，通过算法化方式增加有效join条件（经语义冗余检查和多样性剪枝）来系统性提升查询结构复杂度，仅在最后用LLM重写NL；(2) Textual Query Augmentation (TQA)——使用SNAILS分类器将schema标识符从自然命名（N1）降级为缩写形式（N3），并通过SQL ALTER和正则替换保持可执行性，专门压力测试检索阶段；(3) 细粒度指标——定义Execution Precision (EXP, 预测正确单元格比例)、Execution Recall (EXR, 真实单元格被恢复比例)及其F1，支持Exact-Column/Semantic-Column/No-Column三种列匹配、Exact-Cell/Partial-Cell两种行匹配，以及Penalize Extras/Ignore Extras两种额外列处理策略。

Result: 在BIRD dev集上的实验：JQE生成6873条查询，58条具有非同构的join图结构，平均节点度从0.82升至1.35，环状结构从0.27%升至4.31%（扩展集达51.72%），CHESS/DIN-SQL在扩展查询上EX分别从63.33%/60%降至44.83%/32.76%，准确率随join数增加单调下降（≥4个join时EX≤15%）；TQA在L/L设置下导致DIN-SQL EX下降23.9%，SCSL检索器的Schema Linking Recall从15%降至9.8%；单错误突变实验证明EXP/EXR能精确反映14种不同SQL错误的过/欠预测模式，而EX在所有错误下均为0；在三个系统共同失败的410个查询上，CHESS的EXR约19.66%，MAC-SQL仅16.07%，F1指标揭示了EX无法体现的部分正确性差异。

Conclusion: SQLMorph将Text-to-SQL评估从静态基准测试转变为可控的压力测试流程。JQE和TQA作为目标性choke points分别针对SQL生成的结构复杂性和检索阶段的语言鲁棒性，而EXP/EXR指标提供了诊断级的执行正确性度量。三者结合构成了一个可复现的、面向企业部署需求的评估框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language queries into executable SQL, democratizing access to structured data. Despite recent advances driven by large language models (LLMs), evaluation remains a major bottleneck: public benchmarks fail to capture the complexity of enterprise schema, while building private evaluation sets is costly and nondeterministic, making evaluation results difficult to reproduce. To address this issue, we present SQLMorph, a framework for Text-to-SQL evaluation via query mutation. SQLMorph introduces two techniques to automatically generate and expand evaluation sets: Join Query Expansion (JQE), which systematically increases structural complexity through valid join additions, and Textual Query Augmentation (TQA), which generates controlled natural language perturbations to assess robustness to linguistic variation. JQE and TQA create targeted choke points to challenge specific system components. When applied to state-of-the-art systems, JQE increases query coverage and reveals accuracy degradation as the number of joins grows. Meanwhile, TQA shows that linguistic brittleness induced by heavy abbreviation can reduce accuracy by up to 17%. Beyond evaluation sets, SQLMorph introduces a family of execution-level metrics that address the limitations of current binary measures, such as Execution Accuracy. We define Execution Precision (EXP) and Execution Recall (EXR) to quantify the fraction of correct and recovered results, respectively, and combine them via F1 for unified scoring. Our experiments show that these relaxed metrics enable fine-grained analysis of over- and under-prediction, revealing differences across systems that binary metrics obscure. Together, SQLMorph's query mutation and fine-grained metrics support debugging and better align Text-to-SQL evaluation practices with real-world deployments.

</details>


### [490] [Factorized and Vectorized Execution: Optimizing Analytical and Semantic Queries over Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09002)
*Sunny Yasser,Anas Dorbani,Amine Mhedhbi*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: FFX 是首个在完全向量化的流水线中支持任意因子化方案的查询引擎，通过引入打包因子化向量（packed factorized vectors）级联更新算子和因子化语义处理，在 join-heavy 分析查询和 LLM 语义算子上同时获得因子化的紧凑性和向量化的高效执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多对多 join 在分析型工作负载（欺诈检测、图分析、推荐）和新兴的"分析+语义"工作负载中产生巨大的中间结果（有时比输入大几个数量级），导致传统 RDBMS 和图数据库以及 LLM 推理成本急剧上升。因子化表示虽能利用条件独立性将中间结果压缩到 AGM 界以下，但与向量化执行（块式、扁平布局）存在架构不兼容：现有方法要么全物化牺牲流水线，要么仅支持受限的因子化布局，损失两者的优势。

Method: 三大核心机制：(1) **打包因子化向量**：在固定大小的连续内存块内，通过 offset 数组显式编码 f-tree 的父子分组关系，保持 fully packed，避免 LBP 的稀疏向量问题，支持任意分支的 f-tree。(2) **级联更新算子 (Cascade Update)**：从 f-tree 派生的依赖树上传播切片收缩和选择器失效，包含 AGG（向上聚合）和 SCATTER（向下散播）两类传播，并采用延迟插入、算子融合和 delta-driven AGG 三种优化。(3) **因子化语义处理**：通过结构感知的窗口迭代器直接对因子化向量做提示词序列化，利用 f-tree 结构避免重复属性，并指示 LLM 执行隐含的笛卡尔积展开，输出端恢复为扁平元组。(4) 多路 join 采用"扩展-求交"交替的最坏情况最优策略。(5) 当因子化无收益时优雅回退到标准向量化执行。

Result: 在 Google/Epinions/Amazon 数据集上，FFX 的打包向量相对 LBP 的解包向量在 96.5% 的执行计划上更快，平均加速 2.08×，最大 9.39×；虚拟函数调用减少 78.77×，分支预测、cache miss 均显著改善。在 Amazon 九个 query 上相对 DuckDB/Kuzu 达到 10²–10⁵× 加速，尤其在星形查询（Q5）上 10⁵× 优于 Kuzu。LSQB 和 JOB benchmark 上对 DuckDB 持续更快。在 ArXiv 2-hop 引文任务上，因子化提示词将输入 token 减少 1.7×–22.54×（对比 Lotus 最高 18.83×），在较大 batch size 下退化更平缓。

Conclusion: 因子化与向量化是互补的设计选择；FFX 证明了二者可以在单一流水线引擎中统一，支持任意 f-tree 布局而不牺牲全打包和缓存友好性，并通过端到端传递因子化中间结果优化 join-heavy 分析查询和 LLM 增强的语义查询。

Abstract: Many-to-many joins are central to analytical and semantic workloads such as fraud detection, network analysis, and recommendation, where insights arise from relationships between entities. These workloads often suffer from an explosion of intermediate results, sometimes orders of magnitude larger than the inputs. Factorized representations address this problem by exploiting conditional independence among attributes to encode intermediates more compactly. In some cases, they can reduce the output size asymptotically below the worst-case output size. However, adopting factorization in modern vectorized query processors remains challenging: factorized representations are hierarchical, whereas vectorized execution is built around flat, block-oriented processing. Prior approaches either rely on full materialization or support only restricted factorization layouts, sacrificing much of the benefits of both factorization and vectorization. We present FFX, a novel engine for Fast Factorized eXecution. FFX is the first pipelined engine to support arbitrary factorization schemes while preserving full vectorization. The engine introduces packed factorized vectors and operators that maintain cache-friendly, contiguous layouts. Beyond analytics, FFX also co-optimizes semantic operators by serializing factorized intermediates into compact prompts for large language models (LLMs), substantially reducing token usage and inference cost while maintaining output quality and, in some cases, improving it. Together, these contributions enable efficient execution of join-heavy analytical queries, including queries augmented with semantic operators.

</details>
