Its mechanisms follow from the ingestion architecture (subject of a separate patent application): (a) a producer-side fact layer rendering precomputed metric facts verbatim without ranking; (b) positional addressing with deterministic cross-source alignment, resolved ahead of query time at zero LLM cost; (c) provenance scoping as an attribution constraint with multi-tier named-reference routing; and (d) two-tier context with model-triggered verbatim hydration. Across four ablations, a 2B model reaches parity with a 35B model on factual integrity (exact values in all runs; zero confabulated numbers on absent-entity traps); structured retrieval beats flat RAG by +11.4 points at 2B; skeleton-only context preserves quantitative answers at 20-30% smaller prompts; and hydration recovers verbatim narrative in ~8s versus ~29s. Two properties matter for regulated domains: each query resolves in a single generation call, and every reported value is traceable to its exact source and position by construction.

</details>


### [520] [Exploring Bottom-Up Clustering for Creating Semantic IDs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08310)
*Leah Woldemariam,Sudhanshu Garg,Taha Belkhouja,Charles Kim-Yip,Ali Sahami*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于自底向上（bottom-up）聚类生成语义ID（Semantic IDs, SIDs）的算法，旨在同时保证每个物品拥有唯一标识符并保留原始嵌入空间的局部结构。通过从最细粒度聚类开始并逐层向上合并，方法能够更好地保留嵌入空间中的局部邻域关系，从而提升下游生成式检索（generative retrieval）任务的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义ID构建方法（如RQ-VAE和残差K-Means）主要采用自顶向下的方式，容易丢失局部结构信息，且面临码本坍塌（codebook collapse）和标识符冲突（item collision）两大核心问题。如何在保证唯一性的同时保留嵌入空间的局部结构，成为提升生成式检索性能的关键。

Method: 1. **最细粒度聚类**：使用MiniBatchKMeans将N个物品嵌入划分为k₁个细粒度簇，对每个簇内成员枚举分配第L个码字以保证唯一性。2. **递归合并**：计算加权质心后，在更高层级上迭代使用MiniBatchKMeans对质心进行聚类，使用成员数作为样本权重，并将标签传播到原始物品。3. **新物品分配**：新物品继承其最近邻的前L-1个码字，在选中簇内分配唯一第L个码字，可处理冷启动场景。整体通过自底向上方式构建层次化语义ID树。

Result: 在自定义580万物品数据集、Amazon Beauty和Sports & Outdoors数据集上的实验表明：- **唯一性**：Bottom-Up方法每个ID对应恰好1个物品（RQ-VAE为1.35-1.63个）。- **聚类质量**：轮廓系数（silhouette score）显著优于RQ-VAE（如自定义数据集0.29 vs 0.00）。- **下游检索性能**：Recall@10和NDCG@10在多数数据集上优于RQ-VAE。- **语义一致性**：每个簇内的平均唯一类别数更高，表明码本使用更充分。

Conclusion: 自底向上聚类方法能够有效生成同时满足唯一性和保留嵌入空间局部结构的语义ID，相比RQ-VAE在聚类质量和下游生成式检索任务上均表现更优。这表明将预训练表示转换为离散抽象的方式会显著影响其下游可用性，保留任务相关的局部结构可使这些表示在下游决策中更具可操作性。

Abstract: The success of generative retrieval has largely been attributed to the use of Semantic IDs, which improve over arbitrary item-level identifiers such as hashes by capturing the semantics of items. The main challenges faced when constructing Semantic IDs, however, is in mapping each identifier to a unique product and capturing information valuable to downstream tasks. Past works have appended additional codewords to de-duplicate item identifiers and utilized residual quantization to create hierarchical clusters. In this work, we present an algorithm for generating Semantic IDs that ensure the identifiers are both unique and preserve the structure of the original embedding. Key to our work is the use of bottom-up clustering to preserve local structure in the embedding space, improving the clustering quality of the resulting Semantic IDs and their utility for downstream generative retrieval.

</details>


### [521] [SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08443)
*Lin Guan,Jia-Qi Yang,Zhishan Zhao,Jiaqi Huang,Hangyu Wang,Longbin Li,Beichuan Zhang,Haonan Jiang,Jinan Ni,Xiangyu Fan,Xiaowen Li,Ziyao Ren,Yuhang Qi,Xiaolong Zhu,Xuanyuan Luo,Qiwei Chen,Yi Cheng,Lele Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SequenceO1是字节跳动在抖音全量部署的端到端超长(100K)用户行为序列建模框架,采用"先压缩后推理"的范式,通过Sketch Attention将超长历史压缩为固定大小的目标无关用户草图,再结合近期10K后缀与压缩草图分别进行目标条件STCA推理,并通过低秩缓存、MRLB批处理、FlashSA内核等系统优化,实现缓存命中路径对原始序列长度的O(1)复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 百亿级短视频推荐中,单用户一年可积累10万级交互行为,蕴含短期窗口难以捕捉的稳定偏好与周期性模式。然而细排阶段受限于严格的延迟、内存、通信和训练吞吐约束,直接将100K序列进行端到端建模面临存储、传输、计算三重系统性瓶颈。现有方案(截断、TWIN V2两阶段检索、长度外推)要么削弱端到端优化,要么仍保留显著的长度相关成本。

Method: 模型层:1)Sketch Attention(SA):通过可学习原型与原型维度softmax归一化,将100K历史压缩为固定大小(k≈512-1024)、目标无关、长度无关的用户草图;2)堆叠精炼(N_sa=2)进一步提升草图质量;3)双时间尺度STCA推理:近期10K后缀捕捉短期兴趣,压缩草图捕捉超长期信号;4)轻量融合模块(部署中为MixFormer)整合两路。系统层:1)训练端本地KVCache跨同一用户的重复实例复用用户草图;2)服务端共享缓存复用连续请求的草图;3)MRLB(多请求用户级批处理)将同用户多请求的草图计算摊销;4)Pipeline Lift将用户草图计算前移至请求入口;5)FlashSA融合内核避免在ragged batching下物化kn中间矩阵。

Result: 离线:全量生产环境下相对STCA 10K+TWIN V2基线,Finish AUC +0.29%,10个目标UAUC均提升(Dislike +1.47%, Favourite +0.94%, Share +0.94%)。在线A/B(一个月,抖音与抖音Lite全量):Duration +1.50%/+1.67%, Finish +2.33%/+3.49%, Dislike -6.98%/-6.00%, 低活跃用户活跃度+0.55%/+0.66%。复杂度:100K下训练FLOPs为STCA+MRLB的1/49.9(约3.05 vs 152.13 GFLOPs/target),推理为1/63.9(约0.67 vs 43.08 GFLOPs/target)。压缩质量:SA在相同1K×128预算下以+1.07% Finish AUC优于K-means(+0.30%)、chunk mean(+0.46%)、position-bucket queries(+0.72%)、Lightning-Attention压缩(+0.83%)等方法,且保留直接扩展STCA至100K增益的83%(+1.07% vs +1.29%)。

Conclusion: SequenceO1通过模型与系统协同设计,首次在工业级短视频推荐中实现端到端100K序列建模全量部署。核心洞察是超长用户历史既"可压缩"又"可复用":将昂贵的目标条件推理从原始序列转移到固定大小的低秩用户草图上,结合缓存优先的系统摊销策略,可同时获得训练与服务两端数量级的成本下降,并在抖音主站与Lite上取得稳定在线收益。框架具备向百万级历史扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Modeling long-term user behavior is central to sequential recommendation and billion-scale industrial recommender systems, yet production ranking models operate under strict latency, memory, communication, and training-throughput constraints. At the 100K scale, the challenge extends beyond attention complexity: raw sequence features must be stored, transferred, and repeatedly processed during training and online serving. Existing approaches based on history truncation, multi-stage behavior retrieval, compressed lifelong histories, or train-short/infer-long extrapolation either weaken end-to-end optimization or retain substantial length-dependent cost. We present SequenceO1, an end-to-end framework for ultra-long user behavior sequence modeling, deployed at full traffic on Douyin with histories of up to 100K interactions. SequenceO1 follows a compress-then-reason design. Its Sketch Attention (SA) uses learnable prototypes and prototype-wise normalization to compress the raw history into a fixed-size, target-agnostic user representation. Target-conditioned Stacked Target-to-History Cross Attention (STCA) then models complementary time scales: a recent 10K suffix for short-term interests and the compact sketch for long-term preferences. To make training and inference practical, SequenceO1 combines low-rank user representation caching, multi-request user-level batching, pipeline lift, and a fused FlashSA kernel to amortize feature storage, communication, and computation across targets, training instances, and consecutive requests. Production experiments show consistent offline and online gains, while the compact cached sketch retains most of the benefit of directly scaling end-to-end sequence ranking to 100K. These results provide a practical model-system approach to efficient attention, sequence compression, and scalable long-sequence and long-context recommendation systems.

</details>


### [522] [EigenLI: Spectral Approximations to Late Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07561)
*Archish S,Sabyasachi Basu,Ankit Garg,Ravishankar Krishnaswamy,Kirankumar Shiragur*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 EigenLI，一种基于谱方法的晚期交互（late-interaction）多向量压缩框架。它利用文档token嵌入的低秩结构，将每个文档表示为文档特定的低维子空间（通过二阶矩矩阵的top-k特征向量），并设计了新的评分函数。在此基础上进一步提出 EigenLI-SV，通过二次多项式核映射得到单向量表示，可兼容ANN检索。实验在BEIR和ViDoRe-v3上进行，覆盖ColBERTv2、AnswerAI-ColBERT-small、GTE-ModernColBERT和ColQwen3-4B等模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多向量（晚期交互）检索模型如ColBERT虽然效果强大，但每文档需要数百个token向量，导致索引成本高、存储占用大、MaxSim打分昂贵。现有的训练-free压缩方法（k-means、Ward聚类池化）将文档压缩为更小的"代表性向量集合"，但效果仍有提升空间。本文观察到多向量嵌入天然存在低秩结构，探索能否利用该结构实现更高效的压缩。

Method: 核心方法 k-EigenLI：对文档token向量集合，计算其二阶矩矩阵 M_D = Σ d_i d_i^T，取其top-k特征向量 w_1,…,w_k 作为文档的压缩表示。新的评分函数定义为 s_k(Q,D) = Σ_i Σ_j ⟨q_i, w_j⟩²，即查询token向量在文档top-k子空间上的投影能量之和（等价于查询token投影到子空间后的L2范数平方和）。该评分函数可重写为 d²维单向量点积形式 s_k = ⟨Σ q_i⊗q_i, Σ w_j⊗w_j⟩，进而用二次多项式核 K(x) = (x_1²,…,√2 x_i x_j,…) 将维度降至 d(d+1)/2，得到 EigenLI-SV 单向量表示，可兼容ANN索引系统。理论上证明该评分函数与MaxSim相关，且当top-k特征值捕获大部分质量时效果良好。

Result: 在BEIR 13个数据集上的主要结果（k=32）：
- ColBERTv2：EigenLI-32相对KMeans++在nDCG@10上AM提升15.0%，相对Ward提升8.0%；全MaxSim仅有-3.2%的差距。
- AnswerAI-ColBERT-small：同样趋势，nDCG@10相对KMeans++提升11.9%（AM）。
- GTE-ModernColBERT：k=32时聚类方法更优，EigenLI在nDCG和MRR上落后。
- ViDoRe-v3（ColQwen3-4B，k=32）：EigenLI相对KMeans++ nDCG@10 AM提升5.5%，相对Ward提升3.4%。
- EigenLI-SV vs MUVERA（8256维 vs 10240维）：ColBERTv2 nDCG@10 AM提升78.9%，AnswerAI提升178.1%，GTE-ModernColBERT提升156.0%，在三个模型上均显著优于MUVERA。
- 压缩时间：k-means++比EigenLI慢6.81×（AM），Ward慢17.46×。
- 对各向异性模型（GTE-ModernColBERT等），MUVERA对centering敏感，而EigenLI-SV相对鲁棒。

Conclusion: EigenLI证明晚期交互表示存在显著的低秩结构，将文档压缩为低维子空间表示比聚类成代表性向量集合更有效。EigenLI-SV作为兼容ANN的单向量代理，在多个模型和数据集上一致超越MUVERA。然而效果具有模型依赖性——在GTE-ModernColBERT等各向异性模型上，EigenLI可能不如聚类方法。EigenLI为多向量压缩提供了新的理论视角（集合到子空间的压缩），但仍需进一步研究模型几何特性与最优压缩策略之间的关系、ANN端到端检索流程、以及向更大token维模型的扩展。

Abstract: Late-interaction models such as ColBERT achieve strong effectiveness by representing each document with many token-level vectors, but this expressivity leads to large indexing cost, storage footprints and expensive MaxSim scoring. We show that late-interaction representations exhibit an intrinsic low-rank structure: document token embeddings concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace that preserves most of the retrieval signal. Leveraging this observation, we introduce EigenLI, a spectral approximation framework that compresses late-interaction representations via document-specific low-dimensional subspaces. Unlike clustering or pooling methods, EigenLI identifies the dominant eigendirections of each document and uses them to construct reduced interaction representations. Empirically, $k$-EigenLI with $k \le 32$ outperforms k-means and Ward clustering based pooling methods on ColBERTv2 and AnswerAI-ColBERT-small; GTE-ModernColBERT exhibits a different tradeoff at $k=32$, where clustering methods perform better. The same spectral construction also yields EigenLI-SV, an ANN-compatible single-vector representation derived from the second-order summary of the reduced structure. Across multiple datasets and all three text models, EigenLI-SV consistently outperforms comparable single-vector surrogates such as MUVERA.

</details>


### [523] [EviMap: Evidence-Grounded Hierarchical Topic Maps for Exploring Unlabeled Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06664)
*Zhiyin Tan,Changxu Duan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: EviMap 是一个交互式系统，能够自动从无标签文本语料库中构建一个三级层次主题地图，每个主题节点都可追溯到原文中的具体短语片段，使主题标签从"可读"变为"可验证"。它在六个异构语料库（2,108 到 101,699 篇文档）上进行了演示和评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在项目早期，研究人员需要探索未标记的自由文本集合，但现有方法在规模和可验证性之间存在权衡：定性编码保留证据但缓慢；搜索需要预设查询；聚类和主题模型可扩展但标签需要解读；一次性 LLM 摘要流畅但难以复现和审计。EviMap 旨在提供一个既可扩展又可审计的主题地图。

Method: 系统采用两阶段流水线：(1) 利用 LLM 生成的领域背景和利益相关者关注点，从文档中抽取证据短语作为基本单元；(2) 自底向上构建层次结构——先用 K-Means 对短语进行细粒度嵌入聚类以缩小搜索空间，再通过 LLM 进行更精细的语义判断；通过多轮随机子集采样的协同关联投票（共现分组计数）来稳定分组结果，抵制过度合并。层次结构包含三个层级：顶层 aspect、中层 group 和细粒度 leaf topic。每个节点都链接到原始文档中的字符偏移短语片段。

Result: 在六个异构语料库（ICLR 同行评审、TripAdvisor 酒店评论、Pitchfork 音乐评论、LinkedIn 职位发布、食谱、欧盟辩论）上进行了验证：(1) 对 3,290,920 个主题-证据链接和 4,357,621 个字符偏移跨度的追踪性检查未发现缺失或失配；(2) LLM-as-judge 评估显示 EviMap 的 96 个分层叶子主题在证据连贯性（4.53 vs 3.60/3.96）和标签合理性（4.33 vs 3.50/3.79）上优于 TopicGPT 风格和 TnT-LLM 风格的基线方法；(3) 最大语料库（101,699 篇文档）完整构建约需 18 小时（4×H100 GPU）。

Conclusion: EviMap 通过将每个主题标签锚定到原文短语片段，实现了可审计的主题地图探索，解决了早期语料理解中规模与可验证性的矛盾。系统支持地图浏览、证据检查、主题交集检索和长尾审计，但模型生成的抽取上下文可能遗漏重要方面，小主题折叠可能掩盖少数群体关注点。未来工作将增加用户指定方面、衡量抽取召回率、参数敏感性和运行间变异性，并开展形成性用户研究和多语言评估。

Abstract: Research teams and organizations often explore unfamiliar free-text collections, from survey comments and reviews to reports and domain documents, before labels, queries or coding schemes exist. At this stage, the first thematic map shapes what users notice, prioritize and carry into downstream analysis, so it should be trusted only insofar as it can be verified. Existing options force a trade-off between scale and verifiability. Qualitative coding preserves evidence but is slow. Search presupposes a query. Clustering and topic models scale but produce labels users must interpret. One-shot large language model (LLM) summaries are fluent yet difficult to reproduce or audit. We present EviMap, an interactive system providing researchers and practitioners with an auditable thematic overview of such corpora. Guided by model-generated context describing the corpus and hypothesized stakeholder concerns, EviMap extracts within-document evidence phrases and organizes them, rather than whole documents, into a three-level map of aspects, groups and fine-grained topics. Embedding-based clustering narrows the search space for finer semantic judgments by the LLM. Each node traces back to supporting phrase spans, so documents link to topics through evidence they contain and users can audit labels against the original text. Users can start from a top-level corpus map, drill into topics, inspect highlighted evidence in original documents, and combine two topics to find documents discussing both. We demonstrate this workflow across six heterogeneous corpora spanning 2,108 to 101,699 documents, with a comparison against flat and hierarchical LLM baselines. By grounding every label in verbatim source spans, EviMap makes a topic map not just readable, but verifiable. Code, demo video, and interactive dashboard are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [524] [Measuring GEO Visibility: Prompt Corpora Define the Answer Market](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06811)
*Olivier Martinez*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于生成式引擎优化(GEO)可见性测量的批判性文献综述，指出GEO可见性评分本质上由提示语料库及其权重所定义的"应答市场"决定，而该市场未必反映真实用户需求。文章构建了一个将提示视为"主动测量仪器"的方法论框架，明确区分建构效度、部分识别与来源归因，并提出四项核心决策(D1-D4)以规范GEO评分的报告与比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEO可见性评分在产业实践中被广泛使用，但现有研究缺乏对其测量效度的系统审视。当前的GEO评分实践存在根本性模糊：提示语料的选择决定了被评估的"应答市场"，权重决定了相对重要性，而这些选择实际上参与了测量对象本身的定义，而非仅仅是对已有现象的估计。提示措辞会改变检索结果与生成答案，LLM评判器的指令也会改变评分——这意味着同一答案可能获得不同分数。文章旨在填补这一方法论空白。

Method: 文章采用批判性文献综述方法，综合借鉴测量建构效度研究(Jacobs & Wallach)、总调查误差(Groves & Lyberg)、信息检索评估中的池化问题(Zobel)、部分识别理论(Tamer; Manski)以及项目反应理论等。提出形式化框架：将协议定义为元组(R, Aη, K, H, g)，分别表示目标分布、注释程序、提示策略、执行条件和评分规则。在权重未定时，计算可接受分数集Θ(Π)；区分部分识别集与规范性敏感度包络。定义"来源移除反事实"以区分受控文档上下文下的条件归因与完整引擎中的竞争性干预。

Result: 1. 分析示例证明：在两层场景中，重新加权可逆转两个系统的排名（当λ从0.2变至0.8时，A从0.78降至0.42，B从0.58升至0.52，临界点为λ=0.6）。2. 使用Grossman等发布的三个子语料库(ORCAS, Amazon Retail, ELI5)聚合数据进行二次演示：在权重(0.2,0.6,0.2)与(0.2,0.2,0.6)下，生成式答案激活率分别为39.66%和70.54%，相差30.88个百分点——仅改变权重而子语料库内激活率不变。3. 提出七步实施协议与四项决策(D1明确协议；D2证明权重合理性；D3定义干预；D4在共同权重下比较)。4. 在约束β∈[0.2,0.6]时得到可识别集ΘA=[0.42,0.78]与ΘB=[0.52,0.58]，A在权重低于0.6时严格优于B。

Conclusion: 文章得出结论：GEO可见性评分的价值取决于能否明确说明其所描述的应答机会、比较条件及其变化所允许的推论。提示语料库、注释规则、权重来源与评分仪器共同构成"主动测量仪器"，必须作为测量定义的一部分加以记录。四项决策(D1-D4)提供了可计算的解释框架，但其经验效用仍需通过将语料库与观察到的使用情况对比、评估注释与评判器、以及在合适实验设计中检验结论来加以验证。文章未报告新实验，仅对已发布聚合数据进行可重现的重新计算。

Abstract: GEO (generative engine optimization) visibility scores aggregate source appearances, citations, or brand mentions in generated answers. The prompt corpus selects the situations evaluated, while weights determine their relative importance. Together they define an "answer market" that need not represent actual user demand. Prompt wording can alter retrieval, competing sources, and generated answers. Scoring then requires identifying the appearances, citations, or mentions of interest. If a language model performs this task, its instruction can change the score assigned to an unchanged answer. Our critical survey examines how these choices help define what a GEO score measures. It draws on research into whether indicators measure the intended phenomenon, total survey error, and information retrieval evaluation. The framework specifies situation annotation, prompt formulations, execution conditions, weights, and scoring rules. When weights are unknown or remain to be chosen, the framework reports sets of admissible scores. It distinguishes values compatible with data and assumptions about a target population (partial identification) from variation across weighting conventions (normative sensitivity). A citation alone does not establish a source's contribution. The article defines a comparison of answers generated with and without a source in a controlled documentary context, distinct from an intervention on the full engine with competing sources. The framework is supported by reproducible calculations. No new experiments are reported; its general empirical validity remains to be assessed.

</details>


### [525] [Q2D-Web: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Retrieval in Agentic RAG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08887)
*Maximilian Schall,Sedigheh Eslami,Markus Krimmel,Antoine Chaffin,Louis Milliken,Bo Wang,Denis Bykov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Q2D-Web是一个面向生产级Agentic RAG系统首阶段检索器的大规模评估基准，包含1.9亿文档语料和7万条十种语言的智能体改写查询，并提供三套相关性标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开检索基准存在三个关键缺口：(1)大规模语料（如MS MARCO Web的1亿文档）仅有极少评估查询（9,374条）；(2)查询数量充足的基准（如BEIR）语料规模有限（百万级）；(3)多数基准评估人类查询，而生产环境中Agentic RAG管道首阶段检索器实际服务的是机器改写查询，其分布与人类搜索行为显著不同。此外，现有基准相关性标注稀疏，导致大量假阴性。

Method: 四阶段构建流水线：(1)查询采样——从9个月生产流量中抽取2.3万次搜索，经去重、PII过滤、语言筛选后得到约7万条LLM改写查询（12,365条primary + 57,356条support），覆盖十种语言；(2)语料构建——用生产检索系统对每个查询取top-5000结果取并集，MinHash-LSH去重（Jaccard≥0.975）得到约1.9亿文档；(3)三套相关性标注——Citation（智能体引用，高精确低召回）、Web Ranking（内部BM25+稠密+cross-encoder排序的前50条）、Combined+LLM-Judged（前三者并集加DeepSeek-V4-Flash对RRF合并后未标top-500的LLM判断）；(4)子语料采样——比较depth-k池化、RRF、统一随机三种策略，验证在30%语料规模下保留全语料系统排序。评估13个检索器（BM25 + 10稠密 + 2晚期交互），主指标为Recall@1000。

Result: 主指标Recall@1000冠军因标注集而异：pplx-embed-v1-4b在Web Ranking和Combined上获胜，Nemotron-3-Embed-8B在Citation上获胜；nDCG@10冠军为Nemotron-3-Embed-8B。检索器相对排序对标注集选择不敏感，但在主题领域、查询语言、查询类型（primary vs support）上分化显著。所有神经检索器在support查询上表现更差，BM25反而略优。BM25 Recall@1000最低却贡献14,621个独有正例（约为次高者的6倍），最强神经检索器独有正例仅数百。RRF子语料（30%）保留全语料系统排序，绝对Recall@1000仅上浮3–7点；将4B模型评估成本从4,608降至约1,500 H200 GPU小时。硬负例分类显示15.8%实际为假阴性，主要错误模式为wrong-aspect（39%）；硬正例（6,424个）主要失败原因为词汇不匹配（51%）。

Conclusion: Q2D-Web首次同时提供大规模语料、生产采样的智能体改写查询与深度可复用的相关性标注，填补了Agentic RAG首阶段检索器评估的关键空白。检索器排序在标注集间稳定，但在领域、语言、查询类型上敏感；弱检索器可贡献独有正例，提示多样化集成价值。约30% RRF子语料为该规模下首次实现评估保真的采样方案。为防止训练污染，语料、查询与标注保持私有，仅开放公共排行榜。

Abstract: Evaluating first-stage retrievers in large-scale production RAG requires a benchmark that pairs a large-scale corpus with a large set of agent-reformulated search queries based on real user queries and their conversation threads, and that labels many relevant documents per query. No existing public benchmark evaluates this setting: large-scale collections typically provide only a small number of evaluation queries, whereas benchmarks with many queries generally contain only millions of documents. Moreover, most benchmarks assess human-written queries, while the first-stage retrievers in agentic RAG pipelines serve machine-written reformulations whose distribution differs from human search behavior. To overcome these evaluation gaps, we introduce Q2D-Web (Query2Doc-Web), a large-scale agentic retrieval benchmark consisting of a 190M-document web corpus and 70k agentic search queries in ten languages, reformulated from real-world user queries in production systems. Q2D-Web provides three sets of fixed relevance judgments: agent citations, production rankings, and a combined set that unions both signals and adds LLM-based judgments of unlabeled pooled documents to reduce false negatives. We benchmark 13 retrievers including lexical, dense, and late-interaction models and find that their relative ordering is largely insensitive to the choice of judgment set, while diverging substantially across topical domains, query languages, and query types. To enable fast evaluation, we also study subcorpus sampling as an approximation to full-corpus evaluations. Retaining a third of the corpus, selected by reciprocal rank fusion over pooled retriever runs, preserves the full-corpus model ranking under the combined judgments while raising absolute Recall@1000 only by 3 to 7 points. The public leaderboard is accessible under: this https URL

</details>


### [526] [Who Anchors AI Overviews in Health? Baidu, Google, and the Geography of Authority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06798)
*Mingyue Zha,Ho-Chun Herbert Chang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对Google和百度AI Overview在健康查询中的信息差异进行了系统审计。通过在12个国家、4种语言下测试1920条健康查询，发现两大平台均存在"垂直整合"现象，倾向于引用自有平台内容；小国和低本地化国家获得的本地来源引用更少；使用本国官方语言可使本地引用增加3.5-13.5倍；健康免责声明具有跨文化和跨语言的多维差异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI被整合进搜索引擎（AI Overviews），健康信息检索的方式发生了根本性变化，但跨平台、跨地理、跨语言的信息公平性审计几乎空白。健康查询涉及高风险决策，且不同文化对健康议题（如中医）有不同框架，因此亟需系统性审计。

Method: 使用SerpApi的Google和Baidu搜索API，在12个国家、4种语言下收集1920条健康查询的AI Overview响应（共11,944条引用）。查询涵盖12个健康话题，分为四类（常见疾病、争议性议题、法律可变议题、中医）。采用OLS回归（HC3稳健标准误）分析国家和话题对本地化引用的影响，并使用本地部署的Llama-3.1-70B模型进行零样本标注，分析TCM立场、安全警告等维度。

Result: 1. 平台层面：Google最常引用YouTube（其母公司Alphabet旗下），百度最常引用博禾及自有平台（百科、百家号、健康），均呈现"垂直整合"特征。2. 地理层面：澳大利亚(48.2%)、英国(41.3%)本地化最高，新加坡(11.5%)、挪威(8.5%)、印度(2.3%)、尼日利亚(0.2%)最低。3. 语言层面：使用本国官方语言查询可使本地化引用增加3.5-13.5倍（日本和新加坡3.5倍，马来西亚9倍，韩国13.5倍）。4. 话题层面：HIV、长新冠、糖尿病、抑郁症等本地化引用较高；堕胎、性别确认护理、TCM等敏感/争议性话题本地化引用较低。5. 中医对比：百度比Google更支持中医，但安全警告也更明确；Google对中医查询的AI Overview返回率最低（约42%），百度则更高但引用更少（平均每条约1个引用）。

Conclusion: 生成式搜索通过三个关键锚点影响健康信息获取：平台所有权、地理位置和查询语言。AI Overview的信息来源在不同平台、国家、语言和健康话题间存在显著差异，呈现"平台垂直整合"和"地理不均衡"两种信息公平问题。需要建立具有文化敏感性的AI搜索监管框架，医疗权威的认定不应仅由平台所有权、查询语言和检索管道的偶然效应决定。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is being rapidly incorporated into traditional search systems, yet scant work audits the information disparities across platforms, geography, and languages. We address this gap by comparing Google and Baidu's AI Overview systems for health queries, and measure informational anchors that emerge. Auditing 1,920 health queries across 12 countries and 4 languages, we find that Google and Baidu exhibit vertical integration, routing users toward their own company platforms in AI Overviews rather than a diverse set of primary sources. Smaller, lower-localization countries receive fewer domestically sourced references for health queries. Issuing the same query in a country's official language rather than English raises the share of locally sourced citations approximately 3.5- to 13.5-fold. Comparing queries across health topics of varying severity and controversy, including Traditional Chinese Medicine as an example, we also show that health disclaimers are multidimensional and vary across language and culture. We discuss how generative search influences access to health information, and the urgent need for culturally-aware oversight of these systems that influence critical health decisions.

</details>


### [527] [Overview of ROMCIR 2026: The 6th Workshop on Reducing Online Misinformation through Credible Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05684)
*Marcos Fernández-Pichel,Marinella Petrocchi,Kevin Roitero,Marco Viviani*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ROMCIR 2026是第6届"通过可信信息检索减少在线错误信息"研讨会（ECIR 2026分会）的概述论文。该研讨会旨在超越传统的错误信息检测方法，探讨将可信度与真实性作为IR系统中的基本相关性维度，涵盖虚假新闻、欺骗性评论、误导性医疗建议等信息污染问题。本文介绍了研讨会的目标与主题、主题演讲、接受的论文、历届情况及组织架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线数字生态系统中充斥着各种形式的信息污染（虚假新闻、欺骗性评论、未经核实的医疗建议等），对个人和社会构成严重威胁。传统错误信息检测方法存在局限，需将可信度/真实性作为IR系统相关性的核心维度，并关注LLMs在信息检索中的双刃剑作用。

Method: 作为研讨会概述论文，方法包括：1）界定"信息混乱"（information disorder）概念；2）梳理17个相关研究主题；3）邀请主题演讲人探讨错误信息检测领域的进展与不足；4）组织同行评审并选出5篇论文（10篇投稿，录用率50%）；5）围绕三大研究主题进行分类总结。

Result: ROMCIR 2026收到10篇投稿，录用5篇（录用率50%），来自6个国家。接受的论文围绕三个主题：(i)可解释与多模态事实核查方法（2篇，涵盖可解释AFC综述和近重复图像检索基准数据集）；(ii)生成模型的可靠性与评估（2篇，研究RAG系统在错误信息环境中的鲁棒性及LLM幻觉检测基准的评估偏差）；(iii)数据集与以人为中心的错误信息检测评估（1篇，研究众包在深度伪造检测中的有效性）。主题演讲由Tommaso Caselli发表，批评该领域过度追求基准性能提升而忽视真实社会影响。

Conclusion: ROMCIR研讨会持续推动信息检索社区应对信息混乱问题。本届强调将可信度与真实性融入IR系统相关性维度、早期检测、可解释性、LLMs的角色以及人在回路的范式。未来的研究应更多关注真实世界从业者（记者、事实核查员、公众）的需求，以实际社会成效而非基准指标来衡量进展。

Abstract: In the digital online ecosystem, we are surrounded by distinct forms of information pollution, posing significant threats to both individuals and society. Fake news, for instance, wields power to sway public opinion on matters of politics and finance. Deceptive reviews can either bolster or tarnish the reputation of businesses, while unverified medical advice may steer people toward harmful health practices. In light of this challenging landscape, it has become imperative to ensure that users have access to both topically relevant and factually accurate information that does not warp their perception of reality, and there has been a surge of interest in various strategies to combat misinformation through different contexts and multiple tasks. The purpose of the ROMCIR Workshop, for some years now, is precisely that of engaging the Information Retrieval community to explore potential solutions that extend beyond conventional misinformation detection approaches. Key objectives include identifying subjective and objective factors associated with information credibility and truthfulness, respectively, and integrating such factors as fundamental dimensions of relevance within IR Systems (IRSs), achieving early detection of misinformation, and ensuring that the search results retrieved are not only truthful but also explainable to the users of IRSs. Moreover, it is essential to evaluate the role of generative models such as Large Language Models (LLMs) in inadvertently amplifying misinformation problems, and how they can be used to support IRSs, together with the contribution that the human-in-the-loop paradigm can have in this context.

</details>


### [528] [What Price Fairness? Evaluating Energy - Fairness - Accuracy Trade-off in Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05759)
*Abhirup Mitra,Oleg Lesota,Antonela Tommasel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文针对公平性推荐系统长期忽视计算与环境成本的问题，提出将能耗纳入评估体系，构建"准确性—公平性—能耗"三方权衡框架，并通过多模型、多数据集、多硬件的实证分析揭示不同公平干预策略的绿色代价差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平性推荐系统研究主要关注准确性与公平性之间的权衡，而忽视了公平干预带来的计算与能耗成本（"绿色代价"）。不同干预方式（训练时 vs 后处理）在不同模型、数据集、硬件上具有差异化的能耗特性，缺乏系统性量化评估，亟需将能耗作为公平评估的第三维度。

Method: 在 RecBole 框架下，使用 MovieLens-10M 与 Amazon Books 两个数据集，对比 BPR、NCF、MultiVAE、RecVAE、LightGCN、ItemKNN 六类模型；公平干预包括损失级 in-processing 公平正则化、图结构 IPW 重加权、FA*IR 后处理重排序；使用 CodeCarbon 分别测量训练、推理、全流程能耗；分别在服务器（GTX 1080 Ti）与笔记本（RTX 5070）两套硬件上运行；评估指标包括 nDCG@10、长尾覆盖率与目录覆盖率。

Result: 实证发现：(1) 后处理 FA*IR 在单次全流程评估中能耗增幅小（+0.1%~+36.2%），但在重复服务场景下推理能耗增幅可达 +6.5%~+394.9%，被显著低估；(2) 训练时公平正则化与 IPW 在多数配置下成本适中（+2.1%~+45.2%），但在 LightGCN+ABs 笔记本、NCF+ABs 笔记本等特定组合下飙升（+192.9%、+195.8%）；(3) 相同方法在不同模型/数据集/硬件上的能耗差异巨大，硬件选择对结论有显著影响；(4) 能耗增加并不必然对应公平收益提升，FA*IR 带来长尾曝光提升的同时常伴随 nDCG 下降；(5) 不同模型可同时改善公平性与准确性，但需付出显著能耗代价。

Conclusion: 公平性推荐系统应作为"准确性—公平性—计算成本"三方权衡问题进行评估，而非简单视为"几乎免费"的附加属性。研究者应分开报告训练与推理能耗，区分一次性全流程成本与重复部署成本，并将计算成本纳入公平性评估标准。

Abstract: Fairness-aware recommender systems aim to mitigate systematic imbalances in recommendation outcomes, including how visibility, relevance, and opportunities are distributed among users, items, and providers. However, these systems are usually evaluated in terms of accuracy and fairness alone, while their computational and environmental costs remain largely invisible. This omission matters because fairness interventions may affect the cost of recommendation in different ways. Training-time methods modify model optimization, post-processing methods add computation at inference time, and both may depend on the model, dataset, hardware, and deployment setting. We examine whether provider-side fairness in recommendation comes with a measurable green cost. We compare in-processing, graph-level reweighting and post-processing interventions across multiple models, two datasets, and two hardware settings. We measure recommendation quality, provider-side exposure, and energy consumption separately across training and inference stages. Our results show that the green cost of fairness is not uniform, post-processing shifts cost to repeated serving, while in-processing and graph-level methods avoid re-ranking overhead but vary substantially across models, datasets, and hardware. Findings call for evaluating fairness-aware recommendation as a three-way trade-off between accuracy, fairness, and computational cost.

</details>


### [529] [Do All Nodes Benefit Equally from Knowledge Graphs? Adaptive Node-Aware KG Fusion for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05909)
*Jaehyun Park,Minseo Jeon,Daewon Gwak,Sunuk Kim,Hanvit Lee,Jinhong Jung*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: AdaKG 是一种面向 KG 感知推荐的自适应节点级融合方法，通过解耦 IG 与 KG 编码、基于对抗扰动估计每个节点 CF 信号的稳定性，并据此自适应控制 KG 贡献，有效避免了对所有节点一视同仁地注入 KG 信息所带来的干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KG 感知推荐方法对所有用户和物品节点不加区分地融合知识图谱信号，可能损害那些已有可靠协同过滤信号的节点的表征；作者认为不同节点对 KG 的依赖程度应当不同，需要一种节点感知的自适应融合机制。

Method: AdaKG 包含三个核心组件：(1) 解耦双视图图编码，分别使用 IG 编码器（基于 LightGCN）和 CKG 编码器对交互图和协同知识图谱进行编码，以保留各自的视图特定信号；(2) 基于排序感知对抗扰动的 CF 信号不稳定性估计，通过对初始嵌入施加扰动并度量 IG 表示的变化，得到每个节点的不稳定性分数；(3) 节点级自适应融合门控与自适应对比学习，基于不稳定性分数学习节点融合权重 α_v，并据此在共享语义空间中对齐 IG 与 KG 表征。

Result: 在 Amazon-Book、MovieLens-1M、Book-Crossing 和 Last-FM 四个真实数据集上的实验表明，AdaKG 在 Recall@10 和 MRR@10 指标上均优于包括 KGAT、KGIN、MCCLK、KGRec、DiffKG、LightKG 等在内的 13 种 KG 感知基线方法，获得了最佳平均排名；消融实验验证了自适应融合、不稳定性估计和自适应对比学习三个模块各自的有效性；定性分析表明 CF 稳定用户的偏好表征更紧凑，而不稳定用户则更分散，验证了不稳定性分数的合理性；训练效率分析显示 AdaKG 显著快于 KGRec。

Conclusion: 论文证明了并非所有节点都能从 KG 信息中同等受益，KG 的贡献强度应根据每个节点协同过滤信号的可靠性进行自适应调整；AdaKG 通过节点感知的自适应融合策略，在保持可靠 CF 信号作为推荐基础的同时，为 CF 不稳定节点提供更强的 KG 辅助，为 KG 感知推荐提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: KG-aware recommendation has been widely studied to alleviate data sparsity by using knowledge graphs (KGs), which represent items, entities, and their relations as graphs and provide item-side knowledge. However, existing methods incorporate item knowledge without considering how much each user or item node should rely on it. As a result, they apply KG signals indiscriminately across nodes, even to nodes whose collaborative filtering (CF) signals from the interaction graph (IG) are already reliable. In this paper, we propose AdaKG (Adaptive Node-Aware KG Fusion), a novel KG-aware recommendation method that adaptively adjusts the contribution of auxiliary knowledge for each node. Since user-item interactions and item knowledge provide different types of signals, directly mixing them can distort the CF signals. To avoid this, AdaKG separately encodes the IG and KG with view-specific encoders, allowing each view to capture its own information. It then estimates how strongly each node should rely on item knowledge by measuring the stability of its CF signals under small adversarial perturbations, assigning a larger KG contribution to less stable nodes. Finally, AdaKG adaptively aligns the IG and KG embeddings in a shared space and fuses them according to the estimated node-wise reliance. Through experiments, we show that AdaKG achieves strong performance compared with its baselines and the effectiveness of our adaptive fusion strategy.

</details>


### [530] [Visual Analysis of LLM-based Entity Resolution from Scientific Papers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06037)
*Siyu Wu,Yi Yang,Weize Wu,Ruiming Li,Yuyang Zhang,Ge Wang,Huobin Tan,Zipeng Liu,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型（LLM，如GPT-4）与可视化分析技术的交互式实体解析框架，以解决从科学文献（特别是金属有机框架MOFs合成文献）中提取领域特定实体的难题。通过人机协作的RAG示例选择，将单文档实体解析精度提升约30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学文献中包含丰富的领域知识，但传统基于规则或机器学习的实体解析方法难以应对文献结构和写作风格的多样性。LLM虽展现出强大的文本理解能力，但其输出存在数值提取不准确、结构化输出不一致、推理能力有限等问题，且缺乏直观的错误分析和RAG过程可视化工具，限制了领域专家利用专业知识提升模型性能的能力。

Method: 1. 构建了完整的数据标注与实体解析流水线：收集CSD-MOFs数据集，通过领域专家标注获得122个合成段落；使用BERT模型识别相关段落（F1=0.95）；设计包含提示工程、标注样例和相关段落的LLM输入框架。2. 比较了BM25、BERT和Sentence-BERT三种RAG算法，选择BM25作为最优方案。3. 设计了多层次可视化界面：包含整体指标视图（Precision/Recall/F1/ACC）、详细结果热力图视图、错误图网络视图（展示FP/FN错误关联）、数据分布视图（基于one-hot编码和PCA降维的散点图及饼图），以及RAG配置面板（高亮BM25匹配文本，支持用户交互选择示例）。

Result: 1. 整体性能：在106篇论文、122个合成段落上，无人工干预时达到89.54% Precision、96.85% Recall、93.05% F1和90.73% Accuracy。2. 错误分析：发现"solvent name"和"solvent amount"参数存在强错误相关性（14篇论文同时出错），且活性时间和温度的低性能源于样本量不足而非系统性问题。3. RAG示例选择：通过案例研究，从BM25自动选择（所有指标约71%）改进为人工选择相似结构模式的示例后，单文档实体解析准确率提升约30%，所有实体类型均成功提取。

Conclusion: 该工作通过将LLM能力与交互式可视化设计相结合，有效解决了科学文献实体解析中的可解释性和可优化性问题，验证了人机协作方法在提升LLM特定领域性能的显著价值。框架无需编程背景即可实现批量实体解析，具有跨领域可迁移性。未来需改进多任务并行比较、RAG配置对比以及大规模数据集的可扩展性。

Abstract: This paper focuses on the visual analytics support for extracting domain-specific entity from extensive scientific literature, a task with inherent limitations using traditional named entity resolution methods. With the advent of large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, significant improvements over conventional machine learning approaches have been achieved due to LLM's capability on entity resolution integrate abilities such as understanding multiple types of text. This research introduces a new visual analysis pipeline that integrates these advanced LLMs with versatile visualization and interaction designs to support batch entity resolution. Specifically, we focus on a specific material science field of Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) and a large data collection namely CSD-MOFs. Through collaboration with domain experts in material science, we obtain well-labeled synthesis paragraphs. We propose human-in-the-loop refinement over the entity resolution process using visual analytics techniques, which allows domain experts to interactively integrate insights into LLM intelligence, including error analysis and interpretation of the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) algorithm. Our evaluation through the case study of example selection for RAG demonstrates that this human-machine collaborative approach improved single-document entity resolution accuracy by approximately 30%.

</details>


### [531] [Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06219)
*Lingfeng Shi,Chengkai Huang,Lina Yao,James Caverlee*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对序列推荐中"训练用长历史、推理仅用短窗口"所导致的长短视域性能差距问题，提出了一种无需缓存用户历史的两阶段框架：第一阶段通过余弦相似度打分和softmax₁注意力聚合修正几何缺陷；第二阶段仅微调偏置与LayerNorm参数，并结合跨视域蒸馏，显著缩小甚至消除性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统中，长历史训练虽能提升质量，但因推理延迟限制只能服务短窗口，导致显著的性能下降。现有方法通过压缩用户历史为KV缓存或token memory来解决，但增加了基础设施开销，且无法处理冷启动场景。本文旨在探索一种无需缓存用户历史的短视域推理方案。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 长视域骨干训练阶段——将点积替换为温度缩放的余弦相似度打分，采用softmax₁注意力聚合机制（分母加1避免强制分配单位概率），使用sampled softmax损失；(2) 短视域适应阶段——仅微调骨干网络中固有的bias和LayerNorm仿射参数（γ, β），采用BCE损失与跨视域KL蒸馏损失的联合目标，无需任何新增参数或辅助模块。

Result: 在SASRec和HSTU两个骨干、ML-10M/Taobao/XLong三个数据集上：(1) 长视域配方本身就超越原始Full基线（如HSTU/XLong NDCG@10提升9.5%）；(2) 零样本短视域推理已优于或匹配原始Full基线；(3) 经bias/LayerNorm适应后，在Taobao SASRec上甚至超越Full配置；(4) 仅用2,764个参数即达到PersRec全参数微调方法95.9%的NDCG@10性能，且无需任何per-user存储或prefill开销；(5) 在滚动评估的9个未来请求位置上表现出时间稳定性。

Conclusion: 本文实证识别了长短视域差距的两个结构性根源——点积范数偏差和前缀位置偏置（sinking效应）。通过几何感知的训练配方和极轻量的偏置/LayerNorm适应，可以在不缓存任何用户历史的情况下有效弥合这一差距，为实际部署提供了高效实用的解决方案。未来将探索更长序列、多模态信号以及LLM增强推荐系统中的扩展。

Abstract: Sequential recommenders are typically trained on long user histories to capture rich behavioral signals, yet serving with training-length sequences is often impractical due to real-time efficiency constraints. Directly using only recent behaviors leads to a severe performance drop. To bridge this gap, existing approaches compress user histories into persistent per-user states, storing and retrieving them at inference time; while effective, they impose non-trivial infrastructure overhead and offer little remedy in cold-start scenarios. In this paper, we empirically identify two structural flaws rooted in geometric properties and dataset sparsity, and propose a novel two-stage framework to close the long-short-view performance gap. Specifically, in the first stage, we replace the commonly used dot-product with angular similarity scoring and leverage a modified softmax to counter prefix position bias. In the second stage, we fine-tune only bias and LayerNorm components, which are universal to standard sequential backbones, for further improvement. Both stages are guided by carefully designed learning objectives. Extensive experiments on two representative backbones across three public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework.

</details>


### [532] [Relevance is not enough: A Communication-Oriented Retrieval System for Consequential Scientific Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06222)
*Avina Nakarmi,Naga Datha Saikiran Battula,Anthony Diaz,Aritra Dasgupta*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对水质等"高利害科学问答"场景，提出一种面向公众沟通的RAG系统，通过推理类型分类、证据缺口诊断与角色化表达，在大幅减少检索上下文的同时提升回答的人本"完整性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统以事实正确性和相关性为目标，但当科学信息直接影响公众生活与决策（如水质风险）时，仅"切题"并不足以帮助非专业读者理解含义并采取行动；且标准相关性指标无法捕捉人类所感知的回答完整性。

Method: 1) 构建结构化知识库（按章节索引的JSON分块）；2) 双阶段检索审计——预后检查（Prognostic）过滤低相关文档，诊断检查（Diagnostic）按四种推理策略（因果/监管/比较/解释性）识别证据缺口并触发第二轮检索（限两次迭代）；3) 双LLM响应生成——生成器产生基于证据的结构化声明并显式标注认知缺口，沟通器以"关怀邻居"或"市政翻译官"等角色重写为通俗语言；4) 与社区共同设计"完整性"评估指标，并对Qwen 2.5-7B用LoRA微调作为自动评判器。

Result: 在160个社区常见问题上的消融实验显示：(1)检索上下文从基线约56,000字符骤降至约2,200字符（约25倍缩减），人类评完整性由0.60提升至0.711–0.751；(2)标准相关性指标仅解释约1%的人类完整性方差（R²=0.014）；(3)显式诊断检查在72.6%查询中识别缺口并解决其中73.8%，但对最终完整性无统计显著增益；(4)角色化显著提升共情与可读性（如"关怀邻居"可读性均分51–52，>50%回答含情感反应），但不改变完整性；(5)经微调的LLM评判器与人类相关性从ρ=0.41提升至ρ=0.73，但仍仅中等一致（Cohen's κ=0.54）。

Conclusion: 面向高利害科学沟通的RAG应在相关性之外纳入人本"完整性"目标；推理引导的检索可大幅压缩上下文并维持质量；诊断式缺口检索在直接查询上收益有限，但在多跳/开放场景值得进一步探索；LLM评判器需经微调才能逼近人类评估，相关性指标不应被等同于完整性。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly answer scientific questions about health, safety, and the environment. But most retrieval-augmented generation systems are tuned to provide factually correct, on-topic answers rather than to help non-experts understand what those answers mean for their lives and decisions. We focus on consequential scientific questions whose results directly shape people's lives and study them through a public water-quality communication system, where residents and community leaders interpret the findings and choose actions. Their experiences show that on-topic answers can still be insufficient without explanation and context and that the emotional weight of risk information cannot be ignored. Our system first classifies each question by reasoning type (for example, causal versus policy-based), then generates follow-up questions to identify missing evidence and retrieve it. One component clearly distinguishes between what is known and what is uncertain, while another rewrites scientific details into accessible language, using persona-based styles, such as a caring neighbor or an administrative official, to adapt tone and readability. Ablations on over $160$ questions show that the system uses $\textit{an order of magnitude less context}$ and, in several configurations, improves human-rated completeness. A completeness metric co-designed with community members and a fine-tuned learned judge reveal that standard relevance scores explain about $1\%$ of variation in human completeness ratings, and even the tuned judge only moderately aligns with humans, indicating that completeness is a distinct human-centered objective that current metrics do not reliably capture.

</details>


### [533] [TaxoConf: Taxonomy-Guided Automatic Conference Program Organization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06604)
*Daomin Ji,Zhifeng Bao,Junhao Gan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TaxoConf是一个端到端的会议程序自动编排系统，通过构建会议专属的规范化多父节点主题DAG、推导基于最优传输的论文间距离，并将其整合到约束感知的二元整数线性规划中，同时最大化主题一致性并满足所有硬性运营约束。在四个2025年顶级会议基准和SIGIR 2026实际部署中均取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会议程序编排（将录用论文分组到主题一致的session中）是一项劳动密集型工作，现有方法难以同时兼顾主题连贯性和硬性运营约束（如会场容量、演讲者冲突、轨道兼容性等）。手工编排耗时巨大，亟需自动化方案。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 规范化多父节点主题DAG构建——通过LLM迭代提出子主题、与全局注册表比对合并等价节点、多标签路由支持多父节点结构，确保全局规范性和严格层次性；(2) 基于信息内容加权的最优传输距离——论文用frontier主题的均匀分布表示，论文间距离为1-Wasserstein距离；(3) 二元整数线性规划求解——最小化session内主题距离，同时编码容量、轨道兼容性、演讲者冲突等硬约束；(4) 后处理优化——生成session标题、按主题分散排布并行slot、基于引用预测热度分配房间、海报按谱排序(spectral seriation)放置在物理邻近板位。

Result: 在ICML25、ICLR25、KDD25、ICSE25四个基准上：主题连贯性4.62/5（最高），NMI 0.761（最高），ARI 0.242，F1 0.541，零约束违反；相比最强基线LLM-ReAct提升4%连贯性、12% NMI、33% F1。效率上平均45.9分钟/$6.30，比LLM-ReAct减少34%运行时间和38%成本。SIGIR 2026真实部署：覆盖657篇论文（293 oral + 364 poster），91.8% oral分配被保留，poster程序无需修改，零硬约束违反，47位与会者现场调查整体评分4.26/5。消融实验证实frontier表示和最优传输贡献最大。

Conclusion: TaxoConf通过将语义建模（主题taxonomy）与组合调度（整数规划）解耦，并创新性地引入规范化多父节点DAG和最优传输距离，同时解决了主题连贯性和运营约束问题。该系统已在SIGIR 2026成功部署，并即将被VLDB 2026、SIGIR 2027、ICDE 2027、DASFAA 2027采用。未来工作重点是改进基于引用的流行度估计以优化房间分配。

Abstract: Conference program organization, the task of assembling accepted papers into a technical program, is labor-intensive. Papers must be grouped into topically coherent sessions under hard operational constraints, and existing methods rarely achieve both at once. To address this problem, we present TaxoConf, a system that organizes conference programs around a conference-specific topic taxonomy. TaxoConf constructs a canonicalized multi-parent taxonomy over the accepted papers and represents each paper by its frontier of most specific topics. It derives a specificity-weighted optimal-transport distance between papers from this taxonomy, then solves a binary integer programming problem that assigns papers to sessions by minimizing within-session distance subject to all hard constraints. On benchmarks built from four 2025 conferences, TaxoConf attains the highest session coherence (4.62 out of 5) and the closest agreement with human-curated sessions (NMI 0.761) while incurring no constraint violations. TaxoConf has also been deployed to generate the technical program of SIGIR 2026, where the organizers accepted the initial output with only a few edits, preserving 91.8% of oral assignments and the entire poster program while requiring no correction of hard-constraint violations, and an on-site survey of 47 attendees rated the overall program quality 4.26 out of 5. The system is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [534] [FunnelAudit: Responsibility Auditing in Multi-Route Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06964)
*Jie Li,Dudu Luo,Jiayang Niu,Ke Deng,Yongli Ren*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: FunnelAudit提出了一种可执行的问责审计框架，用于多路由推荐系统。它通过问责契约规范争议事件、受控对象和重放语义，并应用分级实际责任（graded actual responsibility）来寻找使每个控制变得关键的最小事实保持性应急条件。研究发现，92.55–99.64%的责任事件需要非空应急条件，单控制消融仅能恢复0.36–7.45%，表明推荐系统的问责需要明确的服务语义和可验证的事件级证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐系统采用多阶段、多路由架构（检索、分配、融合、排序），使得单一物品的包含或排除难以审计。路由重叠会掩盖单次消融的效果，而冻结下游阶段会产生与服务行为不一致的反事实。现有方法要么基于最终分数进行溯源，要么使用Shapley/Banzhaf等平均贡献分数，这些方法都无法回答特定事件级别的责任归属问题——即在某个具体Top-K事件中，哪个服务控制是技术原因。

Method: 方法包括三个核心组件：(1) 问责契约（Accountability Contract）——明确规范争议事件、受控对象集合、每个控制的允许参考动作、重放起点以及版本化的Serve函数；(2) 阶段忠实重放（Stage-faithful replay）——从最早受影响阶段开始重新计算所有下游组件，为每个允许的控制配置构建完整的Top-K结果，形成2^m个反事实世界的布尔格；(3) 分级实际责任提取——应用Chockler和Halpern的分级实际责任理论，对每个控制寻找最小的事实保持性应急条件W，使得W保持事件不变但W∪{c}改变事件。系统还生成包含应急条件和配对重放记录的可验证证书。

Result: 在MovieLens-1M、Amazon Beauty和UCI Online Retail II三个数据集的258,809个用户-目标事件上的实验表明：(1) 4.24–16.24%的事件至少有一个责任控制，92.55–99.64%的责任事件-控制对需要非空应急条件；(2) LOCO仅恢复0.36–7.45%的责任对，随机搜索预算为128时仍不完整；(3) 不同服务策略（C1固定并集、C2加权配额分配、C3加权RRF融合）在仅0.31–2.39%的事实结果分歧下，责任路由集的Jaccard距离可达21.44–54.05%；(4) Shapley和Banzhaf分数与ρ的Spearman相关性为0.847–0.965，但对排除事件中最大分数控制是责任的概率仅25.26–60.52%；(5) 独立字面重放完美再现9,121,792个目标-世界结果，穷举搜索和MILP与每个采样判断一致。

Conclusion: FunnelAudit填补了推荐系统问责的运营空白：将注册的Top-K事件链接到有所有权的服务控制干预，重放每个受影响阶段，并返回最小的事实保持性证据。其贡献不是新的问责理论、融合规则或通用解释方法，而是推荐系统特定的反事实世界和控制规范构造。结论明确：可辩护的问责判断既需要服务忠实的反事实，也需要可检查的事件级证据，而非另一个聚合重要性分数。研究限于确定性二元路由和分配器控制的重建两阶段漏斗，扩展到多值配额、随机策略、下游模型控制和更大注册表仍是未来工作。

Abstract: Multi-route recommender systems combine retrieval, allocation, fusion, and ranking, making individual inclusions and exclusions difficult to audit. Route overlap can hide effects from one-at-a-time ablations, while freezing downstream stages produces counterfactuals inconsistent with serving behavior. We introduce FunnelAudit, an executable framework for incident-level responsibility auditing. An accountability contract specifies the disputed Top-K event, controls and owners, permitted reference actions, and replay semantics. FunnelAudit evaluates every permitted control configuration and applies graded actual responsibility to find the smallest outcome-preserving contingency that makes each control pivotal. Its certificate records the contingency and paired serving executions needed to verify the judgment. We instantiate the framework in two-stage, nine-route funnels using fixed union, weighted quota allocation, or weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, followed by SASRec ranking. Across 258,809 user-target incidents from three real interaction datasets, 4.24-16.24% admit a responsible control. Among responsible incident-control pairs, 92.55-99.64% require a nonempty contingency, so single-control ablation recovers only 0.36-7.45%. Policies differing in factual outcomes on only 0.31-2.39% of incidents yield 21.44-54.05% Jaccard distance between responsible-route sets on matched exclusions. Independent replay reproduces all 9,121,792 checked target-world outcomes; exhaustive search and a generic mixed-integer linear program agree with every sampled judgment. These findings demonstrate the importance of explicit serving semantics and checkable witnesses for recommender accountability.

</details>


### [535] [Tracing Query Expansion Effects through Sparse Autoencoder Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06968)
*Fangan Dong,Weiran Shi,Zhiwei Xu,Xuri Ge,Ben He,Xin Xin,Zhumin Chen,Ying Zhou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文首次利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从稠密检索器内部表征的视角系统性分析查询扩展（QE）效果，识别与检索意图、实体属性相关的稀疏潜在特征，并通过激活导向（activation steering）在推理时直接干预查询表征，实现无需查询改写或检索器微调的轻量级检索性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询扩展（QE）在现代稠密检索中效果不稳定，尤其对未经过微调的现成检索器常常失效甚至损害性能。现有研究多关注扩展质量、语义漂移或最终检索指标，但鲜有研究解释QE如何在稠密检索器内部改变表征，即哪些潜在特征被激活或抑制，以及它们如何与检索意图相关联。本文旨在填补这一内部表征层面的研究空白。

Method: 1. 在稠密检索器（Qwen-Embedding和SimLM）的每一层训练BatchTopK SAE，将查询隐藏状态分解为稀疏潜在激活。2. 从2000个MS MARCO正收益QE配对（Q2D扩展后MRR@10提升的查询对）中，计算每层潜在特征的扩展诱导激活差异，并用Cohen's d标准化效应量评分排序，识别QE相关潜在特征。3. 通过PCA分析特征可分性，用GPT-5.5加人工验证生成自然语言语义标注。4. 利用SAE解码器权重构建加权转向向量，在推理时直接加到查询隐藏状态上（仅干预查询端，文档表示不变），通过超参数选择层数l、潜在数K和强度α。5. 在MS MARCO dev、NQ、TREC DL19/20四个基准上对比Q2D、Q2E、Q2C三种QE基线，并进行消融实验（无权重、随机、打乱、反向）和查询扰动（拼写错误）实验验证。

Result: 在四个检索基准和两种稠密检索器上，SAE导向均比随机干预或传统QE产生更一致的检索提升。Qwen-Embed在TREC DL20上NDCG@10提升+0.430，SimLM在TREC DL19和DL20上NDCG@10分别提升+1.503和+1.404，且通过配对bootstrap检验具有统计显著性（p<0.05）。消融实验证实增益依赖于所选潜在特征及其扩展诱导权重。分析发现：浅层和中层包含丰富的QE敏感特征但判别强度低，深层则包含更强判别性的语义相关潜在特征（实体、意图类型），且深层干预在最终嵌入空间中保留更充分。该方法在BGE-base和E5-base上同样有效，且无测试时LLM调用开销（每查询仅2.66ms延迟）。

Conclusion: 本文证明有效的查询扩展通过改变稠密检索器内部与检索意图、实体属性、主题相关的稀疏潜在特征来发挥作用，而不仅仅是扰动最终查询嵌入。SAE为分析QE效果提供了可解释的内部表征视角，且基于解码器权重的激活导向是一种轻量级、无需LLM调用和检索器微调的精确检索行为调制方法。但绝对增益仍为中等，应作为文本级扩展的补充而非完全替代。局限性包括主要在两种检索器和四个基准上验证，依赖逐层SAE训练带来额外离线成本。

Abstract: Query expansion (QE) is a critical technique in information retrieval that enriches underspecified queries with additional textual context. However, its effect is often unreliable in modern dense retrieval, especially for strong off-the-shelf retrievers without retraining. Existing studies mainly examine expansion quality, semantic drift, or retrieval outcomes, but rarely explain how QE changes dense retrievers internally. In this work, we trace QE effects through sparse autoencoder (SAE) features. Using paired original and expanded queries, we decompose layer-wise retriever representations into sparse latent activations, identify QE-related latents from expansion-induced activation shifts, and interpret them with natural-language descriptions and retrieval cases. Our analysis shows that effective QE induces layer-concentrated changes in sparse latents aligned with retrieval intent and entity attributes, rather than only perturbing final query embeddings. SAE-based activation steering further validates these latents improve retrieval more consistently than random interventions or vanilla QE across four benchmarks, suggesting that SAEs can explain QE effects and offer a lightweight option for precise retrieval behavior modulation without query rewriting or retriever fine-tuning.

</details>


### [536] [EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07143)
*Shuwei Yuan,Mingqian Ding,Luxin Liu,Rong Xiao,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: EAGER提出了一种两阶段"富化-对齐"生成式查询推荐框架，用于在电商搜索中根据用户点击的商品生成个性化查询建议。第一阶段通过监督微调（SFT）扩展查询生成空间，第二阶段通过GRPO强化学习对齐线上业务约束与用户点击偏好。该框架已在某大型电商平台投产，并通过线上A/B测试验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商平台在用户点击商品后需要在信息流中提供查询建议以捕捉即时搜索意图。现有方法存在两大局限：(1) 基于历史日志挖掘的方法受限于数据稀疏，难以覆盖长尾和个性化意图；(2) 通用LLM缺乏平台特定知识，生成的查询虽然流畅但与真实点击行为脱节。此外，单次商品点击只揭示一种显式选择，但系统需生成覆盖多种潜在意图的查询集合，并同时满足点击率、转化率和部署约束等多目标。

Method: EAGER采用两阶段框架：
1. **SFT富化阶段**：构建多源意图有序监督（点击查询q^click、点击后查询Q^post、LLM生成查询Q^llm），通过PARM（基于Qwen-4B的生成式点击预测器）对LLM生成查询打分排序。采用四阶段课程学习（I2Q→增强I2Q加推理→UI2Q加用户上下文→增强UI2Q），每阶段融入rationale增强、多样性正则化和自蒸馏（提升温度和top-p生成高质量样本重建训练数据）。
2. **GRPO对齐阶段**：设计混合奖励函数R=αR_rule+βR_model。规则奖励包含8项可验证子奖励（体验合规、数量合规、词项重叠、用户意图对齐、流畅性、多样性、惩罚项）。模型奖励采用PARM的预测点击率1-p_PARM(no|i,u,q)，对齐真实用户偏好。

Result: 离线实验基于Qwen3-1.7B，与Gemini 3.1、GPT-5.2及多个开源LLM对比。EAGER在Soft HR@1达77.96%、APD达72.96、Distinct-2达83.04、Rule达9.16，均达到最优或接近最优。消融实验表明：课程学习累计贡献+6.57 Soft HR@1和+6.97 APD；多样性正则化与相关性存在权衡（牺牲0.38 Soft HR@1换取+4.72 APD和+4.18 Distinct-2）；GRPO主要贡献于业务规则合规（Rule从7.21提升至9.16）；自蒸馏显著提升APD（69.62→72.96）。骨架规模实验显示EAGER-4B和EAGER-8B进一步提升。线上9天5%流量A/B测试显示：UCTR +0.83%、PCTR +1.28%、DAC +2.98%、Pay Count +3.49%、L2P +2.38%（均p<0.05）。PARM与线上排序器Top-1一致性达79.8%，Top-2至Top-4均超72%。

Conclusion: EAGER通过"先扩展后约束"的两阶段设计有效解决了电商I2Q查询推荐中意图覆盖与部署对齐的互补目标。SFT阶段通过课程学习、自蒸馏和多样性正则化显著扩展生成空间，GRPO阶段通过混合奖励确保业务合规性与用户偏好对齐。框架已在大型电商平台投产，并稳定带来用户参与度和下游转化的显著提升。未来工作将探索去偏用户反馈和与下游搜索模块的端到端优化。

Abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly display clickable query suggestions alongside items in the user feed, enabling users to refine or expand their intent without manually reformulating queries. Existing approaches either mine suggestions from historical logs -- limited to past behavior and blind to long-tail, personalized intents -- or rely on off-the-shelf LLMs whose lack of platform-specific knowledge yields fluent but generic queries disconnected from real click behavior. We propose EAGER (Enrich-and-AliGn gEnerative Query Recommendation), a two-stage framework for generating query suggestions from clicked items. In the enrichment stage, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) follows a four-stage curriculum that scales information richness (from item-only to user-conditioned) and reasoning depth (from direct to chain-of-thought). Each stage incorporates rationale augmentation, diversity regularization, and self-distillation. In the alignment stage, we post-train via GRPO with a hybrid reward of multiple rule-based business signals and a preference-aware click reward. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B test demonstrate the effectiveness of EAGER, which has been deployed in production at a major e-commerce platform.

</details>


### [537] [Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07273)
*Yuchen Wang,Feng Niu,Qing Tan,Junting Lu,Baoxin Wu,Jun Gao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出MORE模型,将多任务信息流嵌入统一排序骨干网络,通过Shared/Private Anchor Tokens在每一层与序列和特征表示协同进化;在陌陌Nearby Feed场景离线7个任务全面领先,并在线A/B测试显著提升参与度和深度社交指标,同时降低约30%推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统普遍需要多任务学习,但现有统一排序骨干网络(HyFormer、MixFormer、OneTrans)仅在骨干后用浅层塔(MMoE/PLE)做多任务融合,骨干本身保持任务无关,导致三个结构性问题:任务盲的序列读取与特征交互、任务分化前的表征瓶颈、多任务扩展收益递减。

Method: MORE骨干内部引入持久跨层的Anchor Tokens:Shared Anchors编码跨任务共性,Private Anchors编码任务特定先验;每个MORE Block含三个子模块——Task-Aware Sequence Reading(独立交叉注意力+共享序列寄存器)、Selective Semantic Mixing(MLP-Mixer式token混合+任务边界掩码隔离Private Anchor)、Task Enhancing(基于FiLM的per-task仿射调制);推理时采用request-level shared computation共享用户侧序列计算。

Result: 离线:Momo Nearby Feed 90天数据、7个核心任务,全部优于两阶段(Transformer+RankMixer/Wukong/DCN-v2、HSTU+RankMixer、STCA)和统一骨干基线(MixFormer、HyFormer、OneTrans),Greet +1.58%、Like +1.47%、Deep Chat +0.33%,且FLOPs更低(1.85G vs HyFormer 2.16G、MixFormer 4.65G);消融显示任务边界掩码贡献最大;扩展性实验(0.1B–0.9B参数)显示MORE比任务无关骨干更高效地转化参数和算力为多任务增益。线上A/B两周:停留时长+3.0%、点击+2.8%、评论+3.6%、打招呼+2.5%、深度聊天+2.0%,P99延迟降低约30%。

Conclusion: MORE通过将多任务信息流嵌入堆叠骨干,实现任务信号与序列/特征表示逐层协同进化,在离线和在线均显著优于现有统一骨干,且具备良好的扩展性和工业部署效率;任务感知骨干设计具有跨场景泛化潜力。

Abstract: Industrial ranking models for recommendation have scaled feature interaction and sequence modeling separately; recent architectures such as HyFormer and MixFormer unify both in a stackable backbone. Real-world recommender systems, however, nearly always require multi-task learning, yet existing unified architectures confine multi-task modeling to shallow post-backbone towers, leaving the backbone without task-aware information flow. We propose MORE (Multi-task cO-evolving Ranking modEl), which embeds multi-task information flow inside the backbone, enabling task-specific signals to co-evolve with sequence and feature representations at every layer rather than in a post-hoc fusion. It introduces Anchor Tokens that persist across backbone layers: Shared Anchors encode cross-task commonalities, while Private Anchors capture task-specific priors. In each block, Anchor Tokens (1) read task-conditioned signals from behavior sequences, (2) mix with non-sequential features under a task-boundary mask, and (3) refine per-task representations through independent branches; as blocks stack, each task obtains a differentiated representation refined through all backbone layers. Experiments on large-scale industrial datasets show that MORE consistently outperforms baselines across all tasks under comparable parameter and FLOPs budgets, and scales well with model size. Online A/B tests on Momo, a leading Chinese social discovery platform with tens of millions of monthly active users, yield 3% improvement in usage duration, 3.6% in interaction rate, and 2% in deep-chat rate. MORE is deployed in production with request-level shared computation reducing scoring latency by about 30%.

</details>


### [538] [Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents: A Taxonomy, an Evaluation Protocol, and an Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07395)
*Moule Lin,Qizhen Lan,Shuhao Guan,Weipeng Jing,Jiexin Fan,David Gregg,Goetz Botterweck*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体在长程、多轮、多工具交互场景下的不确定性量化问题，提出三轴分类法（不确定性来源、估计方法、管道阶段）、轨迹级校准的形式化分析（含两个核心命题）、TC-ECE评估协议，并在4个模型上完成了最长达50步的真实智能体轨迹实证研究。主要发现是：步级校准不能复合为轨迹级校准，智能体的口头置信度并不稳定优于简单的步数基线，池化校准误差会掩盖晚期的过度自信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM不确定性量化研究几乎完全针对单轮问答场景，而LLM越来越多地作为智能体在长程环境中规划、调用工具、维护记忆、与多智能体协作。错误和不确定性产生于多轮对话、环境和工具交互，而非单轮QA；它们出现得晚且具有不可逆性，需要新的框架来处理"何时信任智能体系统"这一安全部署前提。

Method: 1) 构建120篇核心论文语料库，采用双标注+LLM裁判+第三人裁定的流程；2) 提出三轴分类法：Panel A（不确定性来源A1-A5）、Panel B（方法家族B1-B9）、Panel C（管道阶段C1-C6）；3) 形式化定义步级校准（定义1）和轨迹级校准（定义2），证明步级校准不能复合（命题1）并给出复合误差上界（命题2）；4) 提出TC-ECE度量及完整报告协议（校准零假设、符号化差距、嵌套自助法、因果受限基线）；5) 在4个模型（Qwen2.5-32B、Qwen3.5-9B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemini 3.1 Pro）上完成HotpotQA、GSM8K/TriviaQA链式QA、ALFWorld三个实验，最长50步预算。

Result: 1) 命题1通过简单反例证明步级完美校准不能保证轨迹级校准；2) 命题2给出复合误差的有界闭式表达，其量随轨迹长度增长而退化；3) 实证发现：轨迹预测的晚期过度自信在4个配置中一致出现；4) 智能体口头置信度在HotpotQA上略优于步数基线但在ALFWorld上劣于它，表明该结论是任务依赖的；5) 池化TC-ECE=0.125隐藏了符号化差距从-0.166到+0.320的漂移；6) 在ALFWorld上观察到正的前缀耦合系数（依赖性项）随轨迹长度扩大，符合命题2预测；7) 等渗重校准能消除池化偏差但保留位置相关偏差；8) 在Llama运行中AUROC=0.293出现低于随机的反排序情况。

Conclusion: LLM智能体不确定性量化需从单轮置信度转向轨迹级可靠性研究。三轴分类法整合了分散文献；形式化命题揭示了步级校准无法复合的本质困难；TC-ECE协议配套报告规范可被实际计算。实证表明：1) 单一标量无法代表轨迹可靠性；2) 评估结论依赖协议选择；3) 晚期过度自信跨任务和模型一致出现。需进一步研究轨迹级校准基准、干预优势估计、不确定性感知蒸馏等十大开放问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are no longer deployed only for single-turn conversation but increasingly act as agents that plan, call tools, retrieve evidence, maintain memory, and interact over long horizons, often together with other agents through multi-turn conversations. Therefore, knowing when to trust the agentic system is a prerequisite for safe deployment. However, existing work on quantifying uncertainty for LLMs was built almost entirely for single-turn question answering. This paper argues that errors and uncertainty arise from multi-turn conversations, environments, and tools rather than from a single-turn question answering setting. It comes late, however, and is compounded in a single score that is too coarse to represent the unreliability. We organize the literature with a three-axis taxonomy, (1) what the uncertainty is, (2) how it is estimated, and (3) where uncertainty arises during an agent pipeline. We investigate step-level and trajectory-level calibration and show with a simple counterexample that the first does not imply the second. Experiments on real agent traces across four models and up to a 50-step budget show that the proposed metric and reporting protocol (Trajectory-Checkpoint Expected Calibration Error, TC-ECE) can be computed and that step errors are coupled along a trajectory. We find that confidence estimates from the agent's own responses do not consistently outperform a simple baseline. The experiments also show that averaging all trajectories together can hide overconfidence at later stages, which becomes visible when results are analyzed across different horizons. In simpler terms, this paper identifies where the uncertainty comes from in the agentic system pipeline, how to teach agents to know when they are wrong, and why one confidence number is not enough.

</details>


### [539] [Cassette: Case-to-Case Structural Distillation for Efficient Legal Case Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08185)
*Yanran Tang,Ruihong Qiu,Hongzhi Yin,Xue Li,Zi Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Cassette框架，通过跨架构知识蒸馏将基于GNN的CaseLink教师检索器的高准确性迁移到轻量级的混合学生双编码器中，以解决法律案例检索（LCR）中现有图方法推理效率低下的问题。该框架利用排名蒸馏目标与特征匹配目标实现语义相关性与结构信息的有效传递，在保持SOTA检索性能的同时实现最高约340,000倍的速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图神经网络的LCR方法（如CaseLink）虽取得SOTA准确性，但其在推理阶段需要动态构建案例图并执行O(n²)复杂度的成对相似度计算，导致在大规模法律数据库中推理延迟极高（COLIEE2022需500ms，LeCaRDv2需3500秒以上），严重阻碍实际部署。

Method: 1. 教师检索器：基于CaseLink的GNN模型，在包含查询与候选案例的教师法律图（TLG）上预训练。2. 学生候选编码器：采用GNN，在仅含候选案例的学生候选法律图（SCLG）上离线预计算表示。3. 学生查询编码器：采用MLP，用于在线快速编码新查询。4. 蒸馏策略：包含排名匹配目标（MSE/KL）和特征匹配目标（通过伪邻接矩阵的拉普拉斯矩阵特征值对齐），辅以InfoNCE监督损失。

Result: 在COLIEE2022、COLIEE2023（英文）和LeCaRDv2（中文）三个基准数据集上，Cassette在检索性能上达到或超越教师CaseLink，同时推理效率接近传统双塔方法。相比CaseLink，COLIEE数据集实现约50倍加速，LeCaRDv2数据集实现约340,000倍加速。消融实验验证了GNN候选编码器、MLP查询编码器、排名蒸馏和特征匹配蒸馏各模块的有效性。

Conclusion: Cassette框架通过跨架构知识蒸馏有效弥合了图基LCR模型高性能与双塔模型高效率之间的差距，是首个将GNN到双塔蒸馏引入法律案例检索领域的工作。其结构引导的蒸馏策略与司法推理原则一致，可在不重新训练的情况下支持增量文档插入，具有实际部署价值。未来工作可拓展至多语言/跨司法管辖区语料、集成细粒度法律知识以及在线持续蒸馏。

Abstract: Legal case retrieval (LCR) is an essential tool for not only assisting legal practitioners to efficiently retrieve precedents but also enabling ordinary individuals to find valuable legal case information without relying on expensive professional legal services. Our previous work CaseLink demonstrated the effectiveness of using case to case graph structures to improve retrieval accuracy. However, its high computational cost during inference on large-scale legal databases limits its practical use in real-world settings. The main inefficiency comes from constructing test time graphs and computing pairwise term frequency similarities of cases. This process has O(n^2) complexity for n legal cases, making the runtime prohibitive as the number of candidates grows. For example, the retrieval time for one query on a database (COLIEE2022) with 1,563 candidate cases is more than 500 milliseconds, while the runtime would increase drastically to more than 3,500 seconds for a database (LeCaRDv2) with 55,192 candidate cases. To further enhance the retrieval performance while achieving a significant speed-up, in this extension paper, Cassette framework is proposed with a distillation strategy involving ranking objective and eigen-matching objective for an effective transfer of knowledge from a powerful and well-trained heavy teacher retriever to a lightweight and efficient hybrid student dual encoder. Specifically, the student query encoder is implemented as a multilayer perceptron model designed for fast online processing, whereas the student candidate encoder adopts a GNN architecture, suitable for an offline manner within the case database. Extensive experiments are conducted on three benchmark datasets, and the results verify the effectiveness of the ranking distillation while achieving high efficiency. The code has been released on this https URL .

</details>


### [540] [Individual Text Corpora Predict User-Specific Knowledge: Benchmarks of Individualized Knowledge Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08532)
*Christoph Wigbels,Ali Abusaleh,Markus T. Jansen,Alexander Mehler,Manuel Schaaf,Markus J. Hofmann*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究探讨利用个人搜索历史构建的文本语料库（ICs）通过检索增强生成（RAG）来模拟个体知识。316名成年人参与，结果显示Match准确率显著超过随机水平，但概率校准较差；语料库超过500万token时知识缺口预测才显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数化知识反映的是训练语料的聚合模式，而非特定个体的知识。然而在适应性辅导、个性化诊断等应用中，需要建模特定用户的知识状态。研究旨在利用个人搜索历史作为"个体文本语料库"（ICs）来模拟个人晶化智力（Gc）。

Method: 1. 收集316名成年人的Google搜索历史，平均320万token；2. 36道多选题（12道公开BEFKI GC-K + 24道自编非公开题）；3. 模型选择：仅Qwen3-1.7B可行（GPT-2、GerPT2不及随机）；4. 三阶段评估：零样本参数化知识、LoRA任务微调、IC-based RAG；5. 评估指标：答案正确性、Match准确率、log loss（含信息论解释）、CK-accuracy。

Result: 1. 公开BEFKI题上LLM优于人类（81% vs 63%），但非公开题上LLM劣于人类（60% vs 65%），暗示训练数据污染；2. RAG的Match准确率显著高于随机（0.31 vs 0.25，d=1.06），证明存在可检测的个体知识信号；3. log loss远超随机水平（6.29 nats vs 1.39 nats），概率校准差；4. CK-accuracy低于多数类基线；5. 仅在语料≥500万token的前30%子样本中，语料大小才显著预测CK-accuracy（r=0.36）。

Conclusion: ICs中可检测到个体晶化知识信号，但概率校准是主要瓶颈；当前方法受数据量限制而非根本缺陷，未来需从"答案导向"转向"个体导向"的训练目标，例如通过per-participant LoRA将语料直接写入模型权重，并整合兴趣作为补充信号。

Abstract: This study examines whether individual text corpora (ICs) from search histories can be used to simulate individual knowledge. We collected ICs from 316 adults, who answered 36 multiple-choice knowledge items, and compared several large language models (LLMs) on this task, of which only Qwen3-1.7B proved viable. After task-specific fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), Qwen3-1.7B outperformed both participants and a representative German norm sample on publicly available items. On non-public questions, however, the LLM performed worse than our participants, suggesting possible training data contamination for the public questions. When integrating ICs into retrieval-augmented generation to predict individual responses, LLM-participant Match accuracies significantly exceeded chance, which demonstrates a detectable individual knowledge signal. The probabilities assigned to the participants' answers were, however, low and far below the probability of correct answers, indicating poor calibration toward individual response patterns. Knowledge-gap prediction was sub-optimal, though it improved for corpora exceeding five million tokens. We discuss our entropy based evaluation benchmarks as calibration indices for individualized knowledge simulation.

</details>


### [541] [PDMR: Passage-Driven Multi-ID Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08762)
*Smail Oussaidene,Mohand Boughanem*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PDMR提出了一种基于段落级多标识符的生成式文档检索框架，通过为每个文档分配多个段落级标识符来替代传统的单一文档级标识符，从而解决多面文档在单目标生成检索中的表征瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式检索方法普遍采用单标识符假设，将整个文档压缩为单一目标序列。对于内容多面的文档，这种做法会导致有损表征，且在面对不同查询意图时缺乏鲁棒性，因为所有查询意图必须竞争同一个生成访问路径。

Method: PDMR包含四个核心组件：(1)基于LLM的两阶段段落提取流程，平衡召回率与精确率；(2)段落标识符构建，包括随机数字ID(RNID)、段落标题ID(PT-ID)和标题组合ID(TC-ID，含Doc→Pass和Pass→Doc两种顺序)；(3)查询-标识符对齐策略，包括合成段落查询和原始训练查询(采用最佳段落匹配或全部段落分配)；(4)多目标训练损失，将单一查询关联的多个段落标识符作为有效目标，通过加权平均分配概率质量。推理阶段采用约束波束搜索，通过取文档所有段落标识符的最大似然得分进行文档级排序。

Result: 在NQ320K上，PDMR达到R@1为67.6、MRR@100为74.4，优于NCI和MINDER等强基线。在MS MARCO Document上，PDMR达到R@1为37.71、MRR@10为48.66，在报告方法中取得最佳R@1和MRR@10。消融实验表明：段落级监督、TC-ID(Doc→Pass)标识符设计、训练查询增强和多目标学习各自带来互补增益。NQ数据集适合全部段落分配策略，而MSM数据集由于网页文档语义异质性更强，更适合最佳段落匹配策略。

Conclusion: 将单一文档级标识符替换为多个段落级标识符是生成式检索的有效方向，能够提升早期精度排名质量和对未见查询的泛化能力。未来工作可探索多阶段训练策略以及联合学习段落选择、标识符构建和查询-标识符匹配的端到端框架。

Abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) models map queries directly to document identifiers, replacing conventional retrieval over external sparse or dense indexes with autoregressive identifier generation. However, most generative retrieval frameworks rely on a single-identifier assumption, mapping each document to a single target sequence. This forces the model to represent all document content with one sequence. Since documents are often multi-faceted, this can lead to lossy representations and reduced robustness to query variation, where multiple query intents must compete for a single generative access path. In this work, we introduce Passage-Driven Multi-ID Retrieval (PDMR), a generative retrieval framework that represents documents through multiple passage-level identifiers. PDMR segments each document and assigns one identifier to each selected passage, which provides multiple semantic entry points for retrieving the same document. This multi-entry representation allows the model to align queries with specific semantic facets, thereby reducing the dependence on a single document-level target. To address the supervision ambiguity of this one-to-many mapping, we formulate training as a multi-target learning problem and explore an objective function designed to distribute probability mass across multiple valid passage-level identifiers. We evaluate PDMR on NQ320K and MS MARCO Document. On NQ320K, PDMR improves over strong generative and non-generative baselines on Recall@1 and MRR@100. On MS MARCO Document, PDMR achieves the best Recall@1 and MRR@10 among the reported methods, while remaining competitive on Recall@10. Controlled ablations further show that passage-level supervision, identifier design, training-query augmentation, and multi-target learning contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [542] [REDSI: Addressing the Reproducibility and Evaluation Consistency of Differentiable Search Indexing for Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08860)
*Vivien Nicolas,Hicham Randrianarivo,Pascale Sébillot,Caio Corro*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReDSI，首个支持全部三种 DSI 文档标识符类型（atomic、naive、semantic）的开源实现，并发布可参数化的 NQ320K 数据集构建流水线。作者通过广泛实验证明，在 T5 模型降规模场景下，atomic 标识符在检索效果、参数效率和训练速度上均显著优于 naive 和 semantic 标识符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微分搜索索引（DSI）已成为生成式检索的事实基线，但其复现性存在严重问题：现有公开实现未覆盖全部三种原始文档标识符类型；不同文献报告的结果差异巨大；广泛使用的 NQ320K 数据集由 Natural Questions 经多种未充分说明的预处理构建而成，导致同名数据集实质不同。这些问题阻碍了 DSI 作为可靠基线的使用，也使得不同作者之间的结果难以公平比较。

Method: 1. 开发 ReDSI 开源框架，在统一训练与评估流水线中实现 atomic、naive、semantic 三种标识符类型；2. 形式化 NQ320K 构建过程，发布可参数化流水线，支持去重策略（text4k、URL、Title、PageID）与文档序列化方法（NciNorm、HtmlNorm）的多种组合，并引入基于 Wikipedia PageID 的新型去重算子和基于 HTML 重建的 HtmlNorm 序列化方法；3. 在 T5-Efficient-Tiny、Small、Base 三种规模下系统比较三种标识符类型，覆盖检索效果、参数效率、训练策略（索引-检索采样比）和解码策略（无约束、后过滤、前缀树约束）；4. 对数据集构建选择进行定性与定量分析。

Result: 1. ReDSI 取得与或优于先前 DSI 基线的结果：使用 PageID 去重 + HtmlNorm/NciNorm 配置时，T5-Base 上 Hits@1 达 63.1，MRR@10 达 70.0；2. Atomic 标识符在所有模型规模下均优于 naive 和 semantic 标识符；3. 在降规模场景下优势更为显著：44M 参数的 atomic 模型 MRR@10 达 62.2，超过 220M 参数 T5-Base 配合 naive（60.1）或 semantic（59.7）标识符的效果；4. Atomic 标识符训练速度更快（T5-Base 上约 6.8 小时达峰，naive/semantic 需 74.5 小时以上）；5. Semantic 标识符在最小模型上对非法生成更具鲁棒性；6. 约束解码相比简单后过滤无一致性增益；7. 索引-检索采样比的"自然比"（1:2.8）优于 DSI 原文报告的 32:1；8. PageID 去重比 Title 去重更准确，可避免 1.62% 训练查询和 2.54% 开发查询的跨页冲突；9. HtmlNorm 将前 32 个 token 内含未知标记的文档比例从 18.7% 降至 1.6%。

Conclusion: ReDSI 与其命名数据集变体为未来 DSI 风格系统提供了可复现的评估基础。研究表明，atomic 标识符具有最强的检索效果，在模型降规模下退化最小，且训练速度显著更快，应作为生成式检索研究中被认真考虑的基线选项；同时，PageID 去重相比 Title 去重能带来更大且更一致的效果提升，HtmlNorm 对未来依赖文档文本内容的工作将特别有价值。

Abstract: The differentiable search index (DSI) framework (Tay et al., 2022) has become the de facto baseline for generative retrieval. However, DSI is hard to reproduce: no public implementation covers all three original document identifier types (atomic, naive, semantic), reported results vary widely, and the ubiquitous NQ320K dataset is built from Natural Questions through diverse and underspecified preprocessing. We introduce ReDSI, the first open-source DSI implementation supporting all three identifier types, together with a parameterizable and well-documented NQ320K construction pipeline. Experimentally, we achieve results that are competitive with or stronger than previous DSI baselines. Moreover, we conduct extensive experiments under model downscaling, covering retrieval effectiveness, parameter efficiency, training methods and decoding strategies, opening novel directions for future research.

</details>


### [543] [FINALLY: A Dataset Recommender System for Recommender-Systems Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08941)
*Louis Owie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: FINALLY是一个基于Web的推荐系统数据集推荐器，旨在帮助研究者构建可配置的数据集集合用于离线推荐系统评估，通过集成必需数据集、候选池限制、元数据过滤、可配置目标集大小以及基于Effective Covariance和Convex Hull的多种选择策略来解决现有工具在构建完整数据集集合方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集选择决定了推荐系统算法评估的实证条件，但现有工具仅支持发现单个数据集，无法支持构建满足实验约束和集合级选择目标的完整数据集集合。论文指出86%的RecSys 2024论文未说明所选数据集的适用性，且数据集使用集中于少数常用基准，这凸显了对集成化数据集集合推荐工作流的需求。

Method: 开发了一个Web应用程序FINALLY，整合了必需数据集固定、候选池限制、元数据过滤、目标集大小配置、随机选择以及基于Reising的Effective Covariance（EffCov）和Convex Hull多样性度量的多样化/非多样化策略。系统采用浏览器端架构，使用MySQL数据库和PHP API，并通过贪心多起点启发式算法执行选择策略。性能向量通过列均值填充缺失值，不进行特征标准化。通过420次推荐运行（10个配置×42次）评估系统，每个配置包含4个确定性策略各3次重复和随机选择30次重复。

Result: 所有420次运行均成功完成，满足目标集大小（420/420）、去重（420/420）、必需数据集包含（84/84）、快照成员资格（420/420）和元数据过滤（168/168）约束。所有40个确定性策略-配置组合均可复现。EffCov和Convex Hull策略在所有10个配置中均产生预期的多样化与非多样化排序方向。多样化策略的得分高于所有30个配置特定随机结果，而非多样化策略的得分低于所有随机结果。响应时间随目标集大小增加而增长，从size5的约0.24-0.28秒增加到size20的约8.3-9.6秒，随机选择保持约0.15秒。

Conclusion: 在评估的技术范围和配置空间内，FINALLY满足了其研究目标，提供了满足评估约束且始终反映所选推荐方向的集成工作流。结果建立了评估版本的FINALLY的技术一致性和目标对齐，但并未证明所生成数据集集合的科学适用性、贪心选择的全局最优性或相对于手动选择的实际优越性。研究局限包括评估配置空间有限、贪心搜索不保证全局最优、均值填充和缺乏特征标准化的预处理决策，以及缺少用户研究。

Abstract: Dataset selection shapes the empirical conditions under which recommender-system algorithms are evaluated, yet existing tools provide limited support for constructing complete dataset sets that jointly satisfy experimental constraints and set-level selection objectives. To address this problem, I developed FINALLY, a web-based dataset recommender for constructing configurable dataset sets for offline recommender-systems evaluations. FINALLY combines required datasets, candidate-pool restrictions, metadata filters, configurable target-set sizes, Random selection, and diverse and non-diverse strategies based on adapted Effective Covariance and Convex Hull objectives. I evaluated FINALLY through 420 recommendation runs across ten systematically varied configurations. All evaluated dataset sets satisfied the applicable target-size, duplicate-avoidance, snapshot-membership, required-dataset, and metadata-filter requirements. All 40 deterministic strategy--configuration combinations were reproducible. Both the Effective-Covariance-based and Convex-Hull-based strategies produced the expected diverse-versus-non-diverse score ordering in all ten configurations. Under their corresponding objectives, the diverse strategies produced scores above all 30 configuration-specific Random results, whereas the non-diverse strategies produced scores below all 30 Random results. These results establish technical consistency for the evaluated FINALLY workflow and show that the implemented strategies follow their intended optimization directions within the investigated configuration space. They do not establish the scientific suitability, global optimality, or practical superiority of the generated selections.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [544] [Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07199)
*Hang Xiao,Chuhong Xu,Kainan Zhou,Gangzhen Qian,Lu Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 硬件木马检测结果对测试集划分高度敏感。若同一宿主电路的多个变体同时出现在训练集和测试集中，随机划分会因逻辑复用造成数据泄漏，使随机森林和XGBoost的性能被明显高估。整网表留出和整宿主家族留出均带来持续且显著的F1与AP下降，因此仅报告随机切分分数会产生过于乐观的泛化结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个硬件木马基准测试由同一宿主电路的不同木马变体构成；传统随机门级切分可能让训练与测试共享高度相似的宿主逻辑，从而夸大检测器在未知设计上的迁移能力。本文不提出新分类器，而是通过系统性改变测试边界，量化这一数据泄漏或评估边界效应对结果的影响。

Method: 研究使用包含5个宿主家族、16个网表和49,124个门的Trust-Hub语料。保持解析器、36个门级特征、类别权重、模型超参数、决策阈值及家族级聚合规则不变，仅比较三种测试策略：1）从全部门中随机抽取测试门（pooled）；2）完整留出一个网表（netlist holdout）；3）留出某一宿主电路的全部变体（host-family holdout）。比较随机森林、XGBoost和逻辑回归，并进一步检查特征删除、多次模型与模拟器随机种子、分数归一化、解析器相关门排除及子样本等敏感性因素。最终分数按宿主家族投票，而非按门数加权。

Result: 随机森林的F1/AP从pooled划分的0.914/0.978，降至单网表留出的0.636/0.851，再降至宿主家族留出的0.460/0.577。XGBoost从0.946/0.976降至0.464/0.544。逻辑回归的平均精确率（AP）随留出强度显著下降，但固定阈值F1并非单调。五个宿主家族均呈相同趋势；补充敏感性分析仅改变性能差距大小，未改变方向。Bootstrap和jackknife中的训练折仍复用家族，因此所得区间不等同于真正的跨家族不确定性。

Conclusion: 论文支持一个较窄但重要的结论：具有同一宿主电路多个变体的基准会显著抬高表面上的迁移性能，测试边界应被视为实验结论的一部分。建议同时报告随机/池化分数、完整网表留出结果及逐宿主家族留出结果，并对存在多个变体的硬件木马基准使用family-aware holdout。五个家族不足以代表总体，也不能证明对新标准单元库或工业设计的迁移能力。

Abstract: Trust-Hub reuses host circuits: several files differ mainly in the inserted Trojan. When gates from sibling variants enter both training and test folds, a detector can benefit from host logic it has already seen. We measure that effect instead of proposing another classifier. The corpus contains 49,124 gates from 16 netlists grouped into five host families. We left the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family-level aggregation unchanged and altered one choice: the test boundary. The three settings draw test gates from the pooled corpus, withhold a complete netlist, or withhold every variant of one host. The choice matters. Random forest records F1/AP of 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates, 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out, and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out. XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544 across the same comparison. Logistic regression loses AP, although its fixed-threshold F1 is not monotonic. Each family shows the same pooled-to-family direction. Feature removal, repeated model and simulator seeds, score normalization, parser-related exclusions, and a smaller sample change the size of the gap without reversing it. Aggregation also matters: a gate-weighted average is dominated by the larger ISCAS files, so the headline values give each host family one vote. Bootstrap and jackknife summaries keep the gap positive, but their folds reuse training families. We treat the five family rows as descriptive evidence rather than independent trials. Five host families are too few for a population claim, and the experiment says nothing about transfer to a new cell library or an industrial design. It supports a narrower conclusion: sibling benchmark variants can inflate apparent transfer. Benchmarks with several variants of one host circuit should report family-aware holdouts and all five family results beside pooled scores.

</details>


### [545] [When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05508)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过理论与实验证明Option-Critic算法中"增加选项数量提升性能"的现象并非源于时序抽象，而是源于三个相互作用的失败/修复机制：终止函数无效、下层策略"坏死"、以及多选项冗余覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Option-Critic的标志性实验结果是"增加选项数量K能提升性能"，常被解读为时序抽象带来的增益。然而这一曲线中混杂了三个混淆因素：时序结构变化、容量/优化几何变化、以及路由决策负担变化。该论文旨在通过控制变量法分离这些因素，揭示性能提升的真实来源。

Method: 理论与实验相结合：(1)在两层UCB老虎机模型中证明终止规则的理论性质（Proposition 1、Theorem 2、Theorem 3）；(2)提出"策略坏死"诊断——状态级测试，基于最优可接受动作集A*(s)判断选项是否在某状态"坏死"；(3)使用FourRooms环境（表格+神经实现），350个匹配种子，采用冻结检查点零探索评估协议；(4)五种转移核（局部滑移、全局传送）×两种奖励（稀疏、恒定代价），包括直接行动和惯性两种连续变体。

Result: 三个核心发现：(1)终止函数β≡1（每步重选）时K-性能曲线完全保留，学习的终止函数在K=2时有利、K=8时有害，方向随K反转；(2)softmax温度τ=10⁻³与学习率0.25的组合使状态在一次更新后即"坏死"——约3/5状态坏死；恢复下层探索后，单个选项从306.7降至55.4步，350/350种子改善；(3)增加选项不改善任何单个选项（单选项坏死率稳定在~60%），但联合坏死率从59%降至4%，性能跟随联合指标变化；有效独立选项数κ在K=8时约为6.20。

Conclusion: Option-Critic的K-缩放结果不源于时序抽象，而源于：(a)下层softmax的坏死失败，(b)多选项冗余作为该失败的变通方案，(c)下层探索作为根本修复。一旦探索被恢复，单个选项足以完成任务，更多选项开始带来路由成本。终止函数在一致值下是恒等操作，在不一致值下可能成为无次线性保证的探索否决器。论文的更广泛启示是：任何架构先验若被放在有可修复缺陷的基学习器之上，会被错误归功于它所掩盖的缺陷。

Abstract: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $\Omega(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

</details>


### [546] [PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05676)
*Mina Mirzadehsarcheshmeh,Amir Keyvan Khandani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将PAC隐私预测（PAC-private prediction）从分类任务扩展到自回归语言生成任务。核心思想是从私有语料构建m=128个重叠子集（"世界"），每个记录恰好出现在64个世界中，每个世界训练一个LoRA适配器。在每个token生成时，公共模型定义候选集，所有世界在候选集内投票，其后验加权分歧决定PAC噪声校准；一致投票无需噪声。作者证明了端到端互信息上界I(S;Y_{1:T}) ≤ bT，并提出了耦合Gumbel解码以避免采样带来的虚假分歧。在WikiText-103和GPT-2-small上的实验显示，该方法在每token预算b=2^{-32}下保留了74.3%的微调增益（贪婪解码）和84.4%（耦合Gumbel），成员推理成功率被限制在51.08%以下，10^6 token后；通过后验熵估计的实际泄漏约为固定记账的17%。在相同成员推理约束下，对比PMixED基线，在10^2到10^6 token的所有查询范围内保留了98%的非私有性能上限（而PMixED最多保留56%），且无交叉点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在私有文本上微调后通过API部署，隐私泄漏通过生成输出而非模型权重发生。现有隐私预测方法（如PMixED）在每次发布时消耗隐私预算，随着生成长度增加越来越依赖公共模型，导致效用下降。PAC隐私通过根据输出在不同可能秘密间的变异性来校准噪声，稳定的预测只需更少噪声，但此前仅适用于分类任务，未被扩展到自回归生成。

Method: 1. 私有语料U（含2,048篇WikiText-103文章+16个金丝雀记录）分配到m=128个重叠"世界"，每个记录恰好在64个世界中；2. 每个世界训练一个LoRA适配器（r=8）于冻结的GPT-2-small基础模型上；3. 每步t：公共模型定义top-200候选集V_t，所有128世界在V_t内投票（贪婪或耦合Gumbel τ=1.0）；4. 计算后验加权投票协方差C_t = diag(π_t) - π_t π_t^T，秩至多a_t-1；5. 在C_t的活动子空间上用PAC校准函数Σ(P_{t-1}, M_t, b)确定噪声协方差Σ_t；6. 形成内部向量R_t = e_{v_S} + Z_t，更新后验P_t，发布Y_t = argmax_{v∈A_t}(R_t)_v；7. 耦合Gumbel解码使用共享随机变量U_t以保持确定性条件和边际保真度。理论证明包括四个核心引理/命题：标记释放（数据处理不等式）、活动子空间校准（处理奇异协方差）、自回归查询可纳性、耦合解码保持记账。

Result: 1. 稳定性普查：k=200时83.4%位置上所有128世界投票一致，中位数不同投票数为1，第95百分位为2；2. 隐私-效用权衡：在b=2^{-32}下，贪婪解码保留74.3%微调增益（42.44% vs 公共38.16% vs 非私有43.92%），耦合Gumbel保留84.4%；3. 预算平坦性：在b从2^{-4}到2^{-32}的2^28范围内，精度几乎不变（42.43-42.87%），因为一致投票占主导；4. 实际泄漏估计约为固定记账的17%（跨15个cell稳定在17.0-18.8%），相当于约5.8倍保守性；5. 金丝雀压力测试：强制记忆下，b=2^{-16}时成员推理优势统计上与零无显著差异，但金丝雀字符串发射率仍基本不变（48.9-51.3%），区分了推理隐私与内容保护；6. 与PMixED对比：在ε≈1匹配成员推理界下，PAC-Gumbel在T=10^2到10^6所有查询范围保留98.0-98.4%的非私有性能上限，而PMixED最多55.7%（慷慨记账）至0.9%（严格记账），且PMixED的回退率（f_∅）从19%升至85%，说明其被迫用公共模型回答大多数查询；7. 计算成本：128世界批量前向传播29.71ms/token，机制本身仅0.223ms（0.74%），吞吐量33.4 tokens/s。

Conclusion: 本文成功将PAC隐私预测扩展到自回归生成，通过128个重叠世界的构造实现了：1. 端到端隐私保证I(S;Y_{1:T}) ≤ bT（定理4）；2. 处理了自回归设置特有的四个问题——标记输出而非向量、大词汇表下的奇异协方差、自生成查询流、采样解码的随机性；3. 经验上保留了大部分微调增益，且精度在宽预算范围内平坦；4. 实际泄漏仅为固定记账的约17%，表明固定预算记账约保守5.8倍；5. 相比PMixED在长查询范围下保持显著优势（98% vs ≤56%），无交叉点；6. 揭示了两个广泛教训：隐私泄漏在退化文本中可能人为变小（因为集成也倾向于一致），且低成员推理优势并不意味着记忆内容不能被重现。该方法的主要局限在于：评估基于单一语料和单一世界集合，记账在内部历史而非token流上的松弛未被量化，且推理隐私不等同于内容保护。

Abstract: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation. We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. At each token, the public model defines a candidate set, the worlds vote, and their posterior-weighted disagreement determines the PAC noise; unanimity requires no calibration noise. We prove $I(S;Y_{1:T}) \leq I(S;H_T) \leq bT$. Our contributions are extending PAC privacy to autoregressive generation, handling adaptive self-generated contexts, and introducing coupled decoding that preserves privacy accounting while avoiding greedy degeneration.
