Result: 六种模型-变换条件下，9.7%–27.0%的基线正确行为在语义保持变换后变为错误。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B的T1(操作数重排)、T2(重命名)、T3(加括号)不变性失败率分别为9.7%、10.2%、21.8%；DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite分别为16.1%、19.5%、27.0%。特别值得注意的是，DeepSeek在T2下整体准确率从53.9%上升到63.7%，却有19.5%的原本正确行为失效——说明聚合准确率可掩盖严重的不稳定性。人工审查30个案例识别出四类错误：路径谓词遗漏/丢失、else-if分支极性错误、布尔结构破坏(否定分布错误)、输出契约违规(合并多个赋值行为)。Qwen全部15个采样损失为语义/路径错误；DeepSeek 13个为语义错误、2个为输出契约违规，无评分器假阳性。仅Qwen-T3的准确率差分自助置信区间完全不含零，其他条件区间均跨零。

Conclusion: 该论文证明点准确率不足以表征LLM在SVA生成中的可靠性，需要鲁棒性感知评估。聚合准确率与行为稳定性是衡量模型质量的不同维度：模型可能在提升整体准确率的同时，破坏大量原本正确的行为。建议硬件验证基准同时报告(1)规范输入上的点准确率，(2)语义保持变体下基线正确行为的不变性失败率，(3)总翻转率。论文强调受控、有限规模的变形研究而非模型排名，并指出未来工作应扩展到更大RTL语料、更丰富时序SVA构造以及完整形式化/仿真语义验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for automating SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, yet most evaluations report correctness on a single syntactic representation of an input. Such point accuracy does not reveal whether a model's correct output is stable when the same RTL behavior is written differently. This paper presents a controlled metamorphic evaluation of LLM-based SVA generation under semantics-preserving RTL transformations. Starting from the VERT dataset, we construct a quality-filtered conditional-control pool and a stratified 40-program evaluation set containing 295 assignment behaviors. We evaluate two open code models, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite, with an identical evaluation prompt and greedy decoding. Three transformations are studied: operand reordering, deterministic identifier renaming, and redundant parenthesization. Beyond baseline and transformed accuracy, we measure conditional robustness, invariance failure, and any-flip rate, with 10,000-sample clustered bootstrap intervals at the RTL-program level. Across all six model-transformation conditions, 9.7%-27.0% of behaviors that were correct on the original RTL become incorrect after a semantics-preserving transformation. Aggregate accuracy can therefore hide substantial instability: under identifier renaming, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite improves from 53.9% to 63.7% accuracy while 19.5% of its originally correct behaviors fail. Manual review of 30 sampled correct-to-wrong transitions identifies dropped path predicates, branch-polarity errors, Boolean-structure corruption, and output-contract violations. The results show that point accuracy alone is insufficient for characterizing LLM reliability in assertion generation and motivate robustness-aware evaluation for AI-assisted hardware verification.

</details>


### [631] [Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05688)
*Zhankun Luo,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合线性回归（MLR）中方差保持扩散的分数匹配估计器，分三方面分析：（1）路径积分分数匹配估计器的最大似然渐近性；（2）固定尺度分数匹配损失与期望最大化（EM）的分解关系；（3）高噪声梯度动力学与分数匹配盲性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合线性回归是经典的潜变量模型，但分数匹配在未知混合权重下的统计性质、与EM优化的联系，以及噪声水平对参数信息保留的影响尚不清楚。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 方法包括：（1）通过相对熵和KL散度桥接，建立路径积分分数匹配与似然函数的联系；（2）利用交叉熵和EM算子分解固定尺度分数匹配损失；（3）分析高噪声极限下的梯度下降动力学；（4）研究高信噪比固定射线下分数匹配梯度的盲性现象。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）路径积分分数匹配估计器在终端调度条件下具有联合符号一致的相合性，且缩放误差渐近服从逆Fisher协方差的高斯分布；（2）固定尺度分数匹配损失可分解为交叉熵/EM残差加算子Jacobian和潜方差修正项；（3）高噪声极限下梯度下降呈现O(K^{-2})收敛（零目标）或几何收敛（非零目标），例外初始集具有零测度；（4）沿固定高SNR射线，混合权重不平衡梯度点趋于零，呈现分数匹配盲性。

Conclusion: 结论：本文建立了混合线性回归中分数匹配与最大似然渐近性的精确联系，揭示了固定尺度分数匹配与EM优化的深层结构关系，并刻画了高噪声条件下分数匹配的盲性现象。数值实验验证了理论发现，包括联合Fisher椭球覆盖率从93.5%到95.0%的校准结果。

Abstract: We study variance-preserving diffusion of the response in mixed linear regression (MLR) with unknown mixing weights. Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. This decomposition yields an EM-related low-noise gradient expansion with additional correction terms of latent variance. In the high-noise limit, we further characterize gradient descent on this limiting loss under isotropic covariance. Along fixed high signal-to-noise ratio rays, the score matching imbalance gradient and the latent-variance term tend to zero pointwise. Numerical experiments illustrate our theoretical findings and statistical guarantees.

</details>


### [632] [GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05694)
*Mrityunjay Sharma,Sarabeshwar Balaji,Valentina Parma,Ritesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphNOSE是一种开源的图Transformer框架，通过整合位置与结构编码（GPSE）和基于GPS的混合架构（局部MPNN+全局自注意力），从SMILES预测多标签气味描述符。其参数量仅为314K（约为OpenPOM的1/6），在单一分子和二元混合物的标准测试中AUROC达89%，在物理化学极端分布外（OOD）测试中AUROC达84%，均显著优于现有GNN基线、分子语言模型嵌入和经典化学指纹方法，并结合集成梯度提供化学可解释的子结构归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从分子结构预测嗅觉感知是化学信息学中的开放难题。线性模型和基于分子指纹的方法在面对新颖化学骨架、极端分子量或复杂气味混合物时泛化能力不足；已有GNN（如OpenPOM）受限于局部感受野，难以捕捉分子全局拓扑对气味的影响。论文旨在利用图Transformer的全局注意力机制结合预训练的位置/结构编码解决这些瓶颈。

Method: 1. 数据：使用OpenPOM发布的GS-LF数据集（4,983个分子，138个气味描述符）及二元混合物数据集（44,000训练对/40,000测试对，74个标签）。通过RDKit/DeepChem构建分子图（92原子特征+7键特征）。2. 模型：GraphNOSE基于GraphGPS架构，4层GPS层，隐维64，使用GINE作为局部消息传递分支，全局注意力分支提供两种变体——GraphNOSE_lin（Performer线性注意力）和GraphNOSE_trans（标准自注意力），均池化后接512维MLP分类器。3. 位置与结构编码：系统比较RWSE、LapPE，以及GPSE的5种预训练变体（MolPCBA、ZINC、ChEMBL、PCQM4Mv2、GEOM），通过MLP投影后与节点特征拼接。4. 训练：80/20划分，使用不平衡加权二值交叉熵损失，Adam优化器，Optuna贝叶斯优化超参数。5. OOD评估：基于11种物理化学属性的D_phys偏差分数构建65:35极端分布外划分。6. 解释性：使用集成梯度识别关键子结构。

Result: 1. GPSE预训练语料库选择影响有限但MolPCBA数值最优（GraphNOSE_lin AUROC 89.02%）；RWSE在标准自注意力下出现注意力塌陷。2. 在标准测试集上，GraphNOSE_trans达89.15% AUROC，显著优于OpenPOM（87.14%，p=0.0028, d=2.94）、LDM_GCN/LDM_DMPNN及所有线性/LLM基线，平均优势4.52%（p<0.01）。3. 极端物理化学OOD测试中，GraphNOSE达84.34% AUROC，超越OpenPOM的80.84%（p<0.001）。4. 在低数据（30%训练）场景下仍优于GNN基线。5. 学习到的潜空间保留气味标签的层次聚类（KDE分析）且近邻检索在感知上比Morgan指纹更优（86.91% vs 79.73%）。6. 二元混合物任务中AUROC达77.96%，以281K参数超越2M参数的MPNN基线（p=0.0083）。7. 集成梯度归因与化学直觉一致（如醇类→羟基、硫味→硫原子、果味→酯基）。

Conclusion: GraphNOSE以约6倍参数效率建立了气味预测的新SOTA，证明了GPSE预训练的位置/结构编码比手工编码（RWSE、LapPE）提供更丰富的归纳偏置；图Transformer的全局注意力对捕捉长程依赖和OOD泛化至关重要。该框架在单一分子、低数据、极端OOD和二元混合物等多种条件下均稳健有效，且具备化学可解释性，为计算嗅觉提供了可扩展、可解释的基础架构。局限性包括：仅使用2D表示（手性异构体不可区分）、未涉及浓度依赖的感知变化，以及仅在GS-LF数据集上验证。

Abstract: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and structural encodings within a transformer-based graph architecture, GraphNOSE achieves strong performance with six times fewer parameters than standard graph neural network (GNN) baseline while consistently outperforming linear models, molecular language model embeddings, molecular fingerprints, and baseline GNNs by an average area under the ROC curve (AUROC) margin of 4.52% (p < 0.01). GraphNOSE achieves an AUROC of 84% on out-of-distribution compounds (OODs). This exceeds the current state-of-the-art GNN for OOD in olfaction (Open-POM: 81%, p < 0.001), and identifies conditions under which linear models empirically fail. Finally, we apply XAI (explainable AI) methods to identify which substructures and molecular features drive odor predictions, yielding insights consistent with chemical intuition and grounded in the model's learned representations. Together, these results establish GraphNOSE as a scalable and interpretable architecture for olfactory prediction that generalizes to structurally distinct compounds underrepresented in current perceptual databases.

</details>


### [633] [A Multi-Source Ensemble Approach to Candidate Generation for Alternative Vacation Rental Property Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05748)
*Syed Mohammed Arshad Zaidi,Eric Rincon,Shayan Hassantabar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究度假租赁平台中替代房源推荐的候选生成(CG)方法,在包含超200万活跃房源的大规模平台上,系统比较了协同过滤(IBKNN)、浅层嵌入(Hotel2Vec)和图神经网络(GNN)三类方法,并提出融合IBKNN与GNN的多源混合架构。GNN单独使用即比Hotel2Vec在Recall@K上取得48%–68%的相对提升;混合架构在Recall@300上较最强基线提升14.8%,IBKNN在早期召回占优,GNN在高K值与多样性候选上贡献显著,且更好的候选池带来更高的下游排序质量(Booking NDCG@5从0.345提升至0.365)。同时,论文明确讨论了候选生成改进与下游排序之间的"召回-转化差距",并指出存在的若干实验与归因局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 度假租赁市场的替代房源推荐面临异构库存、地理约束、快速可用性变化和长尾分布等独特挑战,传统单一来源的候选生成方法各有不足:IBKNN在早期召回强但存在冷启动与流行度偏差问题,Hotel2Vec等浅层嵌入方法只能捕获对称、单跳的共现关系。因此需要研究更适合该领域的多源候选生成策略,并系统评估候选生成阶段改进对下游排序的影响。

Method: 1. 将候选生成形式化为异构图上的链接预测任务,构建包含LHS(参考房源)与RHS(候选房源)两类属性节点的异构图,集成用户-房源交互、预订衍生的备选标签以及结构、位置、政策、质量和62项便利设施等属性特征,通过消息传递学习非对称的双重嵌入(LHS/RHS)。2. IBKNN基于用户受众重叠的Jaccard相似度,并加入便利设施相似度的置信度加权提升。3. 多源融合采用按房源的秩归一化最大融合策略,合并IBKNN与GNN候选。4. 轻量级LightGBM LambdaRank重排序器使用分层难负样本采样(硬负40%/约束违反30%/中等20%/随机10%),特征为各来源单独的相似度分数、房源属性和成对特征,显式排除融合后的单一候选生成分数。5. 时间划分严格:训练用2025年3–5月数据,测试用2025年6月数据,避免信息泄漏。

Result: 1. GNN相对Hotel2Vec在所有Recall@K阈值上取得48%–68%的相对提升,中段K值增益最大。2. 消融实验:64维优于32维(+0.5pp),48标签邻居优于24(+0.7pp),加入便利设施与评论特征提升+1.6pp。3. 混合架构Recall@300较基线提升14.8%(39.9%→45.8%),早期R@10仅+1.3%,增益集中在中后段,验证了IBKNN早期、GNN后期的分工。4. 单源分析表明IBKNN在低K占优(R@100 28.5% vs 25.0%),GNN在高K反超(R@500 49.2% vs 48.5%),融合池在K≥50一致优于任一单源。5. 下游排序质量提升:Test NDCG@5从0.345提升至0.365,但归因受到候选池变化与重排序器重训练的耦合影响。

Conclusion: 在度假租赁替代推荐场景中,异构图GNN能通过非对称嵌入、多跳消息传递与显式特征聚合显著优于浅层嵌入方法;与基于受众重叠的协同过滤(IBKNN)组合形成的多源混合架构,能利用IBKNN的早期召回强度与GNN的多样性、后期召回覆盖,在Recall@300上取得+14.8%的提升,并带来下游排序质量改善。然而候选生成层增益难以干净地传递给最终排序,即"召回-转化差距",提示实际部署新检索方法时需联合适配下游排序器并谨慎设计评估;未来工作包括受控的单变量消融、固定排序器的跨池评估、多时间窗与置信区间报告、暴露偏差缓解,以及在线A/B验证。

Abstract: Alternative property recommendations play a critical role in vacation rental marketplaces, helping users discover relevant options when viewing a specific listing. However, generating high-quality candidate alternatives presents unique challenges: heterogeneous inventory, geographic constraints, rapid availability changes, and long-tail property distributions. We present a comprehensive study of candidate generation (CG) approaches for vacation rental alternatives, comparing collaborative filtering, shallow embeddings, and graph neural network (GNN) methods. Our experiments on a large-scale vacation rental platform (over 2M active properties) show that a hybrid architecture combining item-based collaborative filtering with GNN-based retrieval improves Recall@300 by 14.8% over the strongest baseline, by leveraging the complementary strengths of the two sources: collaborative filtering excels at early recall for properties with rich interaction history, while GNNs discover diverse, non-obvious alternatives and handle cold-start scenarios more effectively. As a component result, GNN-based embeddings alone substantially outperform shallow Hotel2Vec embeddings (48-68% relative recall improvement across K), motivating their inclusion in the ensemble. Crucially, we examine how CG-stage gains carry through to the downstream ranking stage, and find that a stronger candidate pool yields higher downstream ranking quality, though attributing this effect cleanly is complicated by the coupling between candidate generation and ranker training. This recall-conversion gap is an important consideration for practitioners deploying new retrieval methods in two-stage recommendation systems.

</details>


### [634] [RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05770)
*Duc Dm,Khai Le-Duc,Nguyen Do,Minh Son Hoang,Florent Draye,Thai Hoang,Hoang Phuong Dam,Jiarui Liu,Chris Ngo,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Anh Le Duc Tran,Nhat Do Minh,Minh Ngoc Le,My T. Thai,Ran Xu,Silvio Savarese,Mona Diab,Bernhard Schölkopf,Zhijing Jin,Huy L. Nguyen,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RAPTOR，一种针对稀疏MoE模型的差分隐私微调框架，通过区分共享层与专家层的角色结构（角色感知私有训练），解决现有将MoE视为单一稠密块所导致的三种结构失败：裁剪干扰、更新尺度稀释和负载依赖的信噪比退化。核心创新包括交替共享/专家流优化、专家专属裁剪与噪声、公共期望所有者分母、计数无关的更新调度，以及基于公共语料路由熵的隐私无关层选择规则。作者证明在并行组合下，更新所有E个专家的隐私成本等同于更新单个专家，并在Switch Transformer、OLMoE和DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny上验证了方法在紧隐私预算下的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的差分隐私微调方法（如DP-SGD、DP-Adam及其MoE扩展）将稀疏MoE模型视为单一稠密块处理，忽视了共享层（接收所有记录）与路由专家（仅接收路由记录）之间的结构性差异。这种结构性不匹配导致三种失败模式：（1）全局裁剪因子由稠密块主导，抑制专家梯度；（2）全批次归一化稀释稀疏专家更新；（3）固定隐私噪声在低负载专家上造成不均匀的SNR退化，最终损害MoE的核心价值——专家特化能力。

Method: RAPTOR将DP机制与MoE的角色结构对齐，引入两个流：共享流对所有记录做标准逐记录裁剪加噪更新；专家流仅在每个记录的所有者专家（基于门控加权多数票的确定性分配）上更新，采用专家专属裁剪Ce与噪声σe、公共期望所有者分母De=B/E（避免泄露路由信息）、计数无关的更新调度（即使所有者子集为空也进行纯噪声更新），并通过独立泊松子采样实现交替优化。层选择基于公共语料上的路由熵H(q^⁽ˡ⁾)最大化，在不消耗隐私预算的前提下确定受保护的稀疏层l*。隐私保证通过并行组合（每个记录恰分配给一个所有者专家，跨专家组合不增加隐私成本）与跨流/跨层的序贯组合（PRV账户）实现。理论分析给出公开分母估计器的偏置-方差分解，证明偏置随路由不平衡可预测增长，由此导出熵作为隐私无关层选择准则的合理性。

Result: 在Switch-base-8（E=8）的四个GLUE任务（SST-2/MNLI/QNLI/QQP）上，RAPTOR在ε∈{1,4,8}全部12个任务-预算单元上均优于Monolithic DP-Adam LoRA，ε=8时增益+0.23至+3.24点，ε=1时+1.51至+2.92点；在OLMoE-1B-7B（E=64，top-8路由）上同样12/12单元最优，ε=8时增益最高+2.18点（MNLI），ε=1时最高+4.50点（QNLI）；在DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny视觉语言模型上于ScienceQA保持一致优势。熵选择层（block 1/7/11/9）在多数任务中匹配或超越首末层选择。消融显示交替调度贡献最大（最高-1.97点），其次为公共分母、专家专属裁剪与残差目标。MIA审计显示DP方法均显著降低LiRA TPR@0.1%FPR。运行时与Monolithic LoRA相当（4.51 vs 4.07秒/步），峰值显存更低（112 vs 131 GB）。

Conclusion: RAPTOR证明将MoE视为稠密块进行差分隐私微调是一种结构性不兼容，而非实现细节。通过角色感知的双流优化（共享流+专家流）、公开分母归一化与路由熵驱动的层选择，RAPTOR在保持形式化(ε,δ)-DP保证的前提下，在紧隐私预算下取得一致且显著的精度提升，验证了并行组合在路由诱导的不相交所有者分组上的有效性。公开分母估计器的偏置可由路由熵控制，为隐私无关的层选择提供了原则性准则。局限包括路由器冻结、私有归一化的非最优性以及残差权重对异常值/标签噪声的放大风险；未来工作涉及私有路由器自适应、动态归一化以及生成式/多模态MoE扩展。

Abstract: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records. We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. We prove the resulting mechanism satisfies $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP: because each record is assigned to exactly one owner expert, per-expert mechanisms within a layer compose in parallel, so updating all $E$ experts costs no more, in privacy terms, than updating one, with shared and expert streams composing sequentially across training. We further derive a bias-variance decomposition of the public-denominator estimator showing its bias grows predictably with routing imbalance, yielding a privacy-free rule for selecting which layer to protect from routing entropy measured on a small public corpus. Experiments on Switch Transformer and OLMoE fine-tuning across GLUE tasks, and on DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, show consistent gains over standard DP baselines across several privacy levels ($\varepsilon$), with the largest margins typically at the tightest budgets. Code and models are publicly available: this https URL

</details>


### [635] [Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05778)
*Conor Rowan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出参数化Deep Ritz方法（parametric Deep Ritz method）用于求解非线性椭圆均匀化中的参数化胞问题。该方法利用胞问题的变分结构，用神经网络同时离散空间和宏观状态参数维度，并强约束周期性边界条件。相比传统FE²方案，该方法提供关于宏观状态和梯度的连续可微表示，显著加速多尺度数值求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性椭圆均匀化中，均质化本构关系由常数张量描述；但在非线性情形下，均质化响应依赖于宏观状态及其梯度，需要求解参数化胞问题。传统FE²方法在每次Newton迭代中需重新数值求解胞问题并做灵敏度分析，计算昂贵；且需要关于宏观参数的可微表示以便Newton迭代求解宏观场。需要一种能够高效提供连续可微参数化解的方法。

Method: 1) 利用胞问题的变分结构（Fourier型：能量泛函含(δ_ij+∂χ_i/∂y_j)²项；p-Laplace型：能量泛函含|∇_x u_0+∇_y χ|^p项）。2) 用MLP神经网络同时离散空间坐标𝐲和宏观参数ℳ。3) 通过对输入坐标进行sin/cos周期嵌入（式(14)）强约束周期性边界条件。4) 用平均惩罚项去除corrector的刚体模。5) 对低维参数空间用网格积分，对高维参数空间用Monte Carlo积分。6) 训练采用ADAM优化器，损失为参数化变分能量。

Result: 1) 一维Fourier型问题：corrector的相对L¹误差0.7%，均质化解用20×更少的基函数准确捕获低频响应。2) 二维Fourier型两相复合问题：corrector相对L¹误差4.7%，均质化热导率分量最大误差3×10⁻³；网格外u=0.2处张量误差仅0.15%。3) 二维p-Laplace格子超材料问题：用Monte Carlo积分，corrector相对L¹误差17%，但宏观热流通量相对误差仅0.2%。4) FE²对比：100组随机宏观参数下，求解热流通量及其梯度，神经网络方法耗时2.7秒，Fourier+灵敏度分析耗时948.7秒，加速超过300倍。

Conclusion: 参数化Deep Ritz方法能准确高效求解非线性均匀化中的参数化胞问题，神经网络离散天然提供关于宏观参数的连续可微表示，可通过自动微分直接获得Newton迭代所需的本构关系导数。相比FE²方案显著加速多尺度仿真（>300倍），且无需训练数据、可随机采样高维参数空间。附录证明通过胞问题得到的均质化本构张量自动满足对称性和正半定性。未来工作将拓展至非线性弹性向量值问题，并进一步评估在FE²方案中的集成与高维参数可扩展性。

Abstract: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. When computing a numerical solution with the homogenized constitutive relation, it is useful to have a differentiable representation of the solution to the cell problem, as derivatives of the homogenized constitutive relation are required in Newton iterations for the macroscopic state field. In this work, we use the Deep Ritz method to solve the parametric cell problems that arise from nonlinear homogenization. First, we exploit the variational structure of the cell problem, then we discretize the dependence of the cell response on both space and the macroscopic state with a neural network. Enforcing boundary conditions on the cell response strongly, we next use the parametric Deep Ritz method to simultaneously solve the cell problem over a range of macroscopic states. We show that this method is accurate, efficient, and offers a continuous and differentiable representation of the cell response over the macroscopic state and gradient. We then show that our parametric representation of the cell response significantly expedites macroscale solutions when compared to a traditional $\text{FE}^2$ scheme.

</details>


### [636] [Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05820)
*Wang Wei,Soumyabrata Pal,Koyel Mukherjee,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Branislav Kveton,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限反馈预算下，自适应地将提示路由到多个LLM专家的在线学习问题，将其形式化为上下文老虎机，并提出了在何时何地获取反馈的算法，在全信息与老虎机两种设置下均获得了近最优的遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同LLM专家具有不同能力和成本，没有单一模型占优，但实际中用户对LLM响应质量的反馈（如人类反馈或LLM-as-a-Judge）成本高昂，无法在每一轮都获取。如何在有限反馈预算 $m \ll T$ 下，高效学习高质量的LLM路由策略是核心问题。

Method: 将问题建模为线性上下文老虎机：$K$ 个专家（对应 $K$ 个LLM），每个专家有未知参数 $\theta_a$，prompt 为上下文 $x_t$，奖励为 $\langle \theta_a, x_t \rangle + \eta$。反馈预算为 $m \ll T$。算法需决定：何时查询反馈、对哪些历史prompt查询反馈。核心方法是在定期间隔内，选择能使协方差矩阵行列式增益最大的历史prompt进行反馈观察。(1) 全信息设置：所有专家共享协方差矩阵，算法 LimFullFeed 每 $T/m$ 轮选一次最大化行列式的过去prompt。(2) 老虎机设置：每个专家维护独立协方差矩阵，算法 LimBanFeed 使用UCB策略选择专家，并按专家使用计数触发反馈。技术上利用信息增益最大化（行列式准则）、正则化最小二乘估计、置信集分析。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 全信息设置遗憾上界 $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{T/m})$，下界 $\Omega(T\sqrt{d/m})$（匹配至 $\sqrt{d}$ 因子）。(2) 老虎机设置遗憾上界 $\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$，下界 $\Omega(T\sqrt{K/m})$（匹配至 $\sqrt{d/K}$ 因子）。(3) 扩展至可变专家评估成本场景。实验结果：在 RouterBench（$K$=11）和 Nectar（$K$=6, $d$=40, $T$=60000）数据集上，所提算法 LimFullFeed 和 LimBanFeed 一致优于 NoLookBack 基线；随着反馈预算 $m$ 增加，遗憾下降趋势与理论一致（$\sqrt{T/m}$ 依赖）；LimFullFeed 运行时与 $K$ 无关，LimBanFeed 运行时与 $K$ 线性相关。

Conclusion: 本文提出在有限反馈下进行LLM路由的上下文老虎机框架，核心创新在于算法主动选择何时何地获取反馈，而非被动接收。通过最大化历史prompt的协方差行列式增益，实现了近最优的遗憾保证。实验验证了在多种LLM专家（GPT-3.5/4、LLaMA、Mistral）上高效学习路由策略的有效性。未来方向包括动态专家可用性、变化prompt分布及改进老虎机设置的下界。

Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

</details>


### [637] [Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05822)
*Pablo Boitel,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 NOMAD-RL，一种基于物理信息正则化流的自适应域随机化强化学习控制器，通过通用热 thermostat 接口实现跨异构热区的可迁移 HVAC 控制，无需逐站点建模或重调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑能耗占全球终端能源的 30% 与能源相关 CO₂ 排放的 26%，但 MPC 与传统 RL 都依赖精确建筑模型，限制大规模部署。需要一种可在异构热区间迁移、免建模的通用 RL 控制器。

Method: 1) 监督式控制接口：策略仅输出温度设定点增量，由低层 PID 执行，保留安全性与可解释性。2) 基于 RC5 模型 + 水源热泵 + PID 的 25 维参数化热区模拟器（JAX 实现）。3) 循环 PPO（LSTM actor-critic）+ 时序卷积编码短时预测，处理 POMDP 与在线适应。4) 基于上下文归一化奖励（相对固定设定点 PID 参考回放）稳定训练。5) 核心创新：用神经样条流（normalizing flow）对 25 维热区参数联合分布建模，以 Boltzmann 目标 + 物理合理性代价 + 惊奇奖励构建候选评分，KL 信赖域约束下加权最大似然更新流参数，形成自适应训练课程。物理代价惩罚不合理热泵效率、基线控制下的舒适偏差与执行器饱和。

Result: 单区标称环境：NOMAD-RL 较 PID 节能 70.4%，但比无域随机化循环 PPO 多耗 8.7%；单区采样（漂移动力学）环境：较 PID 节能 60.1%，较 PPO 节能 51.4%，比 MPC 多耗 46.6%（MPC 有精确模型，近似全局最优）。多区（3 区耦合建筑）：较 PID 节能 67.9%，仅比 MPC 多耗 14.5%，差距随复杂度提升而缩小。

Conclusion: NOMAD-RL 证明基于物理信息的自适应域随机化可在不依赖精确建筑模型的前提下实现跨热区可迁移的 HVAC 控制，性能接近精细调参的 MPC。未来工作包括更长训练、超参调优、更大规模架构（Transformer、flow matching）及真实建筑验证。代码已开源。

Abstract: Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface. The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability. Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across buildings. We evaluate NOMAD-RL against a constant-setpoint PID controller, RL without domain randomization, and MPC in single- and multi-zone settings. NOMAD-RL consistently outperforms the PID and non-randomized RL baselines, and approaches the performance of a well-tuned MPC, especially in the more challenging multi-zone case. These results highlight the potential of adaptive, physics-informed domain randomization for robust and transferable HVAC control.

</details>


### [638] [Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05826)
*Jiancheng Tu,Wenqi Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Weighted STreeD 与 Adaptive STreeD 两种方法，通过联合特征空间与样本空间缩减来扩展基于动态规划的最优分类树学习框架 STreeD 的可扩展性，在五个二值化数据集上取得了显著的加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于动态规划的最优分类树方法在高维特征空间和大样本场景下计算成本高昂：候选特征增加导致状态空间和分裂评估爆炸，重复记录扫描放大样本相关开销，且预处理后的高维二值特征空间进一步加剧了这些成本。

Method: 论文构建在 STreeD 动态规划框架之上，提出两种互补机制：(1) Weighted STreeD 在固定候选集下，将投影到候选集后产生的重复记录合并为加权代表，在满足信息保持条件下对固定候选优化问题提供无损等价重构；(2) Adaptive STreeD 采用有界候选集迭代精化策略，初始候选集来自随机森林特征排序，后续迭代保留当前最优树的分裂特征支持集并通过重复 CART 拟合提议新特征，每次更新后重新投影并聚合数据，再调用 Weighted STreeD 求解缩小后的问题。理论方面给出了固定候选集下的等价性证明、时间/空间复杂度分析以及条件解质量下界。

Result: 在五个公开数据集(COMPAS、Diabetic、Give Me Some Credit、FICO HELOC、Transactions)上的实验表明：Weighted STreeD 相对标准 STreeD 平均加速 8.20 倍，最高 121.41 倍；Adaptive STreeD 在深度 2–4 的匹配对比中降低运行时间(深度 4 时加速 34.02 倍)，在深度 5–7 仍能返回可行树而全特征方法受限于时间或内存；在相同计算预算下预测性能与最优分类树基线相当，在最大数据集 Transactions 上甚至优于基线。候选容量 K=20 被识别为高效运行点。

Conclusion: 联合特征空间和样本空间缩减能够有效扩展基于动态规划的最优树学习。Weighted STreeD 为固定候选集提供无损加权聚合，Adaptive STreeD 在此基础上通过有界候选集迭代精化扩展了可处理的深度范围。主要局限在于外层特征搜索仍是启发式的，不保证全特征最优性，且整体复杂度仍依赖原始样本量和特征维度。

Abstract: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. Experiments on five data sets show that Weighted STreeD achieves speedups of up to 121.41 times over standard STreeD. Adaptive STreeD reduces runtime in matched comparisons at depths 2 to 4 and continues to return feasible trees at greater depths where full-feature methods are limited by time or memory. Under the same computational budget, its predictive performance remains comparable to the evaluated optimal classification tree baselines and is higher in some comparisons. These results show how joint feature- and sample-space reduction can scale dynamic-programming-based optimal-tree learning to more demanding instances.

</details>


### [639] [Selective Posterior Margin Regularization for Forward-Corrected Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05859)
*Zexing Zhang,Jichao Li,Tianyang Lei,XiongYi Lu,Yang Kewei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性后验间隔正则化（SPMR），用于在Forward校正框架下处理类别条件标签噪声。SPMR保留Forward似然目标，通过反向后验中前两类之间的间隔作为连续系数，对干净分类器施加分离式pairwise margin更新，避免将所有后验冲突都视为硬伪标签。在五个已知转移矩阵基准上，SPMR相比完整Forward提升2.5–7.0 pp，相比Forward+Mixup+早停提升0.7–2.5 pp，并通过匹配实验验证了证据-目标-动作三个角色的独立贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Forward校正在有限样本下仍会记忆噪声标签。当反向后验的首选干净类与观测标注不一致时，虽提供替代解释但领先的备选类可能几乎并列。若将后验赢家直接作为硬标签，会引入确认偏差。需要一种方法将这种不一致转化为对干净分类器的分级（graded）更新，对模糊冲突施加小影响，对清晰分离的替代类施加更强更新。

Method: SPMR是一个两分支扩展：(1) 似然分支保留Forward损失ℓ_F；(2) 辅助分支基于反向后验q，当领先类ŷ≠观测k时，以顶部两类间隔s=q_ŷ−q_r作为连续系数，并对干净logit施加detached pairwise hinge h=[m−z_ŷ+max_{c≠ŷ}z_c]_+。间隔s可分解为s=μ·tanh(Δ/2)，其中μ=前两类的后验质量和，Δ=(z_ŷ−z_r)+log(T_ŷk/T_rk)为转移调整后的成对得分。活跃hinge的下降方向是局部最小ℓ₂范数方向γ/2(e_ŷ−e_c*)。完整目标：ℒ=mean(ℓ_F)+λ·r(t)·mean[sg(g·s)·h]。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100的对称和语义非对称噪声下（已知转移），SPMR相比Forward提升2.50–7.00 pp，相比Forward+Mixup-ES提升0.70–2.51 pp（5个种子配对）。转移矩阵估计场景下，Anchor提升5.20 pp，DualT提升1.78–4.85 pp；人类标注C10N Worst和C100N Fine分别提升1.43和1.42 pp；WRN-28-2无重训下提升6.31 pp。匹配消融：后验间隔证据贡献1.34 pp、配对方向贡献1.22 pp、转移调整目标贡献1.33 pp；目标正确性AUROC从0.769升至0.842，干净梯度对齐从0.329升至0.486。训练开销仅增加6.4%。

Conclusion: SPMR将后验冲突分解为证据（间隔系数）、目标（领先后验类）和动作（pairwise margin）三个独立角色，通过匹配干预验证了各自的贡献。在对称噪声下，转移矩阵主要提供解析的依赖噪声率的冲突阈值；在非对称噪声下还可改变备选目标。方法作为Forward校正的有限样本正则化器，附带局部稳定性和扰动界的分析，能与Mixup等增强方案互补。

Abstract: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. The gap factorizes into transition- adjusted pairwise separation and the posterior mass carried by the leading pair. The active margin follows the locally minimum-norm logit direction that enlarges the selected pairwise margin. Across five known-transition benchmarks, SPMR improves full-length Forward by 2.5-7.0 percentage points and remains 0.7-2.5 percentage points above Forward with Mixup and early stopping. Matched interventions support distinct gains from the posterior-space coefficient, transition-adjusted target, and pairwise action. The same design transfers to estimated transitions, human annotations, architectural changes, and stronger Forward recipes. The formulation uses latent-class evidence already available inside Forward correction without promoting every posterior conflict to a corrected label.

</details>


### [640] [Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05860)
*Peiyao Chen,Zhouyuan Xu,Jianguo Nie,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出拓扑泛化是神经PDE算子学习中一个独立于几何泛化的新维度，通过Hodge热流作为受控分析工具，构建TopoBox-3D基准测试，发现显式拓扑先验（如谐波基）不仅有助于识别核空间，还能有效组织对衰减谱分量的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子虽常声称支持"任意几何"，但这仅代表输入兼容性而非统计泛化能力。未见的域拓扑变化会同时改变PDE算子的不变子空间（谐波核）和衰减子空间（正谱部分），而Betti数变化是同伦障碍，无法通过微分同胚处理。该研究旨在将拓扑泛化从几何泛化中分离出来，系统研究其作为独立泛化轴的机制。

Method: 1) 提出同伦分层框架：将域按Betti向量β(Ω)分类，区分固定拓扑几何偏移（β相同）与拓扑-OOD（β不同）。2) 构建TopoBox-3D基准：三维盒子减去可独立控制的隧道和空腔，通过四元组边界矩阵验证拓扑属性；求解k=0,1,2形式的Hodge热方程（100步Crank-Nicolson，固定T=0.1），四类能量混合配置。3) 设计四个泛化协议（A:固定拓扑几何偏移；B:隧道-OOD；C:空腔-OOD；D:混合拓扑-OOD），共5280个域、63360个PDE实例。4) 评估MGN、RIGNO、Transolver、GNOT、GAOT、TNO六个架构（~1.2M参数），采用三种子、300周期训练。5) 定义匹配惩罚比Q=R_p/R_A（消除模型特异性校准差异）以及受控探针（I_H核恒等误差、L_H→⊥/L_⊥→H子空间泄漏、E_⊥^mix非谐波混合误差）。6) 分析七个几何/拓扑/谱描述符（特别是初始Rayleigh商ℛ(w₀)和Jensen谱展宽J_T）。

Result: 1) 拓扑-OOD退化普遍存在：5个隐式拓扑模型在45个模型-任务拓扑-OOD单元中有37个（82.2%）Q>1，几何均值1.110。2) 谐波维数变化未放大惩罚：20个谐波变化单元的均值惩罚1.083，略低于整体均值。3) 初始Rayleigh商ℛ(w₀)是最稳定的误差预测因子（72个单元中43个R²最高，Spearman中位数0.784）。4) 谱展宽J_T对k=0几乎无增量信息，但对k=2增量R²达0.086。5) TNO具有独特能力不对称性：I_H=0.349（不如MGN/RIGNO/GNOT），但E_⊥^mix=0.256，在所有六个有非平凡谐波支持的任务中排名第一。6) TNO的混合输入非谐波误差优势超越其谐波恒等能力，表明显式拓扑信息的作用超越直接核重建。7) 显式关联和谐波坐标不会产生最佳核恒等精度，但能组织对更快衰减互补分量的学习。

Conclusion: 拓扑泛化是与几何泛化不同的独立问题轴。Betti支持变化不仅改变全局连通性，还改变边界、离散化和频谱。主导误差信号来自衰减谱内容（而非不变谐波子空间），而具备全局谐波信息的模型在此类内容上表现最强，即使其谐波恒等能力并非最优。这表明低频结构先验可提供上下文以学习高频/快速衰减场分量，超越了直接表达该先验的模式。该研究支持因子化设计目标：核分支约束为恒等（保留几何驱动处理器的低I_H），互补谱分支利用显式关联和谐波坐标追求低E_⊥^mix，通过投影路由控制泄漏。局限：Hodge热是线性、自治、固定时间问题；绝对边界条件不常见；Box-minus-void域限制；架构差异非单因素消融；三种子不足以支持精细区分。

Abstract: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. Most strikingly, controlled probes show that explicit incidence and harmonic coordinates do not yield the best kernel-identity accuracy; nevertheless, TNO ranks first in mixed-input nonharmonic accuracy on all six tasks with nontrivial harmonic support. Together, these results establish topology as a distinct generalization axis beyond arbitrary-geometry compatibility and show that its influence extends across the Hodge spectrum rather than remaining confined to the harmonic kernel. More broadly, they suggest that global, low-frequency structural priors may help organize predictions in the faster-decaying complementary component, offering a new perspective on how neural operators may generalize across topology as well as geometry.

</details>


### [641] [Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05862)
*Zihe Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Scout框架，针对部分观测的动态图，在有限查询预算下学习"哪些过时节点值得刷新"以提升下游任务性能。通过将采集价值定义为下游任务效用而非结构变化，Scout在21个基准-预算设置中的19个上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图的底层变化常因观测和计算成本而无法被模型完整获知；现有研究将预算观测、缺失信息推断、主动采集和数据刷新调度分开处理，缺乏一个统一的框架来同时考虑图动态、部分观测、采集成本和下游任务效用。因此需要解决一个核心问题：在过时图视图和历史查询结果的条件下，如何学习在有限预算下哪些过时节点最值得查询，其价值取决于查询揭示的变化如何影响下游任务。

Method: Scout是一个轻量级任务感知采集框架，包含五个阶段：(1) 维护特征构建——为每个已知节点构造19维特征向量，涵盖节点陈旧度、查询频率、维护度数等；(2) 维护图编码器——使用输入MLP加两层带跳跃连接的图卷积层，学习图感知节点表示；(3) 任务效用学习——通过单例反事实观测构造下游任务效用目标，结合MSE回归损失和KL散度排序损失进行训练；(4) 预算查询选择——基于采集分数加上陈旧度对数探索奖励，选择Top-b个节点；(5) 查询执行与图更新——将观测结果合并到维护图中并传递到下一步。核心创新在于将采集监督信号从结构变化替换为下游任务效用。

Result: 在1个合成数据集(drift_sbm)和4个真实动态网络(AS-733、Reddit、email-Eu-core-temporal、MathOverflow)上，跨2个下游任务(节点分类、链接预测)、9个采集基线和多档预算进行评测。Scout在21个基准-预算设置中的19个取得最高平均下游性能。例如在drift_sbm上10%预算达到0.882准确率(最强基线0.871)，AS-733上AUC从1%预算的0.802提升到10%的0.844(最强基线0.839)。消融实验显示任务效用监督在16个真实设置中的13个优于结构变化监督；评分器容量消融显示增益并非来自模型容量增大。任务依赖性实验中，在AS-733上任务匹配的采集使链接预测AUC提升0.012-0.016，节点分类准确率提升0.064-0.090。

Conclusion: 本文形式化了部分观测动态网络上的预算任务感知采集问题，并提出了轻量级解决方案Scout。实验证明下游任务效用比结构图变化提供更有效的采集信号，有限预算可以通过学习下游效用更有效地分配。这为动态图上资源受限学习提供了通用方向。未来工作可扩展至异构采集成本、集合级效用学习和跨任务迁移。

Abstract: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation history. Our evaluation covers one synthetic and four real-world dynamic networks, two downstream tasks, nine acquisition baselines, and several query budgets. Scout achieves the highest mean downstream performance in 19 of the 21 benchmark-budget settings. Task-utility supervision also outperforms structural-change supervision in 13 of the 16 real-world settings. On the same dynamic network, task-matched acquisition improves link-prediction AUC by 0.012-0.016 and node-classification accuracy by 0.064-0.09 over task-mismatched acquisition. These results show that useful graph observations depend on the downstream task and that limited observation budgets can be allocated more effectively by learning directly from downstream utility.

</details>


### [642] [A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05877)
*Jia Bi,Alin-Marin Elena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对机器学习原子间势（MLIP）训练集的紧凑选择问题，研究了在压缩已标注数据集时，是应优先保留结构多样性的覆盖选择（coverage），还是聚焦于模型预测分歧区域的响应选择（response），并发现保留数据量（budget）是决定哪种策略更优的关键变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原子模拟数据集（如GAP-20 Carbon、rMD17、OC20等）规模日益庞大，MLIP的精度依赖于训练集的配置构成。在压缩已标注数据集时，存在两种主要策略：基于表示空间结构多样性的覆盖选择（如FPS、DPP），以及基于模型预测误差或分歧的响应选择（response-guided）。然而，在某一固定保留比例下比较是不够的，因为不同数据量下两种策略的相对优势可能不同。本文旨在系统探究保留数据量对两种选择策略相对性能的影响。

Method: 作者在GAP-20 Carbon和pooled rMD17数据集上构建了固定的分析面板（每数据集1000训练+200验证+200测试结构），采用MACE架构在1%、5%和20%三个保留比例下，分别使用随机采样、FPS/DPP覆盖选择和响应见证选择（基于覆盖训练模型与全数据参考模型之间的力分歧）选出子集进行重新训练。通过配对训练种子（5个）评估与全数据参考模型的偏差（绝对间隙）和直接DFT力误差。四个力误差终点包括：均值力误差、验证选定层、高力尾端和高新颖性掩膜。还进行了补充分析：学习相似性度量、冻结MACE-MP-0误差选择、HEA25描述符回归。

Result: 1. 在5%预算下，FPS/DPP覆盖选择在两个数据集四个终点上的全数据偏差均小于随机采样（差值+0.20到+0.93个百分点）。2. 覆盖与响应见证的相对排序随预算反转：在1%和5%时，覆盖更优；但在20%时，响应见证在所有八个数据集-终点对的绝对间隙上更优（差值-0.46到-4.78 pp），所有配对种子区间均低于零。3. 在20%时，响应见证选择的模型在所有八个比较中均降低了直接力误差（0.46%-5.89%相对降低），六个端点低于全数据参考。4. 5%响应选择存在端点权衡：能改善某一项但恶化其他项。5. 冻结模型误差与嵌入新颖性高度相关（Spearman 0.86-0.91），去除新颖性后误差选择仍劣于嵌入覆盖。6. 学习相似性保留覆盖排序（Spearman 0.98-0.99）。

Conclusion: 保留数据量是MLIP训练集选择策略相对性能的决定性变量。覆盖选择在低预算下更优，而基于响应的选择在较高预算（20%）下反超，并能产生比全数据训练更低的力误差（在六个终点上）。选择准则与训练集大小应作为一个耦合决策来确定，而选择分数与训练后模型预测之间的联系才是数据价值的最终判据。这一发现将MLIP训练集选择与数据剪枝中观察到的预算依赖权衡联系起来。

Abstract: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. The witness has larger deviations than coverage at 1\% and 5\%, but the ordering reverses at 20\%. At 20\%, witness-selected models also lower direct held-out force errors by 0.46--5.89\% relative to coverage, with all eight paired training-seed intervals favouring the witness. Six errors fall below the full-data reference. Mean force-error reductions are 0.164--0.167~meV~$\textÅ^{-1}$, with larger gains for tail and masked endpoints. Complementary analyses show that learned similarity preserves the coverage ranking, while selecting by frozen-model error gives higher error than embedding coverage. These findings establish retained-data budget as a deciding variable in atomistic training-set selection and provide a direct test of when response-guided compression improves on structural coverage.

</details>


### [643] [One Rate Is Not Enough: Adaptive Anisotropic Learning Rates for LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05885)
*Huiyi Wang,Daijiao Liu,Lina Yao,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出LoRA微调中标准的"统一学习率"惯例忽略了同一适配器内不同秩一分量之间显著的训练异质性。为此，论文提出了自适应各向异性学习率模型AnLR-LoRA，为每个秩一分量分配基于训练时信号（函数空间速度与Adam SNR）在线计算的学习率乘子，在保持全局学习率预算不变的情况下，促进低秩容量被更充分地利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA已成为大语言模型参数高效微调的标准方法，其变体普遍沿用对所有适配器的每个秩一分量施加单一全局学习率的"统一学习率"惯例。然而，作者通过实证分析发现，同一适配器内的r个秩一分量表现出明显不均匀的训练动态（速度各向异性），且这一异质性在训练早期即确立并持续存在；低速模块的最终更新矩阵BA呈现集中的奇异谱，未能充分利用名义秩预算。这一模块内的异质性无法通过调节单一全局学习率解决，凸显了在秩一级别上引入自适应学习率机制的必要性。

Method: 论文提出自适应各向异性学习率模型，为每个秩一分量θ_k=(A_{k,:}, B_{:,k})附加一个时变乘子s_k^(t)，使有效学习率变为η_{t,k}=s_k^(t)·η_t，同时通过模块内均值归一化保持全局LR预算不变。AnLR-LoRA具体利用两个训练时信号：(1)函数空间速度——秩一分量贡献B_{:,k}A_{k,:}的Frobenius范式瞬时变化率，经EMA平滑；(2)Adam SNR——参数空间中偏置校正后一阶与二阶矩估计的信噪比，衡量更新方向可靠性。两信号经模块内归一化后以对数加性融合（log s_k = α·log(1/ν̃_k) + β·log snr̃_k），并通过Proposition 1和Proposition 2证明：在AdamW下，步前梯度缩放会被预处理器抵消而失效，而步后delta缩放等价于直接用s_k^(t)·η_t作为外层学习率。该方法不引入额外可训练参数或额外前向/反向传播。

Result: 在常识推理（Commonsense170K，LLaMA2-7B/3-8B/Qwen2.5-7B）上，AnLR-LoRA在三个骨干网络上均取得最佳平均准确率，相较LoRA最高提升4.3%；在自然语言生成（MT-Bench/GSM8K/HumanEval）上均优于LoRA和LoRA+，HumanEval提升3.66%；在视觉指令微调（LLaVA-1.5-7B，七项基准）上平均得分68.80%，优于LoRA及多个变体。消融实验表明：(a)速度与SNR信号互补，结合时效果最佳；(b)AnLR-LoRA在不同学习率下始终优于LoRA，且对LR选择的鲁棒性显著更强（变化范围仅7.7% vs LoRA的16.5%）；(c)在r∈{4,8,32}不同秩下均稳定提升；(d)可干净地迁移至PiSSA、MiLoRA、LoRA-Dash等其他LoRA变体；(e)有效秩由LoRA的12.7提升，接近全微调的27.2，谱能分布更平坦。超参数α、β、ρ、κ及warmup长度敏感性测试均显示结果稳定。

Conclusion: 论文重新审视了LoRA微调中的统一学习率惯例，揭示了适配器内秩一分量训练动态的显著异质性，并提出在秩一级别上以训练时信号驱动自适应各向异性学习率分配的框架。AnLR-LoRA通过函数空间速度与Adam SNR的融合，以轻量的步后缩放实现，在不增加可训练参数和计算开销的前提下，跨语言和多模态场景一致提升LoRA适应性能，并促进名义秩预算的更充分利用。未来的工作方向包括替代信号选择、更复杂的更新方向不确定性度量以及向多语言、长上下文、更大规模训练场景的扩展。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Most LoRA variants follow a uniform-LR convention, applying a single global learning rate across every rank-one component of every adapter. We show that this convention overlooks substantial within-module heterogeneity, where the rank-one components of a LoRA adapter update at highly uneven rates and low-velocity modules converge to concentrated singular spectra that underutilize the nominal rank budget. To address this, we propose an adaptive anisotropic learning-rate model that assigns each rank-one component its own effective learning rate, computed online from training-time signals and mean-normalized per module to preserve the global LR budget. AnLR-LoRA instantiates this model with two signals available during AdamW optimization, namely function-space velocity and Adam SNR, as a lightweight scheme with no extra trainable parameters. Across commonsense reasoning, natural language generation and visual instruction-tuning benchmarks, AnLR-LoRA consistently improves over LoRA while encouraging broader use of rank capacity, with gains that remain robust across a wide range of global learning rates and transfer cleanly to other LoRA variants.

</details>


### [644] [A First-Order Learning Algorithm for Online Resource Allocation with Constant Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05895)
*Menglong Li,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域在线资源分配问题，提出一种原空间一阶学习策略。该策略在每期仅对当前请求类型相关的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新，无需求解任何线性规划，且不依赖流线性规划的非退化假设。在独立同分布到达、到达概率未知的情况下，该策略实现了相对于后视最优的 O(1) 期望附加遗憾，遗憾界不依赖于时域 T。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有常数遗憾策略要么需要反复求解流线性规划，要么需要非退化假设；本文旨在完全消除 LP 求解步骤，仅用一阶更新实现常数遗憾，且不依赖非退化条件。

Method: 对归一化流问题施加资源过度使用的二次惩罚，得到凹目标函数；策略在每期仅更新当前到达类型对应动作坐标的梯度上升步长，并选择更新后值最大的动作；利用加权 p^{-1} 范数的收缩性质证明距离最优解集的平方期望和有限，结合灵敏度界与集中不等式完成遗憾分析。

Result: 算法 1（固定惩罚参数）和自适应惩罚参数版本均达到 O(1) 期望附加遗憾，遗憾常数仅依赖于动作菜单、资源消耗矩阵、奖励向量和 1/p_min，但与时域 T 无关。分析不要求流 LP 非退化，允许动作平局和最优基变化。

Conclusion: 一阶学习方法可在不求解线性规划、无需非退化假设的条件下实现在线资源分配的常数遗憾，扩展了对未知到达概率和退化情形的处理能力；常数界最坏情况下可能随资源数指数增长，但与时域 T 无关。

Abstract: We study a finite-horizon online resource allocation problem with initial resource capacities proportional to the horizon. In each period, a request type is observed and one action is chosen from a finite menu. Each action earns a reward and consumes a vector of resources. The arrival types are independent and identically distributed, but their probabilities are unknown. We present a primal first-order learning policy that, in each period, performs one gradient ascent update of the action coordinates associated with the current request type. The policy achieves $O(1)$ expected additive regret relative to the hindsight optimum, with a bound independent of the horizon $T$. It does not solve any linear program, and the regret bound does not require a nondegeneracy assumption on the fluid linear program.

</details>


### [645] [A dictionary learning framework for graphs via filters and optimal transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05919)
*Jinchuan Liao,Dai Hai Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出fGOT-GDL，一种基于滤波器与最优传输的图字典学习框架，通过fGOT（滤波器图最优传输距离）进行质心比较以捕捉全局结构，并利用sfGOT（代理fGOT）作为可微重构损失处理无节点对应的图。理论贡献在于从HSIC（希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则）视角对sfGOT进行全新解释，揭示其最小化等价于最大化两图谱嵌入间的统计依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）距离的图字典学习方法依赖成对节点距离（如最短路径），主要反映局部邻域结构，难以捕捉图的全局拓扑模式。GOT/fGOT系列方法虽能通过图拉普拉斯伪逆的零均值高斯分布表征全局结构，但其代理距离sfGOT的结构含义此前未被充分解释。

Method: 方法包含两大核心组件：(1) HSIC视角的sfGOT解释：将滤波拉普拉斯视为节点上的核矩阵，证明最小化sfGOT等价于在最优置换下最大化两图谱嵌入的统计依赖（HSIC），并给出特征模分解的加权对齐形式；(2) fGOT-GDL框架：使用fGOT作为质心度量（通过Bures-Wasserstein Fréchet均值的不动点迭代求解），使用sfGOT作为重构损失（通过Sinkhorn-Knopp算法松弛置换矩阵为模糊分配求解），配合softplus+对称化重参数化保证原子图为非负对称零对角矩阵，端到端反向传播优化。

Result: 在合成SBM实验中，低通滤波器显著优于高通滤波器（ARI 0.140 vs 0.007）以及GW基线（GWF-PPA和BW-GW），证明全局拓扑敏感性优势。在AIDS、PROTEIN、PROTEIN-F、IMDB-BINARY四个真实基准上，多滤波器多种子（MFMS）变体取得最优聚类准确率（99.50%、71.84%、71.73%、64.00%）和有竞争力的分类准确率（74.31%、64.60%），整体优于基于GW的字典学习方法。

Conclusion: fGOT-GDL成功将滤波器与最优传输结合用于图字典学习，通过fGOT/sfGOT有效捕获全局图结构；sfGOT的HSIC解释提供了新的理论洞察，揭示其与谱嵌入统计依赖最大化的等价性；实验验证了该框架在图聚类与分类任务上与现有GDL方法相比具有竞争力，并证明多带宽滤波器能捕获互补的谱信息。

Abstract: We propose a graph dictionary learning (GDL) framework where each graph is represented as a zero-mean Gaussian distribution derived from its filtered Laplacian. Each observed graph is approximated by a barycenter over learned atom graphs, computed under the filter graph distance (fGOT), a graph comparison metric sensitive to global structural properties. The reconstruction error between the observed graph and its barycenter is measured by the surrogate fGOT (sfGOT) distance, a tractable approximation of fGOT that handles graphs without known node correspondence, and is minimized end-to-end via backpropagation. We further provide a novel interpretation of sfGOT through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, showing that minimizing the sfGOT distance between two graphs is equivalent to maximizing statistical dependence between the spectral embedding of their nodes. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance over existing GDL methods on graph clustering and classification tasks.

</details>


### [646] [Rethinking the Evaluation of Efficiency Methods for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05933)
*Jiamu Zhang,Lingxi Zhang,Pengjun Lu,Qiyue Zhang,Yu-Neng Chuang,Zhengchen Li,Shuai Xu,Vipin Chaudhary,Hanjie Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于LLM的多智能体系统(MAS)效率方法的评估问题,指出当前评估存在两大被忽视的威胁:不受控的实验设置差异和非MAS必需的评估场景。作者构建了一个受控且对MAS有要求的诊断基准,在统一的主干模型、智能体注册表和运行时下,对5种代表性MAS剪枝方法(AgentPrune、AgentDropout、AGP、DAGP、GPTSwarm)进行系统评估,涵盖38个测试单元,跨越拓扑、规模、深度和工具使用四个维度。实验表明许多报告的效率增益是设置依赖的,可能源于结构坍塌、工具通路被禁用,或起始系统中随机剪枝已能保持准确率的情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM多智能体系统规模不断扩大,执行成本急剧增加,因此涌现出大量MAS效率优化方法(剪枝智能体、移除通信边、搜索紧凑结构等)。然而现有评估方法存在两大问题:(1)不同方法在各自特定的提示词、起始拓扑和智能体定义下报告增益,无法将增益归因于结构变化本身;(2)许多评估场景并非真正需要MAS,单智能体或随机剪枝已能保持性能。这使得报告的效率增益可能被高估,评估的有效性存疑。

Method: 作者将MAS形式化为四元组(拓扑T、智能体分配A、LLM配置L、局部超参数H),其中拓扑由三个二元掩码表示:空间掩码S、时间掩码D、节点激活掩码Z。提出锚点加单轴变化的诊断基准设计:固定一个参考配置(Star拓扑,n=6,r=2,无工具),其余37个单元仅沿一个轴变化(拓扑/规模/深度/工具)。关键设计包括:(1)共享的智能体注册表(10个类型化条目)和固定的角色到节点分配,消除智能体定义差异;(2)每个任务族固定一个LLM主干;(3)严格的观察控制——每个智能体包裹按拓扑授权的发送者白名单过滤器;(4)同时记录prompt token和edge-passing token两种成本指标;(5)引入匹配随机剪枝控制(相同结构预算下的随机剪枝)作为对比基线;(6)区分prompt token成本和edge-passing token成本,指出二者可能反向变化。评估5种方法×38单元=228次运行,涵盖4个任务族(GSM8K、MMLU-500、HumanEval、LiveCodeBench-150)。

Result: 主要结果: (1)在20个主网格单元上,优化方法相对原始MAS的平均准确率差为-0.77,而匹配随机剪枝仅为-0.44,仅DAGP(+1.29 vs +0.08)显著优于随机控制;AgentPrune和AgentDropout与随机剪枝几乎无区别。 (2)结构指纹分析表明:AGP在74%单元中发生图坍塌(关闭所有原始节点,仅保留附加的finalizer),导致HumanEval上-17.39的准确率暴跌;AgentPrune因附加聚合节点导致prompt token不降反升(+2.83K);GPTSwarm在Chain/GSM8K上切断关键路径,准确率从93.78%崩塌至7.51%。 (3)工具使用场景下,所有方法退化加剧:AGP在Oracle工具下准确率损失-5.75,是不使用工具时(-1.67)的三倍多,因为剪枝恰好移除了负责工具调用的节点。 (4)HotpotQA多跳问答任务(200题)上,无方法显著优于未压缩MAS,AGP再次因坍塌损失-10分。 (5)运行间标准差为0.6-2.1分,与许多报告的小幅增益处于同一量级,大多不具统计显著性。 (6)核心发现:主动节点轮次变化(ΔA)几乎决定了prompt token变化的方向;坍塌率决定了准确率方差。有意义的压缩保留功能性MAS路径,退化的压缩则移除了路径本身。

Conclusion: 当前MAS效率方法的评估存在系统性的有效性问题,许多报告的增益是设置依赖的,反映的可能是非MAS必需场景中随机剪枝即可达到的效果,而非对MAS效率的真正改进。本文提出受控且对MAS有要求的诊断评估协议,将评估焦点从头条数字转向评估有效性以及效率声明成立的条件。建议未来MAS效率研究应在能揭示方法真实价值的场景中进行,并报告完整的结构和成本指纹(而非仅聚合指标)。局限性在于:仅覆盖4B-8B小型开源模型;评估限于从已有MAS出发的压缩方法(未涵盖从零构建MAS的方法);任务族有限,长期规划和交互环境等场景未覆盖。

Abstract: Efficiency is increasingly important for Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS), as larger models and more agents introduce substantial execution costs. Recent methods aim to make MAS cheaper by pruning agents, removing communication edges, or searching for compact structures. However, we argue that existing evaluations may overestimate their true ability to improve MAS efficiency. Reported gains are often measured under method-specific prompts and starting topologies, making them difficult to attribute to the proposed structural changes. Moreover, many reported successes appear in non-MAS-demanding settings, where a single agent or a randomly pruned system can already preserve strong performance. To study these issues, we introduce a controlled and MAS-demanding diagnostic benchmark for representative MAS efficiency methods. We evaluate methods under a shared backbone model, agent registry, and runtime, across controlled variations in topology, scale, depth, and tool use. Our analysis shows that many reported gains are setup-dependent and may arise from structural collapse, disabled tool pathways, or starting systems where random pruning already preserves accuracy, rather than robust improvements in MAS efficiency.

</details>


### [647] [Interpretable and Fair Generalized Additive Neural Networks via Multi-objective Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05946)
*Ziming Wang,Changwu Huang,Ke Tang,Yew-Soon Ong,Xin Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MONBM框架,首次将多目标进化学习引入NN-based GAM,联合优化准确性、可解释性(局部与全局)和公平性,并通过实验揭示了这些维度间复杂的权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NN-based GAM研究多聚焦于提升预测准确性,缺乏对可解释性(尤其是全局可解释性的平滑性和单调性)的显式量化与优化,同时忽视了准确性、可解释性与公平性三者间的联合权衡及其内在机理。

Method: 1) 提出显式的全局可解释性度量指标(平滑性Ms和单调性Mm);2) 提出MONBM框架,将GAM构建建模为多目标学习问题,采用进化多目标优化(EMO,具体为SRA环境选择+权重交叉与高斯扰动繁殖策略)同时优化CE、DP、LI和GI;3) 采用部分重训练策略,仅优化预训练NBM的"feature specific"输出层(约2%参数),使EMO适用于大规模深度模型;4) 给出四种实例化:MONBM-CD、MONBM-CL、MONBM-CG和MONBM-CDLG。

Result: 在六个公平性常用数据集上验证:1) 所提指标有效,能引导NBM生成期望的全局解释;2) 局部可解释性对准确性影响最大(极端LI下ACC平均下降12.59%),全局可解释性影响最小(平均0.85%),公平性居中;3) 公平性、LI与GI三者间关系复杂且依赖数据集,大多数情况下三者改善可相互促进,但Dutch数据集出现公平-可解释性冲突的反例;4) 与FairEMOL等基线相比,MONBM在HV、MS、PD指标上具有更优的收敛性与多样性,且可获得一组具有不同权衡的Pareto最优自解释模型。

Conclusion: MONBM是首个将多目标进化学习应用于GAM的工作,能够同时优化准确性、局部可解释性、全局可解释性与公平性,提供多样化的权衡解集供不同利益相关者选择;揭示了这些可信AI维度间复杂的关系及其机理,为可信模型设计提供了新视角。未来工作将探索自适应选择压力机制、更多自解释模型与公平性指标,以及向图像等结构化数据的概念级扩展。

Abstract: Interpretability and fairness are two of the most emphasized dimensions in trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI). Various explainable AI methods have been introduced to improve interpretability. This paper focuses on neural network (NN)-based generalized additive models (GAMs), a class of self-interpretable models. While most existing research has prioritized improving the accuracy of NN-based GAMs, their interpretability remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, this paper introduces explicit quantitative metrics for evaluating the interpretability of NN-based GAMs, empirically examines their effectiveness, and explores strategies for improving interpretability within these models. In addition, the simultaneous and explicit optimization of both interpretability and fairness, along with their trade-offs and the underlying reasons, remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a multi-objective neural basis model (MONBM) framework based on multi-objective evolutionary learning to consider accuracy, interpretability, and fairness simultaneously. A partial retraining strategy is further developed to facilitate the practical application of evolutionary multi-objective optimization to deep model architectures. Based on MONBM, this paper reveals the complex relationships between these dimensions and the reasons behind these intricate relationships. This analysis demonstrates how multi-objective optimization can be combined with self-interpretable models to reveal relationships among trustworthiness objectives. In addition, MONBM obtains a set of models with different trade-offs between dimensions, and the competitiveness of the approach is validated by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [648] [QGB-W$k$NN: Quantum Granular-Ball Learning for Robust Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05952)
*Suzhen Yuan,Dehang Chen,Lifeng Shen,Shuyin Xia,Jeremiah D.Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于量子粒度球的可靠性感知加权K近邻分类框架QGB-W$k$NN，通过量子核粒度球表示、纯度引导的HNSW图导航和纯度-相似性加权投票三个耦合组件，实现了高效且鲁棒的近邻分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统$k$NN算法存在两大固有缺陷：一是推理时需遍历所有训练样本计算相似度，计算冗余大、效率低；二是均匀投票机制对噪声敏感，在噪声环境下鲁棒性差。现有改进方案（图索引HNSW、粒度球计算、量子增强方法）分别针对某一瓶颈进行优化，但未能在一个系统中同时解决检索效率、非线性特征提取和噪声鲁棒性三个问题。

Method: 1) **量子核粒度球表示**：利用LDA降维、MinMax归一化到$[0,\pi]$、角度编码电路（Pauli-Y旋转门）将经典数据映射为量子态，通过量子核估计电路计算保真度相似度$\text{sim}_q(x,x')=|\langle\psi(x)|\psi(x')\rangle|^2$，引入量子比较器筛选满足相似度阈值$T_s$的样本形成粒度球，按纯度阈值$T$决定是否按类别分裂。2) **纯度引导的HNSW图导航**：将传统随机层级分配修正为$L_{\text{adj}}=\max(L_{\text{temp}}-\beta(P-P_{\text{avg}}),0)$，高纯度节点降低层级增强局部连接，低纯度节点（类边界区域）增加层级实现跨区域跳转，缓解局部最优。3) **纯度感知加权投票**：权重$w_i = P_i \cdot \text{sim}_i^{(\text{norm})\alpha}$联合考虑粒度球纯度和归一化相似度，$\alpha=2.2$为放大系数，平票时选纯度最高者。构造复杂度$O(N\cdot d)$，搜索复杂度$O(d+\log M)$。

Result: 在8个真实数据集和2个合成数据集上的实验表明，QGB-W$k$NN在高维多分类任务（如20newsgroups准确率0.919、Splice准确率0.898）上取得最优或极具竞争力的结果；在20newsgroups和Ionosphere上实现了精度与计算开销的Pareto最优权衡；在噪声比0.2和0.4下平均准确率分别达0.871和0.859，均优于所有基线（GB$k$NN++、GLVQ、HNSW、$k$NN、QSVC）；消融实验验证了纯度引导HNSW和加权投票两个模块对鲁棒性的互补贡献。需注意：量子操作采用PennyLane经典模拟，报告的运行时间不含真实量子加速。

Conclusion: QGB-W$k$NN将可靠性建模贯穿表示（图构建）、检索（图导航）和决策（加权投票）全过程，验证了可靠性感知量子粒度球学习可作为高效鲁棒近邻分类的有前途范式。局限在于当前实验基于经典模拟，无法反映真实量子硬件上的运行性能，未来工作将在实际量子设备上验证。

Abstract: Nearest-neighbor classification is widely used in machine learning, yet existing methods often suffer from low computational efficiency and limited robustness in noisy environments. To jointly address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient and reliable weighted $K$-nearest neighbor classification framework based on quantum granular balls, termed QGB-W$k$NN. The proposed framework improves computational efficiency by integrating quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation with hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, while enhancing classification reliability through a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism. Specifically, quantum-kernel granular balls are constructed to reduce retrieval redundancy and strengthen nonlinear feature representation under limited quantum resources. A granular-ball purity-guided HNSW optimization strategy is developed to exploit structural reliability for hierarchical graph construction during neighbor retrieval, alleviating the local optimality issue caused by conventional random layering. Finally, a weighted voting mechanism jointly incorporating granular-ball similarity and purity is introduced to produce more reliable classification decisions in noisy environments. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that QGB-W$k$NN achieves competitive classification accuracy while exhibiting favorable Pareto trade-offs between classification performance and computational cost. Moreover, the proposed framework consistently improves robustness under various noisy conditions, suggesting that reliability-aware quantum granular-ball learning provides a promising paradigm for efficient and robust nearest-neighbor classification.

</details>


### [649] [LoGIC: Budgeted Context Construction for Node-Level Graph In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05955)
*Mingqi Yang,Zidong Guo,Jihui Yang,Wenming Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了LoGIC框架，针对基于表格基础模型（如TabPFN、GraphPFN）的节点级图上下文学习（ICL），将上下文构建形式化为带预算的资源分配问题：标签上下文预算（k）和无标签"光环"节点预算（h）。通过图局部查询聚类、三种检索通道（结构PPR、特征kNN、覆盖采样）和无标签光环实现有界提示，在不修改冻结骨干的前提下显著降低显存并保持全上下文性能，支持百万节点级图的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有G2T-FM和GraphPFN等基于表格基础模型的图ICL方法在推理时使用整个训练表作为上下文，导致注意力计算随标签池规模二次方增长，显存和预处理成为瓶颈；该论文旨在研究在给定预算下，应选择哪些标签节点和无标签节点构成提示。

Method: LoGIC方法包含：(1) 基于RCM排序的图局部查询聚类，多个查询共享同一检索上下文；(2) 三种检索通道——个性化PageRank（结构局部性）、特征kNN（属性相似性）、覆盖采样（全局代表性）；(3) 无标签"光环"——从Q∪S的1-hop闭包中采样标签屏蔽节点，用于适配器骨干的消息传递；(4) 基于边标签同配性和验证集得分无监督选择通道与预算；(5) 兼容纯表格和图适配器两类骨干。

Result: 在GraphLand八个数据集上、两种模型家族的三种骨干配置下，LoGIC以k=4096的受限上下文在多个数据集上匹配或超过全上下文/全图推理精度（如LimiX在artnet-exp上AP从48.42升至48.87，GraphPFN在artnet-exp上AP超过全图0.27）。显存显著降低：GraphPFN在artnet-exp从19.59 GB降至8.24 GB，city-roads-M从7.71 GB降至5.73 GB；推理时间在artnet-exp从117.78秒降至65.68秒。在163万节点pokec-regions图上实现4.2 GB显存推理，随机上下文仅8.6%而LoGIC达36.3%准确率。通道消融表明无单一通道最优，PPR在同配性正的数据集表现佳，覆盖采样在负同配性（如twitch-views）更优，特征kNN在属性强（如avazu-ctr）时占优。

Conclusion: 论文将上下文构建确立为基于表格基础模型的图ICL中独立于骨干设计与训练的关键推理层，提出双资源（标签预算+光环预算）分配框架，并通过LoGIC证明有界检索可在不重训前提下维持竞争力并打破全图驻存瓶颈；通道选择应依据图的同配性等结构属性自适应；未来方向包括学习式检索信号混合、归纳/流式图、链接与图级任务以及与适配器深度匹配的多跳光环。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models have become powerful graph learners. Systems such as G2T-FM and GraphPFN encode each node as a feature row and make predictions through in-context learning (ICL), with labeled rows serving as the prompt. Current protocols employ the complete training table as context, causing attention to scale quadratically with the labeled pool and introducing preprocessing and memory bottlenecks. We investigate context construction for node-level graph ICL: which labeled nodes and auxiliary unlabeled nodes should constitute the prompt for specified queries. We formulate this allocation in terms of two resources: a labeled-context budget for predictive evidence and an unlabeled-halo budget for adapter message passing without using label capacity. We present LoGIC, which retrieves labeled nodes via structural, feature-based, and coverage channels, shares each context across the queries in a graph-local cluster, incorporates an unlabeled halo for adapter backbones, and chooses the channel and context budget without test labels. Across three backbone configurations drawn from two model families on GraphLand, budgeted contexts maintain locally runnable full-context performance, stay competitive with published large-dataset results, and markedly lower peak memory requirements compared with full-context and whole-graph inference. They further permit frozen graph ICL on million-node graphs without retraining. Our analysis identifies when retrieval channels work best and connects their behavior with graph properties.

</details>


### [650] [On-the-go Forgetting without Explicit Unlearning via ERASE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05966)
*Kushal Chakrabarti,Mayank Baranwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ERASE提出了一种推理时遗忘框架，通过输入空间的类条件扰动抑制私有数据的影响，无需修改模型权重即可在子类级别实现功能性遗忘，同时在多模态基准上取得遗忘效果与保留性能的最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法依赖事后权重调整或蒸馏，存在重复内存开销、泛化性能下降和可扩展性受限的问题。本文旨在探索无需修改模型参数即可实现即时、行为级遗忘的替代方案。

Method: ERASE采用两阶段设计：离线阶段利用FGSM风格的输入梯度符号计算并存储每个子类的语义指纹；在线阶段通过条件门控机制，对预测为目标超类的输入应用"遗忘方向-保留方向"的线性组合扰动，仅优化两个标量缩放因子(εf, εr)，不更新模型参数。理论上基于方向平滑性、投影有界性和经验对齐三个假设，推导出同时保证遗忘与保留的充分条件。

Result: 在CIFAR-100(ResNet18/ViT)、Tiny ImageNet、ESZ和HAR四个多模态基准上，ERASE在遗忘效果与保留保真度之间取得最佳平衡，例如Tiny ImageNet上retain-overall准确率达82.76%（接近原始模型的83.47%），而DELETE仅为34.03%；MIA抗性(AUC-ROC 0.37-0.50)与权重调整方法相当；消融实验确认保留方向δretain对维持兄弟子类性能的关键作用。

Conclusion: ERASE将数据移除重新定义为"无需遗忘的遗忘"，为判别式模型提供了一种可扩展、符合法规要求的推理时遗忘路径；但其保证仅针对功能性遗忘而非结构性遗忘，在白盒、重建或自适应攻击下可能暴露遗忘信息，且门控依赖超类预测可能引发误分类样本遗忘失败的问题。

Abstract: Existing unlearning approaches typically rely on post hoc weight adaptation or distillation, leading to duplicated memory costs, degraded generalization, and limited scalability. In this work, we introduce ERASE, Erasure via Reconstructive Adversarial Signal Editing, a framework for on-the-go forgetting that suppresses the observable influence of private data without modifying model weights. ERASE leverages structured, class-conditioned input perturbations to induce selective forgetting during inference, eliminating the need for retraining, fine-tuning, or model copies. We rigorously characterize sufficient conditions when ERASE provably achieves functional forgetting of designated subclasses while preserving predictions across other subclasses within the same superclass. This analysis offers a principled foundation for inference-time forgetting under mild regularity assumptions. Across diverse architectures and benchmark datasets, ERASE maintains the best observed balance between forgetting efficacy, computational efficiency, and retention fidelity over recent unlearning-based methods. By reimagining data removal as forgetting without unlearning, our work establishes a scalable, regulation-aligned pathway for continual, privacy-conscious learning.

</details>


### [651] [Machine Learning for Pre-Culture ESBL Risk Stratification to Guide Empiric Antibiotic Selection: A 12-Hospital Study of Enterobacteriaceae Cultures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05970)
*Aravind V. Kuruvikkattil,Lalitha Pranathi Pulavarthy,Rashmita Kudamala,Saptarshi Purkayastha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发并验证了一个基于XGBoost的成本敏感机器学习模型，利用培养前可获取的45个EHR特征，在12家医院的132,955份肠杆菌科培养中预测ESBL表型（对头孢曲松、头孢他啶、头孢吡肟或哌拉西林-他唑巴坦耐药）。患者级分区的调优模型AUROC达0.763，在90%灵敏度阈值下NPV为95.8%，可将培养后ESBL概率降至4.2%，支持非ICU环境下安全避免经验性碳青霉烯使用。SHAP分析显示既往ESBL定植是最强预测因子；区域剥夺指数（ADI）排名第三但单独判别力极低（AUROC 0.496），移除后仅损失0.020 AUROC，支持部署42特征无ADI模型以保证公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ESBL耐药威胁日益严重，经验性抗生素必须在培养结果出来前48-72小时开具，临床医生面临治疗不足与碳青霉烯过度使用的两难。本研究旨在构建一个可于培养下单时使用的预测模型，以NPV支持安全的碳青霉烯节约策略，同时量化社会经济学因素（ADI）与临床史的相对贡献。

Method: 使用Mass General Brigham的ARMD-MGB数据集（2015-2024年，12家医院，225,000+患者），筛选132,955份肠杆菌科培养（72,217患者，14.41% ESBL表型阳性）。基于培养下单时刻（t₀）可获取的45个结构化EHR特征（人口学、社会经济学、合并症、90天抗生素暴露、既往耐药菌、护理环境），采用患者级别的80/20分层划分。比较成本敏感学习与SMOTE处理类别不平衡（14.41%阳性），训练逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost三种模型，Optuna贝叶斯优化超参数，Platt缩放重校准。SHAP TreeExplainer解释特征贡献，进行决策曲线分析、生物分层评估及严格IDSA ESBL-E定义下的敏感性分析。

Result: 调优XGBoost在患者分离测试集（26,369培养/14,475患者）AUROC 0.763（95% CI 0.750-0.775），AUPRC 0.435，Brier 0.098（重校准后）。DeLong检验显示XGBoost显著优于逻辑回归（z=13.87）和随机森林（z=12.71）。在90%灵敏度阈值（p≥0.068）下，NPV达95.8%，每千份培养可避免307份不必要的广谱治疗，仅漏检14例ESBL。SHAP显示既往ESBL定植（mean|SHAP|=0.389）为主导预测因子，既往病原体负担（0.197）次之，ADI第三（0.191）。ADI单独判别力极低（AUROC 0.496），移除全部ADI特征仅使AUROC下降0.020，AUPRC下降0.018。生物分层AUROC范围0.710-0.784；严格IDSA定义下AUROC 0.766。成本敏感学习与无校正XGBoost表现相当（0.760 vs. 0.762），说明类别加权并未真正提升判别力。

Conclusion: 该模型是迄今最大规模、关注ESBL表型且采用患者级分区的多医院EHR预测研究，其NPV足以支持非ICU环境下的碳青霉烯节约策略。SHAP揭示既往定植史的主导作用远高于社会经济学因素，ADI的信号主要来自与临床特征的交互效应，移除ADI以避免编码算法偏见仅付出极小性能代价。研究建议部署42特征无ADI模型，并强调假阴性集中于病史记录不足的门诊培养，需进行本地再验证和前瞻性评估。局限包括单一新英格兰医疗体系、ADI非随机缺失（42.6%）、日期随机偏移无法评估时间漂移。

Abstract: Empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae must be selected 48-72 hours before culture results, forcing clinicians to choose between undertreating resistant infections and overusing carbapenems that drive further resistance. We developed a cost-sensitive XGBoost model predicting an ESBL phenotype (resistance to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefepime or piperacillin-tazobactam) at culture ordering using 45 pre-culture EHR features across 132,955 cultures from 72,217 patients at 12 hospitals (14.41% with the ESBL phenotype). Cultures were partitioned at the patient level. At 90% sensitivity, the model achieved 95.8% NPV, reducing post-test ESBL probability to 4.2%, a threshold that may support safe carbapenem-sparing in non-ICU settings, while sparing 307 of every 1,000 cultures an unnecessary broad-spectrum course at the cost of 14 missed ESBL cases per 1,000. SHAP analysis identified prior ESBL colonization as the dominant predictor, ahead of prior organism burden and neighborhood deprivation; removing deprivation features caused minimal performance loss ($\Delta\text{AUROC} = -0.020$), enabling equitable bedside deployment. Discrimination was unchanged under a strict IDSA ESBL-E definition (AUROC 0.766), with specimen type added as a predictor (0.764) and without any class-imbalance correction (0.762), and ranged from 0.71 to 0.78 across organism strata.

</details>


### [652] [Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering for Resource-Efficient and Robust Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06016)
*Suzhen Yuan,Qilin Xie,Lifeng Shen,Shuyin Xia,Jermiah D.Deng,Guoying Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GBQC提出了一种将PCA引导的粒球压缩与量子核学习紧耦合的聚类框架，将量子核评估从O(n²)降至约O(m²)，核评估次数减少约80%，同时通过基于量子特征空间的凝聚度机制过滤噪声粒球，在复杂、非凸和含噪数据上同时实现了更高的聚类精度和更强的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子核聚类需要O(n²)次量子电路执行，在NISQ时代构成严重瓶颈；经典粒球压缩虽能降低样本量但依赖欧氏度量，无法捕获量子关联；而现有量子压缩方法牺牲结构保真度。该研究旨在同时解决效率与精度的矛盾。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) P-GBG采用可扩展k-means++初始化后，以核心样本上的PCA主成分方向作为分裂超平面，递归生成粒球；(2) 将粒球中心通过角度编码映射到量子态，利用Swap Test估计保真度核矩阵；(3) 基于量子特征空间中k近邻平均相似度定义凝聚度，剔除底部10%低凝聚度粒球后，在核心粒球上执行平均连接层次聚类。整体复杂度O(n^{3/2}d + nd²)。

Result: 在16个合成、16个含噪、4个重叠和5个UCI真实数据集上，GBQC平均ACC=0.976、NMI=0.975，显著优于KM、DP、GBSC、GBCT、QM、QKKM、QCKM等基线；粒球数较GBCT减少约54.6%，Swap Test执行次数减少约80%，运行时间控制在10–100秒，而QKKM常超时。消融实验证实P-GBG（ACC 0.976 vs 2-means 0.893）和凝聚度机制（ACC 0.964 vs 0.884）均为关键组件。

Conclusion: 粒球表征不仅是一种压缩手段，更是一种结构抽象机制——通过消除冗余和结构模糊的学习单元，在降低量子资源消耗的同时提升聚类质量，为资源受限的量子机器学习提供了一条可扩展的路径。未来工作将聚焦于真实量子硬件部署、可训练量子特征映射以及粒化与量子表示的理论关系研究。

Abstract: Quantum clustering aims to exploit quantum feature representations to uncover complex data structures beyond conventional Euclidean geometry. Yet this sample-level kernel construction requires O(n^2) quantum circuit executions for n data points, creating a major bottleneck under near-term quantum resource constraints. Prior solutions fail to resolve this efficiency-accuracy dilemma: classical granular-ball clustering reduces sample complexity but relies on Euclidean metrics that cannot capture quantum correlations, while existing quantum compression schemes prioritize efficiency over structural preservation, degrading performance on non-convex or noisy data. Here we propose Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering (GBQC), a framework that tightly couples granular-ball structural abstraction with quantum feature learning. GBQC first compresses raw data into compact, representative granular balls via a PCA-guided splitting strategy, reducing kernel evaluations by 80% compared to full-sample methods. A quantum cohesion mechanism then filters noisy granules in Hilbert space to improve clustering robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, noisy, overlapping, and real-world datasets demonstrate that GBQC consistently achieves superior clustering accuracy and robustness compared with representative classical and quantum clustering methods. Meanwhile, the proposed granular-ball compression significantly reduces quantum kernel evaluations and computational overhead, enabling quantum clustering experiments on larger datasets within parameterized quantum learning frameworks. These results suggest that granular-ball representations serve not only as a compression mechanism to reduce quantum computational costs but also as an effective structural abstraction mechanism that improves clustering quality by eliminating redundant and structurally ambiguous learning units.

</details>


### [653] [IXPLORE: Bounded Ideal Point Estimation with Grid-Based Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06018)
*Fynn Bachmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IXPLORE是一种有界理想点估计算法，结合预测拟合目标与稀疏感知似然函数，在二维有界潜在空间上使用基于网格的后验推断，在五个基准数据集上同时超越基于IRT的模型和基于机器学习的嵌入方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的空间政治模型存在权衡困境：基于模型的方法（如IRT）从效用函数出发而非针对预测准确性优化，而大多数机器学习方法在处理稀疏测试响应时难以泛化。IXPLORE旨在统一两类方法的优势，为稀疏响应场景下的政治地图构建提供兼顾预测性能、可视化可解释性与不确定性量化的框架。

Method: IXPLORE将用户和项目联合嵌入二维有界潜在空间[-L,L]²，潜在空间被离散化为R²个网格点；通过贝叶斯定理在网格上逐点计算后验分布；用户嵌入取后验均值，预测通过逐项logistic回归实现；采用交替迭代优化（用户步更新后验均值，项目步用Newton-Raphson重拟logistic回归）；支持高斯先验或对数障碍先验；可选PCA初始化；可选多项式或随机傅里叶特征（RFF）非线性变换以生成曲线决策边界；支持置信权重及权重缩放。

Result: 在五个真实数据集（Smartvote 2019/2023、Voteview S117、Polis vTaiwan、EVS 2017）上，IXPLORE在四个评估单元（训练重建、训练插补、测试重建、测试插补）中均取得最低或次低MAE。在Smartvote 2023上，二维IXPLORE达到与21维线性PCA相当的训练重建误差，但插补误差在PCA任意维度下均无法匹配。RFF变换将训练重建MAE从0.166降至0.144；先验方差控制边界比例与潜在空间失真之间的权衡而不改变预测质量；PCA初始化可在少于2次迭代内收敛。多项式变换在保持单条平滑决策边界可解释性的同时改善重建误差。

Conclusion: IXPLORE为构建有界、可解释的政治地图提供了新颖框架，弥合了基于模型的IRT算法与基于机器学习的嵌入方法之间的方法论鸿沟。它特别适用于在线应用场景（投票建议应用、自适应问卷、在线协商平台），在这些场景中用户以稀疏响应到达，需要快速推理并能可视化地融入地图。其基于网格的后验推断还提供原生不确定性量化。代码以开源Python包形式发布于GitHub和PyPI。

Abstract: Ideal point estimation is widely used to analyze and visualize political data. However, selecting the corresponding spatial model involves various trade-offs: while model-based approaches such as Item Response Theory (IRT) are based on utility functions rather than optimized for predictive accuracy, most Machine Learning (ML) alternatives struggle to generalize beyond training data when embedding sparse test responses. We introduce IXPLORE, a bounded ideal point estimation algorithm that combines a predictive fit objective with a sparsity-aware likelihood function. On five benchmark datasets spanning surveys, roll calls, and deliberation, this approach surpasses model-based and ML-based algorithms on reconstruction and imputation error - especially for users with sparse responses. Furthermore, we show that non-linear feature transforms can further reduce the reconstruction error while remaining visually interpretable. To quantify uncertainty, IXPLORE applies grid-based posterior inference on a bounded 2D latent space. Available as a Python package on PyPI, IXPLORE offers a flexible framework for constructing bounded, interpretable political maps with fast inference and strong imputation performance.

</details>


### [654] [Minimizing the Effect of Sleep Deprivation in the Forward-Forward Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06042)
*Joy Datta,Puja Saha,Rawhatur Rabbi,Nafiz Imtiaz Rafin,Swakkhar Shatabda,Md. Golam Rabiul Alam,Chad Mourning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对 Forward-Forward (FF) 算法在"睡眠剥夺"（正负通过严重不平衡）条件下学习性能急剧下降的问题，提出了三类缓解策略：使用 Tanhshrink 替代 ReLU 的优化激活函数、引入周期性"短暂休息"的训练调度，以及融合咖啡因效应、稳态可塑性和侧抑制机制的 Caffeine-Induced Loss (CIL) 损失函数。在 MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST 上的实验表明，这些方法在严重睡眠剥夺（正通过 16、负通过 1）条件下可实现 2%–62% 的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FF 算法被认为是一种更符合生物认知机制的反向传播替代方案，但其正负双前向通过的结构可被分离与不平衡使用，类比人类"睡眠剥夺"。已有研究表明负通过减少会导致学习性能灾难性下降（如 MNIST 上准确率从 74% 降至 10%），但既有工作仅观察现象而未给出解决方案。本文旨在分析并缓解 FF 算法中睡眠剥夺的负面影响。

Method: 1) 最佳层间阈值搜索：在 Fashion-MNIST 上测试 6 种三层阈值组合，发现金字塔式阈值（1.0/1.25/1.5）效果最佳（37.47%）。2) 激活函数比较：系统评估 ReLU、ELU、SiLU、Tanh、Tanhshrink、Softplus、Mish 七种激活函数，发现在睡眠剥夺场景下 Tanhshrink 显著优于 ReLU。3) 简单加权损失：在正负损失前分别乘以权重 α=1/awake_period 和 β=1。4) Caffeine-Induced Loss (CIL)：引入咖啡因效应项（动态调制 G_neg/(G_pos+ε)）、稳态可塑性损失 η·(A-r)² 和侧抑制损失 ReLU(G_neg−G_pos+m_g)。5) 短休息机制：在交替 epoch 中调整正负通过比例（如 2:1 与 1:1 交替），模拟昼夜节律。模型为三层 500 神经元网络，Adam 优化器，批量大小 512，训练 100–500 epoch。

Result: 在 Fashion-MNIST 一致睡眠剥夺设置下，Tanhshrink 在 awake=8 时达到 49.83%，远优于 ReLU 的 33.19%。引入短休息后准确率进一步提升至 53.60%。CIL 在严重睡眠剥夺（awake=16, sleep=1）下，于 MNIST 上较基线实现 62% 的精度提升（从 10% 到 72%）；在 awake=64 时增益达 36%（19%→55%）。Fashion-MNIST 上 CIL 较基线稳定提升约 27%–28%。短休息机制在所有 α、β 组合下均带来精度改善，且训练曲线更稳定（波动消失，准确率超过 60%）。综合而言，最佳策略组合为"最优层间阈值 + Tanhshrink + CIL + 短休息"。

Conclusion: 本文证明了通过合理选择激活函数、引入结构化休息周期和生物启发的损失函数，可以有效缓解 FF 算法在睡眠剥夺下的学习性能退化。Tanhshrink 激活、CIL 损失和短休息调度分别从不同角度增强了算法鲁棒性，使其更贴近人类认知的适应性机制。该研究为在持续/在线学习等难以实时生成负数据的场景下部署 FF 算法提供了可行路径，也为开发更具生物合理性的人工学习系统提供了参考。

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge posed by sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm, where separating the two passes in this algorithm and imbalancing the data processing in the passes is considered an imitation of the cognitive processes observed in humans suffering from sleep deprivation. Previous research has demonstrated that sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm has a catastrophic effect on learning efficacy. To mitigate this issue, we explore several approaches; these include alternative activation, optimized loss function, and threshold tuning. To simulate periodic rest, we reduce the number of positive passes in alternating epochs, creating short break phases. We additionally investigate the potential of caffeine-induced stimulation to enhance performance during sleep-deprived conditions. Experimental evaluations conducted on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets demonstrate that these modifications improve accuracy under the context of sleep deprivation. For example, a 2%-62% accuracy gain is observed in a severe sleep deprivation setting (16 positive or awake periods and 1 negative or sleep period). The approaches also enhance the resilience of the algorithm and its alignment with the adaptive mechanisms of human cognition.

</details>


### [655] [Data Quality Rule Generation with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06053)
*Anna-Christina Glock,Thomas Hütter,Johannes Fürnkranz,Wolfram Wöß,Christine Dominka-Kiss,Lisa Ehrlinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 LeDQeR，一种面向企业数据质量（DQ）工具的 LLM 规则自动生成框架。它将已漏检的脏数据元组转化为候选规则，并通过语法、正确性、覆盖率和冗余性四层过滤，使最终规则集能够扩展现有规则库。五数据集实验表明：在提供规则名称及参数信息时，生成规则的可执行率为 87.13%–100%；错误类型与位置信息使 F1 平均提高 0.33；仅提供脏元组时平均 F1 为 0.66，覆盖阶段平均召回率约 0.88；去冗余后规则集仅保留 2–136 条规则。在无假阳性的设置下，五分之四数据集可覆盖至少 50% 的未见脏元组。该方法适合持续维护企业 DQ 规则，但仍受语义错误、阈值选择、候选质量和数据隐私等问题制约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业数据质量工具依赖专家手工维护规则，但复杂领域和大规模数据使规则容易遗漏。LLM 虽适合从少量错误实例生成语义规则，却可能产生不可执行、误报、过拟合或重复的规则；同时，直接将敏感数据交给 LLM 还可能带来成本、隐私和企业系统集成问题。因此，作者将 LLM 用于候选规则生成，并以可部署的规则型 DQ 工具和渐进式过滤作为安全、可解释的落地方案。

Method: 作者首先形式化数据质量规则生成的“生成—过滤”框架。生成阶段以脏数据元组、目标 DQ 工具语法、规则名称、参数说明和可选数据集语义描述构建提示词，调用本地 LLM 生成多条候选规则；比较了 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3-Coder 和 Gemma-4，以及仅脏数据、带错误类型、带干净数据三种输入条件。过滤阶段依次采用：①语法过滤，通过在 Great Expectations 1.9.1 中执行规则来检查可执行性；②正确性过滤，删除不能检测触发错误、会产生假阳性的规则，并以 F1 评估；③覆盖率过滤，将规则应用于训练集中相同错误类型的其他变体，以召回率评估泛化性；④冗余过滤，在独立测试集上使用贪心集合覆盖算法优先选择高精度规则，删除重复或重叠规则。实验覆盖 Beers、Flights、Hospital、Tax 和个人联系信息 PCI 五个数据集、9 类错误，并通过语法执行率、F1、召回率、精确率、覆盖率及最终规则数进行评价。

Result: 提供规则名称与参数信息时，候选规则可执行率为 87.13%–100%，平均可执行率分别为 GLM-4.7-Flash 61%、Qwen3-Coder 91%、Gemma-4 93%。错误类型和位置信息相比仅提供脏数据使 F1 平均提高 0.33；仅脏数据条件下总体平均 F1 为 0.66，其中嵌入值错误为 0.87，矛盾错误仅 0.40。覆盖率过滤阶段的平均召回率约为 0.88；复杂或变体较多的错误类型较弱，领域违反和矛盾等类型的召回率明显低于简单格式或模式错误。冗余过滤将规则压缩到 2–136 条，并产生可控的精确率—覆盖率权衡：要求精确率为 1 时，五分之四测试集可检测至少 50% 的脏元组；在 Tax 数据上，容忍 6 个假阳性（0.007%）即可使脏值覆盖率接近 99.58%。结果显示，提供错误类型与位置通常比直接提供干净数据更具成本和隐私优势。

Conclusion: LeDQeR 证明，利用 LLM 从实际漏检的脏元组增量生成企业 DQ 规则是可行且有效的；其核心价值并非信任 LLM 的原始输出，而是通过多阶段过滤把高召回的候选生成与可执行、正确、低冗余的生产规则结合起来。模型在简单结构化错误上表现良好，但复杂跨字段语义约束仍是主要瓶颈。未来可研究自动识别错误类型、自动生成自然语言规则说明、减少对脏数据清洗和人工筛选的依赖，并在更多企业 DQ 工具与真实数据上验证。

Abstract: The validation of data, such as customer and employee data, is an important task in many organizations. Errors in data can have severe consequences. For example, a wrong drug unit in a patient record can lead to life-threatening medication errors, and a missing street number in an address to failed deliveries. Companies often employ rule-based enterprise data quality (DQ) tools, which allow domain experts to specify rules to validate the data over time. While rule-based DQ tools are computationally efficient and provide explainable reports, maintaining a comprehensive rule set manually is challenging, as domain experts often overlook essential rules, especially in complex domains and large data volumes. Hence, closing these gaps remains an open problem in practice. In this paper, we address the challenge of automated DQ rule generation. For this, we formalize a generalizable generate-filter framework and introduce LeDQeR, an LLM-based DQ rule generation approach. First, a large language model (LLM) generates candidates rules from an observed dirty data tuple for a given rule-based DQ tool syntax. Second, we apply four filter techniques that ensure the (i) executability, (ii) correctness, and (iii) generalizability, and avoid (iv) redundancy of the generated rules. An extensive experimental evaluation suggests that LeDQeR is able to produce effective and compact rule sets for various datasets and error types.

</details>


### [656] [Beyond Retraining-Free MoE Compression: A Cost-Normalized Study of Post-Compression Adjustment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06076)
*Sieun Hyeon,Jaeyoung Do*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张"免重训式 MoE 压缩"不应被视为产出最终模型，而应被视为一种"压缩后的初始化"，并通过一个极小规模的"压缩后调整(post-compression adjustment, PCA)"阶段即可显著恢复性能。作者在两个 MoE LLM 骨干、4 种剪枝/合并方法、3 种专家保留率与 28 个基准测试上系统对比了因果语言建模微调(LM-FT)与基于教师的知识蒸馏(KD)在匹配小数据预算与实测 GPU 成本下的恢复效果。结果表明：仅用 3,000 条 C4 样本、单个 epoch 的全参数微调(Full FT)即可平均恢复原始-压缩性能缺口的 37.3%；在相同可训练参数范围内，LM-FT 比标准 token 级 KD 性价比更高，全参数调整在所测范围内给出最强的成本-恢复权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的免重训式 MoE 压缩(专家剪枝/合并)虽然降低了部署内存，但常将压缩后的 checkpoint 直接当作最终产物。然而这类压缩会引入路由偏移、专家函数失真以及路由器-专家交互误差等残留误差，仅靠压缩过程本身无法完全消除。若已允许使用极少量数据与算力，应将其用于"压缩后调整"以恢复性能，而非仅用于压缩本身。论文将 PCA 定义为 MoE 压缩流水线中一个被忽视的一阶设计维度。

Method: 1) 理论分析：基于活跃集合分解，将压缩前后 MoE 层输出的差异分解为"路由误差 e_route^p"和"专家路径/函数误差 e_path^p"(附录 C 为剪枝、附录 D 为合并、附录 F 为编辑)，并通过一阶线性化分析压缩噪声沿残差流的传播以及不同可训练参数范围(路由器、专家、稠密/共享)所对应的 Jacobian 列空间包含关系。2) 实验设置：使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 和 gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 两个 MoE LLM，分别采用 REAP/AIMER(剪枝)和 HC-SMoE/M-SMoE(合并)四种压缩方法，专家保留率 50%/62.5%/75%。调整数据为 3,000 条 C4 样本，单 epoch，bs=2×4 累加，lr=5e-5，bf16，2×H200 GPU。对比 13 种调整策略：两种目标(LM-FT 与 token 级 KD) × 多种可训练范围(仅路由器、路由器+top-k 专家(k∈{8,16,50})、路由器+全部专家、全参数)，加上 Direct Router Logit Matching 作为诊断基线。在 28 个下游基准上评估，并实测有效 GPU 小时、显存 GiB-小时与能耗 kWh。3) 鲁棒性：将 C4 预算降至 1,024；并对比 C4 与 OpenR1-Math-220k 两种标定域。

Result: 1) Full FT 平均得分从压缩基线 39.01% 提升至 42.50%，恢复原始-压缩缺口(48.37%→39.01%)的 37.3%；其次为 Router+All-Expert FT(+2.31 pp)与 Full KD(+2.19 pp)。2) 在相同可训练范围下，LM-FT 一致优于 KD；Router-only 调整仅带来 +0.23 pp(FT)与 +0.17 pp(KD)的微弱提升。3) 在成本-恢复权衡图上，Full FT 虽非最便宜，但提供了最佳的恢复/运行比；top-k 策略因额外的专家选择推理开销，性价比反而劣于全参数或全专家调整。4) 收益主要集中在 CoT、MCQA 与通用基准，数学与编程基准仅有边缘变化，提示通用域 LM 调整擅长恢复流畅生成与推理连贯性。5) 1,024 样本预算与 C4↔Math 域切换下结论稳健(Spearman ρ=0.973)；路由器-全专家到全参数的"最后一跃"收益最大，提示误差已传播到稠密/共享模块。6) 行为代理指标(IFEval/TruthfulQA/ToxiGen/WMDP/CrowS/WinoGender)表明 PCA 同时可能恢复有用行为与有害知识，应被视为效率技术而非安全对齐手段。

Conclusion: 免重训式 MoE 压缩不应被视为终点，而应作为一种"压缩后的友好初始化"；只要附加一个用通用域小数据、单个 epoch 的压缩后调整阶段，就能以极低成本回收可观性能。在小预算下，因果 LM 微调优于标准 token 级 KD，而全参数 LM 微调是所测范围内性价比最高的默认策略。论文将"压缩后调整"提升为 MoE 压缩流水线的一阶设计维度，并配套给出活跃集合分解、噪声传播分析、跨 12 个压缩设置与 28 个基准的实测成本-恢复证据。

Abstract: Retraining-free MoE compression reduces deployment memory by pruning or merging experts, but often treats the compressed checkpoint as the final artifact. We argue that this view is incomplete: compressed MoE checkpoints are better understood as compressed initializations that benefit from a tiny post-compression adjustment stage. Across two MoE LLM backbones, four pruning/merging methods, three expert-retention ratios, and 28 benchmarks, we compare LM fine-tuning and teacher-based KD under matched small-data budgets and measured GPU costs. Using only 3,000 C4 examples and a single epoch of adjustment, Full FT recovers 37.3% of the original-to-compressed performance gap on average. Moreover, LM fine-tuning is more cost-effective than standard token-level KD, and full-parameter adjustment gives the strongest cost--recovery trade-off among the tested scopes. These results suggest that retraining-free compression should be paired with small post-compression adjustment to recover a substantial portion of the performance lost during compression.

</details>


### [657] [Learning to Price and Stock Under Contextual and Censored Demand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06083)
*Zean Han,Zezhen Ding,Jiheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文环境下联合定价与库存控制问题，同时考虑需求被截断（缺货损失）的情况。提出基于线性基函数模型的算法，在凹收益条件下达到O(K√T log T)后悔界，一般条件下达到O(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(logT)^{1/2})后悔界，均匹配下界，具有minimax最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联合定价与库存控制方法大多忽略两个关键现实因素：(1) 受上下文信息（如季节、促销活动、顾客特征等）影响的需求变动；(2) 由于缺货损失（lost sales）导致的截断需求观察——真实需求被不可观测地截断。这两个因素使得传统静态策略不再适用，且需求参数无法被直接无偏估计。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 模型设定：单产品T周期决策问题，每期观测上下文x_t，需求D_t = λ(x_t, p_t) + ε_t，其中λ为K个基函数的线性组合。决策为价格p_t和补货目标库存y_t，瞬时补货，仅观测到截断需求o_t = min{D_t, y_t}，期末有线性持有成本h和缺货惩罚b。算法分为两阶段：(1) 探索阶段T_0期内均匀随机定价并设置高库存(log T)以充分观测需求，用最小二乘估计参数θ̂，经验CDF估计噪声分布F̂及最优安全库存ẑ(p)，构建经验收益函数Ĝ(x,p)；(2) 承诺阶段贪心最大化Ĝ选择价格，并以max{I_t, ŷ_t}设置库存。理论分析中，利用强凹性将价格差转化为Ĝ梯度差，并用GI/D/1排队论方法将不可行库存偏差y_t - ŷ_t与等待过程联系起来。一般情形下采用极小极大估计误差控制差分。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 强凹收益下后悔界O(K√T log T)，与下界匹配；(2) 仅需可微性条件下后悔界O(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(logT)^{1/2})；(3) 对m阶可微收益函数证明下界Ω(T^{(m+1)/(2m+1)})，当m=1时给出Θ(T^{2/3})的minimax最优性；(4) 排队论方法（Proposition 4.1, 4.2）有效控制库存偏差引起的额外后悔O(√T)。数值实验覆盖不同h, b和维度K∈{4,...,12}，50次独立运行验证相对后悔随T增加而下降，且随K增大而上升，log-log图呈线性趋势，验证幂律关系。

Conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个上下文感知的联合定价与库存控制框架，首次同时处理截断需求和上下文信息。所提算法简单易实现，在凹和非凹两种情形下均达到minimax最优后悔界。排队论方法优雅地解决了上下文环境下目标库存不可行的问题。未来方向包括超越线性可加模型的需求设定，以及针对截断需求设计UCB式原则性探索策略。

Abstract: To make optimal joint pricing and inventory control decisions is a critical challenge for modern retailers. In practice, retailers face changing market conditions where demands are influenced by various contextual factors, while simultaneously dealing with the difficulty of lost sales that obscure true demand information. However, existing approaches often fail to account for both contextual information and censored demand observations.
